== Song Connections / Remixes == * The melody of テトリス's chorus is based on ''Korobeiniki'', a 19th century Russian folk song based on a poem by Nikolay Nekrasov, which is most widely known for its usage in the ''Tetris'' video game series. ** The beginning and ending of [[AC DMX 2nd|Dance Maniax 2ndMIX]]'s [[Happy-hopper]] are based on Korobeiniki. ** A remix of Korobeiniki by [[Ryutaro Nakahara|Ryu☆]], titled [[KOROBUSHKA (Ryu Remix)|KOROBUSHKA (Ryu☆Remix)]], appears in Ryu☆'s [[AGEHA (album)|AGEHA]] album. ** A more classical take on Korobeiniki, titled [[Korobushka|コロブチカ]], appears in the [[CS jb plus|jubeat plus]] うんどうかい pack. * A parody of テトリス, titled ''テリヤキ'', was uploaded to McDonald's Japanese [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u4-dqYub2uo YouTube account] as a promotional video for their weekday lunchtime set menu ''HiruMac'' (ひるまック). == Trivia == * テトリス is exclusive to Japanese BEMANI cabinets due to licensing issues. * テトリス was added to SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR on January 9th, 2025. * テトリス was added to ポラリスコード on April 1st, 2025. * テトリス was added to pop'n music High☆Cheers!! on December 25th, 2025. * In the pop'n music series, テトリス's artist is credited as '''柊マグネタイト feat.重音テト'''. * In the pop'n music series, instead of displaying its character's portrait, テトリス displays its jacket on the song selection screen. * テトリス's NORMAL chart was re-rated in pop'n music High☆Cheers!! on July 21st, 2026. * テトリス was added to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on September 10th, 2026. ** The ending of テトリス's EXPERT charts feature patterns shaped like [[Wikipedia:Tetromino|tetrominos]]; specifically, I, J, O, S, and T in Single EXPERT, and I, T, O, Z, and J in Double EXPERT. == Song Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A guitar arrangement of Any%, titled [[Any Percent (GITADORA Edition)|Any% (GITADORA Edition)]], appears in [[AC GD GALAXY WAVE DELTA|GITADORA GALAXY WAVE DELTA]]. == Trivia == * Any% is one of the unlocks of the [[BEMANI noryosai 2026|BEMANI納涼祭2026]] event. It could be unlocked in all participant games (besides GITADORA GALAXY WAVE DELTA) from June 18th, 2026 to August 17th, 2026. * Any% marks Mememe's debut in the DanceDanceRevolution, jubeat, pop'n music, and SOUND VOLTEX series. * In the pop'n music series, Any%'s title was incorrectly shown as '''Any%%''' during gameplay. This was fixed on July 21st, 2026. * Any% is a term used in [[:wikipedia:speedrunning|speedrunning]], a style of playing video games in which players try to complete a game as quickly as possible. It refers to a category where there are no additional restrictions or requirements beyond reaching the game's completion. ** The effector credits for Any%'s SOUND VOLTEX charts refer to additional speedrunning terms; "NMG" stands for "no major glitches" and "OOB" stands for "out of bounds." ** Fitting for a song title, Mememe finished working on Any% in just ''three days''. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === Mememe === The song is called “Any%” because that’s literally what I did here.
Usually, it takes me one or two weeks to finish a single rhythm game track, but this time tho I only had approx. 3 days to work on it (and honestly that’s my fault).
…so I had to speedrun the entire process just to get it done somehow. Here’s a quick BTS I want to share.
I’m a staunch believe in “every song should come from some kind of story, concept, or emotion you want to share with people”. But this time, my mind was completely empty, and I couldn’t come up with any idea that truly click with me.
Whenever I get stuck in a rut like this, I usually step away from music and do something else – go outside, play games, watch anime – anything to look for a spark of inspiration.
But this time I didn’t have that luxury.
This is what happens when your hobby and your job become the exact same thing. You gotta make something before the deadline no matter what.
I was in SHAMBLES.
“What if I can’t make it this time?”
“Maybe I’m just a failure after all…”
All those thoughts I usually try to suppress found their way back to the surface, and I eventually burnt up in all the pessimism I’ve carried for years.
The time kept running relentlessly.
I really gotta make somethin… something… SOMETHING-
…aaaand BOOOOOOOOOM
The song was finished. I’m gonna be honest, this isn’t my best work and I know it (not sure if I’m being reprehensive as an artist by saying that).
But at the very least, I learned that under extreme pressure, I’m capable of pushing myself beyond what I ever thought possible.
Maybe that is what Any% ended up being about. === [[Toshiyuki Kakuta|L.E.D.]] === Untranslated. === [[Shunsuke Sato|SYUNN]] === Untranslated. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It can be unlocked from December 4th, 2024. == Music Comment == Run across the earth and dance in the sky! Towards the distance, beyond nostalgia. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== Nekomata Master ==== This chorus melody was called "shiraso sorashi shidore" and it kept spinning in my head round and round, and before I knew it, I created this song. Hmm, I'm sure when I walked around Keyakizaka to relax~.... I immediately returned in a hurry and programmed the data, which I feel was completed relatively quickly. I think that was around one year ago.
As the [[CS 7th style|7th CS version]] sound director kita-g [[suggestion|previously said]], I think it's important "to feel". We interpret feelings using our own sensibilities to create new works. That expression contains empathy and all possibilities for something born from other interpretations. I've currently listened to many CDs and went to see many live performances, so I don't really know what are the roots that influenced me, but to those who somehow have empathy when listening to this song, by all means, please try to express this with some other things. It can be anything, such as pictures, words, or sounds. I'm sure it'll lead to something in the future. Just kidding~. From Nekomata Master. === pop'n music === ==== Nekomata Master ==== Hello, I'm Nekomata Master, who's participating in the pop'n series for the first time. I've only played pop'n for half a year in the first place. As I saw [[Tatsuya Mizuno|ota2]] loudly hitting the pop'n controller behind me, and momentarily murmured to myself "what's happening here?", I unexpectedly received a song request.
Using the theme of ethnic music, this resulted in a sorrowful pop feeling with various north to south tastes. Please listen, feel, and dance to it together. That's right, feeling is more important than listening. However, perhaps you might not have time to dance, but....
No, it still has a high difficulty level. You won't really have time to dance. By the way, I'm not the culprit in charge of these notecharts. This song's charts were created by ota2, which brilliantly soars beyond the human reflex limit. I mean, to be honest, I can't clear them. In particular, the middle section's percussion solo is a demon. I want to scream "aaaaaaaaah". Let's scream like a screaming machine.
So, don't give up and clear it~. === REFLEC BEAT === ==== Nekomata Master ==== I'm very fond of Beyond The Earth, which was the first song I created for the BEMANI series. So please play it! == Video Production Information == === SYO-jy === On a certain day, somewhere in Tokyo.
"There's a meeting."
"Hmm."
"Here's the video for the next song in the next game (CS 9th)..."
"Is it wrong?"
"Well, it's just that time..."
"... Is something wrong?"
"...... It's nothing."
"If that's the case, wonderful."
"It's a telegram!"
"Let's read it aloud."
"Huh!... the sound comment and song image is stolen" "Stolen...?... Is this assault?"
"... (It's nostalgic perhaps...)"
"Hmm. Is the middle section's 'charare~ chorare~ chara~ chachacha~ chare~ teraro~ teorare~' a horseman's gallop? Then that's assault..."
"... You have a point."
"Maeda Toshimasu (Keijiro)!"
"Hmm. A horseman's gallop blooms on the battlefield!"
"In that case, I'd like elements of a castle raid."
"Umm... my work time..."
"Let's be motivated somehow."
"!!"
"It's great to overcome a quantitative disadvantage."
"No, no, it's more than that..."
While arguing
"... Well, are there no objections about "this" content?"
"No objections x2"
"Yeah, no objection..."
"Well, CONTEN... it's not... hmm, Be... Beyo..."
"Beyond the Earth"
"I decided that this video will be about 'a small castle raid, with a happy and embarrassed horseman, and a bonus'! Well, this is the end of the 46th emergency meeting in my mind!"

It can be unlocked from November 29th, 2024. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === Dokyou Kyoudai (Red) === Well, hello, I'm the one from the Dokyou Kyoudai who doesn't wear glasses. "DIAVOLO" was created based on a very delightful chuunibyou-style suspicion that, because of his incredibly super violin technique, he must have made a deal with the devil and sold his soul to obtain that technique, giving him the nickname DIAVOLO (Devil). The piece is based on the 6th etude from Paganini's "Caprice No. 24 Solo Violin," arranged to IIDX style. Although it's attributed to Paganini, the composer of this piece is actually Franz Liszt, who apparently based it on some of Paganini's works.
So, shouldn't Liszt be listed as the arranger? That's what I think, but perhaps it's customary, or maybe because while there's a base piece, it's so transformed that it's almost as if Liszt composed it himself. Regardless, it seems the convention is to credit Liszt as the composer of this piece. Well, for the details on this, I firmly believe that the glasses-wearing one from the Dokyou Kyoudai, whose catchphrase is "Don't talk about classical music in front of me, you amateur, pathetic!" will elaborate here, sharing some interesting tidbits about Paganini that you can only read here. Now, about the ANOTHER chart of this piece, I think it's probably the highest difficulty chart in IIDX history.
Confident players, go ahead and score that AAA, and let the rumors spread that you're "the DIAVOLO who made a deal with the devil..." === Dokyou Kyoudai (Blue) === Well, hello, I'm the one from Dokyou Kyoudai who doesn't want to sink. To put it simply, I'm the sinking half.
We're the ones who, even when hit with immense pressure from the team right at the last minute for song submissions, possess the guts to stand firm, hence the name, the Dokyou Kyoudai.
To be honest, back then, space was kind of trending among the brothers, so we roughly settled on this name. As for this "DIAVOLO," well, the non-sinking half of the Dokyou Kyoudai has already said everything up there, so I don't have much left to say.
Frankly, I don't really get classical music either. My specialty is metal fusion with a bit of gabba.
I don't even know what I'm saying anymore. Anyway, just to add a bit of context, this piece incorporates not only Paganini and Liszt but also a subtle hint of Rachmaninoff's "Rhapsody on a Theme of Paganini". If we had more time for the track, I would've loved to include that famous beautiful inversion of the theme. Actually, all I really did was pick the best parts of the original and two variations and squeeze them into a two-minute structure.
To be honest, I didn't do much at all.
Since that felt a bit lacking, I just tossed in a little variation of my own as a modest touch. After all, it's called Lincle. Link! Expanding, connecting, emotions.
Connections between people, a collaboration. In other words, the tangled, intertwined bond of five men spanning across time and space is condensed right here.
That's right. Paganini, Liszt, Rachmaninoff, all of us. We're all part of the Dokyou Kyoudai.
And you, who are about to perform this piece, are also part of the Dokyou Kyoudai.
With courage, anything is possible! == Video Production Information == === Charm Sisters (The Older Sister) === I'm the one who came up with the characters. === Charm Sisters (The Younger Sister) === I made the logo! }} == Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of Four Leaves appears in Endorfin.'s fourth album, [[Alt.Strato]]. * A remixed mashup of Four Leaves and [[Snowmelt]] by [[Alicemetix|ZAQUVA]], titled [[White Stream]], appears in GITADORA HIGH-VOLTAGE and [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]. * A remixed cover of Four Leaves by Whitelily.([[Kohei Kimijima|みーに]]&[[Aya Shirosaki|しろさきあや]]), titled [[Four Leaves (Whitelily. remix)]], appears in [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]. == Trivia == * Four Leaves is a song part of the ''SOUND VOLTEX IV Production Confirmation Commemorative Original Song Contest'' (SOUND VOLTEX IV 制作決定記念 オリジナル楽曲コンテスト). It was added to SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN at release date. * Four Leaves is one of the songs in Part 24 of [[FLOOR INFECTION]]. During its periods of availability, it could be unlocked in the jubeat series by playing 2 rounds of the corresponding SOUND VOLTEX series game to raise the ''infection level'' to Level 1 MAX. For more information on the dates it could be unlocked, please see the event page. ** From November 15th, 2018 in [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased using in-game currency. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. *** It could also be unlocked in ''STAR RECORD'' from April 5th to 25th, 2023, by lighting up 6 stars. * Four Leaves was added to [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s REGULAR and INFINITE modes on August 1st, 2019. * Four Leaves was added to jubeat (2021) on June 2nd, 2022. * Four Leaves could be unlocked in GITADORA HIGH-VOLTAGE and [[AC GD FUZZ-UP|GITADORA FUZZ-UP]] from November 1st, 2022 to January 11th, 2023, as part of the [[Ichika no gochamaze Mix UP!]] (いちかのごちゃまぜMix UP！) event. ** In GITADORA FUZZ-UP, it is also one of the unlocks of the ''Daishuugou atsumare together! GITADORA All Star GIG!'' (大集合あつまれトゥギャザー！GITADORAオールスターGIG！) event. It can be unlocked from December 13th, 2023. ** In [[AC GD GALAXY WAVE|GITADORA GALAXY WAVE]], it can be unlocked in the ''Daihousou awasero channel! GALAXY MUSIC PARADE!'' Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None yet. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of Happy Dance Day 2 U appears in the [[DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary Vocal Audition special CD vol.2|DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary ボーカルオーディションスペシャルCD vol.2]] album. == Trivia == * Happy Dance Day 2 U was added to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 4th, 2024. * Happy Dance Day 2 U's vocalist, CHOPIN (ちょぴん), is one of the winners of the ''DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary ~Vocal Audition~'' (DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary ～ボーカルオーディション～). * Happy Dance Day 2 U's vocals were recorded at ''G-angle Ebisu STUDIO'' (G-angle恵比寿STUDIO) [https://x.com/CHOPIN_sing/status/1808744141574320465]. * Happy Dance Day 2 U is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 12th, 2026, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.5''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.5). == Song Production Information == === CHOPIN === My dream was to have my vocals included in a music game that I can clear, so I'm very happy to pass the audition as both a vocalist and player! This time, I was in charge of the vocals and lyrics.
Together with the composer Shoichiro Hirata, I sincerely expressed about moving forward together in the future, while reminiscing on the precious times from the day I first played DDR until now.
I'd be very happy if players can enjoy it!! === Shoichiro Hirata === I came back to DDR after [[This Beat Is.....|a long time]]. And congratulations on the 25th anniversary!!
This time, this is a collaboration with "CHOPIN", who's one of the winners of the vocal contest.
[[Yuichi Asami|U1]] ordered me to "make a song with a happy anniversary feeling" and with a Shoichiro Hirata feeling, so I was able to do whatever I liked in the end, but what do you think? I'd be happy if everyone loves it.
CHOPIN's very refreshing and carefree singing voice was impressive, and I really enjoyed working with her from the moment I thought of the melody.
This time, I was also able to provide the vocal direction, and not only was her singing very good, but she had the skills to "easily respond to my requests", so the recording went by very smoothly..
I was told that writing these lyrics was very difficult, but when I actually read them, they felt very fresh and "conveyable". I wonder if there are many key points that DDR fans can relate with.
It's a personal matter, but it's been over 20 years since I left KONAMI, and I'm simply thankful to everyone that I can still participate in DDR in this way.
By all means, please enjoy playing this song! == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards. }} == Song Connections / Remixes == * Harmonia is a vocal extended version of ''pop'n music ラピストリア Introduction'', the pop'n music ラピストリア opening theme. ** Some of the animations in Harmonia are a remake of the opening anime movie animation as well, albeit done in the traditional pop'n music art style. * The ノスタルジア series uses a slightly different version of Harmonia, featuring additional piano arrangement by [[Jun Wakita]]. * A long version of Harmonia can be found on PON's first album, [[Power Of Nature]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Harmonia is pop'n music ラピストリア's opening theme song. * Harmonia is one of the Story Mode hidden songs in pop'n music ラピストリア, unlockable from September 12th, 2014 through [[RETSU]] and [[MZD]]'s story: ''Things left behind'' (忘れ物). ** In [[AC pnm eclale|pop'n music éclale]], it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 300 lumina. ** As of [[AC pnm Usaneko|pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢]], it is available by default. * Harmonia marks Atsumi Ueda's debut in BEMANI. * Instead of a rival character, Harmonia's "character" is a series of animations. * [[Nyami]] and [[Mimi]] appear on the banner for Harmonia. ** RETSU, [[HIUMI]], [[FUGA]], and [[RINKA]] also appear on the rival splash screen before the song begins. All 6 characters also appear on the song's jacket. *** In addition, ''every'' character new and old that appears in pop'n music ラピストリア up to the release of Harmonia appears in some part of Harmonia's animations. *** Kiryu, whose song [[Midareta fuuki ni tenbatsu wo|乱れた風紀に天罰を]] appeared two months ''later'' in pop'n music ラピストリア, also appears in Harmonia's animations. * Harmonia is one of the only two songs from pop'n music ラピストリア with staff comments, the other being [[Anelis]]. * Harmonia's working title was '''モノクロリーパー''' (Monochrome leaper) [https://twitter.com/BEMANI_FanSite/status/1265897102829170688]. * Harmonia could be unlocked in BeatStream from December 24th, 2014 to October 26th, 2015 as part of the [[PON no unmei jouka keikaku]] (PONの運命浄化計画) event, by obtaining the Earth Purification (大地の浄化) power. ** As of December 3rd, 2015, its LIGHT chart has been unlocked for normal play. Its MEDIUM and BEAST charts could be unlocked via the BisCo mail ''Atarashii sekai! ヾ(＠^▽^＠)ノ'' in ''Takahashi-san Lab.''. *** In [[AC BST AnimTribe|BeatStream アニムトライヴ]], these charts have been unlocked by default. * Harmonia's artist name was misspelled as '''ASTUMI UEDA''' upon its addition to BeatStream. Its charts could be unlocked from July 15th, 2021. ** From February 14th, 2022, its charts could be purchased in [[AC CastHour|beatmania IIDX 29 CastHour]] with [[AC CastHour/Archive Links|Archive Links]] (アーカイブリンク). ** As of [[AC RESIDENT|beatmania IIDX 30 RESIDENT]], it is available by default. * Ignis†Iræ is Jun Wakita's first original song in the beatmania IIDX series since [[Bokushin fuefukite|牧神笛吹きて]], back in [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]]. * According to Ignis†Iræ comments, Jun originally received an order for [[Super sentou Babanburn|a musical piece with the theme of hot springs]], and that he planned to have a warrior personifying the hot spring resort appear. * Ignis Irae is Latin for "Fire of Wrath". * According to ''[https://uta.573.jp/artist/1027098 着信★うた♪]'', the artist name "神" is pronounced ゴッド (GOD) instead of the traditional かみ (KAMI). ** This is consistent with the correct answer "ゴッド" as seen in ''QuizKnock Stadium BEMANI イントロ STADIUM ver. beatmania IIDX'' when the game asks the player to name the artist after hearing an audio sample of Ignis†Iræ. * Ignis†Iræ was added to [[CS ULTIMATE MOBILE|beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE]] on June 6th, 2024. * Ignis†Iræ is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] from October 2nd, 2024 after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * Ignis†Iræ is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from June 25th, 2026, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.37''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.37). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, Ignis†Iræ can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. * Ignis†Iræ's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX. == Song Production Information == === BEMANI Sound Team "GOD" === Hello there, I'm God. Wait, no, no. Absolutely not. Please call me Kami-sama. This time, [[Ryutaro Nakahara|Kagura]] and I, who we are close to each other in terms of appearance, played as if we were a god-god duo.
In other words, I'm like the god who doesn't have fun.
I have no fun here. In fact, I am not having fun at all.
As if, at the retirement games of professional baseball players, there are those who give a press conference saying that they never had any fun playing baseball.
I probably feel the same way. After all, I am a professional. As I was mumbling to myself, I was limping, without spirit or energy, as usual.
And then, [[Toshiyuki Kakuta|L.E.D.]], the devout lamb, made a wish for me to write a song for IIDX.
Well, it's not a wish, strictly speaking, but it's more of a business request instead. And it came. It just came one day. God was furious. God doesn't understand IIDX.
Before I knew it, the most talented track makers in the music scene had gathered together.
IIDX has become a place where the latest club music is performed using the latest equipment, the latest techniques, and the latest taste.
To be frank, I don't get it. It's scary. It makes me scared. (My personal opinion.)
It's no longer something that can be handled with the same old skills I had. So I feel like I don't want to be in the same ring with them.
I don't want to be in the same ring as you. To be frank, IIDX is no longer my place anymore! You know that, right? I've been saying these things over and over again in my mind, running away, putting it off, and before I knew it, it had been about eight years since I contributed.
In other words, it seems that the time for paying tribute has finally come for this time.
I may be a god, but I have to pay tribute to the humans. It is said that the more ears of rice grow, the more they droop their heads.
But if this is the case, then I should have at least written about it in Rootage, which looks back on the past.
It's a nostalgic story, and I could have made an excuse that it's old-fashioned and on target. Well, as Mistborn said, the bill for your life will be paid at the most difficult time.
To students who have a bright future ahead of them, please be careful. It's really dangerous to put things off like that. But God is a man of information, so he know exactly what he's talking about.
IIDX has traveled to a lot of places this time, right? It's basically like, "Travelling is awesome, let's go somewhere sometime!" Something like that, right?
If so, it will be a music from a region that no one knows, like ''Unjarague Travia''.
If you make music that no one knows the correct answer to, you might be able to fool them somehow...?
I was trying to find a ray of hope in this low-level direction.
As if he had realized this, L.E.D. appeared dashingly and said,
"If that's so, please choose a hot spring as the theme." Huh.
Hot springs.
Hmmm. Hot springs...
Let's make it a samba and sing "Viva Viva Non". No?
Then... Let's start with an intro that sounds like [[FLOWER]].
Then maybe I'll make a solemn harpsichord that resembles a public bath in ancient Rome.
Let's get a bunch of anthropomorphic warriors from various hot spring resorts and have them shout "OOH!"
If you're looking for a hero song, you can't go wrong with the timpani and marimba arrangements from the past.
IIDX's scratch sounds have always been either cymbals or timpani. Now, I was starting to feel like I had a good idea of what I wanted to do.
In fact, I was trying to keep my distance from L.E.D. as naturally as possible when the delivery date started to flicker.
As if he had realized this, L.E.D. appeared again and said, "Excuse me. I know it's a little shameful for me to do this, but for various reasons, please make the music theme a volcano instead of a hot spring." Huh.
Volcano.
Hmmm. A volcano... The god was furious. In his anger, he spewed fire, like the old man's violent eruption.
The flames that erupted as a result lit up the night and burned the whole world for seven days.
As a result, people recognized the volcanic eruption, and thus the flaming aftermath, as the wrath of God.
Sometimes they feared it, sometimes they respected it, and sometimes they used it to burn iron, make tools, bake food, and warm themselves.
In other words, this culinary evolution is the reason why IIDX BISTROVER was born in the future. I don't care what you say.
In fact, unfortunately, or fortunately, even though it was just before the deadline, I had only played about five notes on the timpani.
I had no reason to be angry, and was rather pleased that the deadline had been extended.
I threw away the idea of the hot spring and solemnly wrote the volcano song with a completely fresh mind.
In other words, what I wanted to convey the most in this long article is a lesson that postponement is not always a bad thing.
I will continue to do my best to put things off.
In the end, I was not a good person in many ways, so I have been given a pardon for my genre. I'll see you again in probably around eight years.
This is God. == Video Production Information == === BEMANI Designer "over the mountain" === I still remember making it while being forced to the edge.
My screen and schedule were on fire!
Now I'm just happy that we made it past the firestorm! == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

Upper on July 16th, 2015, as part of the 10th Set ([[Takayuki Ishikawa|dj TAKA]]'s SELECTION) of the ''BEMANI MUSIC FOCUS'' unlock system. ** From September 17th, 2015 onwards, it could be purchased from the REFLEC Shop for 3800 and 1500 Refle for its BASIC/MEDIUM/HARD and SPECIAL charts, respectively. ** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]], its BASIC/MEDIUM/HARD charts could be purchased in the Garage for 20 VOLZZA KEYs. Its SPECIAL chart could be purchased for 8 VOLZZA KEYs after clearing the song. ** In [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], it was playable by default. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], Lucy was revived on January 19th, 2017. * Lucy is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from September 4th, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * Lucy also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. * Lucy is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from June 25th, 2026, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.37''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.37). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, Lucy can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. * Lucy received a new jacket in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Lucy's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== ELE BLOCK (no hidari) ==== Hi, we're ELE BLOCK. I'm on the left side. We're cheerful guys who can sing and dance. Let's go with these characters for now.
I really thought about adding "pipo" at the end to sound ELE-ish, but I didn't do it after all since I'm almost 30 years old. This time, the sound director requested me to create an '80s sound.
Personally, the real time '80s sound means band boom, amateur idol groups, and shiny music halls, but the sound director seems like a guy who celebrates the revival of the Maharaja. Oh. About that. That's an unreasonable request.
As someone who's familiar with '70s content, I'm not familiar with the '80s in the first place, and come to think of it, I only have a vague impression of a girl who sat on the right side next to me during middle school, and liked Rick Astley.
I continued to interact with her for a while after we graduated from middle school, but it naturally faded out. She had a very strong physique, si if I was destined to fight her, she'd definitely see my half-dead eyes, but actually, her heart was young and delicate.
That girl's name was Lucy. I'm lying. I don't have anything else to write about, so I'll stop here. I can't help that there's a character like this.
Yours truly. === REFLEC BEAT === ==== dj TAKA ==== I chose this song because I couldn't leave out a wac song. It got my choice for its cute lyrics and vocals. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === April. New classes.
A girl who isn't obviously~ bright and immediately becomes popular in class, but a girl who doesn't really stand out but you're very interested in! Do you have memories like this?
Such scene came to mind from the lyrics.
I tried to create the interaction between an excited boy, and a girl (named Lucy) who fell in love at first sight. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of Move On appears in the [[DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary Vocal Audition special CD vol.2|DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary ボーカルオーディションスペシャルCD vol.2]] album. == Trivia == * Move On was added to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 4th, 2024. * Move On's vocalist, haru, is one of the winners of the ''DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary ~Vocal Audition~'' (DanceDanceRevolution 25th Anniversary ～ボーカルオーディション～). * Move On's vocals were recorded at ''G-angle Ebisu STUDIO'' (G-angle恵比寿STUDIO) [https://x.com/haru_mu_vo/status/1808703623855288685]. * Move On is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 12th, 2026, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.5''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.5). == Song Production Information == === haru === My name is "haru" from haru&You, and I'm one of the vocal contest winners.
This time, I was able to make music with kors k that's also different to the genres I'm used to. It feels like I've encountered a brand-new self, and I'm very excited.
I wrote the lyrics about my feelings when I entered this audition, and about start running and moving your feet, the latter being a characteristic in DanceDanceRevolution games.
I was worried when I entered the audition, but I was given this opportunity by taking a step forward.
I'd be very happy if I could move the "feet" of everyone's hearts. === kors k === I was able to create a wonderful song for haru, who happened to be among the vocal contest award winners this time.
I was able to make full use of haru's powerful singing voice, which won during the audition, and it resulted in a strong song with a passionate message.
I [[Clione|started]] my career from a [[AC 4th style|beatmania IIDX]] audition, and I remember my straightforward feelings while having the guts to say "let's do it" back then.
You should never forget where you came from.
I wish good luck to haru and the other award winners in your future endeavors. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of O JIYA appears in the [[GUITAR FREAKS 7thMIX & drummania 6thMIX Soundtracks]] and Mutsuhiko Izumi's [[Ponta to meguru sekai no ongaku|ポン太と巡る世界の音楽]] albums. * O JIYA is the first song in a series of Indian songs by Mutsuhiko Izumi. * Several of O JIYA's vocal samples are also featured in [[AC jb|jubeat]]'s [[In Scottish Highlands]], another song composed by Mutsuhiko Izumi. * A cover of O JIYA by [[Reiji Sakurai|Reiji Sakurai feat.Reichel]] was uploaded to his [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I-1f25h3uP0 YouTube channel]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * O JIYA marks vocalist ASMAT's debut in BEMANI. * O JIYA is Hindi for "I love you". This is mentioned by NAK in the song comments from the GUITARFREAKS 7thMIX & drummania 6thMIX website. * O JIYA is available in [[AC GF10DM9|GUITARFREAKS 10thMIX & drummania 9thMIX]] and [[AC GF11DM10|GUITARFREAKS 11thMIX & drummania 10thMIX]] with an e-AMUSEMENT account. ** O JIYA has been made automatically available in Standard mode as of [[AC GFDM V|GuitarFreaks V & DrumMania V]]. * O JIYA is available for play in GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3 as an unlockable song in ''Pleasure Box'' Volume 5, from June 6th to July 10th, 2012. * O JIYA was one of the ''bistro saucer'' 5th Set unlocks of jubeat saucer. It could be unlocked from February 1st to 28th, 2013. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * O JIYA was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see [[AC jb saucer/Song Swap System|this page]]. * In ''ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom'', O JIYA's artist is credited to '''ASMAT & emi.'''. * O JIYA could be unlocked in REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2 from June 16th to July 13th, 2016, as part of the ''Pastel challenge!'' (パステルチャレンジ!) unlocking system. It is available after clearing CHALLENGE CARD 3. ** From July 28th, 2016, it can be purchased in the Garage for 20 VOLZZA KEYs. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], O JIYA was revived on June 29th, 2017. * O JIYA is currently the only song with vocalist ASMAT that has appeared outside the GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series. * O JIYA (CLASSIC) is one of the unlocks of [[AC GD NEX+AGE|GITADORA NEX+AGE]]'s ''GITADORA wo tomodachi to issho ni play shiyou!! It could be unlocked from July 8th to August 2nd, 2020. ** It could be unlocked again from December 2nd, 2020 to January 3rd, 2021. ** As of [[AC GD FUZZ-UP|GITADORA FUZZ-UP]], it is available by default. * O JIYA's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * O JIYA was added to DANCERUSH STARDOM on April 1st, 2023. * O JIYA is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]] from March 13th, 2025, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.3''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.3). ** It received new charts upon its appearance in GRAND PRIX. * O JIYA features a modified widescreen version of its GuitarFreaks & DrumMania video in DANCERUSH STARDOM, which consists of its original video tiled three times across the screen. ** O JIYA uses its DANCERUSH STARDOM video in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, which eliminates any on-screen dancers. ** The GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series also use this video for its regular and CLASSIC charts as of [[AC GD GALAXY WAVE DELTA|GITADORA GALAXY WAVE DELTA]]. * O JIYA is one of DanceDanceRevolution WORLD's ''EXTRA SAVIOR WORLD'' songs. It can be unlocked from December 4th, 2025. ** It also received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, unlockable from December 4th, 2025 through EXTRA SAVIOR WORLD after having unlocked ''all'' BEMANI SELECTION vol.3 songs. == Song Production Information == === GUITARFREAKS 7thMIX & drummania 6thMIX Official Website === ==== Mutsuhiko Izumi ==== The vocalists are "ASMAT & emi". ASMAT is Indian, so the Hindi lyrics were written by him.
A wonderful singing voice from India has arrived. Although emi is Japanese, she received a special Hindi lesson from ASMAT and she also has a wonderful singing voice. In DrumMania, Indian percussions like tabla can be played.
It's a difficult song, but do your best to clear it. === GUITAR FREAKS 7thMIX & drummania 6thMIX Soundtracks Booklet === ==== Mutsuhiko Izumi ==== Untranslated. == Video Production Information == === NOZZY === Continuing from "[[BALALAIKA,CARRIED WITH THE WIND]]", I was in charge of the foreign colored "O JIYA" video. I made it thinking of the vivid colors of an Indian painting. The singing Hindi voices in this song are wonderful. I was inspired by them, as the picture of the woman in the video was drawn while imagining her based on the vocals. By the way, the model of the man with a snake is a manager of an Indian curry shop near the highschool where I attended. == Staff Comments == === NAK === This is the most recent entry in what is becoming a regular folk music series. Personally, I enjoy it when they shout "Hohohoi hoho hoi" because it's funny.
Now, how come this song is included in the LOVE-4 course?
...The answer is because "O JIYA" is the Hindi phrase for "I love you". == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

It can be unlocked from August 6th, 2026. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === Power Of Nature === Hello! It's QuoN. A representation of Jadeite's silently terrifying yet strikingly majestic nature, blended with a scientific techno sound crafted in a laboratory, accented with the voices of a man who has become dignified with age. Through all of these elements, I've managed to fully express his character image.
Even in a techno song, the shine of one's lapis, and the transience of that shine, are expressed through the song's break portions and ending. While composing, I kept in mind the motions of one's hands; the wild synth track during the middle portions is one I found enjoyable to play to. By the way, the song's title comes from the word "kuon", which means "eternity". While composing the last piano phrase, I had a particular scene in mind I wanted to illustrate.
That scene is Jadeite after being defeated by RETSU and his friends, as his lapis shatters in slow motion. He open his eyes and stares up at the sky, as his lapis crumbles to shards before him.
That image of Jadeite reliving his memories, remembering his past as it fades from existence, is what inspired this song’s title. Both the impact and beauty of the word "eternity". For the midboss of a still-continuing story, I feel that I have created a suitably striking song. == Character Information == Untranslated. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

Its charts can be unlocked through DanceDanceRevolution WORLD's FLARE SKILL RANK unlock system from launch date. * Roche Limit marks Felysrator's debut in BEMANI. * In celestial mechanics, the "Roche Limit" is the closest possible distance that an orbiting planetary body can get to a larger body of mass without being overwhelmed by tidal forces. If a satellite is inside the limit, it will disintegrate into smaller pieces of matter and even out into orbiting rings. * Roche Limit is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]] as a FINAL STAGE exclusive song from July 3rd, 2024. == Song Production Information == Nice to meet you. I'm Felysrator.
I usually compose music for anime and voice actors under a different name.
I'm very happy that my song has been accepted for this 25th anniversary contest.
Before I talk about my song, let me tell you a story of my past. When I was a child, I gave up in my dream of becoming a manga artist.
I still had that dream when I entered junior high school, with no hobbies and nothing to be passionate about.
I was fed up with myself. One day, while browsing the Internet, I found a certain piece of content.
I was very impressed and hooked with it, and ended buying CDs and goods, went to tournaments and live shows; it was everything in my youth. That was BEMANI, and why I started creating music. Sorry for the long story. The first thing when I thought about "DDR" was gimmicks, such as soflan and stops.
I also included various techniques such as stutters and halftimes.
I myself play frequently, so I always imagined the charts while creating this song.
Also, what I usually create is what's known as "artcore", and I was worried about whether I'd be able to write bass music, but I'm glad that it turned out wonderfully. I'm very happy to have found BEMANI, to have continued making music, and to have finally achieved my dream of being accepted. I'm looking forward to the day when I can play this song at the arcade. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards. {{DDR Chart Header| {{DDR Chart Notecounts|112 / 12|208 / 41|392 / 25|548 / 18|619 / 17 / 0|208 / 41|392 / 25|548 / 18|615 / 17 / 0}} {{DDR Chart|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD→Present|3|7|11|14|15|7|11|14|15}} {{DDR Chart|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX|3|7|11|14|15|7|11|14|15}} }} {{DDR25th}} [[Category:Songs]] [[Category:DanceDanceRevolution Songs]]

Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki|発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡]] event. ** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]] and [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], it was playable by default. ** Stand Alone Beat Masta being crossed over marks GUHROOVY's first appearance in the REFLEC BEAT series. * With 556 objects, Stand Alone Beat Masta's MEDIUM chart is tied with [[Eclipse Zero]] for the third highest number of objects of any MEDIUM chart in REFLEC BEAT (pre-[[AC RB Reflesia|悠久のリフレシア]]), beaten only by [[Rebellio]]'s 689 and [[vajra|伐折羅-vajra-]]'s 666. * After being removed from the initial release of REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア, Stand Alone Beat Masta was revived on October 12th, 2017. ** Its WHITE HARD chart could be unlocked through a quest in Reflesia Mode (リフレシアモード) from October 19th to November 1st, 2017. *** Since March 8th, 2018, it is available by default. * Stand Alone Beat Masta's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * Stand Alone Beat Masta is available in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD from June 12th, 2025 by having purchased the ''DanceDanceRevolution PLATINUM MEMBER PASS'' (DanceDanceRevolutionプラチナメンバーズ). ** From June 30th, 2026, it is available by default for all players. *** It is also playable in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]] from the same date. * In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, Stand Alone Beat Masta's BPM is listed as 200 regardless of the difficulty selected. == Song Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

It can be unlocked from December 4th, 2025. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === NU-KO === Hello poppers! Are you enjoying the world of Lapistoria? I'm NU-KO!
This time, Aka to ao no rampage has a different atmosphere than before, and it's a very good song! I'm also singing the lyrics quite seriously, NU-KO: "Here... it's written as hikareau unmei, but is 運命 read as 'sadame'?"
PON: "Oh, no, that's 'unmei'! (laughs)" I ended up reading a bit too deeply into something like that. (laughs) However, the character is RETSU's grandmother. She looks younger than RETSU...! Hmm, there's a gap between them. She's a cuticle old woman! From the lyrics, the old woman seems like her life has ups and downs, but she's probably a lovely grandmother who takes care of her grandchildren. I also want to be a cute and lovely old woman like AKANE in the future. Earnestly.
I fully sang along to PON's cool sound! Please continue to support Aka to ao no rampage! === PON === "Let's make RETSU's grandmother tiny! A tiny grandmother's great! We need a grandmother like that!"
This song & character started from my own words. As expected, I'm happy that it turned out as a character with strong individuality.
Well, this is my [[Renaikansoku|third]] [[Pochiko no shiawasena nichijou|tag team]] with NU-KO, so this time, I created a serious minor key song with a sad melody from the concept of "showing a different side of NU-KO". I love how the bursting chorus and key changes raise the tension. When opposites collide, such as red and blue, or life and death, an enormously large presence appears and consumes everything.
"Aka to ao no rampage" was named to express such unknown phenomena and worldview.
I created such a song for NU-KO and I to grow once more. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == RETSU's grandmother looks like a child.
Is there still a secret hidden in her inherited power...? === Chihi === Hello everyone, this is the old woman AKANE, who's rumored to be braver than her grandchildren. The concept of "RETSU's grandmother looks like a child" was conceived by PON.
I wondered if she was always an old woman who becomes younger as time passed by, but she has always looked like a child.
I thought she was a cute child, but she's quite calm for her age.
I designed the old woman by gathering information that gradually became clearer. When I look at RETSU in the story, he simply has a carefree impression, but after listening to this song, I thought "he's had quite some difficult experiences to reach this point...".
I just listened to it without reading the lyrics, so I'm super looking forward to the day when they're officially released in a soundtrack.
And at the very end of production, when the vocals were added, I jumped around saying "ooh~ it's NU-KO~!".
It's NU-KO! When I said this to PON, he smoothly dodged me while saying "oh, I didn't tell you?".
He's probably the type of person who doesn't really reveal the vocalists and lyrics. [[Zero to ichi no kagi no uta|Continuing]] from [[Akinari]]'s lead, this is NU-KO's shining and dazzling new side that hasn't been seen in pop'n's vocal songs, thank you very much!! The story about [[Kouen]] and the abilities he inherited from his grandmother has spread to my mind and probably everyone's minds as well, and it seems like some amazing things are going to happen. Will they answer together someday? I want to know! Even in her FEVERWIN animation, the old woman's action doesn't usually change from WIN.
Related characters will appear in the future... and I have a feeling that her action will change... I'll do it, right~? I'm excited! piyo-ko, who decorated the pop'n music card with a gentle taste, also helped me come up with the old woman's COOL action idea. Thank you very much ＾＾ == Choreography Information == === [[Dai.]] === Every time we had meetings to decide what songs to include, I continued to say "I want to play Rampage, I want to play it, I'll do anything", and this time, my wish came true, and it was included!
It wasn't really said there, but this time, it's a joint choreography with Yuu, who's famous for [[LUV CAN SAVE U|luv can save u]].
Halfway through the choreography we decided "this is a pair choreography after all, right?", and it's my first choreography where 1P2P have different choreographies.
I think its difficulty level is easy to dance to (compared to usual), so please take this opportunity with this song to try and enjoy dancing with various people and become dance mates! === Yuu === In the middle of the choreography, D said "more, damn... my right eye hurts... the choreography feels like that" and "this feeling... there's no doubt... does it mean I've finally woken up... the poses feel like that". It was really troubling.
Anyways, I'm satisfied with the very stylish choreography in the "moesakaru akane sora ni yaburenai yakusoku wo shita" part. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It can be unlocked from April 10th, 2025. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === Nukoneko-san === Zu-ba-ba-ba-baaam! It's Nukoneko-san~!
Is everyone having fun living a karuta life!?
Speaking of karuta, I used to own a set of karuta cards when I was younger, but I used to enjoy playing menko with them instead!
I always had trouble flipping the cards over!
It took me a few years to figure out the proper way of playing!
Huh, why did I play alone...? It's not because I didn't have anyone to play with! It's not! Well, now I can play with Kuroneko-san! A battle with (all two members of) Nekomanma Team! ...Huh!? There's no one to be the reader!?
This feels great~ ☆ Nataradin ☆ [The end] (P.S. When recording the song, wac was shouting "MOCHI!!!" "IKA!!!" really energetically. I'll never forget PON trying to keep a straight face while recording.) === Kuroneko-san === Zu-ba-ba-ba-baaam! It's Kuroneko-san.
Do all of you kids know how to play karuta?
This is a love song, definitely a love song. One time I was distracted as usual, and had the passing idea of writing a song using the Hyakunin Isshu.
Then, suddenly, it was time to begin preparing for the next KAC.
Which meant I had to choose the queen of the pop'n girls division.
When I hear "queen", I think of karuta. Karuta Queen.
At that moment, everything came together; the competitive karuta queen Iroha suddenly burst into existence.
I never understood why they call the female champions queens even though it's a completely Japanese-styled game.
Well, it's probably because karuta originally came from Europe. But then, why are the male champions called meijin? I'm probably the best competitive karuta player in the BEMANI world.
Because of all the reference material I've read about competitive karuta (a bunch of manga), I'm a bit of an expert on the subject.
I'm pretty much on the level of a champion already. Even though I've never actually played a game before. The beginning of the song uses the usual introductory poem used in karuta tournaments, and the "zu-ba-ba-ba-baaam!" shout is based on the beginning syllables of each poem.
That's all the relevant karuta information I know.
By the way, why does everyone think the ending sounds like Nataradin?
To the trained ear of a competitive karuta player, she's clearly saying "this feels great".
Now, everyone can stop bringing up Nataradin.
(Acknowledged by Q-Mex) The skills required in competitive karuta translate easily over to pop'n.
When writing the music, I wanted to create karuta-like hand movements.
If you decide to take on the rapid-fire hand movements of this song, it's a battle with Nekomanma Team for the title of karuta queen or meijin.
Ah, I've already forgotten all the poems. Try your best, Nukoneko-san. == Video Production Information == === VJ ika === Hellooooo~☆ It's the grieving squid. Kuroneko-san's lyrics had a bunch of karuta-related phrases scattered throughout, which I thought was really clever, so I tried to include as much of that as possible in the movie!
While creating the video I kept in mind how excitable, lively, and expressive Iroha is. When I saw the official announcement from the pop'n team, I was surprised at how well everything came together. §/❘▽❘)§　←she's cute! It was the song from KAC pop'n women's division, and a song that the BeatStream champion wanted to see, so I poured all of that fighting spirit into creating the video...!
And Chihi from the pop'n team illustrated the video as well! It's really wonderful! === belldot === Once again, I was asked to create a video.
Thank you!
I created a video which is just as high-tension as the song!
Be sure to pay attention to all of the karuta wordplay in the lyrics! === Chihi === The pop'n women's finals song was invited to BeatStream.
Since I was bringing Iroha over from the pop'n team, Mimi and Nyami decided to tag along too! Sorry to intrude~
I was very happy to be in charge of illustrating the video, and when all the drawings were finished and I saw the video for the first time it really felt amazing!
My favourite illustration is Iroha dressed as NaN. This feels great~ ☆
I inserted a number of pop'n references into the video. If they caught anyone's attention, please go play the song in pop'n as well!
I'm very glad she was able to become friends with BisCo ^^
Iroha, love with all your heart~ == Character Information == === Chihi === Hello everyone! This is Karuta Queen Iroha, who filled the women's division with her cuteness. At the beginning, the sound team suggested writing a song using the Hyakunin Isshu, which I was excited about.
The character's image is a blend between a Heian-era 12-layer kimono and a cutesy mini yukata.
Her design is very colourful, like many other éclale characters; but at one point the colouring shifted toward being more Heian-inspired. I think I ended up reaching a perfect balance between the two concepts!
At first I thought her miniskirt would make her look too lively to be a karuta player, but her song is already super lively! I feel great~! wac was rather excited about writing a love song, but the character theme ended up being more focused on karuta than love!
Through her animations, please experience Iroha's burning passion for karuta.
At first I was worried, since the theme of Heian-era love seemed like a great idea; but when I considered Iroha's life, I realised that she's completely in love with karuta. It's a karuta-themed love song. The reckless girl who loves karuta, who seems clumsy at first glance: Iroha. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It could be unlocked from August 12th, 2013. ** In [[AC pnm Lapistoria|pop'n music ラピストリア]], it could be unlocked via Story Mode from September 12th, 2014. ** In [[AC pnm eclale|pop'n music éclale]], it could be purchased from the Star Factory shop for 60 lumina. ** As of [[AC pnm Usaneko|pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢]], it is available by default. * ポチコの幸せな日常's songwheel genre, わんわんコア, can be read as "wanwan core". ** "Wanwan" is the Japanese onomatopoeia of a dog's bark. * In the pop'n music data, ポチコの幸せな日常 is named "inuko", making a pun on "inu" (犬, dog), NU-KO, and "inuko" (犬子, dog girl). * ポチコの幸せな日常 is one of the unlockable crossover songs for jubeat saucer fulfill on the [[Hakken! It can be unlocked from December 4th, 2025. == Song Production Information == === Tezuka === Good evening. I'm Tezuka.
I've created a number with a fun, fresh feeling and a very enjoyable answer back.
As I grew up by playing KONAMI music games, I'm very happy to be involved by providing a song for them.
As an admirer of the old times, I think it'd be nice if this song would become memorable for other people. === Amimi Oonishi === Good morning! I'm Amimi Oonishi!
Thank you for accepting our song and illustration now.
I'm pleased to be able to participate in this work together, since I like and admire you two very much. We did it!
I'd be happy if this becomes a song that many people can think of, and that they'd like to listen and play again and again! == Jacket Production Information == === △○□× === Hello, △○□× is read as Miwashiiba.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * An extended version of 罪と罰, titled ''罪と罰 (Extended Mix)'', appears in Xceon's first album, [[Tsumi to batsu (album)|罪と罰]] and Mayumi Morinaga's second album, [[Din Don Dan (album)|Din Don Dan]]. == Trivia == * 罪と罰 is the first song composed by Yusuke Seo in beatmania IIDX that does not involve [[Ryutaro Nakahara|Ryu☆]] or [[Toshiyuki Kakuta|L.E.D.]]. * "Tsumi to batsu" (罪と罰) means "crime and punishment". * Both Yusuke Seo and Mayumi Morinaga appear in 罪と罰's video. * 罪と罰 is the CHALLENGE5 unlock of DanceEvolution ARCADE's ''CHALLENGE category'' (CHALLENGEカテゴリー) unlocking system. * 罪と罰 is available in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.6''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.6). * 罪と罰 was added to DANCE aROUND on May 18th, 2022. ** Its charts use some slowed parts of its choreography from DanceEvolution. * 罪と罰's DANCE aROUND ADVANCED chart is the first ADVANCED chart in the series to be rated Level 9. * 罪と罰 received a MASTER chart in DANCE aROUND's ''Gauge Unlock Event'' (ゲージアンロックイベント) Part 2. It could be unlocked from July 6th to 24th, 2022, from January 11th to January 29th, 2023, and from March 3rd to 19th, 2023. ** From July 19th, 2023, it is available by default. * 罪と罰's MASTER chart is the first in the DANCE aROUND series to be rated Level 10. ** It is also the first to completely reuse its original choreography from DanceEvolution. * 罪と罰 is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX from March 13th, 2024, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.1''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.1). * 罪と罰 features its beatmania IIDX video in the DanceDanceRevolution series. In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, it eliminates any on-screen dancers. * 罪と罰 is one of DanceDanceRevolution WORLD's ''EXTRA SAVIOR WORLD'' songs. It can be unlocked from November 29th, 2024. ** From November 26th, 2026, it will be available by default. == Song Production Information == === Xceon === BEMANI fans, nice to meet you. Hello! I'm Xceon, who was in charge of composing "Tsumi to batsu" this time. ＾－＾－＾－＾－＾－＾ I'm really happy to be included in my admired BEMANI series!! Well, the piano intro in this song almost makes my fingers break, but how will it turn out in the game? This song's theme is that if you commit a crime, there's naturally punishment.... but because of that, something new and lovely is born. If there's an apple in front of you, you'll end up eating it, right?!! So, I'd be happy if you can feel the heart-pounding feeling suspense of committing a crime, and the excitement of something new being born ＾－＾－＾－＾－＾ === Mayumi Morinaga === Hello! I'm moimoi. This time, I was in charge of singing "Tsumi to batsu". If you see delicious looking food in front of you... But, if you were previously told not to eat it... You would....... While eating it, you're offered a replacement! (If there was pudding left there and I ate it, I'd try chocolate-flavored pudding later I'll update the version a bit later and leave this here) That's what it feels like! Please listen to it "Tsumi to batsu" === mitsu === In the past, God said "if you eat the fruit of the knowledge of good and evil, I'll get angry!" When Adam and Eve ate it...... they suddenly realized "are we completely naked!?"...... I also started walking outside my house while wearing clothes. Hello! I'm mitsu, who was in charge of the lyrics for "Tsumi to batsu" this time. I went to the arcade after getting dressed. That's when I encountered beatmania IIDX. When I turned around, the person who I liked...... wasn't behind me. But, I think we can listen and create music because humans ate the forbidden fruit. Thank you! mitsu will continue to be friends with everyone......!! == Video Production Information == === Kiyoshi Tanada(Motion Combat) === My name is Motion Combat, and I was in charge of creating the video for "Tsumi to batsu".
This song has Mayumi Morinaga's powerful vocals placed over a beautiful piano melody, and it's truly the perfect fit for IIDX, with a powerful upper groove that might feel sad. Like its title, the song and lyrics are based on two opposite keywords, and I wanted the video to also be like that, so Mayumi Morinaga sang in two costumes, with black and white images. I went through trial and error to draw out the best image of this song, with intense cut changes and effects to match its beat!
I'd be happy if you can play it while watching the video with the same feeling as listening to the song. == Choreography Information == === [[Yossy]] === ~Let's walk together in crime and punishment~ Sorry to keep you waiting!
So, Yossy has finally appeared in the DanEvo world! I choreographed Xceon and Mayumi Morinaga's "Tsumi to batsu" from beatmania IIDX!
It's based on a JAZZ dance.
Its dance genre is the same as [[Oboro]], but it resulted in an intense choreography.
There are rumors that the calories consumed are the highest ever (laughs) The chorus, which appears three times, has different choreography each time, so it's difficult to learn, but the choreography is conscious of the overall lyrics.
Please feel the lyrics and music, and express them with your body!

Its MEDIUM and BEAST charts could be unlocked via the BisCo mail ''Usausausausa（＊｀ω´＊）'' in ''Takahashi-san Lab.''. ** As of December 3rd, 2015, these charts have been unlocked by default. * In BeatStream, ウサテイ used its SOUND VOLTEX NOVICE, ADVANCED, and EXHAUST jackets for its LIGHT, MEDIUM, and BEAST jackets, respectively. ** ウサテイ's LIGHT jacket was changed to its MEDIUM jacket on November 19th, 2014, to distinguish between [[Oyome ni shinasai!|お嫁にしなさいっ！]] and this song, which used the same jacket. ** The DanceDanceRevolution series, jubeat plus, and REFLEC BEAT plus use ウサテイ's EXHAUST/BEAST jacket as well. * HIGH TENSION was added to ウサテイ's charts in [[AC BST AnimTribe|BeatStream アニムトライヴ]]. * ウサテイ was added to [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s INFINITE mode on June 1st, 2021. * ウサテイ was added to DanceDanceRevolution A3 on April 28th, 2022. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], ウサテイ's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series, ウサテイ's artist is credited to '''ビートまりお(COOL&CREATE)'''. * ウサテイ's CHALLENGE charts were added to DanceDanceRevolution A3 on June 22nd, 2022. * ウサテイ is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from November 1st, 2022, by purchasing '''SPECIAL music pack feat.Touhou Project vol.1''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.東方Project vol.1). * In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, ウサテイ received its difficulty changes from DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 3rd, 2024. * ウサテイ received an EXCEED chart in [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]'s [[AC SDVX EG/ARENA STATION|ARENA STATION]], available since August 21st, 2025. It could be unlocked in all participant games from February 15th to April 21st, 2024. ** In [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], it can be unlocked from February 27th, 2025 through ''EXTRA SAVIOR WORLD''. ** In [[AC Sparkle Shower|beatmania IIDX 33 Sparkle Shower]], it is available for play in regular cabinets, although it still required to have been unlocked beforehand. *** It was later made purchasable in beatmania IIDX 33 Sparkle Shower with [[AC Sparkle Shower/Hizou no record|Hizou no record]] (秘蔵のレコード) from January 8th, 2026. ** Since September 11th, 2025, it can be purchased in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR with PCB. * Ambivalent Vermilia marks the first usage of Yoshitaka Nishimura's Suzaku alias in over ''15'' years, since [[Himiko|卑弥呼]] in [[AC EMPRESS|beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS]]. * Although Ambivalent Vermilia has a unique video in beatmania IIDX, it is not used in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * The jacket credits for Ambivalent Vermilia, G2ARTS (which stands for '''G'''RAPHIC - from '''2'''DX - '''ARTS'''), refers to an artwork section of the beatmania IIDX websites that was present up to beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS'. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses Ambivalent Vermilia's MAXIMUM jacket as its jacket. * When Ambivalent Vermilia was first revealed during the February 14th, 2024 stream of ''[[BEMANI PRO LEAGUE]] -SEASON 3- SOUND VOLTEX'', the bottom text of its jacket was displayed as "SOUND VOLTEX" instead of "BPL S3 Triple Tribe". * Ambivalent Vermilia is playable as an EXTRA EXCLUSIVE song in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]] from February 27th, 2025. * Ambivalent Vermilia is available in [[CS SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR コナステ]] from March 13th, 2025, by purchasing '''Konasute SOUND VOLTEX BEMANI Selection Music Pack vol.3''' (コナステ版 SOUND VOLTEX BEMANI セレクション 楽曲パック vol.3). == Song Production Information == === BEMANI Sound Team "Nidaime Suzaku" === Did you know? "[[Shuuen no Claudia]]" somehow seemed to have Suzaku wails [[AC RB colette Autumn|in 2013]].
Going back further from there, "Himiko" had Suzaku wails in 2008, which turned many players into dust. ... And now, 2024 is here.
Finally after a long time, a brand-new legendary song co-produced with my predecessor "Suzaku" has Suzaku wails this time. If you were to compare the brand-new Suzaku wailing song to a doll creation, I first asked my predecessor to draw a face, which I roughly sketched as a faceless being, then we finally both applied makeup to it while saying this and that, and made it as a groovy song. Since I usually immediately start drawing from the face, it was quite refreshing to create it without being able to predict what it looks like, and when it was completed, I think it resulted in an overflowing Suzaku wailing collaboration which felt quite good. So, we've delivered a song with several Suzaku wails as usual, and by all means, please try to count how many Suzaku wails there actually are throughout this song. Please comment this on my behalf! That's why I'd be happy if you enjoy the "Suzaku duo" story filled with my predecessor's feelings. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A slightly extended version of Broken can be found on the ''REFLEC BEAT ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK''. ** ポップンリズミン and the beatmania IIDX series use this extended version of Broken. * A remix of Broken by [[iroha(sasaki)]], titled [[Broken 8cmix]], can be found in [[AC SDVX|SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH]]. * A long version of Broken appears on dj TAKA's second album, [[True Blue...]]. * A remix of Broken by [[Genki Hikota|DJ Genki]], titled ''Broken -DJ Genki Remix-'', also appears on dj TAKA's second album, True Blue.... == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Broken is unlocked in REFLEC BEAT by reaching Level 100. ** In [[AC RB limelight|REFLEC BEAT limelight]], it is unlocked by reaching the third part of Glass Stage 1-3. It is the 24th old REFLEC BEAT song in limelight unlocked via Glass Stage. ** In [[AC RB colette|REFLEC BEAT colette]], it is unlocked by reaching Stage 9 of Pastel Adventure (パステルアドベンチャー) in Reflecting Mountain (初代リフレク山). ** From [[AC RB groovin'!!|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!]] to [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], Broken was available by default. * Retroactively, Broken is the first REFLEC BEAT song to have a chart rated Level 10+, and subsequently Level 11. * Unlocking Broken in REFLEC BEAT or limelight also unlocks the song in beatmania IIDX 18 Resort Anthem or [[AC Lincle|beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle]], as part of [[Lincle LINK]] 1. ** As of June 27th, 2012, it can be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle or [[AC tricoro|beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro]] by reaching Q-pro Level 45 (as part of Lincle LINK 5). It is the seventh and last Lincle LINK 1 song in beatmania IIDX to be unlocked this way. ** As of May 14th, 2014, Broken is instantly unlocked in [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]] if an [[e-amusement|eAMUSEMENT]] PASS is used. * Broken can be unlocked in jubeat saucer from April 1st, 2013 as part of the [[Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon!]] (パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン!) crossover event with REFLEC BEAT colette. It is the first unlockable song of the 2nd Meeting, after Pastel-kun completes 10 laps around the track. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from May 1st, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * Broken received RENEWAL charts in [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]], unlockable as part of the fourth phase of the ''Pastel-kun to Gakkii-hakase no dokidoki rhythm kenkyujou'' (パステルくんとガッキー博士のドキドキリズム研究所) event. They could be unlocked after assembling the ''Eye Bells'' (アイベル) instrument. ** In REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, these charts were playable by default. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], Broken was revived on June 8th, 2017. ** Its WHITE HARD chart could be unlocked through a quest in Reflesia Mode (リフレシアモード) from June 15th to 28th, 2017. *** As of January 25th, 2018, it is available by default. * Broken was added to [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] on July 5th, 2017 as part of the July 2017 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From August 2019, it can be purchased with BITs. * Broken's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * Broken is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from April 24th, 2023, by purchasing '''SPECIAL music pack feat.REFLEC BEAT vol.2''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.REFLEC BEAT vol.2). ** By purchasing this pack with an active subscription, Broken can be played in DanceDanceRevolution A3. ** From April 30th, 2024 in DanceDanceRevolution A3, it is available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === dj TAKA === It was decided early on that I would compose two songs for REFLEC BEAT. "I would like a trance song with a sad melody and foreign vocals, similar to [[Colors (radio edit)|Colors]]" was the request I received from [[Yoshitaka Nishimura|Yoshitaka]].
As he is someone that has done so much for IIDX, I do not think I could bring myself to refuse his request, so I tried my best. However, it caught me off guard when I heard that this was going to be used for the last song.

}} == Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of C-C-C-N-N-N, titled ''C-C-C-N-N-N F-U-L-L M-I-X'', appears in the [[beatmania IIDX 30 RESIDENT ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] album. * A remix of C-C-C-N-N-N by [[Liqo]], titled ''C-C-C-N-N-N 【Liqo Remix】'', appears in RoughSketch's [[With Skreaming Friendz]] album. == Trivia == * C-C-C-N-N-N is one of the unlocks of the [[BEMANI PRO LEAGUE -SEASON 3- Triple Tribe]] event. It could be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution A3 from August 17th to October 16th, 2023 for 20th anniversary model cabinets only. ** In [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], it could be unlocked from August 29th, 2024 through ''EXTRA SAVIOR WORLD''. *** From August 27th, 2026, it is available by default. * C-C-C-N-N-N being crossed over marks Aika Takahashi's first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * C-C-C-N-N-N's video eliminates any on-screen dancers in DanceDanceRevolution A3 and [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]. * C-C-C-N-N-N received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, unlockable from August 29th, 2024 through EXTRA SAVIOR WORLD after having unlocked C-C-C-N-N-N, [[DIABLOSIS::Naga|DIABLOSIS::Nāga]], and [[suspicions]]. * C-C-C-N-N-N was playable as an EXTRA EXCLUSIVE song in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX from August 29th, 2024. ** From August 27th, 2026, it is available by default. * C-C-C-N-N-N is available in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.25''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.25). == Song Production Information == === Aikapin === Good morning everyone! Or good evening! This is Aikapin.
This collaboration with RoughSkreamZ is our second time since "[[Hanakanmuri feat.Aikapin]]", isn't it?
I feel truly honored to have such an opportunity again. Several years have passed since our last collaboration, and I feel like I've matured quite a bit (in my own way), so I tried to reflect that in my singing style this time.
It feels a bit more adult and cool, doesn't it??
While singing this song, I thought, growing older isn't so bad after all.
Thirty years old! Fun! Yeah! Everyone, let's keep partying no matter how old we get.
That's the feeling I'm delivering with this song! === DD "Nakata" Metal === It's your familiar guy again, DD "Nakata" Metal, responsible for the weird male vocals.
This time, I created the lyrics and did the vocals for a slightly playful festival song, delivering it with a relaxed vibe.
The lyrics are entirely in English, and even I admit there are some parts that don't make much sense, but hey, it's a party song, so let's not sweat the details!
What matters is the groove and the energy, woohoo!!
Also, congrats to IIDX on reaching its 30th release, woohoo!!
When the chorus melody starts sticking in your head, it's the signal for the party to begin. Let's go all out with claps and noise and make some noise!! === inkaku === Hello everyone,
I'm inkaku, responsible for the thick strings.
Wow, time flies, doesn't it? Congratulations on IIDX 30!!!
As the weather has been getting warmer, I tried to suppress the urge to create something light and fluffy. Instead, I went for something heavy and manly—sorry about that! To achieve this sound, I ate a lot of rice to fuel up. It's a piece that'll put you in a good mood, so please give it a try! === NUE === Hello hello~! NUE here, the guitar player. First of all, congratulations on reaching the 30th installment of IIDX!
I'm truly delighted to be able to participate in such a major milestone!!
This time, it's a song that's both party-like and hard, with a touch of chaos! The guitar sound is packed with distortion! I also joined in for the chorus recording, which is also heavily distorted! RoughSkreamZ is always full of energy! Please enjoy "C-C-C-N-N-N"! === RoughSketch === Good morning! I'm RoughSketch from beatnation RHYZE and Notebook Records!
Congratulations on the 30th release of beatmania IIDX!!
C-C-C-N-N-N is RoughSkreamZ's celebratory party song!
Alongside the RoughSkreamZ members, we also had the help of Aikapin, and together we created this lively and bustling track!
It's a loud party overflowing with masculine energy!
Let's make some noise! (Please follow the rules of each arcade and cheer with your heart!) == Video Production Information == === BEMANI Designers "Aki" === Time flows after making the bear cat dance...
Hearing that IIDX has reached 30th, the mood is celebratory!! Everywhere.
That feeling has been directly channeled into this movie. When you listen to the song, you'll find it impossible not to dance, so please be careful while playing. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

But at the same time, I had a lot of fun arranging a song created by NAOKI. I actually want to remix many other NAOKI's songs.
NAOKI, please let me do it someday!! === DanceDanceRevolution Community === Another great collaboration between NAOKI and jun.
