The legend is revived here and now. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== [[Jun Wakita|wac]] ==== Hello to those who love Concertino in Blue everywhere. I'm wac.
I get it. You're probably asking "who are you and what happened to Sasaki", but well, it's OK, let's calm down and discuss its notecharts.
Thank you for waiting. I received a comment from Sasaki! Hooray, Sasaki's on time, he's on time, right? Hey!
Well then, Sasaki, go ahead! ==== Hirofumi Sasaki ==== Hello. I'm Hirofumi Sasaki.
Thank you very much for your comment, wac. I'm sorry for being late.
Did I make it on time? Was I close? I went to an amusement spot after a long time to see the new game, and I was able to watch and listen to videos and sounds of players playing from behind.
When I listened to it after a long time, I thought I created a messy song, and there are moments where it sounds clear, yet flashy, but I also remember that I didn't like it much when I initially made it. It's too much like me. Now that I think of it, there are things that can only be created at the moment, and life has encounters and connections, and come to think of it, I somehow wrote that tqy had a mustache when I met him, Well, see you somewhere ＾＾ === GUITARFREAKS 7thMIX & drummania 6thMIX Official Website === ==== Hirofumi Sasaki ==== What I wanted to do recently is to "establish a unit with Izumi and perform a progressive live".
I'll come back to this.
Every time I request for him to play a crazy music score for my songs, he always does it with a smile, and something even more progressive returns to me... this is already my [[The Least 100sec|third]] [[Kodomo no rakugaki chou|song]], but if I didn't join this company and encounter Izumi, none of these songs would've probably been born.
So this time, the guitar is even more at the center than in 100sec., and it became a guitar concerto.
The guitar/piano, and of course the drums/bass, became even more intense, independent, and united. === GUITARFREAKS 7thMIX & drummania 6thMIX Soundtracks === ==== Hirofumi Sasaki ==== Hello, I've recently liked crossover (a fusion of two music genres), and this time, I tried to bring out music in the "Romantic era", which represented Europe in the 19th century, into a "blue" world. Usually, I'm not foolish to say that I "don't like" Chopin, a composer who represented that era, or Rachmaninoff, who had a late Romantic era color, but when I tried to make a "crossover" like this, it was more pleasant than I thought.... by all means, I hope you'll taste this pleasant feeling.
How was it? Did it feel pleasant? Huh?
.... I wonder if there's a fate of an ENCORE...!? == Video Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== tqy ==== Finally, "Concertino in Blue" has been crossed over to IIDX, and I was asked by [[Gyo Eguchi|GYO]] to provide materials for its video. So, I searched around and looked for old data, but due to its rough resolution and various other reasons, it isn't very good and can't be used in that state.
Then, I tried to recreate the video by redrawing it with some modifications to match the horizontal screen. As a basic principle, I tried not to change its image as much as possible since it's a popular song, but it felt that it wouldn't be appropriate for IIDX if I kept it the same....
I had quite some trouble making it like that. When redrawing it, I noticed I previously drew detailed parts very carelessly, like the fingers holding the flute (I was surprised to see it), so I studied drawings by watching classical concert footage.
But when I saw the video afterwards, there wasn't much progress, right? (bitter smile) But, it's been a while, I carefully listened to "Concertino in Blue" after how many years?
Come to think of it, slightly before I remade this video, I just met Sasaki after a long time.
There's something called a "connection", right? Bye then. === GuitarFreaks & DrumMania === ==== tQy ==== Well, it's progressive. It's an ENCORE.
This time, Sasaki's melody is clear. When I first listened to the demo, I thought "this is amazing".
I was making snow textures during the start of the New Year, while wondering if it was snowing throughout the city when this game would be released. == Character Information == === shio === Here's "OTOBEAR (blue)". His colors are beautifully separated! Since this song, movie, and Maurizio are all legendary to those who've played Gitadora, I wanted to cross over as much of its atmosphere as possible, not just the song, and I added animations referenced from the data provided by its movie creator tQy. (Thank you very much for taking time off despite being busy!)
The impressive tile patterns in the movie made my eyes flicker in the background, so I made it like that song card, and with these thoughts... I hope they came..!
I'd be happy if you smile a bit at its "likeness", such as the snow falling with the other musical notes, and the lovely cobalt blue choice, which I wouldn't~ be able to establish just a shade of "blue". == Staff Comments == === Ta === Progressive.

What's difficult is the odd time signature, in irregular time.

But this song might be easier to understand.

== Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == Under the deep, deep sea, lives a siren.
If we didn't meet, would we have never known these feelings...? === shio === Since SHION is a yukionna, let's go with a mermaid next!
And it feels like Yoshi-kun firmly decided on it.
Yoshi-kun was busy, so I was very worried since the character was created first, but I was glad to receive a cool song!
I created detailed animations for her.
Her design was inspired by the story of The Little Mermaid, so I tried to express her fixed gaze from the sadness and frustration of not being able to talk to the person she loves, even when he's close.
Unfortunately, she's a fish, and a different species... I wanted to mix her prettiness with an eerie feeling, so people wouldn't relate to her.
I had a stronger impression of "The Red Candle and the Mermaid", which I read when I was a child, than The Little Mermaid, so mermaids somehow have a scary image. They feel very beautiful, pure, and cruel. But, when I thought about the story of The Little Mermaid once again, the story isn't really satisfying. Andersen is heartless. Did something very bad happen to him back then? == Staff Comments == === PON === And, that's what it feels like.
In these times, there are comments like this, too. === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === This is the first audio comment! === [[tokky]] === The spinning background noise sounds like a whirlpool or splashes, and sounds cool!
An image of swimming in a torrent comes to my mind. === [[Ryo Sugawara|Ga~su~]] === The high-speed feeling is impressive!
The guitar at the end is especially cool! Everyone, please love it as well. === [[Chihiro Inoue|Chihi]] === I'm impressed that shio worked very hard...
It feels like there weren't many young female characters who were fully wholehearted~
From the moment you start walking, you'll be moved by various flashback scenes! === [[Ryuta Tamura|TAMA]] === This is a moist, steady, cool, and sad song.
I'm looking forward to his next upper song. === [[Jun Wakita|wac]] === Yoshi-kun seems to be the busiest man in the BEMANI world now.
It was very difficult for him in many ways, but in the end, he created a nice song, with a water splash.
I wasn't going to repay him, but I didn't create a song for [[AC RB limelight|limelight]].
I'm sorry!!! === [[Yuki Shibata|Mameshiba]] === This is the [[Mermaid girl|second]] mermaid song.
It feels like KIRARA is a bright idol mermaid, but MANA feels like she has a dark side. But, she's nice.
I like the end of the chorus.
Let's all feel excited! The unlock quest, "The Voice from the Deep Sea", appears after clearing the "Tired Madam", "Therefore, she's female", and "Idol Mermaid Concert" quests.
"Therefore, she's female" is a red quest, with the [https://web.archive.org/web/20180908103330/http://www.konami.jp/bemani/popn/music20/mc/12/12_04.html unlock conditions stated here].
"Idol Mermaid Concert" is also a red quest, with the [https://web.archive.org/web/20160525224013/http://www.konami.jp/bemani/popn/music20/mc/15/15_04.html unlock conditions stated here]. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see [[AC jb Qubell/QUBE Availability|this page]]. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * Megalara Garuda is the only unlock in dig dig Qubell to utilise the ''RISKY UNLOCK CHALLENGE'' mechanic, which is significantly harder than normal UNLOCK CHALLENGEs. * Megalara Garuda was the ''only'' jubeat song in the entire series rated Level 10, the highest level, on all difficulty levels on the old 1-10 scale. The charts are made by MICHI, [[Hiroyuki Masuda|まっする]], and RAG, respectively. ** It is the first ever jubeat song rated Level 10.0 or higher on BASIC, and was one of only two jubeat Qubell songs rated Level 10 on ADVANCED, the other being [[Sky High]]. ** It is also the first jubeat song whose BASIC chart has ''more'' notes than the ADVANCED and EXTREME notecounts. ** It was also the first song in any BEMANI series with all the charts rated the highest level (not counting series with no different ratings between difficulty levels, such as KEYBOARDMANIA). * With 932 notes, Megalara Garuda's BASIC chart has the most notes of ''any'' jubeat BASIC chart, beating out previous record holder [[Elemental Creation -GITADO ROCK ver.-]]'s 586. ** With 912 notes, Megalara Garuda's ADVANCED chart has the fifth most notes of any jubeat ADVANCED chart, after [[Thanatos|Thanatøs]]'s 1049, [[Crackpot Evangelist]]'s 1039, [[XENOViA]]'s 923, and [[Confiserie]]'s 919 notes. * Megalara Garuda marks Shunsuke Sato's debut in BEMANI. * The ''Megalara garuda'' is a species of large wasp. It was discovered in 2011 on the Mekongga Mountains, in the southeastern part of the Indonesian island of Sulawesi. ** The species is named after the garuda, the national symbol of Indonesia; it is a giant bird-like creature. ** Megalara Garuda's jacket features an illustration of the male of the species stylized to be made of mechanical components. ** According to SYUNN in jubeat Qubell's booklet comments, Megalara Garuda's title was chosen because he started composing music in the same year the wasp species was discovered. * Megalara Garuda is part of the [[Maishuu! Ichika no chou BEMANI rush 2020]] (毎週！いちかの超BEMANIラッシュ2020) event. It could be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 27 HEROIC VERSE from September 23rd, 2020 until October 28th, 2020. ** From February 14th, 2022, it could be purchased in [[AC CastHour|beatmania IIDX 29 CastHour]] with [[AC CastHour/Archive Links|Archive Links]] (アーカイブリンク). ** As of [[AC RESIDENT|beatmania IIDX 30 RESIDENT]], it is available by default. * Megalara Garuda also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of the '''Qubell pack 17'''. * Megalara Garuda is available in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] from February 9th, 2022 by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS jubeat Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS jubeat セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). * Megalara Garuda is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from June 24th, 2022, by purchasing '''SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.1''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.1). ** Its CHALLENGE charts become available by purchasing both this and '''SPECIAL music pack feat.jubeat vol.2''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.jubeat vol.2). ** By purchasing both packs with an active subscription, Megalara Garuda and its CHALLENGE charts could be played in DanceDanceRevolution A3. ** From June 30th, 2023 in DanceDanceRevolution A3, it is available by default for all players. * Megalara Garuda is the first song in DanceDanceRevolution to have its DIFFICULT charts be rated Level 16, the highest for that difficulty. ** This mimicks Megalara Garuda's jubeat charts being initially rated Level 10 on all difficulty levels on the old 1-10 scale. * Megalara Garuda is available in pop'n music Lively as part of '''jubeat Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (ユビートセレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). * In the pop'n music series, instead of displaying its character's portrait, Megalara Garuda displays its jacket on the song selection screen. * Megalara Garuda is one of the unlocks of pop'n music UniLab's ''Kakusei no Elem'' (覚醒のエルム) unlocking system. It can be unlocked from August 15th, 2024. ** It received UPPER charts in pop'n music UniLab, which are also unlockable in 覚醒のエルム. They can be unlocked from August 22nd, 2024. ** In [[AC pnm Jam&Fizz|pop'n music Jam&Fizz]], both Megalara Garuda and its UPPER charts can be unlocked in the ''Kakusei no Elem Puchi'' (覚醒のエルム プチ) event from August 28th, 2025. ** As of [[AC pnm High Cheers!!|pop'n music High☆Cheers!!]], both are available by default since December 25th, 2025. * Megalara Garuda is not included in the CS category in the arcade pop'n music titles. * Megalara Garuda received a Battle NORMAL chart in pop'n music UniLab. * Megalara Garuda(UPPER)'s EX chart has a [[Spicy Gauge]]. * Megalara Garuda was added to [[CS ULTIMATE MOBILE|beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE]] on December 19th, 2024. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == None. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It was our first time doing this arrangement exchange for English songs. This song was created by me (jun) and rearranged by NAOKI.
I gave NAOKI a rough version of this song and a few days later, I was pleasantly surprised by this remix. I have never imagined that the song would sound like this! NAOKI often remixes my songs for TЁЯRA. But this remix was so different from other remixes. I was impressed again with NAOKI's broad range of abilities. NAOKI's sound is truly deep. === NAOKI === I liked this tune created by jun, so I was happy to rearrange this. === DanceDanceRevolution Community === jun's mastery of melody softly carries Godis's voice higher and higher, never letting you down. This time, Nekomata is in charge of the composition. I only created the musical parts without adding color to it, and gave it to TAKA. As a result, I think this song's output has that balance. (This is a Nekomata composition, with a solid arrangement and sound of a TAKA song) Please enjoy this song with an unprecedented atmosphere. === BEMANI Sound Team "dj TAKA" === Although I've previously collaborated with Nekomata many times, this is actually my first collaboration song just with him.
I was surprised by the quite high quality demo when I first received it, and even thought that it'd be better to leave it without doing anything, but I tried to create a sound which fuses jazzy elements with a rhythm game-like base by layering chords and phrases that I interpreted.
I tried to pay attention to the packed feeling of how the bass serves as the bridge between these 2 elements, so I'd be happy if you can listen to that too. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It could be purchased with 200 T-emo from February 4th to March 4th, 2019. ** It could be purchased again with 150 T-emo from August 5th to September 1st, 2019, from March 2nd to April 6th, 2020, from June 1st to July 6th, 2020, and from October 5th to November 2nd, 2020. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * Wuv U also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of the '''festo pack 10'''. * Wuv U is available in [[CS pnm Lively|pop'n music Lively]] by purchasing '''pop'n music Lively Music Pack vol.6''' (pop'n music Lively 楽曲パック vol.6). * Wuv U is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX from August 10th, 2022, by pre-ordering the DanceDanceRevolution Dedicated Controller (DanceDanceRevolution 専用コントローラ). ** By pre-ordering the controller while having an active subscription, Wuv U can be played in DanceDanceRevolution A3. ** From August 28th, 2023 in DanceDanceRevolution A3, it is available by default for all players. * Wuv U received a slightly different jacket in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Wuv U's pop'n music Lively ratings were adjusted to its [[AC pnm UniLab|UniLab]] ratings on October 31st, 2022. * In DanceDanceRevolution A3 and GRAND PRIX, Wuv U's BPM is listed as 173 for all of its difficulties. == Music Comment == Untranslated. == Song Production Information == === kors k === I remember this! I remember it so much!
Wuv U started production during the peak of summer. This is the third song in the CANDY series, after [[SigSig]] and [[smooooch|smooooch・∀・]]. However, the hurdles were too high and the progress in making this song was slow. Although I had no time to spare, I reopened my door (!?) and went to an outdoor festival and had a BBQ at the beach with my old friends. So I made this song with an "IRL enjoyment" tension (laughs). The slightly reggae-like intro gives the song a summery taste.
The overall tension of the song is very high, but the feeling of loneliness and melancholy on it reflects the sun slowly setting and summer fading away! I like the way the bass flows in the latter half of the song.
By the way, the three CANDY girls and the funny title are inseparable from MAYA's illustration!
Wuv U is a tongue-in-cheek way of saying Love You.
It's a word that was used in an American cartoon set in a world 1000 years in the future that I'm into. It's saying "Love You" in a baby-like voice, and it was so cute that I used it in the title this time!
And, taking into account the word and its meaning, MAYA's three girls have evolved into the cutest catgirls ever!
Ye~ah, they are just too cute! I'm proud to say that Wuv U has become a song that everyone will love for a very long time! ＾ｗ＾ Wuv Wuv! == Character Information == None. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * 鳳 contains and shares various sound samples representing the DanceDanceRevolution series: ** The "sound!" vocal sample with the [[PARANOiA]] song series and [[R10K|R壱萬]]. ** The "electric" vocal sample with the PARANOiA song series. ** The drum loops with PARANOiA, [[LOVE IS ORANGE]], and [[Superior MAXXX]]. ** The "Do you think about me?" vocal sample with [[EGOISM 440]]. ** The DanceDanceRevolution startup sound. ** The "DDR" vocal sample with [[TRIP MACHINE]], [[New Decade]], [[ALPACORE]], [[New Era]], [[Aria]], [[New Millennium]], [[Steps for Victory]], and Superior MAXXX. ** The "revolution" vocal sample with [[AC DDR 1st|DanceDanceRevolution]]'s intro screen, [[DEAD END]], [[DDR MEGAMIX]], and New Millennium. * 鳳 shares the "be quiet" vocal sample with [[Be quiet]] and [[PATRIOTISM]]. * A remix of 鳳 by [[Coyaan]] + [[Yuichi Asami|U1]], titled [[Hou (Five Flares Mix)|鳳 (Five Flares Mix)]], appears in the [[BABY-LON'S GALAXY Special CD vol.2|BABY-LON'S GALAXYスペシャルCD vol.2]] album. ** It was later added to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. == Trivia == * 鳳 is the ENCORE EXTRA STAGE of the ''BABY-LON'S GALAXY'' event of DanceDanceRevolution A3. It could be accessed after unlocking and clearing the charts of [[Come To m1dy]], [[SISYPHUS]], and [[New Millennium]] on the same difficulty level on GALAXY PLAY. ** From November 1st, 2023, its CHALLENGE charts were made available to play. ** From November 30th, 2023, its EXPERT charts were made available to play. ** From December 7th, 2023, its DIFFICULT charts were made available to play. ** From December 21st, 2023, its BEGINNER and BASIC charts were made available to play. *** As of DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, it is available by default. * [[BABY-LON]] appears in 鳳's video. ** In DanceDanceRevolution A3 and [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], 鳳's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * 鳳 is the first DanceDanceRevolution song with a chart rated Level 19 on either Single or Double to have any kanji in its name. * 鳳's Single CHALLENGE chart has the highest possible single-song EX Score of all non-Long Version songs, with 3,198, beating the record of 3,030 by [[MAX 360]]'s Single CHALLENGE chart. * 鳳's charts (except BEGINNER and CHALLENGE) reference PARANOiA's charts at their respective difficulties and play styles during the 228 BPM sections after the "be quiet" and "electric" vocal samples, as well as the brief 228 BPM slowdown between the 456 BPM sections, along with EGOISM 440's charts during the "Do you think about me?" section. * 鳳 is the second song in the DanceDanceRevolution series to have its DIFFICULT charts rated Level 16, after [[Megalara Garuda]]. * 鳳's Single CHALLENGE and Double CHALLENGE charts have CHAOS values of 310 and 312, respectively, making it the first DanceDanceRevolution song with charts that have any values above 300. ** With a total of 897 (STREAM: 191, VOLTAGE: 262, AIR: 54, FREEZE: 80, CHAOS: 310), 鳳's Single CHALLENGE chart has the largest [[GROOVE RADAR]] of any Single chart in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** With a total of 864 (STREAM: 193, VOLTAGE: 241, AIR: 38, FREEZE: 80, CHAOS: 312), 鳳's Double CHALLENGE chart also has the largest GROOVE RADAR of any Double chart in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * 鳳 is available in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode from "A mysterious insect breakthrough!" I tried to liken Shoccho to an insect expert.
The jacket has a small Shoccho signature on it. Since it's a ladybug, I thought "anyways, let's make an impressive, lovely red jacket!"
And I was suddenly inspired. However, I don't like insects... looking for materials is punishing.
When I decided its theme, Shoccho, [[Erina Takeda|T_da]], and I looked at ladybug images on the internet...
It's even doing samba.
The ladybug was doing samba on the monitor. I have fond memories of being the only person to stare somewhere far away with blank eyes. == Chart Production Information == === BASIC & ADVANCED === ==== Shoccho ==== No~, that's biased, isn't it~? It's seriously biased.
I think it's difficult for your hands to go crazy here and there.
It's not in response to that, but the BASIC and ADVANCED notecharts are "mine, by me, for me".
No, of course, I'd also like everyone to enjoy playing them!
I mean, I wish I made the tempo slightly slower (hey!). === EXTREME === ==== MUSCLE ==== Although Shoccho's speaking nonsense, as a sound director, he's seen me working on many difficult boss class songs (that's all), so I wanted to have more people enjoy Shoccho! I made it with that concept in mind.
The song is much milder than previous Shoccho songs.
Well actually, it hasn't really been officially announced, but it's written as s-c-u and read as Shoccho!
Nanahoshi's creator is s-c-u and Shoccho.
Nevertheless, even though you might've read Shoccho on blogs and Twitter, he hasn't composed any songs, right?
s-c-u hasn't appeared, right? Perhaps, there's some people who think this?? == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

It can be unlocked from June 4th, 2025. * 量子の海のリントヴルム's HARD and INFLUENCE chart were re-rated in ポラリスコード on March 23rd, 2026. == Music Comment == The story of the dragon and the girl begins here... watch out for the dynamic keyboard performance and the progressive development! == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== Kuroneko Dungeon ==== That girl-- That blue-haired girl... she was alone gathering fragments in this collapsed world She seems to be collecting the fragments in one place There appears to be a silhouette deep inside that place ... Is it some kind of ritual--? "Please... don't come here again..." That's what the girl, who was connected to the giant dragon, Lindwurm, quietly said. Alone in the floating quantum sea, where the universe collapses into fragments of infinite possibilities There's no doubt this girl standing with the dragon holds the key to the collapsed world... Meow! So, Ryoushi no umi's story returns with a movie by the great master isonin, meow! You're probably at the mercy of this very mysterious movie. Meow! Maud, Lilieze, the hero. What'll happen to these 3 people in the future? Sorry for being late, meow, my name is Kuroneko Dungeon. When you say it in French, it's Chat Noir Donjon, meow. Meow! === jubeat === Untranslated. == Video Production Information == === isonin === Recently, I've been addicted to fried rice. There's a Chinese restaurant in a slightly luxurious 8-floor building, but anyways, it's so delicious that when I was eating, it feels like a force blowing me away, as if time had stopped. Today, I'm looking at the wide cityscape below me, while filling my mouth with fried rice. "The first time I heard KuroDun's announcement was at a Chinese restaurant..."
I was lost in thought. That time, the shop was in a small neighborhood that looks nothing like here. "Ryoushi no umi no Lindwurm" Kuroneko Dungeon's first song.
A few days later, I drew the jacket for this song. It's been a year since then... time flies by so fast. The city is peaceful and the fried rice is delicious.
I'm also eating fried rice like this today.
Even though I'm chased by busy days, I feel happy to be able to enjoy the taste of fried rice. I need to spread the word about this delicious fried rice.
Let's tell the world about how I'm fulfilled by fried rice. My very natural thoughts flowed well, like a sense of purpose. Beep, beep, beep. Just as I took my mobile phone out from my bag, I received a new email. This is rare for me, as someone with few friends. --------------------
The quantum sea has returned! Meow!
-------------------- A few minutes later, my phone exploded.
KuroDun successfully used the latest tools in our information-filled current society. This time, the heroic story is that I used up all my stylus refills?
I like using the felt-type core, but it immediately wears out and breaks. Previously, I gave the pen part of the stylus (=the crucial part) to [[Erina Takeda|T_da]], who lost it, but "isonin's pen tip is fluffy! It's fluffy!" I remembered that she said this. == Jacket Design Information == === isonin === At a certain Chinese restaurant, the team members were eating together.
[[Shigeharu Saeki|Shoccho]], who sat next to me, stood up like he was suddenly struck by lightning, pointed at me and said "It's a last boss-like song, meow! isonin, please do it, meow!" Shoccho stared at the shrimp chili in front of him, as if he was controlled by someone.
It was strange.
Having said this, the conversation ended without incidents. A few days later, on a certain afternoon, Kuroneko approached my feet while I was working at my desk. "I made an amazing song, meow! I'll leave the rest to you, meow!" After KuroDun talked about Lindwurm's world for a while, he started grooming my knees and fell asleep shortly. I was also captivated by it, and just as I dozed off, my sight suddenly became pitch black and my body felt lighter. When I squinted, a small, light blue light flickered in front of me.
When I hesitantly approached that light, a small girl with flowing blue hair looked at me and murmured something.
However, her voice was so soft that I couldn't hear what she said, and I was engulfed in light and lost consciousness. When I suddenly woke up, KuroDun wasn't there, and this jacket was already completed on my computer screen.
How strange is that?
I tilted my head, submitted it to T_da and said "it's done.". == Character Information == A girl who was born with a dragon, and looks towards the end of the world with it.
I wonder what's the story of those eyes. === isonin === Well, I guess I'll return home now... While staying up late, the office floor had few people in it.
I tidied up my work, and prepared to return home. Zuddon garararadon gororodosa When I looked up in surprise at the loud noise, TOMOSUKE, who was covered in bruises on the desk, rolled around while clutching his knees.
Even though we're in Kobe, why... is TOMOSUKE... here...?
TOMOSUKE slowly got up, while supporting his body which was about to collapse any moment, and opened his mouth. "Next time, next time... the 9 buttons... meow!" It's here. This is an announcement from KuroDun.
I don't know why KuroDun somehow always controls someone else to commands me.
Why would he do this to TOMOSUKE, who I'm not related to? It doesn't matter. "Thank you very much!!" Anyways, the opportunity has finally arrived, I can work in pop'n!
I threw the bag I was holding, yelled in victory, and ran around the floor.
Although I thought I heard TOMOSUKE scream, that wasn't the time now.
I was running around in a daze, that I almost lost track of the time for a while.
And before I knew it, TOMOSUKE was no longer there. Of course, my first long battle to create animations for Maud and Lindwurm will begin from now.
Just before the deadline, I thought to myself in front of the computer about how difficult making animations was.
Hats off to the pop'n designers.
I thought my right hand was going to explode. == Chart Production Information == === MUSCLE === The jacket was already made when I created the notecharts, so I made them with the complete image.
I wanted to express a speedy feeling like advancing through a dungeon, running through chaos, and through flames spreading from above and under. Just by looking at the charts, that scene... does it come to mind?? How is it? == Difficulty & Notecounts == BeatStream difficulty rated from 1 to Kami (神) in アニムトライヴ.

== Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * 羊皮紙の上の銀河 is the first ''ノスタルジア STAGE'' unlock of the ''NAVIfes'' (ナビフェス) unlocking system. It can be unlocked in pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢 from July 5th, 2018. ** As of November 26th, 2018 in [[AC pnm peace|pop'n music peace]], it is available by default. ** In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, 羊皮紙の上の銀河 displays its jacket on the song selection screen. * 羊皮紙の上の銀河 is the third song in the main pop'n music series that is not sung by Sanae Shintani but has SANAE♥chan as the rival character, after [[Yes! Yuyuyu YuruYuri|いぇす！ゆゆゆ☆ゆるゆり♪♪]] and the original [[Hikari no kisetsu|光の季節]]. * The last three digits of the PT required to unlock 羊皮紙の上の銀河 in pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢 (1301 PT) are a reference to March 1st, the day when ノスタルジア was released. * 羊皮紙の上の銀河 received a Real chart in [[AC NST Op.2|ノスタルジア Op.2]] on May 2nd, 2019. * 羊皮紙の上の銀河 is one of the ''COURSE TRIAL A3'' unlocks. It could be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution A3 by playing the GALAXY course once from May 18th to June 14th, 2023. ** From June 15th, 2023 onwards, it can be unlocked by playing the aforementioned course multiple times. ** As of [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], it is available by default. * 羊皮紙の上の銀河 being crossed over marks OSTER project's first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * 羊皮紙の上の銀河 is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 13th, 2025, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.3''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.3). == Music Comment == Infinitely birthed melodies become the universe == Song Production Information == === [[Jun Wakita|wac]] === OSTER can do anything and excels at playing the piano, so I wondered about asking her various things such as jazz, grand classical, or R&B, but in the end, I wanted to include a vocal song, so I asked her to create "a pop song with a lot of piano playing". There are many kinds of pop songs, but basically, OSTER creates pop songs that I like so much that I want to make it, and with a higher quality than what I'd make.
It's become a completely convenient world. The chord developments pierce through the sprinting syncopation. Sorako's clear singing voice is placed on a dancing piano.
This song is filled with pop elements that I like, and there's no doubt it's a song which represents NOSTALGIA. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

}} == Song Connections / Remixes == * 1998 (Sparky 2006) is a remix of [[1998]], from [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]]. * The full version of 1998 (Sparky 2006), credited to NAOKI presents WORLD WIDE STYLE, could be found in the ''KONAMI♪MUSICフル'' service. * A portion of 1998 (Sparky 2006) is featured in [[CS DDR HOTTEST PARTY3|DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY3]]'s [[HOTTEST PARTY]] nonstop megamix. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * 1998 (Sparky 2006) appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR HOTTEST PARTY Mega Hit Pack'''. ** Despite that DanceDanceRevolution S+ uses the 1 to 20 scale, 1998 (Sparky 2006) kept the same ratings that it had in DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY. * In DanceDanceRevolution / Dancing Stage HOTTEST PARTY, 1998 (Sparky 2006) uses the ''Double Stomp'' and ''Foot Missile'' gimmicks. * Early chart data for 1998 (Sparky 2006) can be found unused within the data of the North American release of DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY. A story that begins with an "A" and ends with a "period".
Since I was allowed to make one last song, I decided to do something I had wanted to do for a long time. The early DDR soundtracks were tied up with Dancemania, and Disc-1 was synonymous with the regular soundtrack and Disc-2 was a nonstop megamix. I really liked this and thought that when the TAG album came out, I would make Disc-2 a nonstop megamix. As it turned out, said album never came out, but I thought I'd try to make this nonstop megamix into a two-minute song. I wanted to include all of the TAG songs that debuted on DDR, but I couldn't fit them all in, so I put together a lineup that emphasized the composition of the songs, their connections, and my feelings about them. When you hear the title DDR TAGMIX, you might think that it's a TAG version of [[DDR MEGAMIX]]. Yes, there is that nuance, but it has another meaning. It's a fictional version of DDR featuring TAG. DDR has collaborated with [[AC DS TRUE KiSS DESTiNATiON|TRUE KiSS DESTiNATiON]], [[AC DS DREAMS COME TRUE|DREAMS COME TRUE]], [[AC DS Disney's RAVE|Disney]], and [[CS DDR MARIO|Super Mario]] in the past, so it would be easier to think of a TAG version of that. In the early days, the version names were counted as a number + mix, such as 2ndMIX, 3rdMIX, and so on, and I took advantage of this and called it TAGMIX because it's TAG. In this TAGMIX version, all the songs, system BGM, voices, etc. are made by TAG. I thought of a storyline where the TAG album to be released later is an album by an individual artist, but it's also the soundtrack to the fictional game "DanceDanceRevolution TAGMIX", and since it's a DDR soundtrack, Disc-2 is a nonstop megamix. In fact, if a TAG album was ever released, I was rather serious about naming it "DanceDanceRevolution TAGMIX Original Soundtrack". Come to think of it, TЁЯRA also tied up with a fictitious version in the form of "Dance Dance Revolution featuring TЁЯRA ～NON STOP MEGAMIX～" on their first album, and what they did is the same as this.
I think that the title and artist names made the designers cry, but the origins of each are as follows: '''underground'''
First seen in roppongi EVOLVED. It came from the tradition of the Wii DDR games to add "underground" to the artist names of their boss songs. After that, I decided to add this suffix whenever I made a hard song for a game. '''overlay'''
First seen in Over The “Period”. At that time, there was a negative rumor that DDR would end its service upon the appearance of [[MAX.(period)]] in arcades, so I named it with the intention of overriding that rumor. '''UNLEASHED'''
When I was working on this song, a new Gundam model was announced. Its name was "PG UNLEASHED 1/60 RX-78-2 GUNDAM". It's the culmination of PG (PERFECT GRADE), which is the highest grade. UNLEASHED means "set free", and there was nothing more appropriate to express my current feelings. In the first draft, I was going to put it in the title, but later I came up with the string "LAST DanceR", so I decided to put it in the artist name instead. '''DDR TAGMIX'''
As mentioned above, it can mean two things: a TAG version of DDR MEGAMIX, or a fictional DDR version featuring TAG. '''LAST DanceR'''
From the name of the ultimate aircraft in R-TYPE FINAL, the (then) final entry of the classic side-scrolling shooting series "R-TYPE". The name of the operation to protect the Earth from space threats, Operation Last Dance, was already an exciting development, but the name of the aircraft that would do it was very influential at the time. It was named "LAST DanceR" because it was the last song to be provided to a dance game called DDR. It's a very simple reason, but I thought there was nothing better than this. By the way, the mixed case letters in "DanceR" are borrowed from the name of Dance"DanceR"evolution, which is one of my favorite games.
Why do you need KONAMI ORIGINAL songs?
Because ... I ended my comment on Over The “Period” there because I wanted to leave it to your imagination without making any definite decision, since I'm sure that each reader would have their own interpretation and feelings about it. The sorrowful melody from HARD RENAISSANCE, explodes! == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === As the genre name HARD RENAISSANCE indicates, this song strongly keeps a classical atmosphere. Despite that, its melody is hard due to the somewhat strong high-speed and bass drums. The melody line, which is mainly centered on the developing synth and piano, has a somewhat sorrowful sense and a melancholic side. Even among the jubeat original songs, crossing this over to IIDX might've been inevitable due to its exceptional barrage style. There are probably many users who expected it to "perhaps be included here someday", right? === jubeat === ==== Evans ==== ===== DJ YOSHITAKA ===== This song is recently within the top three levels of my memories. When I went on a business trip to research jubeat's gameplay, I took a car and went to lunch with [[Harumi Ueko|Jimmy]], [[Yoshihiko Koezuka|OJ]], [[Kozo Nakamura|Kozo]], and [[Shigeharu Saeki|Shoccho]].
I rearranged parts of this song to emphasize the gameplay.... I remember many fun moments when I listen to it, although it's a dark song. Well, this song's main concept is a "deep-sea fish". I'm always surprised by their(!?) mystique. I wanted to create this song while voluntarily imagining what mystique is within their hearts.
It was worth remaking it once, and I think it resulted in a HARD RENAISSANCE feeling as I was requested.
But I digress, by all means, please try to play it at least once. Well then, let's meet again soon. ※I loved the jacket so much, that I unreasonably requested for the designer to provide me the image to use as my desktop. I did it! ==== Evans -prototype- ==== ===== DJ YOSHITAKA ===== To be honest, this version is more like Evans for me.
That's because this prototype has a clearer outline of the melody, so the scene and feelings I wanted to convey are depicted more clearly. This song wouldn't have been born if I didn't meet [[Hiroyuki Masuda|MUSCLE]] at that place on that day, and it became a song that taught me once again "how to make music". So please listen to.... [[Hakanaki wa waga ketsui]]. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == None. == Chart Production Information == === MUSCLE === And as usual, there are comments and no comments about this song.....
I'm MUSCLE, who created the notecharts for Evans. Well, it's becoming difficult. DJ YOSHITAKA started creating this song, and both of us were becoming too~ excited.
This song was largely remade halfway through its production....
When you play the BASIC, ADVANCED, EXTREME charts in that order, it feels easy to understand the difficulty progression, and you'll be one step closer to clearing it. Actually, I can barely clear EXTREME.
No, it's a world where it'd still be great to clear this. When I let someone better than me to play the chart I created, it's wonderful that they can surprisingly play it!
Then I adjusted it... and repeated that until it became what it's today. Let's all enjoy jubeat's most difficult song tomorrow with this song and MUSCLE!

I aimed for a cool and edgy song♪

There aren't special requirements to make it available. ** Once having played Twinkle Wonderland several times in its FINAL ROUND status, it will be unlocked indefinitely. ** In [[AC RB colette|REFLEC BEAT colette]], Twinkle Wonderland was unlocked by reaching the first part of limelight Mountain in Pastel Adventure. *** From [[AC RB groovin'!!|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!]] to [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], Twinkle Wonderland was playable by default. * Twinkle Wonderland marks Sana's only original song for the REFLEC BEAT series. * Twinkle Wonderland was first made playable in the [[AC pnm Sunny Park|pop'n music Sunny Park]] location tests as a hidden song, and shortly after, in pop'n music 20 fantasia as part of the ''pop'n & REFLEC douji location test kinen event'' (pop'n & REFLEC同時ロケテスト記念イベント). It could be unlocked from July 4th, 2012 by playing 13 Sana songs, and filling the Twinkle Wonderland gauge. ** Before Twinkle Wonderland was added, pop'n music 20 fantasia was the only arcade pop'n music title at the time without a new Sana song. This is also mentioned in [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]]'s and [[Jun Wakita|wac]]'s staff comments on Twinkle Wonderland. * Twinkle Wonderland received an EASY chart in pop'n music Sunny Park. However, this chart is identical to its old 5-Buttons chart. * REFLEC BEAT mascot Pastel-kun makes a cameo in Twinkle Wonderland's pop'n music banner and SANAE♥chan's portrait. * Twinkle Wonderland is one of jubeat saucer's ''Only Now Songs'' (いまだけ楽曲). It could be unlocked from November 19th to 26th, 2012. ** From November 27th, 2012, it could be unlocked via ''bistro saucer''. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * Twinkle Wonderland was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see [[AC jb saucer/Song Swap System|this page]]. * Twinkle Wonderland received a SPECIAL chart in REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!. == Song Connections / Remixes == * We Can Win The Fight features an excerpt from Mozart's ''Symphony No. 25 in G minor, K. 183/173dB, 1. Allegro con brio, 4/4 in G minor'' in the middle. * A long version of We Can Win The Fight featuring additional vocals by [[Thomas Nagano|BM]], titled ''We Can Win the Fight (Realistic MIX with BM)'', can be found on the [[DanceEvolution V-RARE EX SOUNDTRACK]] CD. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * We Can Win The Fight marks Osamu Migitera's first DanceDanceRevolution CS original song. * In DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY2 / [[CS DDR FuruFuruParty|フルフル♪パーティー]], We Can Win the Fight uses the ''Triple Stomp'' gimmick. * In DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY2 / フルフル♪パーティー, and in the DANCE aROUND and DanceEvolution series, We Can Win The Fight's title is capitalized as '''We Can Win the Fight'''. * We Can Win The Fight was performed live with vocals by Thomas Nagano at the DanceEvolution club event at Tokyo Game Show in 2010. * We Can Win The Fight is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]] from January 31st, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.2''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.2). ** By purchasing the pack while having an active subscription, We Can Win The Fight could be played in DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS and [[AC DDR A3|A3]]. ** From January 31st, 2023 in DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS and A3, it is available by default for all players. * We Can Win The Fight received new charts, including Double charts, in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX. * In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, as well as the arcade DanceDanceRevolution titles prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], We Can Win The Fight's BPM is erroneously displayed as 120. * We Can Win the Fight is the unlock of DANCE aROUND's ''Gauge Unlock Event'' (ゲージアンロックイベント) Part 24. It could be unlocked from May 15th to June 2nd, 2024, and from December 4th to 22nd, 2024. ** From May 21st, 2025, it is available by default. == Song Production Information == === D-crew === Here is a truly hip, cool track for you.
This is a rap for grown-ups. The beat of the words is amazing, right?
I wanted to pay respect to that famous song. Have you noticed?
It's nice to soak in the grown-up ambiance.
I want to create a song like this again. I promise I will! === DanceDanceRevolution Community === D-crew creates the a powerful Hip-Hop jam while Matt Tucker drops some incredibly intelligent lyrics. This song's over-riding message is one of unity, strength and positivity. It is a song that draws you in with the first beat, the melody uplifting your soul, and by the end you are ready to change the world. Truly, this is what people mean when they say, "the power of music". == Difficulty & Notecounts == DANCE aROUND difficulty rated from 1 to 10.

== Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == * 共犯ヘヴンズコード's video features Masato Yonamine and Syo Kohinata, characters from the [[DanceEvolution Information|DanceEvolution]] series. ** Their appearance in the beatmania IIDX series was first hinted by a post on the DanceEvolution staff X account [https://x.com/DanEvo_staff/status/923011242674995200]. * 共犯ヘヴンズコード is available in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Start Up Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS スタートアップセレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). * 共犯ヘヴンズコード was added to [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]] on March 14th, 2022. * 共犯ヘヴンズコード crossing over marks Masato Nakayama's debut in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], 共犯ヘヴンズコード's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * 共犯ヘヴンズコード is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from September 19th, 2024, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.2''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.2). == Song Production Information == === Masato Nakayama === It has been a while, Nakayama here.
This time I wrote and composed "Kyouhan heaven's code".
While I have been participating in the beatmania series in the past, this time it is not a completely original song, but instead I was asked to make a character song.
So, male vocalists! Thanks to that, I was able to meet the wonderful vocalists named kazuya and Chagepoyo..
It was a very valuable opportunity!
Please do enjoy it by all means~ === Chagepoyo. === Nice to meet you, I sang the Syo Kohinata part in Kyouhan heaven's code. My name is Chagepoyo..
Usually I post videos of songs on video-sharing websites, but this is the first time that a song I sang is distributed at game centers nationwide. I still cannot believe it! It's almost like a dream!
Although I was concerned when I was asked to sing, I wanna give thanks to everyone who helped me when I actually did the recording.
I was able to give my best as Syo Kohinata and the recording was very fun.
It ended being a really nice song.
Everyone, I would like you to listen and play it!! === kazuya === BEMANI fans, hello everyone! Nice to meet you! It is me, [kazuya], who sang the "Masato Yonamine" role.
This time it's Kyouhan heaven, which I loved so much since I got the demo.
While recording this exciting song, sometimes I forgot my role while moving my body to the shuffle beat! (Laughs) Cool, right?

=== DJ TECHNORCH === When I was a freshman in high school, I had already been baptized by the [[HELL SCAPER|GABBAH]] shock of [[CS bm GOTTA|beatmania GOTTA MIX]], but after clearing the [[CS DDR 1st JP|first PS DDR]] nearly 100 times at home, I was able to do the hidden song "2MB / [[PARANOiA KCET ~clean mix~]]", an unusually clean hardcore techno track that appeared there, and it once again blew me away. This is a room at KONAMI, and the composer, U1-ASAMi himself, aka 2MB, is right in front of me. This song of yours, when I was in school, I was so amazed at how beautiful hardcore techno was in the world.
Later on, I started scouring CD and record stores for similar styles of music. But... "No. There's no music in the world in that style."
It was said to me. Yes... there is none...
There's no other place in the world where you can find this kind of music but in music games.
It was only in a few of your songs, especially when it came to that style.
I've made a lot of efforts to do this. It's gabber, but I put in some solemn sounds, and if that doesn't work, I'll take music theory and try to make it a little more melodic.
Oh, and by the way, the reason why my songs often consist of "song title A ~song title B~" is probably because of your music.
Oh, and by the way, your music may have influenced my basic rhythm structure, which is a two-bar loop with a lot of bass drum...
But there's no point in trying to imitate everything that's on the surface...
It's too different in its innate ability and direction.
That song is just too awesome... "When it comes to your charms, there's rave stubs, gabber kicks, and... odd voices...? That's what I thought it was supposed to be, though."
That's right. I've stopped obsessing about what I can't do. I don't have the same talent as you.
So what you just said is in fact part of my fascination. "Yeah, well, let's get it all out this time."
Huh?
"All of them. We've stopped doing what we can't, haven't we? Then we'll do everything we can." The collaboration has begun. Later, as I handed him my side of the music, I told him this.
"It's done. How about this way? But... if I may say so myself... there's too much sound...
Um, change it with enough force to erase about half of it. I mean... please turn off all the stuff... sorry..."
He then said.
"I'll take care of it." I was immensely stunned with the sound source that was sent back to me later.
"The sounds! You increased them! What's going on? ( ‘ᾠ’ ;)"
"HAHAHA, there's more. Also, a few seconds of female voice are halfway through, so increase it tenfold."
"Tenfold!!?? You're not going to make any more noise, do you!!?? I wasn't thinking of the lyrics or anything like that in the first place!?"
"Once upon a time, there was a god of technology, a Technouchi god, who was loved by all."
"What's going on!?"
"One day, the ancient god Yaoyorozubit, whom the god himself had revered since he was a child, suddenly descended on the village of the god Technouchi."
"That..."
"At first, he just prostrated, but now the Technouchi god is a God. One God is enough for one person. So the Technouchi god had a change of heart, the ancient god responded, and the battle began."
"That..."
"It's like, "Close the eyes of the young and strike a stake through the heart"."
"Let's go with that."
"I knew you'd understand."
"I'll take care of it. Now I've also come up with a straightforward spell to disperse the gods and evil spirits."
"It's going to be a good song."
"Yes, I'm sure." Such a song. == Video Production Information == === BEMANI Designers === The production itself was right after I finished working on [[Junshin karen desire]], so I remember I was struggling to switch my mind to the opposite world for about a week.
I just loved the song so much and I really wanted to be a part of it, so once the transition was made, I was very immersed in it.
It's like you can't turn a rhetorical line, your eyes are swimming in the air, and your brain isn't coming back... that's what it feels like, this song.
It really is "alive!" It was a tremendously fun process that gave me that feeling.
It was.
I'm on my back.
Maybe it's not just because of the emotions, but because I was physically in the front of it all along....

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] * [[AC pnm peace|pop'n music peace]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is related to [[FLugeL(Arp:EggyO)|FLügeL《Λrp:ΣggyØ》]], from SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS. * A symphonic arrangement of Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 by [[Tadahiro Tsuchiya|Morrigan]], titled ''Lachryma《Re:Queen'M》(Orchestra Arr.)'', can be found on the [[BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] album. ** A short version of Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 (Orchestra Arr.), titled [[Lachryma(Re:Queen'M) (BEMANI SYMPHONY Arr.)|Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 (BEMANI SYMPHONY Arr.)]], appears in [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]]. * A rock arrangement of Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 by effraie, titled [[Lachryma(Re:Queen'M) (GITADORA Edition)|Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 (GITADORA Edition)]], appears in [[AC GD GALAXY WAVE DELTA|GITADORA GALAXY WAVE DELTA]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is the Highest Excellence Award winning song of ''The 5th KAC Original Song Contest'' (The 5th KAC オリジナル楽曲コンテスト). It was unveiled in the final round of the SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS section of [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 5th KONAMI Arcade Championship]] on January 30th, 2016. ** Much like with [[Everlasting Message]] on The 4th KONAMI Arcade Championship, Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's GRAVITY chart, rated Level 16, was played. ** It was later added to SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS on February 5th, 2016. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's ADVANCED and EXHAUST charts in SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS can be purchased after clearing [[EMPIRE OF FLAME]]'s EXHAUST chart with an A rank or above. ** Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's ADVANCED chart can be purchased separately after simply clearing EMPIRE OF FLAME's ADVANCED or EXHAUST chart. ** Since [[AC SDVX IV|SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN]], its EXHAUST chart can be purchased after clearing the EXHAUST charts of [[Kumo no kanata|雲の彼方]], [[NEO GRAVITY]], [[Candy Colored Hearts]], [[End to end]], and EMPIRE OF FLAME with an A rank or above, while its ADVANCED chart is available by default. ** Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's GRAVITY chart can be purchased after clearing Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's EXHAUST chart with a AA rank or above and by simply playing [[Bangin' Burst]]'s GRAVITY chart. ** Since [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]], its EXHAUST and GRAVITY chart can be purchased with PCB without any prerequisites. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 represents Malkuth, the tenth sephirot in the Kabbalistic Tree of Life, which means kingship. * [[GRACE]] appears in Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's jackets. ** During The 5th KONAMI Arcade Championship final, Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's jacket credit in the special splash screen was simply '''蒼弐Michael'''. ** This marks the first time GRACE is featured in a KAC final song's jacket. * When playing Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》, EVIL EYE appears in the background. ** In the second half of the song (except on NOVICE), GRACE (as drawn in the song's jacket) appears. *** During The 5th KONAMI Arcade Championship final, GRACE was an overlay on the screen and covered the top half of the track information screen. She now is only part of the background during normal gameplay. ** If playing on EXHAUST or GRAVITY, the chart lanes then temporarily become invisible. * Lachryma or lacrima is Latin for "tear", as in the liquid. ** "Re:Queen’M" is read as "requiem". ** Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's title may be named after ''Lacrimosa'', a movement in the third section of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's ''Requiem''. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is the first SOUND VOLTEX song with a NOVICE chart rated Level 8. * With the re-rating of difficulties in SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN, Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's GRAVITY chart is retroactively the first song in the SOUND VOLTEX series to have a chart rated Level 20. ** It took two years after its debut for a PERFECT to be achieved on the GRAVITY chart. ** As a reward for the [https://twitter.com/anhk7/status/965866745469706241 first PERFECT done on its GRAVITY chart by XD2.BOT] on February 20th, 2018, Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's charts were fully unlocked from February 21st, 2018 to February 28th, 2018, with a 10x multiplier on Block/Packet matching bonus when the song is played. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is one of the songs in Parts 37 and 38 of [[FLOOR INFECTION]]. During its periods of availability, it could be unlocked in the following manner. For more information on the dates it could be unlocked, please see the event page. ** In the pop'n music series, play 4 rounds of the corresponding SOUND VOLTEX series game to raise the ''infection level'' to Level 4 MAX. *** From [[AC pnm UniLab|pop'n music UniLab]] onwards, it is available by default. ** In the DanceDanceRevolution series, play 8 rounds of the corresponding SOUND VOLTEX series game to raise the ''infection level'' to Level 3 MAX. *** From [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]] onwards, it is available by default. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 being crossed over marks Chiharu Kaneko's first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Instead of displaying its character's portrait, Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 displays its SOUND VOLTEX GRAVITY jacket on the song selection screen. ** Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's GRAVITY jacket is also used as its jacket in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's Double EXPERT chart, along with [[VOLAQUAS]]' Double EXPERT chart, sets a new record in terms of highest notecount by difficulty in DanceDanceRevolution series, beating [[MAX 360]]'s former record of 823 notes by 23 notes. ** With a STREAM value of 204, Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》's Double EXPERT chart is also the first chart in the DanceDanceRevolution series to exceed 200 in any aspect of the [[GROOVE RADAR]] that isn't a CHALLENGE chart. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is available in [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s INFINITE course and [[CS SDVX EG|EXCEED GEAR コナステ]] from March 4th, 2020, by purchasing '''Konasute SOUND VOLTEX Music Pack vol.10''' (コナステ版 SOUND VOLTEX 楽曲パック vol.10). * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 received CHALLENGE charts as part of [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]]' ''DDR CHALLENGE Carnival PLUS'' event. They could be unlocked from August 3rd to December 8th, 2020 after obtaining 28 stamps. ** From DanceDanceRevolution A3 onwards, they are available by default. ** These CHALLENGE charts are the first Level 19 charts for a crossover song in DanceDanceRevolution, and the first Level 19 charts with no BPM changes, stops, or Shock Arrows. * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 25th, 2025, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.4''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.4). * Lachryma《Re:Queen’M》 is absent from the North American release of [[AC pnm High Cheers!!|pop'n music High☆Cheers!!]]. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == Untranslated. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

It could be unlocked in all participating models from September 12th to October 15th, 2019. ** As of June 25th, 2020, it has been unlocked by default in all participating models. * 最小三倍完全数 marks Yutaka Yamashita's first appearance in the pop'n music and SOUND VOLTEX series. ** It is also his first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series since [[888]] from [[CS DDR UNIVERSE3|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE3]], and his first arcade original song in that series. ** It also marks Uchu★kurage's first appearance outside the beatmania IIDX series. * 最小三倍完全数 translates to "the smallest 3-perfect number", which is 120. ** On beatmania IIDX's title marquee, the title is displayed as '''SMALLEST 3K-PERFECT NUMBER'''. ** According to the song comments on the いちかのBEMANI投票選抜戦2019 event page for the song, 最小三倍完全数 is pronounced as "Hyakunijuuichi no mae" (ひゃくにじゅういちのまえ), which means "before 121". *** This is a callback to [[Nijuuichi no mae|廿]], which is said to be pronounced as "Nijuuichi no mae" (にじゅういちのまえ), meaning "before 21". ** 最小三倍完全数 moves between 4/4, 5/4, and 6/4 time signatures, which is another reference to 120; 4 × 5 × 6 = 120. ** 最小三倍完全数's DanceDanceRevolution BEGINNER chart's notecount is 120. Additionally, its Single EXPERT chart's notecount is 672, which is the next 3-perfect number after 120, and its Double EXPERT chart's notecount is 659, the 120th prime number. *** All of its Single charts, except BEGINNER, have exactly 6 Freeze Arrows; 6 is the smallest perfect number. * 最小三倍完全数 is the only song in the いちかのBEMANI投票選抜戦2019 whose jacket has an artist credit, as it features DJ TECHNORCH's "TCN" logo. ** In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, 最小三倍完全数 displays its jacket when selected. * 最小三倍完全数's genre, roughly translated as "Pythagorean incompleteness destruction urge tuning (by hammer)", refers to the system of Pythagorean musical tuning. * 最小三倍完全数 also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of the '''festo pack 6'''. * 最小三倍完全数 was added to [[CS ULTIMATE MOBILE|beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE]] on September 2nd, 2021. * 最小三倍完全数 is available in [[CS SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR コナステ]] from May 2nd, 2022, by purchasing '''Konasute SOUND VOLTEX Music Pack vol.16''' (コナステ版 SOUND VOLTEX 楽曲パック vol.16). * 最小三倍完全数 is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] from April 5th, 2023 after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * 最小三倍完全数 is available in [[CS pnm Lively|pop'n music Lively]] by purchasing '''pop'n music Lively Selection Music Pack vol.2''' (pop'n music Lively セレクション 楽曲パック vol.2). * 最小三倍完全数 is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 4th, 2024, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.28''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.28). == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == The strongest high-speed dance song! == Song Connections / Remixes == * The BEMANI series uses a slightly re-arranged version of Grip & Break down !!, with re-recorded vocals and guitars. This version is known in the SOUND VOLTEX series as '''Grip & Break down !! - SDVX Edit. -'''. ** It was later released commercially via the 2016 album ''NANA HOLIC'', and this version (without the subtitle) would appear in subsequent BEMANI titles. * Grip & Break down !! is a Eurobeat remix of ''U.N.オーエンは彼女なのか？'', extra boss theme of the Touhou Project game ''東方紅魔郷 ～ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil''. ** Another rearranged version of Grip & Break down !!, titled ''Grip & Break down!! - 2012 -'', appears on the ''東方PVD4'' DVD. == Trivia == * Grip & Break down !! - SDVX Edit. - was added to SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH on September 14th, 2012. * Grip & Break down !! - SDVX Edit. - was one of the qualifying round songs in the [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|KONAMI Arcade Championship 2012]] for SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH. * The jacket for both Grip & Break down !! and Grip & Break down !! - SDVX Edit. - is a slightly modified image of 紅 -KURENAI-'s jacket illustration, removing the text. * Grip & Break down !! received a NIGHTMARE chart in BeatStream アニムトライヴ on May 26th, 2016, unlockable via ''BEAST HACKER''. * Grip & Break down !! is the only new license at DanceDanceRevolution A's launch that does not have its own unique video. * Grip & Break down !! - SDVX Edit. - was added to [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s INFINITE mode on June 1st, 2021. * Grip & Break down !! - SDVX Edit. - received an EXCEED chart in [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]'s [[AC SDVX EG/ARENA STATION|ARENA STATION]], available since April 25th, 2022. For more information on the dates it could be unlocked, please see the event page. ** Since August 21st, 2025, it can be unlocked via [[BLASTER GATE]]. * Grip & Break down !! was added to DANCE aROUND on October 18th, 2023. * Grip & Break down !!'s DANCE aROUND choreography was created by LEO [https://x.com/leofjmr/status/1714526239804002781]. * Grip & Break down !! is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from November 8th, 2023, by purchasing '''SPECIAL music pack feat.Touhou Project vol.4''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.東方Project vol.4). ** It received brand-new CHALLENGE charts, which become available by purchasing both this and '''SPECIAL music pack feat.Touhou Project vol.3''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.東方Project vol.3). ** By purchasing both packs with an active subscription, Grip & Break down !!'s CHALLENGE charts could be played in [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]] and [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From November 29th, 2024 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, these charts are available by default for all players. * Grip & Break down !! was added to ポラリスコード on May 30th, 2024. == Song Production Information == None. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == BeatStream difficulty rated from 1 to Kami (神) in アニムトライヴ.

}} == Song Connections / Remixes == * チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 is a remix of ''おてんば恋娘'', stage 2 boss theme of the Touhou Project game ''東方紅魔郷 ～ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil''. * A different cut of チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 is used in the DanceDanceRevolution series, which is the same cut used in the original music video. * An EDM remix of チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 by [[Shohei Uno|uno]](IOSYS), titled [[Cirno no perfect sansuu kyoushitsu (EDM REMIX)|チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 (EDM REMIX)]], appears in the ''IOSYS TOHO MEGAMIX -GENSOKYO HOUSE EDITION-'' album. ** A game-size version of チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 (EDM REMIX) appears in [[AC DDR 2014|DanceDanceRevolution (2014)]]. * A remixed cover of チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 by [[beatMARIO|ビートまりお]]（COOL&CREATE）, titled [[Cirno to Mario no perfect sansuu kyoushitsu|チルノとまりおのパーフェクトさんすう教室]], appears in the ''東方Project×SOUND VOLTEX 超激レアCD''. ** It later appeared as a playable song in [[AC SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS]]. ** A different remixed cover by ビートまりお, titled [[Cirno no perfect sansuu gakuen|チルノのパーフェクトさんすう学園]], was released as a single in 2025. *** A short version of チルノのパーフェクトさんすう学園 was later added to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. * Another remix of チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 by [[Ryutaro Nakahara|Ryu☆]], titled ''チルノのパーフェクトさんすう教室 - Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ is a remix of ''月時計　～ ルナ・ダイアル'', Stage 5 Boss theme of the Touhou Project game ''東方紅魔郷　～ the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil''; and ''フラワリングナイト'', Sakuya Izayoi's theme of ''東方花映塚 ～ Phantasmagoria of Flower View''. * A piano arrangement of ナイト・オブ・ナイツ by まらしぃ appears in ノスタルジア. * Remixes of ナイト・オブ・ナイツ by [[Masaya Oya|かめりあ]], [[Kosuke Saito|kors k]], [[Masaharu Kubota|USAO]], [[Shouya Namai|Amateras Records]], [[Youhei Kimura|ARM]], [[Yoshikazu Nagai|REDALiCE]], [[MARON]], [[Hige Driver]], [[Yusuke Ishiwata|xi]], [[Atsushi Morimori]], [[SOUND HOLIC]], [[Hiroshi Watanabe (Cranky)|Cranky]] vs [[Tomoyuki Hamada|t+pazolite]], and [[Ryutaro Nakahara|Ryu☆]] appear in the COOL&CREATE remix album, ''オールナイト・オブ・ナイツ ルナティック''. ** A short version of Ryu☆'s remix from this album, [[Night of knights (Ryu Remix)|ナイト・オブ・ナイツ (Ryu☆Remix)]], appears in [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]]. * Another remix of ナイト・オブ・ナイツ by [[Shohei Uno|RoughSketch]] & [[nora2r]], titled [[Night of knights (RoughSketch & nora2r Remix)|ナイト・オブ・ナイツ (RoughSketch & nora2r Remix)]], appears in [[AC DaR|DANCE aROUND]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ was added to SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH on December 21st, 2012. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ received an INFINITE chart in [[AC SDVX II|SOUND VOLTEX II -infinite infection-]] on May 1st, 2014. It can be unlocked via [[BLASTER GATE|INFINITE BLASTER]]. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ was added to BeatStream on August 21st, 2014. Its MEDIUM and BEAST charts could be unlocked via the BisCo mail ''Akogare no maid-san♪（*´▽｀*）'' in ''Takahashi-san Lab.''. ** As of December 3rd, 2015, these charts have been unlocked by default. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ received a new jacket in BeatStream. ** The DanceDanceRevolution series also uses this jacket. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ was added to jubeat prop on September 1st, 2015. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ received a NIGHTMARE chart in BeatStream on October 22nd, 2015, unlockable via ''BEAST HACKER''. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], ナイト・オブ・ナイツ's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * The word ナイト can be read as either ''Night'' or ''Knight''. Therefore, the name of the song can be read as Night of knights, Knight of nights, Night of nights, or Knight of knights. According to beatMARIO himself, all readings are equally correct. ** ナイト・オブ・ナイツ's video has all of the first three readings appearing at some point. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution A on June 7th, 2018. ** Despite the song appearing in the North American/European versions, these CHALLENGE charts are only accessible in the Asian versions of DanceDanceRevolution A, making ナイト・オブ・ナイツ the first song in DanceDanceRevolution to have charts that are inaccessible in other regions. *** However, these CHALLENGE charts are made playable in the North American/European versions of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]]. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ received a Real chart in [[AC NST Op.2|ノスタルジア Op.2]]. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ's Hard chart was re-rated on February 27th, 2019 in ノスタルジア Op.2. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ was added to pop'n music peace on March 21st, 2019. ** Instead of displaying its character's portrait, ナイト・オブ・ナイツ displays its jacket on the song selection screen. ** In the pop'n music series, ナイト・オブ・ナイツ is simply credited to '''ビートまりお'''. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ was added to [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s INFINITE mode on September 1st, 2021. * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from November 1st, 2022, by purchasing '''SPECIAL music pack feat.Touhou Project vol.1''' (スペシャル楽曲パック feat.東方Project vol.1). * ナイト・オブ・ナイツ was added to ポラリスコード on May 23rd, 2024. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === [[Jun Wakita|wac]] === As a [[Machi bito wa kozu.|similar]] representative Touhou arrangement with a melody that suits music games very well, this song is rampaging. == Song Connections / Remixes == * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい is part of UtataP's ''Koufuku'' (幸福) series. == Trivia == * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい was added to SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS on December 18th, 2014. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい is the first BEMANI song that features the synthesized vocals of the VOCALOID Yukari Yuzuki. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい's title translates into English as "It Seems Like There's A Secret Command To Becoming Happy". * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい's SOUND VOLTEX charts follow the song's "commands": ** In all charts, left and right correspond to the analogs, while up and down correspond to the BT and FX buttons, respectively. ** In its NOVICE and ADVANCED charts, the pitch changes up or down according to the command. ** Similarly, its DanceDanceRevolution charts follow the commands as well, although BEGINNER to a lesser degree. ** These "commands" effectively contain the arrow sequence of the KONAMI Code, repeated several times. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい was added to BeatStream on August 27th, 2015. Its MEDIUM and BEAST charts could be unlocked via the BisCo mail ''Suzushii suzushii!（＞▽＜）／'' in ''Takahashi-san Lab.''. ** As of December 3rd, 2015, these charts have been unlocked by default. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい received a NIGHTMARE chart in [[AC BST AnimTribe|BeatStream アニムトライヴ]] on April 7th, 2016, unlockable via ''BEAST HACKER''. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい was added to DanceDanceRevolution A on August 9th, 2017. ** It received a new jacket in the DanceDanceRevolution series, which uses a different shot of the song's video, as well as displays the name and artist on it. ** It does not appear in the North American/European releases of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] and an earlier North American release of [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|A20 PLUS]], due to licensing issues. *** However, it can be played in these releases during maintenance or when operating in LOCAL MODE due to an oversight. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** The video was removed in [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] at release date. It was later re-added on April 25th, 2019, although with the last scene removed. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい's difficulty level change from DanceDanceRevolution A20 was applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい was added to the North American release of [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]] on February 5th, 2021. * 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい received an EXCEED chart in [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]. It can be unlocked from November 21st, 2024 in the song selection screen, by moving the cursor to 幸せになれる隠しコマンドがあるらしい's EXHAUST chart, and then using VOL-R up, up, down down, then using VOL-L left, right, left, right, and then pressing BT-B and BT-A.
