Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * ACE FOR ACES was performed live as part of the ''DanceDanceRevolution 20th Anniversary NONSTOP MEGAMIX'' medley at [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 7th KONAMI Arcade Championship]]. * The OST version of ACE FOR ACES is slightly re-arranged. * ACE FOR ACES is one of the songs sampled in [[DDR TAGMIX -LAST DanceR-]], from [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]]. == Trivia == * ACE FOR ACES is DanceDanceRevolution A's ''ENCORE EXTRA STAGE'' song, available immediately after clearing [[ENDYMION]] as the ''EXTRA EXCLUSIVE LEVEL A'' song with a AA+ or better. During the ENCORE EXTRA STAGE, the player must achieve a Perfect Full Combo on ACE FOR ACES' charts in order to clear it. Before the song begins, the text "ATTACK! PERFECT FULL COMBO!!" is shown. ** This marks the third time a Perfect Full Combo is required to clear an ENCORE EXTRA STAGE. The previous two times were [[LOVE IS THE POWER -Re:born-]] ([[AC DDR X3|DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX]]) and [[Over The "Period"|Over The “Period”]] ([[AC DDR 2014|DanceDanceRevolution (2014)]]). ** From April 26th, 2018, ACE FOR ACES can be accessed on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 2 after completing ''RINON'S ADVENTURE''. ** From July 26th, 2018, ACE FOR ACES can be accessed on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 1 after completing RINON'S ADVENTURE. *** Its CHALLENGE charts can only be accessed on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 2 instead, after completing RINON'S ADVENTURE. ** From August 30th, 2018, ACE FOR ACES is unlocked for normal play upon completing RINON'S ADVENTURE. *** Its CHALLENGE charts can be accessed on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 1 instead, after completing RINON'S ADVENTURE. ** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. * Despite having a display BPM of 200 prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], ACE FOR ACES contains different BPM values across difficulties; its DIFFICULT, EXPERT, and CHALLENGE charts have BPM changes and stops that are not present in its BEGINNER or BASIC charts: ** DIFFICULT: 100 → 200 → 825 → (stop) → 200 → 100 → 200 → (stop) → 200 → (10 stops) → 200. ** EXPERT: 100 → 400 → 800 → (stop) → 400 → 50 → 100 → 200 → (stop) → 200 → 400 → (4 stops) → 400 → (stop) → 400 → (2 stops) → 400 → (stop) → 100. ** CHALLENGE: (stop) → 100 → 400 → 800 → 400 → 200 → (stop) → 200 → 400 → 50 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 800 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 200 → (stop) → 200 → 400 → 200 → 100 → 400 → (5 stops) → 400 → 800 → (stop) → 400 → (4 stops) → 400 → 800. ** ACE FOR ACES is the first DanceDanceRevolution song to have different BPM values across difficulties, which is referred to as ''split timing''. * ACE FOR ACES' Single CHALLENGE and Double CHALLENGE charts have VOLTAGE values of 260 and 247, respectively, making it the first DanceDanceRevolution song with charts that have VOLTAGE values above 200; both charts exceed [[Blew My Mind]]'s value of 200. ** With a total of 715 (STREAM: 172, VOLTAGE: 260, AIR: 80, FREEZE: 28, CHAOS: 175), ACE FOR ACES' Single CHALLENGE chart has the largest [[GROOVE RADAR]] of any Single chart in DanceDanceRevolution. ** With a total of 701 (STREAM: 189, VOLTAGE: 247, AIR: 54, FREEZE: 28, CHAOS: 188), ACE FOR ACES' Double CHALLENGE chart also has the third largest GROOVE RADAR of any Double chart in the DanceDanceRevolution series, behind [[POSSESSION (20th Anniversary Mix)]]'s Double CHALLENGE chart, with 712, and [[MEGALOVANIA]]'s Double CHALLENGE chart, with 776. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], ACE FOR ACES' music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. ** When played on the ENCORE EXTRA STAGE in DanceDanceRevolution A, it used a slightly different video that also acted as a staff roll for that game. ** [[RINON]] and [[YUNI]] appear in ACE FOR ACES' video. * ACE FOR ACES' sync was improved on August 8th, 2017. * ACE FOR ACES ranked #1 in the BEMANI Fan Site CHECK!SONGS Monthly Ranking list for August 2017. ** A different jacket for ACE FOR ACES, without the artist credit, can be seen in the video of the above Monthly Ranking list [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g4vsnStmeR4]. * ACE FOR ACES is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from February 20th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.15''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.15). == Song Production Information == === TAG === How many people we met and went away during this time.
Going away is never eternal, it was not a coincidence that we met. To all the ACEs. === U1-ASAMi ===
Every age, the best ace creates enthusiasm and creates the future.
== Video Production Information == === square_head === Some ultra-skilled players can play this song.
And even for super-skilled players, I expected that it would take some time to clear this song. "One more step, I want to see the next step!"
I made the movie this time wanting to encourage the feelings of those pure players. RINON loses her consciousness and is wrapped in flames, unable to recognize players that aren't able to clear the song with anything other than a PERFECT FULL COMBO; I hope you, fellow DDR fans who witness this as YUNI looks up at the sky and prays with an anxious look, enjoy this. This song is also used as the ending of the event. All games are packed with plenty of developers' thoughts.
Of course, DDR A was also born with the love of many people.
It's an honor to share a small amount of time at the end of the event with the fans who enjoyed the game so far. Let the messages at the end of the movie touch you! == Jacket Design Information == === square_head === The production approach to this jacket was a little bit special. Speaking of how special it was, I aimed for a design that does not convey the atmosphere of the song through the jacket. The reason I aimed for a visual like this is because I didn't want the jacket image to become a hindrance to the sense of excitement in discovering the entire song little by little. This song being played is the ENCORE EXTRA STAGE which requires a PERFECT FULL COMBO to clear. Considering how the real pleasure of this song is in experiencing for one's self the excited feeling of "What kind of hook is this?!" that has become rare in recent music games, I came up with a design that would avoid the song's genre and its expected progression. And thus the jacket was born.
There's a little bit of obsessiveness in the typography. The artist lettering is what was used on the DDR A teaser site.
It also uses the A logo and the GAMEOVER font in unison.
Thus the letter A extends to the two words "ACE" and "ACES". ACE FOR ACES is the conclusive song of a single story that starts with A and ends with A.
I am expressing the characteristics of such a song using typography. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards. It could be unlocked from August 8th to September 30th, 2019, by collecting 7 stamps for DANCERUSH STARDOM. ** From January 16th, 2020 onwards, it can be purchased with 200 ★ after having unlocked [[Drop The Bounce]]. ** From February 1st, 2023 onwards, it can be purchased without prerequisites. ** As of February 28th, 2024, it is playable by default. * Astrogazer is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from May 23rd, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.6''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.6). * Astrogazer is available in pop'n music Lively by purchasing '''pop'n music Lively Selection Music Pack vol.2''' (pop'n music Lively セレクション 楽曲パック vol.2). * In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, Astrogazer displays its jacket on the song selection screen. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Astrogazer's BPM was shown as 154 for all of its difficulties. * Astrogazer was released as a [[BEMANI Premium Archive Disc#Seventh Release|BEMANI Premium Archive Disc]] in February 2025. * Astrogazer is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.27''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.27). == Song Production Information == === DJ TOTTO === You are here, EDM!
Among the genres in BEMANI, there are already expert artists who are already bringing world class cutting-edge sounds, although BEMANI usually have them to mix up a bit. However, this time, there were strict orders to challenge people who are not EDM experts to do it, so it is impressive that those who seemed unfamiliar with side chain compressors worked all together to complete their works. This song is the sequel to "Gravigazer" which I wrote for IIDX, with the concept that the "○○gazer" series dared to do something a little different from my safe zone, I think to myself that is an attempt to "create a song for myself by someone like me who is not me".
Yeah, that is what I decided a while ago. Of course, a full-fledged sound that is completely faithful to the genre is good, but I think that BEMANI is unique in that a defined genre undergoes changes caused by the artists, so I will be pleased if you can enjoy those parts as well. == Jacket Design Information == === ONIGIRI === It's the sequel to Gravigazer, with a spacelike feeling in keeping with the title! And with the orders received, here's the jacket I made!
As a matter of fact, when I was stuck between a black and a white background, not only TOTTO, but also the rest of the staff decided on white.
(What annoying bastards...)
In time, I want to release the Black Ver. to the public somewhere.
But I'm not gonna talk to TOTTO about it (laughs) == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of '''clan pack 6'''. * Be a Hero! is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from May 8th, 2024, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.25''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.25). == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == "Be a Hero!" is a new song written as the qualifying round common theme song of the BEMANI series. The song combines the high-speed beat of thrash metal with dance elements, creating a sound that is "unique to BEMANI" music games. The vocalist Yuki Nakashima is the next generation idol of the music game world, creating a positive song full of cuteness. This is a song that every KAC contestant can enjoy, from those just trying out for the KAC to those aiming to become champions.
This is the Enjoy Entry song of The 7th KONAMI Arcade Championship, and it will be unlocked when you play during that period. === Yuki Nakashima === I'm grateful to be in charge of the qualifying round common theme song of the BEMANI KAC series this time!!
I've been very happy this past year just to be involved in the jubeat series which I love, but I didn't expect to sing the common theme song, so when I was first told about it, I was so surprised that I thought it was a dream.
This time, "Be a Hero!" has a very fast tempo and is a song which I think will make you want to excitedly play it in a game!
Everyone can be a hero! Let's grab glory together! It's a song that encourages us to leap towards a new stage! == Song Connections / Remixes == * A remix of Come to Life by [[Masaya Oya|Camellia]], titled ''Come to Life (かめりあ's "Not on your life though!" Remix)'', appears in ARM's third album, [[Animal strike!|アニマル・ストライク！]]. * Another remix of Come to Life by [[Daisuke Watanabe|D.watt]] appears in the [[IOSYS RHYTHMICAL WORKS PERFECT HITS]] album. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Come to Life is DanceDanceRevolution A's ''EXTRA EXCLUSIVE LEVEL 4'' song. It was added on September 15th, 2016, and can only be played on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 2. ** As of EXTRA EXCLUSIVE LEVEL 5 (November 7th, 2016), it was moved down to EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 1, making it always available on EXTRA STAGE. ** As of EXTRA EXCLUSIVE LEVEL 6 (December 22nd, 2016), Come to Life is available to play on the FINAL STAGE. ** Come to Life can be unlocked for normal play on the ''RINON'S ADVENTURE II'' event, which started on June 1st, 2017. *** Come to Life can ''not'' be played in the DDR SELECTION folder outside of the EXTRA EXCLUSIVE condition, or without unlocking it first. **** By unlocking it for normal play, its CHALLENGE charts are automatically revealed. ** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. * Come to Life marks Youhei Kimura's first original composition in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** It also marks Youhei Kimura's first BEMANI song with an English title. ** It also marks vocalist Nicole Curry's debut in BEMANI. ** It is also the first KONAMI original song originating from DanceDanceRevolution A that is not made by an in-house artist. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series, Come to Life reuses BOOM RED, [[Samurai Shogun vs. Master Ninja]]'s background dance stage. * Come to Life ranked #1 in the BEMANI Fan Site CHECK!SONGS Monthly Ranking list for September 2016. * Come to Life is one of the unlocks of the ''pop'n time trip -prologue-'' (ポップンタイムトリップ　プロローグ) event. It could be unlocked from November 15th, 2018 to February 19th, 2020 by filling out the first DDR 20th Anniversary stamp card. ** As of November 5th, 2020, it is available by default. * In the pop'n music series, instead of displaying its character's portrait, Come to Life displays its jacket on the song selection screen. * Come to Life is the ''ドライブチューン！with SODA PHASE LINE 1'' unlock of jubeat festo's ''Mission Travel'' unlocking system. It could be unlocked from April 21st to July 18th, 2021 (originally until May 11th, 2021, and then until June 15th, 2021). ** It could be unlocked again from February 2nd to 22nd, 2022, and from June 22nd to July 5th, 2022. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. *** It could also be unlocked in ''STAR RECORD'' from May 24th to June 13th, 2023, by lighting up 1 star. * Come to Life also appears in jubeat (2021)'s plus mode, as part of '''festo pack 24'''. * Come to Life is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from November 28th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.11''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.11). * Come to Life is one of the unlocks of the [[BEMANI PRO LEAGUE -SEASON 4- Triple Tribe]] event. It could be unlocked in SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR from October 24th, 2024 to January 5th, 2025, and from March 28th to April 20th, 2025 for Valkyrie model cabinets only. ** As of January 29th, 2026 in [[AC SDVX NABLA|SOUND VOLTEX ∇]], it can be purchased with PCBs. * Come to Life being crossed over marks vocalist Nicole Curry's first appearance in the jubeat, pop'n music, and SOUND VOLTEX series. * Come to Life is available in [[CS SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR コナステ]] from January 21st, 2026, by purchasing '''Konasute SOUND VOLTEX Music Pack vol.26''' (コナステ版 SOUND VOLTEX 楽曲パック vol.26). * Come to Life is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS DanceDanceRevolution Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS DanceDanceRevolution セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). * In the beatmania IIDX series, Come to Life's artist was slightly changed to '''ARM(IOSYS) feat.Nicole Curry'''. ** Its genre was also slightly modified to '''UK HARDCORE'''. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === ARM === It was my first time to produce a DDR song! Moreover, I was asked to make a straightforward hardcore song!! With a rising eccentric phrase, I asked for lyrics and singing to an English native speaker, for the first time in my music life!! Woooooooh your English is the best!! You are cute, Nicole!! Please dance energetically with the new DDR☆ === Nicole Curry === Hey, this is Nicole Curry from Attack the Music.
I am very thankful that I had the privilege to work with ARM and have my vocals on 'Come to Life'.
The feeling I had when singing this song was pure ecstasy.
It really gives you the feeling of freedom and letting go to dance and be yourself.
I hope that everyone who hears it will feel the same enjoyment as I did while singing it. === Janelle Akina Hirakawa === The first time I heard this song, I had a vivid image of people jumping, getting hyphy in the club.
I'm super nervous and honored to have been asked by ARM to write the lyrics for this song, especially since it's my first time!
I think anyone can relate to being drained from the stress we are put under every day, only to let go of all your troubles in the night and lose yourself in the music.

[[Yuichi Asami|U1]] asked me, convinced: "I would like you to make an EDM song, but with PON-like content, please!", and it was completed with that conviction, but now I think that it is important for me to express how I remember the order to make EDM for DDR. Actually, pop music is not made to dance, and it is true that there are many songs that are hard to dance compared to club music.
I mean, stepping it could be weak, or because it is not simply 4-beat, so it is hard to pull.
By using the ingredient called PON and cooking it in EDM style, I feel that it was made into delicious music for DDR. Although it was a difficult order, I personally do not dislike such a shocking order.
There were many points of concern and trial and error such as the balance of new sounds and the acoustic part, but it was a fresh fun.
I want to demonstrate my skill as a creator! Something like that.
That is why I am pleased if you can feel the new goodness of PON. Oh yeah, do you know what I mean by the lyrics that I am singing?
This...... Unfortunately I do not know. I wonder, what is it!?

Who is... ARM from IOSYS (laughs)
Let's go with a mysterious artist for a boss song with a mysterious feeling!
Following [[Yuichi Asami|U1]]'s advice, I used a strange name, get it? Although Endymion is an enigmatic myth, the scales are inspired by Dan Simmons' science fiction.
Feel the sense of urgency with an absolute strength. Feel it. For this song, the violin, viola, and guitar were played live.
... I will write it again, but the violin was actually performed by human beings.
I studied "Grandes études de Paganini" and barely scratched what can be expressed with the violin.
Paganini, who is said to have sold his soul to the devil, destroyed the hearts of human performers. By the way, thank you Fudeshi (Vn), Hayashi (Vla) of RabbiTon Strings who performed for me.
And thank you zyukucho(COOL&CREATE) for the guitar! == Video Production Information == === square_head === A huge characteristic of this song is its disconnected rhythm, seeming as though patched together, wrapped up with classical elements.
And thus it feels like a demonic shift. With the thought that you will be able to enjoy a memorable experience by visually matching up the characteristics of this type of song, I created a movie with the motif of a shifting sky. The red, burning sky where Endymion falls to earth.
The sky where the winds blow violently to the ultra-high-speed A melody.
The sky that has lost its distorted dimension from the extreme BPM change.
The sky that reassembles itself to the rhythm of the characteristic timbre.
The sky where violently roaring thunder comes and goes to the bass.
The gold sky that blesses the player who finally reached the home stretch.
And lastly, the sky that has regained its blue peacefulness.
Which sky remained in your memory? As a matter of fact, this production continues to the results screen.
Defeat ENDYMION and reclaim the blue sky! == Jacket Design Information == === square_head === The impression I got from this song was a nobility enhanced by the strings, classical timbre and dance music interwoven with a far-off divinity. In order to express that impression, I compared the player to ENDYMION who is a descendant of the gods, and made a jacket with the motif of a "forbidden encounter" with the moon goddess, Selene. Additionally, I thought it necessary to go in a heretofore unseen direction unique to this song, so that the player can experience the far-off divinity and high ranking of this song even more. So I colored the song selection screen a deep red, hid the real jacket, and made production decisions just for this song. The red sky, a sky that cannot be normal, will make the player feel a sense of impending doom. In addition, I thought about the direction of covering the jacket in a black exterior, in order to achieve the virtuous feeling of covering the gods with artifacts and the goddess emerging from the broken visage so that one feels the far-off atmosphere of eeriness. The reason for the production decision of RINON shooting such a thick beam is that the player fighting all their Heat Power can pile their feelings up onto her figure and become immersed in the game. By all means, reach this song with your own feet and relish the atmosphere that the "forbidden encounter" brings. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DANCE aROUND difficulty rated from 1 to 10.

I spent quite some time creating the kicks and synth bass. Actually, I was trying to reduce the synth bass when more kicks came in, but the more I do these kinds of things, the more paralyzed I become, right?
I clearly remember when I left it alone one night and calmly listened to it, I felt like "what's this", and rushing back to it. A long version for it is included in my album "[https://web.archive.org/web/20110507074927/http://www.konamistyle.jp/sp/nekomata_2nd/index.html Sayonara sekai]", so by all means, please listen to it if you're interested~. === jubeat === Untranslated. == Video Production Information == === MatsuTK === I consciously made this video metallic & cyber.
I hope it fits this game's concept.
I'd be happy if you like it. == Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === Chai === Hello, my name is Chai.
When I heard Far east nightbird, I suddenly had the image of "dancing birds shining in the night sky" in my mind. (I'm lying, that image came from the title).
The more I listen to this song, the cooler it becomes. It's my favorite song among those in jubeat knit.
Even though the sound rages with amazing power, it's sharp, has a tense feeling, so I can tell that Nekomata enjoyed making it, and I really love it.

It was added on June 13th, 2016, and could only be played on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 2. ** As of EXTRA EXCLUSIVE LEVEL 3 (August 10th, 2016), it was moved down to EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 1, making it always available on EXTRA STAGE. ** As of EXTRA EXCLUSIVE LEVEL 4 (September 15th, 2016), RISING FIRE HAWK is available to play on the FINAL STAGE. ** RISING FIRE HAWK can be unlocked for normal play on the ''RINON'S ADVENTURE'' event, which started on April 27th, 2017. *** By unlocking it for normal play, its CHALLENGE charts are automatically revealed. ** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series, RISING FIRE HAWK reuses BOOM RED, [[Samurai Shogun vs. Master Ninja]]'s background dance stage. * RISING FIRE HAWK can be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ from May 25th, 2017 as one of the ''Lightning school'' (雷振流) songs of the ''Ninnin shichikenden'' (忍々七鍵伝) unlocking system. ** RISING FIRE HAWK being crossed over to beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ marks it as the first DanceDanceRevolution A original song to be crossed over to another BEMANI game. ** In [[AC CANNON BALLERS|beatmania IIDX 25 CANNON BALLERS]], its charts can be purchased via [[AC CANNON BALLERS/CBS License|CBS License]] (CBSライセンス) from March 29th, 2018. ** From [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]] onwards, it is available by default. * RISING FIRE PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from May 23rd, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.6''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.6). == Song Production Information == === L.E.D.-G === Hello, this is L.E.D.-G. Well, I tend to be one step too late on a trend, and I feel that this time is Hardstyle.
Actually, I challenged myself to do Hardstyle songs a couple of times in the past, but I was not satisfied by them and gave up. For example, there is an event song called [[NEO GENERATOR SEVEN]] in [[AC PENDUAL|beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL]], which was really supposed to be Hardstyle.
"I have given up several times in the past, but this time I will make a hardstyle with a certain degree of patience!" Although I decided to challenge myself, it did not go well, so I changed the song just before the deadline, eventually settling it in MAINSTREM HARDCORE [sic]. So, when I received the request from the DDR staff, after deciding that Hardstyle would match with the nature of a DDR game, this time I had the determination to complete it, and I finally was able to create RISING FIRE HAWK. It seems that my insides, which had been struggling in the past, are feeling nice when listening the finished work, so I think that it was worth the effort. == Video Production Information == None. == Jacket Design Information == Untranslated. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

Its name is ''S!ck'' and its element is Soil. ** The appearance of the boss resembles kors k's pose that has been popularized in his Facebook and twitter pages. ** When you miss a note, it will send out a red energy blast that hurts the Qpro avatar. * According to kors k, S!ck's genre, DRUMSTEP, comes from the song genres drum'n'bass and dubstep put together. * S!ck is one of DanceDanceRevolution A's ''EXTRA SAVIOR'' Vol.2 songs. It could be unlocked from January 17th to February 4th, 2024, and from July 10th to 28th, 2024. ** From February 12th, 2025, it is available by default. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === Since jubeat has many licensed songs, this song sounds so familiar which makes you think "is this a licensed J-POP song?". The light tempo and fresh female vocals makes this a bright house, danceable song that's different from recently trending shining-styled songs. kors k's songs usually lean on hard routes where you can listen to the power of sounds, so it's often surprising that he sometimes makes stylish songs like this. === jubeat === ==== kors k ==== Hello from IIDX! I'm kors k!
I'm very honored to provide a song to jubeat, a new series of music games!
I was entrusted with a "kors k-like song" (I'm thankful), so I created a dance pop song, like the songs that left the biggest impression on me from the [[AC 1st style|1st beatmania IIDX game]]!
Happy handbag~ is a popular house genre that continues from garage house, and it's the sound of my most favorite time period.
To express the sense of the times, I selected and arranged materials and sounds that were mainstream back then.
And I included the vocalist Suzuyo, who can widely cover voices ranging from cute to soulful!
In fact, her singing was so good, that her performance is natural and feels good even without directions.
And above all, she worked quickly! Wonderful!
The repeatedly overlapping chorus work feels good, and I, kors k, am also very satisfied with this result.
I hope Special One will be loved for a long time together with jubeat...!
Please support it♪ == Video Production Information == None. == Choreography Information == === [[Yossy]] === Heeey!
I'm Yossy! This time, I choreographed Special One!

= Towards the TOWER = == Song Information == [[Image:Towards the TOWER.png|thumb|Towards the TOWER's jacket.]] Artist: SHAMDEL

I was riding Braid at midnight.
Distancing myself from my painful vow.
As he galloped I held on so tight
for my heart was too heavy to carry on.

A captive girl came into view.
Bathed in lights born from laughter and a thousand tears.
Braid said,
"It must be you who saves her."
So I opened the rusty door of "tower".

One step, Each step,
Going further, higher...

Now fly, from this crumbling cage and hear my sigh.
(You feel this shower of starlight?)

And I'll travel on to the end of night.
(Be free and cheerful!)

Tiny teardrops breaks the shackles...

I say to you,

"Bye for good, Princess."
== Song Connections / Remixes == * Towards the TOWER is the second song of the "Braid & Blade" series by SHAMDEL. * A piano demo version of Towards the TOWER, titled ''Towards the TOWER -piano demo-'', can be found on the KONAMI♪MUSIC site as a digital download single, along with the original song, from November 4th to 30th, 2015. * The ノスタルジア series uses a slightly different version of Towards the TOWER, featuring additional piano arrangement by [[Jun Wakita]]. == Trivia == * Towards the TOWER is the first unlockable song in jubeat prop's ARENA MODE, unlockable from September 7th to 13th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * Towards the TOWER first appeared as a new song in jubeat plus' CHALLENGE SCRATCH. It was later included in the jubeat plus prop pack 4. * Towards the TOWER is unlockable in DanceDanceRevolution A from August 8th, 2016, as part of the ''BABY-LON'S ADVENTURE'' (バビロン アドベンチャー) event. It is unlocked by clearing WORLD 4. ** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. * Towards the TOWER ranked #1 in the BEMANI Fan Site CHECK!SONGS Monthly Ranking list for September 2015. * Towards the TOWER could be unlocked in ノスタルジア FORTE on August 15th and 22nd, 2017 as part of the ''Version up kinen gakkyoku koukan'' (バージョンアップ記念 楽曲交換) event, by having played both ノスタルジア FORTE and jubeat clan from August 7th to 20th, 2017. ** It could be unlocked again from March 1st to 31st, 2018, as part of the ''Kikan gentei gakkyoku koukan event'' (期間限定 楽曲交換イベント). ** In [[AC NST Op.3|ノスタルジア Op.3]], it can be unlocked from July 3rd, 2020 from the [[AC NST Op.3/Old Hidden Songs|ノスタルジアFORTE&Op.2 イベント]] section at the Episode selection screen. * Towards the TOWER's difficulty changes from DanceDanceRevolution A20 were applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. * Towards the TOWER was included in ノスタルジア Op.3's GITADORA sub-category within the BEMANI category until December 11th, 2019. Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] * [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] * [[AC MSC 1+1/2|MÚSECA 1+1/2]] * [[AC pnm eclale|pop'n music éclale]] * [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A chiptune arrangement of Triple Counter by [[TORIENA]], titled ''Triple Counter -STG Remix-'', appears in the [[CS ULTIMATE MOBILE|beatmania IIDX ULTIMATE MOBILE]] exclusive album [[BEMANI 8bit collection]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Triple Counter is part of the [[NEW Generation natsu no ryuusei festa 2016]] (NEW Generation 夏の流星フェスタ2016) event, a collaboration event involving beatmania IIDX 23 copula, jubeat Qubell, and SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS. ** In beatmania IIDX 23 copula, it can be unlocked one chart at a time by obtaining the 4 SECRET course event songs on the same difficulty. A Gold Tran Medal is also obtained. *** As of [[AC SINOBUZ|beatmania IIDX 24 SINOBUZ]], it is available by default. ** In jubeat Qubell, it can be unlocked as the ''NEW Generation 夏の流星フェスタ2016'' STAGE 5 unlock of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see [[AC jb Qubell/QUBE Availability|this page]]. *** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. *** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. **** It could also be unlocked in jubeat festo from October 6th to 19th, 2021 as part of the ''Stamp Challenge'' unlocking system, by obtaining 12 stamps. *** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. *** From [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|jubeat beyond the Ave.]] onwards, it is available by default with an [[e-amusement]] pass. ** In SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS, it can be unlocked by collecting all 15 stamps. One stamp is awarded each play session. Its GRAVITY chart could be unlocked via [[BLASTER GATE|INFINITE BLASTER]] after unlocking all of the other NEW Generation 夏の流星フェスタ2016 songs' GRAVITY charts. *** From December 15th, 2016, it could be purchased at the SDVX Station. *** As of [[AC SDVX IV|SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN]], its NOVICE to EXHAUST charts are unlocked by default, while its GRAVITY chart can be unlocked via ''BLASTER GATE''. * Triple Counter marks the first song composed ''and'' arranged by Yoshitaka Nishimura himself since [[Lisa-RICCIA]], nearly three years prior. * Triple Counter's genre, RISK + VACUUM, references Takayuki Ishikawa's Risk Junk and Yoshitaka Nishimura's Lucky Vacuum aliases respectively. * Triple Counter is the only song in the NEW Generation 夏の流星フェスタ2016 event that has its own video. ** Chibi versions of the characters from [[JOMANDA]] and [[VALLIS-NERIA]], as well as Charlie and Cathleen from [[FLOWER]], appear throughout Triple Counter's video, along with a chibi version of Takayuki Ishikawa cosplaying as the character from Lisa-RICCIA. They also appear in Triple Counter's jacket. ** References to past BEMANI events [[Nettou! BEMANI Stadium|熱闘！BEMANIスタディアム]], [[Hakken! Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki|発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡]], [[Shiritsu BEMANI gakuen|私立BEMANI学園]], [[Pastel-kun to Smith-shi no RUNRUN marathon!|パステルくんとスミス氏のRUNRUNマラソン！]], and [[APPEND TRAVEL]] can be seen in Triple Counter's video. ** [[Shigeharu Saeki|Shoccho]], REFLEC BEAT mascot Pastel-kun, [[Yasuhiro Taguchi|SUPER STAR -満-MITSURU]], and jubeat mascots Kotaro and Smith make cameos in Triple Counter's video. ** A lion and a baby phoenix appear near the end of Triple Counter's video, a reference to Takayuki Ishikawa's Lion Musashi or Kinjishi aliases, and Yoshitaka Nishimura's Suzaku alias. * Triple Counter's Single ANOTHER chart has 2016 notes, referencing the year in the event's name it debuted in. ** Its Double ANOTHER chart has 1997 notes, referencing instead the year when the first [[AC bm 1st|beatmania]] was released. ** Furthermore, Triple Counter's BPM, 216, might be a reference to the year 2016. * Triple Counter can be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution A, MÚSECA 1+1/2, pop'n music éclale, and REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2 as of October 6th, 2016, as part of the ''NEW Generation ryuusei kakusan festa 2016'' (NEW Generation 流星拡散フェスタ2016) event. To unlock this song in DanceDanceRevolution A, REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, and pop'n music éclale, you must unlock NEW Generation 夏の流星フェスタ2016 songs [[Grand Chariot]], [[Sephirot]], [[StrayedCatz]], and [[ZEPHYRANTHES]] first in whatever BEMANI game you play. ** In DanceDanceRevolution A, it can be unlocked through ''EXTRA SAVIOR'' one chart at a time, starting from BEGINNER/BASIC and all the way up to EXPERT. *** Alternate skins for three DanceDanceRevolution characters, based on Triple Counter's video, will also be unlocked depending on the difficulty level through November 6th, 2016: a JOMANDA inspired [[EMI]] on BASIC, a VALLIS-NERIA inspired [[ALICE]] on DIFFICULT, and a Lisa-RICCIA inspired [[RINON]] on EXPERT. *** Like all the other NEW Generation 夏の流星フェスタ2016 songs, Triple Counter could not be unlocked in the North American release of DanceDanceRevolution A until December 1st, 2016. *** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. ** In MÚSECA 1+1/2, it could be unlocked from October 6th to November 3rd, 2016 as part of the ''NEW Generation ryuusei kakusan festa 2016-ten'' (ニュージェネ流星拡散フェスタ2016展), after three play sessions upon unlocking [[StrayedCatz]]. It is the fifth and final song unlock in the event. *** A Release Mission for a limited edition Grafica based on Triple Counter's video is available after unlocking Triple Counter. *** Its Green chart is available by default from June 26th, 2018 for MÚSECA 1+1/2 machines with an offline kit (its Orange and Red charts have to be unlocked with COLORIS, though). ** In pop'n music éclale, it could be unlocked via ''Star Factory'' for 1000 lumina after buying all other NEW Generation 流星拡散フェスタ2016 songs first. *** As of September 28th, 2017 in [[AC pnm Usaneko|pop'n music うさぎと猫と少年の夢]], it is available by default. ** In REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2, it could be unlocked after completing five rounds of gameplay (five play sessions) after unlocking [[Grand Chariot]]. It was added on August 16th, 2018, and can only be played on EXTRA STAGE LEVEL 2. ** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. ** It is the final EXTRA EXCLUSIVE song added to DanceDanceRevolution A. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Vanquish The Ghost reuses BOOM WHITE, [[HAPPY LUCKY YEAPPY|HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY]]'s background dance stage. * Vanquish The Ghost's difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. * Song comments for Vanquish The Ghost were posted on [https://note.com/tag_underground/n/nc027d93b9a42 TAG's blog]. ** According to TAG, Vanquish The Ghost is named after ''Vanquish Jr.'' (バンキッシュJr.) and ''Big Bang Ghost'' (ビッグ・バン・ゴースト), which are two models of Mini 4WD cars. * Vanquish The Ghost is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 13th, 2024, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.1''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.1). * Prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, and in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, Vanquish The Ghost's BPM is displayed as 78-155 regardless of the difficulty selected. == Song Production Information == === TAG === The theme is "EDM".
The sound concept of DanceDanceRevolution A, which includes this song, was certainly EDM, so it follows that concept.
DDR A was my personal favorite title, and I really enjoyed the variety of EDM songs included, which the composers interpreted in their own unique way. Well, I had never made an EDM song before, so I started by doing some research. I listened to everything from world-famous EDM songs to so-called game-like EDM songs included in IIDX and DDR, and then I realized something. '''EDM is the same thing repeated over and over again...!''' This is obvious when you consider what EDM is originally intended for, since it was originally intended to be danced to in clubs and festivals. Therefore, the rhythm is constant, the same phrases are repeated, and it's easy to figure what is next. If the music suddenly takes an unexpected turn, the people dancing will be confused. You have to consider this to avoid such a situation. However, this was difficult for me. Perhaps it's an occupational disease, but if there's a continuous progression, this disease will kill me. You might call it constant-phobia. Music game songs require a different progression every 8 measures (or at least, I personally think so). So I can't stand the same progression going from beginning to end. I wondered what to do, but my predecessors always had the answer.
The EDM music on the market seems to be the same thing over and over again, but the tone and rhythm subtly change to keep the music interesting. If you listen carefully, you will never hear the exact same progression twice. This is the skill of a craftsman.
Since I don't have this level of technique, I compensated for it by using gimmicky elements like those found in music games. This song is my own interpretation of EDM. I tried to repeat the same chord progression and melody as much as possible, but I was aware that it had to work in a game. I almost put a completely different melody on the chorus because I couldn't stand the same progression, but I decided to stay with it because I knew it wouldn't be EDM at all. It sounds cool when I write it like that, but I just couldn't get into it at all because that melody completely ignored the song flow. If you think about it, [[POSSESSION]] was also a repetition of the same phrases except for the intro. Maybe there's no such thing as a disease that would kill me if there was a continuous progression. The name of the song came from the Mini 4WDs that I was crazy about at the time. There was a third Mini 4WD boom in the world, and I was '''attending the Japan Cup''', so it was named after both "Vanquish Jr." and "Big Bang Ghost", which are considered famous cars among many other machines. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards. I've produced a few songs for the SOUND VOLTEX series, and now am contributing to my first beatmania IIDX. Thank you so much! Usually, my songs are based upon radio hits (among others), and I produce a lot of songs.
So for A-Style Drumstep, I incorporated a lot of A-POP and synthpop (among with nana's vocals(yes even that)), which was a lot to incorporate into a denpa-style song, which made me mad when I had to cut parts of the song off.
Mixing the club music elements along with the Akiba pop elements took a lot of trial and error to get it right.
So, she's supposed to be screaming at full volume the entire time!? Even now?! I'd be honored if you would make some noise while playing. For a vocalist, I chose someone familiar, nanahira.
Her high singing voice exemplifies kawaii culture!
Including her speaking parts, this song exudes cuteness! I've been making a lot of songs, but I really enjoyed this one.
I don't have much time to talk, so Camellia out! === nanahira === Hello, this is nanahira!
Following [[Chou!! Enkyori love ma~il|my work]] in [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX SPADA]], I was chosen again to sing a song.
Again, Camellia and I teamed up like we did in SOUND VOLTEX! Because A-Style Drumstep combined both cool and cute elements in this track, it almost didn't feel like a denpa song! I started to make up lyrics from my mind as I sung.

I'm Ryu☆(HHH), who's in charge of the N chart for HHH×MM×ST. Continuing from [[Follow Tomorrow]] in [[AC Lincle|beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle]], this is already HHH×MM×ST's second song. This time, we inherited the taste of [[Mahoroba]] from [[AC EMPRESS|beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS]], and produced a Japanesque + trance + pop song. We're happy that Oboro is being played with amazing enthusiasm since fantasia was first released. Well anyways, it's fantasia! Play it with your thoughts on a moonlit night! === Dai. (HHH) === It's been a while, poppers.
I'm Dai.(HHH), who's in charge of the EX chart for HHH×MM×ST. Well, HHH finally debuts with a default song.
I'm happy.
They've often been unlockable songs until now, so we're thankful. This time, I was in charge of the lyrics & chart.
The lyrics are a slightly adult-like fantasy, and I hope you can feel the sad atmosphere of "I can't catch up even if I chase you". We also proudly created its charts, so please try and challenge them on all difficulty levels! Well anyways, it's fantasia! Play it with your thoughts on a moonlit night! === Halka (HHH) === It's been a while, poppers.
I'm Halka(HHH), who's in charge of the H chart for HHH×MM×ST. This is the second song of the big family member special!
The FEVER WIN animation is also packed with the five characters. I was able to draw slightly rough sketches of the characters.
And then she became extremely cute, and I kept getting excited!
I immediately chose moimoi as my character♪ Well anyways, it's fantasia! Play it with your thoughts on a moonlit night! === MM (moimoi/Mayumi Morinaga) === It's been a while, poppers.
I'm MM(moimoi/Mayumi Morinaga), who's in charge of the 5-Buttons chart for HHH×MM×ST. This time, I was able to challenge a song with a slightly Japanese taste!
So, I consciously sang it with some undulations.
It was my first time participating in pop'n, so when I heard rumors that a character called "moimoi" would appear, I was already surprised! Isn't she very cute?!← I'm jealous
So, please listen to the shining fantasy Oboro, as if you went back in time (*´∀｀*) Well anyways, it's fantasia! Play it with your thoughts on a moonlit night! === ST (StarvingTrancer) N === It's been a while, poppers.
I'm ST(StarvingTrancer), who's in charge of the Battle charts for HHH×MM×ST. As an episode when creating this song, I received some lyrics written by Dai., and I was strongly influenced by the keyword "moon waterfall" that appeared in it. It felt like this song's impression was fully decided from there. My impression of playing the piano phrases, while coming up with a "moon waterfall drifting in the sky" late at night in the studio, remains particularly strong. I'm happy that I created a song with such sad atmosphere. Well anyways, it's fantasia! Play it with your thoughts on a moonlit night! == Video Production Information == === Yuuki === Hello, I'm Yuuki. I created this video with the image of moimoi waiting for someone on a beautiful moonlit night.
I'd be happy if you can feel a sad, yet dreamy atmosphere, as if you can seemingly reach it, yet you can't. == Character Information == Today, moi♪moi♪ and everyone are shi★ning☆ A lovely world will expand with your singing voices~! === Chihi === moimoi is cute with a big ribbon on her head. She flies away whenever she feels happy. I received a cute~ illustration from HHH's Halka, so I tried my best to expand her idea from there! Since it's a sequel to [[AC pnm 18|pop'n 18]]'s [[Ignited Night|Dai series]] (?), this time, we also made a character for moimoi, who's famous in IIDX!
She feels fluffy and cute~... I intended for her to be like that, but since I've never met her before, I tried as hard as I could to stare at IIDX movies, and we stared at each other intently. No, although she was on the movie screen, it felt like we seemed to understand each other deeper beyond that.
Afterwards, when I visited the homepage, I saw a super cute moimoi with a somewhat short-cut, oh~ why didn't I see the latest information?
From the perspective of moimoi's fans, it's even shorter now. But, I like the fluffy bob!
In the end, it wasn't that I didn't know about the latest information, but that I purposely chose this hairstyle. Even if they don't look similar, I'm happy that the character feels shiny and cute~♪ == Choreography Information == === Dai. === After the second time, there's a third time I'm Dai., who appears here once again.
Nice to meet you all. I was most surprised to actually be dancing in Oboro myself.
Compared to Follow Tomorrow and [[Daisuke]], the choreography is more gentle yet somewhat detailed, so it'd be great if you can be fully immersed in this singing world and express yourself! Well anyways, it's my third song! Play it with your thoughts on a moonlit night! == Staff Comments == === [[Daichi Watanabe|PON]] === I requested for this song within a short time during the final production stage.
... As an apology, I'll polish your glasses to make them shine.
However, as the genre name suggests, it's fascinating.
Everyone was completely fascinated by it, and the song selection rate was super high. Ryu☆'s [[Rainbow Rainbow|release party]] was a great success, but back when the leader [[Jun Wakita|wac]]'s [[Ongaku (album)|album]] production was nearly finished, there was a time when I wondered if he was burned out, but he wasn't that at all, rather, he was so motivated that he bought replacement glasses.

There was never a correct answer to begin with.

People always try to rely on something.
We sometimes think that is necessary to rely on something for a person to be who he or she is.

However, when things are considered on the most microscopic level, the behavior of elementary particles is nothing but random.

You encounter the paradox that if you settle on one view, you lose sight of everything else.

That would be the logic of "Schrödinger's Cat" in a nutshell.

In other words, it is up to you to decide how to deal when you encounter something you don't understand.

Do you accept it as a new and incomprehensibly high level of difficulty, or accept it as a relative understanding of the reasons for the other higher difficulty songs? Whether it makes sense to conquer all the songs or not, I'd rather you go out with me if you get a full combo on TOY CONTEMPORARY! Whether to use it as a pick-up line or not...

It's "FREEDOM-NYAAAAAAAAAAA-------------!".

Because there was never a right answer--

...I wrote this song to encourage everyone to be flexible and have a broader perspective.
This song contains a variety of ideas that can be taken in different ways.
It could be the charts, the tune, the song title and comments, the cat or animal voices....
Overall, the charts were created to be very challenging.
I also incorporated a feeling that has never been seen before in the arrangement, to give the audience a sense of surprise when they first played this song, so I made the tune complex, with rapid changes in development and beat.
However, I mustn't forget that it's a pop'n song, so I made it with the aim of becoming the most fun and crazy boss that I think of in pop'n!

I hope that in many ways, the name of this song will be engraved in the long history of pop'n music. == Character Information == === shio === We received an order from Mr. Cait for a "Dadaist" look, so we took a detour with "Oui, monsieur" and came up from the clouds with a gentleman with Magritte taste.
"It is as beautiful as a chance encounter between a sewing machine on an operating table and a rain umbrella." So please enjoy the poetic and surrealistic world view.
I hope I can also bring out the smoothness of his enchanting hand movements, which is typical of a magician.
He not only does magic, but also tap dances. Mr. Tent is truly a master of his craft. The circus moves through the city. Very mysterious.
What's going on inside the tent? I want to know. I want to see.
The children's curiosity is excited.
But if you accidentally open the door...
It could be a big, unthinkable deal. Nya. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

Upper, and SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS on May 14th, 2015 as part of the [[BEMANI x TOHO project REITAISAI 2015|BEMANI×TOHO project REITAISAI 2015]] event. ** In beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL, it can be unlocked by playing the game once. ** In BeatStream, it could be unlocked by playing seven Touhou Project songs and then receiving a mail in ''Takahashi-san Lab.'' with one of the song's charts. *** As of December 3rd, 2015, it has been unlocked by default. ** In DanceDanceRevolution (2014), it is available in the ''EXTRA ATTACK'' folder on the EXTRA STAGE. Some specimens reflect a bluish sheen along crystal faces. * As of February 12th, 2014, Adularia's ANOTHER charts have been unlocked for normal play in beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA. * Adularia is one of the unlockable crossover songs for DanceDanceRevolution (2014) on the [[Hakken! Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki|発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡]] event. ** In [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], it can be unlocked through ''EXTRA SAVIOR''. ** As of [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]], it is available by default. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Adularia's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * Adularia is one of the Refle unlockable songs in REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!. It could be purchased from the Reflec Shop from August 28th, 2014 for 2000 Refle. ** In REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA and [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], it was playable by default. * Adularia received a new jacket in the REFLEC BEAT series. * The REFLEC BEAT cut of Adularia has never been on an original soundtrack. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], Adularia was revived on April 5th, 2018. * Adularia is available in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.7''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.7). * Adularia is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 20th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.17''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.17). == Song Production Information == === DJ TOTTO === Hello, I'm one of the new DJs, name is DJ TOTTO.
When I start to make a song, I first try to develop a melody, then connect an ensemble of rhythms that would match it well.
Sometimes, from the arrangements that I make, there are elements that I try to empathize and pin down.
For Adularia however, it was suggested from the beginning to "create a song from a reverse playback of a piano."
To say that was the beginning of everything would not be an exaggeration.
Really, all I really wanted to add to the chart were backspin scratches, but....
With that said, I'm not really good with scratching, and I've ended up using the AUTO SCRATCH and LEGACY NOTE options when I play.
I wish I could turn off those options when I play, so I can experience that "Yes!" moment! == Video Production Information == === alo === Using a picture of an adularia as a reference, I expanded that motif into the video.
I wanted to have a seasoned player have a crisp, refreshing feeling (while playing) throughout the song. == Difficulty & Notecounts== beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A portion of Dreamin' is featured in [[CS DDR HOTTEST PARTY3|DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY3]]'s [[HOTTEST PARTY 2]] nonstop megamix. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * In DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY2 / [[CS DDR FuruFuruParty|フルフル♪パーティー]], Dreamin' uses the ''Foot Confuser'' gimmick. * Dreamin' is Tomosuke Funaki's first DanceDanceRevolution CS original song. ** It's also vocalist Adreana's first BEMANI song. * Dreamin' was the first unlockable song of DanceDanceRevolution (2014)'s ''YuniverHills project'' (ユニバーヒルズproject) unlocking system, which started on November 17th, 2014 and ended on December 2nd, 2015. Its charts could be obtained by getting 30, 100, and 200 residents for BEGINNER and BASIC, DIFFICULT, and EXPERT respectively. ** From December 3rd, 2015, Dreamin' is automatically unlocked by playing with an [[e-amusement|eAMUSEMENT]] PASS. * Dreamin's Single EXPERT chart was slightly modified in DanceDanceRevolution (2014), by changing the quantizations of some notes from measures 41 to 48. * Dreamin' received Double charts in DanceDanceRevolution (2014). ** It also received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution (2014), which are unlockable by getting 32,500 residents on the YuniverHills project event. * Dreamin' is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from September 26th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.10''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.10). == Song Production Information == === TOMOSUKE === I wanted to create a song that has the same feel as the songs by the popular band, "Otome House."
The vocalist's airy voice perfectly matches this tune.
If this song is played at full volume at a club, I'm sure everybody will groove to this. === DanceDanceRevolution Community === TOMOSUKE is one of the rare composers who can create songs in a variety of styles, and each one of them seems to come alive under his skilled guidance. "Dreamin'", a House music track wrapped around a beautiful vocal melody, is no exception. Adreana's soft, sultry, voice give this song the feeling of floating along a magical dream. This track will surely carry you away! == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A slightly extended version of EGOISM 440 was performed at the first day of [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 6th KONAMI Arcade Championship]] BEMANI LIVE. * A remix of EGOISM 440 by [[Hmt2|HAMA topground]], titled [[EGOISM -Rebuild-]], can be found in [[AC SDVX VW|SOUND VOLTEX VIVID WAVE]]. * A remix of EGOISM 440, titled [[EGOISM 110]], appears in [[AC DRS|DANCERUSH STARDOM]]. * A remix of EGOISM 440 by [[Ange;art]], titled [[EGOISM 440 (Ange;art remix)]], can be found in [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]. * EGOISM 440 shares the "Do you think about me?" vocal sample with [[Hou|鳳]], from [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]]. == Trivia == * EGOISM 440 is one of the EXTRA STAGE songs of the ''Replicant D-ignition'' event of DanceDanceRevolution (2014). It could be played after obtaining all five orbs, by getting at least a AA rank on the EXPERT charts of the previous five Replicant D-ignition songs ([[chaos eater]], [[Destination]], [[HAPPY LUCKY YEAPPY|HAPPY☆LUCKY☆YEAPPY]], [[Samurai Shogun vs. Master Ninja]], and [[Sand Blow]]). I tried forming an extremely long cryptic-like unit.
It's in a packed form, like in recent, trending tokusatsu media.
If you want to make it packed, not only do you need to make the song and lyrics packed, but also in the singing, dancing, and PV. It's nice to make such an all-star Thanksgiving-like packed song.
I think there's various things to comment on, and it'd be great if you tweet them on Twitter.
It's be great if you tweet them with the #BEMANI #HHHMMST hashtags. Well anyways, it's a new unit! Take another step forward and Follow Tomorrow! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- I'm Dai., who eats ice in HHH×MM×ST's juice. I tried being [[Ignited Night|2D with repeated vertical barrages]] in other [[AC pnm 18|BEMANI game series]], and it's my first appearance in a IIDX video since "Mahoroba". This time, we tried to make "Follow Tomorrow" with a clear déjà vu feeling, and I hope you'll enjoy its "new-comer music unit image"!

Take another step forward and Follow Tomorrow! == Choreography Information == === Dai. === Everyone, I love DanEvo! I'm Dai., who's famous for [[Daisuke|wearing sunglasses]], [[So Fabulous !!|being plump]], [[Dazzlin' Darlin|shining]], wearing Japanese clothes, and showing off more than the vocalists. So, HHH's long-awaited wish to appear in DanEvo has come true! Wow (clapping)! It might not be familiar to those who don't play beatmania IIDX, but this time, I was able to dance to "Follow Tomorrow", a song included in beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle.
Actually, when DanEvo was first released, HHH wondered "whether Follow Tomorrow could somehow be crossed over...", and then the DanEvo staff unexpectedly called us.
My delicious dance part in beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle's exclusive movie, plus the new choreography, was able to be crossed over to DanEvo. I'm fully grateful to the DanEvo staff for choosing this song to be crossed over among the many BEMANI songs. Well, the choreography is essential, and the impressive choreography from the movie was retained, while I obsessed over aspects like "how can you enjoy dancing to it?" and "is it fun to play as a game in DanEvo?".
There's some quite complicated choreography, but I hope you'll carefully learn and enjoy it.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A portion of Habibe (Antuh muhleke) is featured in [[CS DDR HOTTEST PARTY3|DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY3]]'s [[HOTTEST PARTY 2]] nonstop megamix. == Trivia == {{gallery}} * Habibe (Antuh muhleke) is Jun Wakita's first DanceDanceRevolution CS original song. ** It's also his first song under the Sulk Cambyses alias. ** It's also his first DanceDanceRevolution song with vocals. * Cambyses I was king of Anshan in Iran from c. 580 to 559 BC and the father of Cyrus the Great (Cyrus II), younger son of Cyrus I, and brother of Arukku. * In Jun Wakita's [http://web.archive.org/web/20160314022016/http://p.eagate.573.jp/game/bemani/p/artist/artist_wac.html BEMANI Fan Site profile] (archived), Habibe (Antuh muhleke)'s title and artist were accidentally changed to '''Habibe''' and '''Antuh muhleke''', respectively. * Habibe (Antuh muhleke)'s song comments are written in Arabic, Persian, and Japanese. ** It's the first BEMANI song with Arabic and Persian song comments. * In DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY2 / [[CS DDR FuruFuruParty|フルフル♪パーティー]], Habibe (Antuh muhleke) uses the ''Double Stomp'' gimmick. * Habibe (Antuh muhleke) is one of the unlockable songs of DanceDanceRevolution (2014)'s ''EXTRA ATTACK'' unlocking system. It was added on July 18th, 2014. ** From December 17th, 2015 onwards, Habibe (Antuh muhleke) has been automatically unlocked for all players. * Habibe (Antuh muhleke) received Double charts in DanceDanceRevolution (2014). * The ''DanceDanceRevolution X & フルフル♪パーティー Original Soundtrack'' booklet doesn't list Habibe (Antuh muhleke)'s lyrics. * Habibe (Antuh muhleke) is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 13th, 2025, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.3''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.3). == Song Production Information == === Sulk Cambyses === "Hajimemashite." Hello, everyone in Japan.
My name is Sulk Cambyses. I lead a leisurely life in Dubai. Oil is so wonderful.
I was very honored to be able to create a song for the great dance game which Japan should be proud of.
I was so excited about creating this song.
People in Dubai are also talking about this dance game.
I played the game, too, and got so excited and hot. It's really hot here, you know?
I wanted to talk more about this song, but to be honest, I am not even quite sure how to pronounce the title of this song.
Well, I pray for everyone's peace... === DanceDanceRevolution Community === A fast-paced journey to the far east - ensnaring even the most careful traveler with it's enchanting rhythms and mysterious melodies. Created by wac under his Sulk Cambyses alias, this song is sure to become a fan favorite. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. == Song Connections / Remixes == * The GuitarFreaks & DrumMania version of Idola has louder guitars than the other versions in other games. * An instrumental version of Idola, titled ''Idola(カラオケ)'', can be downloaded from the ''Chakushin★uta♪'' (着信★うた♪) service. * The ノスタルジア version of Idola is slightly longer, with an extended outro, and featuring additional piano arrangement by Jun Wakita. * A symphonic arrangement of Idola by 原口 大, titled ''Idola (Orchestra Arr.)'', appears in the [[BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] album. ** A short version of Idola (Orchestra Arr.), titled [[Idola (BEMANI SYMPHONY Arr.)]], appears in [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Idola is a song part of the [[GUMI 5th Anniversary party Presented by BEMANI]] event. It was added on June 26th, 2014 as an unlockable song: ** In beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, Idola's NORMAL, HYPER, and ANOTHER charts are unlockable after playing 3, 6, and 10 credits respectively (you must [http://p.eagate.573.jp/game/2dx/21/p/information/gumi_stamp.html unlock the charts on the event website] though). ** In DanceDanceRevolution (2014), it's one of the songs of the ''EXTRA ATTACK'' unlocking system. *** From [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] onwards, Idola is playable by default. ** In GITADORA OverDrive, it can be unlocked by clearing [[Amanojaku|天ノ弱]], [[BambooSword Girl|バンブーソード・ガール]], [[Gensoukei sekaishuufuku shoujo|幻想系世界修復少女]], [[Houkago stride|放課後ストライド]], [[Manemane psychotropic|マネマネサイコトロピック]], and [[Setsuna trip|セツナトリップ]] on any difficulty. It could be unlocked from June 26th, 2014 to July 31st, 2014. *** As of [[AC GD Tri-Boost|GITADORA Tri-Boost]], it is available by default. ** In jubeat saucer fulfill, you must collect the reward stamps by unlocking all the five songs from the ''Smith Seminar Natsu no jin'' (スミスゼミナール夏の陣) event. It could be unlocked from June 29th, 2014 to February 16th, 2015. *** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. *** As of [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is available by default. ** In pop'n music ラピストリア, you must play バンブーソード・ガール and 幻想系世界修復少女 in one credit. Idola will appear on the next stage. *** From [[AC pnm eclale|pop'n music éclale]] onwards, Idola is playable by default. ** In REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!, Idola's BASIC, MEDIUM and HARD charts are unlockable on the Reflec Shop after playing four GUMI songs, eight GUMI songs and twelve GUMI songs respectively. You can purchase each chart for 300, 700, and 1000 Refle for BASIC, MEDIUM, and HARD respectively. *** Since August 13th, 2014, it is automatically available for all players to purchase. *** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]] and [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], Idola is playable by default. ** In SOUND VOLTEX II -infinite infection- and [[AC SDVX III|III GRAVITY WARS]], Idola's NOVICE and ADVANCED charts could be unlocked by playing either バンブーソード・ガール or 幻想系世界修復少女 on any difficulty, while its EXHAUST chart could be unlocked by clearing バンブーソード・ガール's EXHAUST chart. *** As of [[AC SDVX IV|SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN]], its EXHAUST chart can be purchased without any prerequisites, while its NOVICE and ADVANCED charts are available by default. * Idola is iconoclasm's first song with vocals, and their first non-crossover song to have its own unique video. * Idola is Latin for "idol". * In pop'n music, instead of displaying its character's portrait, Idola displays its jacket when selected. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Idola's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * Idola was added to BeatStream on June 19th, 2014. Its MEDIUM and BEAST charts could be unlocked via the BisCo mail ''Happy Birthday!!（＞∀＜）'' in ''Takahashi-san Lab.''. ** As of December 3rd, 2015, these charts have been unlocked by default. * In DanceDanceRevolution (2014), Idola received CHALLENGE charts on July 4th, 2014. ** Idola's CHALLENGE charts are the fifth charts rated Level 17 in the DanceDanceRevolution series that do not have BPM changes, stops, or Shock Arrows. * Idola received a new title card on the July 16th, 2014 update of beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA, with the song name written in a different font and an acknowledgement to ''INTERNET Co., Ltd.'', the developers of the GUMI VOCALOID software. * In ''ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom'', Idola received a new jacket, and Idola's artist is just credited to '''iconoclasm'''. * Idola did not appear in [[CS GD|GITADORA (Mobile)]]. * Idola is one of the songs featured on the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V-97ucPnRT4 BEMANI SONGS　～Best of BeatStream～] video. * Idola received a HEAVENLY chart in [[AC SDVX IV|SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN]] as part of the [[BLASTER GATE]] unlock system. It can be unlocked from September 13th, 2018. * Idola is one of the unlocks of ノスタルジア Op.2's ''GUMI 10th Anniversary Island'' event. It could be unlocked from June 26th to July 10th, 2019 by collecting 76 stamps. ** It could be unlocked again from October 31st to November 21st, 2019. ** In [[AC NST Op.3|ノスタルジア Op.3]], it could be unlocked from June 11th, 2020 from the [[AC NST Op.3/Old Hidden Songs|ノスタルジアFORTE&Op.2 イベント]] section at the Episode selection screen. *** From June 26th, 2025 in ノスタルジア Op.3, it is available by default. * Idola has never been on ''any'' CS BEMANI game. * Idola is absent from the offline version of [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]]. * The original version of Idola cannot be found on any BEMANI soundtrack, although it can be purchased from the [https://uta.573.jp/konamimusic KONAMI♪MUSIC] service. ** However, its ノスタルジア arrangement can be found on the ''NOSTALGIA Music Collection ～Op.2～'' album. == Music Comment == GUMI 10th Anniversary commemorative recording == Song Production Information == None. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

This was fixed as of [[AC pnm Lapistoria|pop'n music ラピストリア]]. * JOMANDA appears as part of [[POLICY BREAK Medley from SOUND VOLTEX x jubeat|POLICY BREAK Medley from SOUND VOLTEX×jubeat]], which appears in [[AC SDVX IV|SOUND VOLTEX IV HEAVENLY HAVEN]]. * A symphonic medley of JOMANDA, [[VALLIS-NERIA]], and [[Lisa-RICCIA]] by [[Kennosuke Ono|onoken]], titled ''JOMANDA・VALLIS-NERIA・Lisa-RICCIA (Orchestra Arr.) スペシャルメドレー'', can be found on the [[BEMANI SYMPHONY ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] album. ** A short version of the JOMANDA part of the above medley, titled [[JOMANDA (BEMANI SYMPHONY NOSTALGIA mix)]], appears in [[AC NST Op.3|ノスタルジア Op.3]]. == Trivia == * JOMANDA is the only song of Phase 2 of the [[APPEND TRAVEL]] event. It could be unlocked in jubeat copious APPEND by unlocking all 6 songs in the event, then travelling to the DJ YOSHITAKA star. ** In [[AC jb saucer|jubeat saucer]], it can be unlocked via the ''bistro saucer'' unlocking event. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. ** From [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|jubeat beyond the Ave.]] onwards, it is available by default with an [[e-amusement]] pass. * In keeping with DJ YOSHITAKA's plant motif, Jomanda is a cultivar of dahlia, a genus of plants. * JOMANDA's jubeat charts were created by [[Hiroyuki Masuda|まっする]]. * JOMANDA is the ''jubeat copious LIMIT BURST'' (EXTRA STAGE) song of beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro. It was made available to play on December 12th, 2012. ** In [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]], its NORMAL, HYPER, and ANOTHER charts can be unlocked by obtaining 131, 140, and 149 Tran Medals respectively. ** As of July 24th, 2014, it could be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA and [[AC PENDUAL|22 PENDUAL]] through the [[Hakken! Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki|発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡]] event. ** As of July 1st, 2015, it could be purchased in beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL with ''Youkou no hologram'' (陽光のホログラム). ** As of [[AC copula|beatmania IIDX 23 copula]], it is available by default. * JOMANDA is the only LIMIT BURST song that received a brand-new video. ** Although all other LIMIT BURST songs received song/video comments on the beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro NEW SONG page in order of their in-game appearance, JOMANDA's was skipped. Release the destined cross...! == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== DJ YOSHITAKA ==== Before I knew it, I somehow made this song over a year ago.
Time really flies by so fast, doesn't it? Since I specifically wrote this song for jubeat, when I heard that it will be included here, my heart froze because I wasn't sure if whether the BPM changes would suit IIDX, but I was surprised by the enlightening movie which swept my worries away. T_da seriously motivated me. She's amazing. Although in jubeat there's a section where you can press a cross, I wondered~ how to express this in IIDX, and I still clearly remember when I first saw the red cross in the movie, I pointed out "that's right!". === jubeat === Untranslated. == Video Production Information == === T_da === Although it's just the act of writing and composing my own character settings, cool signature phrases, and poems in my notebook, it still lives inside me as a precious memory which vividly shines, even though the wound occasionally hurts.
Well, around the time I made this movie, I was convinced that notebook was fully packed with JOMANDA keys, and I dug out a forbidden notebook from my room in my parent's house.
It's a sweet nightmare. An unbroken seal. The notebook's cover, which I hadn't seen in a long time, was written in my own handwriting as "THE joke notebook".
I particularly gave my notebook that name since it was slightly cold at an absolute zero level, but it's "joke" of all things, and "THE" at the very beginning...
Also, it would've been more normal to definitely give it a name like "sacred book" or "identity notebook", so if I was a parent, I'd worried about the future of my daughter. Well, its contents are filled with extreme laughter and pandemonium that I can't show them, but among the many poems written in my notebook, a certain one caught my attention. One wing is burnt in hellfire, and the fallen angel is dyed black
A fleeting dream in an unreachable sanctuary ... Huh... I can't believe JOMA.boy was living inside me for over ten years.
It's not hard to imagine his unpredictability. This seems like something several adolescent troublemakers across Japan would all think about. With such reassuring item in my hands, while being encouraged, gouged, and sometimes consulted by its contents, even when I sleep or wake up, I'm in a JOMANDA state for over several nights, and I was woken by my twin brother and sister when I was about to fall into darkness, and I plucked JOMA-boy's feathers to cure my worries when I was stuck
"I want the eye to be more flashy and shiny! Because that's important!" (DJ YOSHITAKA) "OK! I'll make a cross!" (Me)
The movie was completed from beginning to end with a peaceful atmosphere.
Repeatedly in my mind, I kept thinking ((the fact that I think it's embarrassing, is embarrassing)).... == Jacket Design Information == === T_da === The corrupted wing burned by taboos, and a broken pair of admonished eyes like blood...
Waiting to self-destruct at the end of civilization he suffered everywhere from his old age, his soul is dry and his throat is burned
--- Struggling at the end of the world... ---
Even amidst the chaos, he pursues his yearned revival inside him, and to eventually return to the fierce heavens... (Translation) When I created this jacket, the wounded wing and odd-eye made me remember my middle school days, when I was very serious about drawing, and I had a relatively strange and exalted feeling despite being embarrassed.
As many of you know, this has a slightly similar pair with VALLIS-NERIA's jacket, which is included in [[AC RB limelight|REFLEC BEAT]]. Which one do you like?
Anyways, DJ YOSHITAKA's unreasonableness was also in full display this time. == Character Information == Shaking his feathers wet with sin, waiting for his awakening together with the accumulating flowers === T_da === When you face the one-winged odd-eyed person wearing in a suit with a serious look, I'm sure many bittersweet and crazy memories will come back to you.
I'm rolling around in my bed. Nice to meet you, my name is T_da.
I've known JOMANDA for quite a long time, but this time, I'm thankfully in charge of his character animations. I'm not used to, or rather, I'm struggling with deformed characters and animations, since he wasn't originally a pop'n character, and they usually appear to have big movements... I think
I tried to draw rough sketches of him doing gags such as backwards somersaults, backflips, and knee drops, but well, he doesn't move like this~... was my own response
Several active JOMANDAs became sacrifices.
However, since only the cartwheel-like animation survived the FEVER animation, smug... also, pay attention to his face!
Finally, since I still don't have enough training, although I can't expose my strongest thoughts about JOMANDA's settings in public, he's a kind-hearted, clumsy, and lonely person.
If you feel like it, please beckon for him to be a good child while saying "JOMA-boy, come here". == Chart Production Information == === MUSCLE === DJ YOSHITAKA means YOSHITAKA tornado!
So, this time, I tried to make the notecharts turn counter-clockwise. It's like going back in time. I first arranged them, then created another chart. Oh, this song also has cross patterns.
