It can be unlocked in SOUND VOLTEX ∇ from January 29th, 2026 to March 22nd, 2026. == Music Comment == Welcome to a fantastic world of sad melodies and cute voices. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX 18 Resort Anthem Official Website === ==== Halka ==== I'm Halka, who helps out with HHH♪ This time, Halka and moimoi produced a new unit, "Cream puff". After all, bubblegum dance should have cute vocals!
It's been a few years since I said it was on my "let's do it" list. This time, we finally said "let's really do it", and I was unexpectedly given a big role as producer! I was entrusted to write these lyrics... it was quite an important responsibility, and I remember groaning and moaning every day whenever I slept or woke up. After doing various things, the shiny Mermaid girl was finally born.
I've already heard it many times! The lead singer of this song is the super new diva moimoi, who has a miraculous super cute voice!
And its sparkling sound is created by Ryu☆, who's known for his catchy melodies!
With the mighty power of them both, this impressive result far exceeded my imagination!!! I'd be happy if you could feel the newness and nostalgia of those days☆ By all means, please play it! ==== moimoi ==== Everyone~♪, nice to meet you! I'm moimoi☆☆☆. One day, I received a sparkling melody alongside a shiny Lyric. From the moment I saw and listened to this, my hair shined in rainbow colors!
I tried my hardest to sing it while filled with various fantasies! I'm very grateful to Ryu☆ and Halka for delivering this lovely song to me! Well, everyone! Let's depart to a rainbow world together♪♪♪ ==== Ryu☆ ==== I'm Ryu☆, who's in charge of the Sound for "Cream puff/Mermaid girl"!
Under Halka P's passionate directions, I'm proud that it became a lovely song!
I'm looking forward to everyone's heavy play! === beatmania IIDX 18 Resort Anthem Original Soundtrack === This is a Euro dance pop tune (bubblegum dance) by Cream puff, a brand-new project started by Halka, a VJ from the well-known BEMANI series unit HHH, and the singer moimoi. The cute lyrics & vocals are completely in English, and the sparkling sound match this girly song. Ryu☆ is in charge of the sound creation. === pop'n music === ==== Cream puff (Halka) ==== Hello, I'm Halka!
I'm usually a member of HHH, but I was in charge of producing and writing lyrics here. The story is based on The Little Mermaid.
The lyrics are a bit sad, but if you've ever shared these same feelings, you can relate to them.
That's why every girl is a princess! Cream puff has the same meaning in English.
What kind of cream puffs do you like? I like stacking a tower of small puffs.
I want to share them with everyone, have some tea, and enjoy eating them together! ==== Cream puff (moimoi) ==== Hello! I'm moimoi! Halka invited me to sing Mermaid girl, and it's my very, very lucky song!
This song allowed me to meet everyone who enjoys playing music games☆彡 Two years later, everyone said
"Mermaid girl is my favorite song!"
"I know moimoi from Mermaid girl"
Which made me very happy^^ The lyrics are sad, but cute at the same time
(Such as "Sugar and spices and all that's nice"!)
With a sparkling melody, it gave birth to a new moimoi voice that has never been heard before! By the way, I love cream puffs!!
I love all kinds of them, whether they have soft dough or crunchy tops!!! ==== Ryu☆ ==== I'm Ryu☆, who's in charge of the sound.
Mermaid girl has finally arrived in pop'n. In beatmania IIDX, there's the original and Akiba koubou MIX
In Dance Dance Revolution, there's the original
In REFLEC BEAT / [[CS RB plus|REFLEC BEAT plus]], there's the Ryu☆Remix
And, in pop'n music, there's the original too It's thanks to your support that you can play this song in various games.
Thank you very much Huh? Do I like cream puffs?
Soft pie is my preferred type.
Soft pie is my preferred type. == Video Production Information == === Fukutomi WAVE === Will you notice the wish hidden in bubbles from the bright and adorable singing voice? Will you notice the fleeting girl who jumps out from a sweet and beautiful paradise? But you surely won't notice them, and that's a very sad fairy tale... == Character Information == None. == Choreography Information == === [[Dai.]] === It's summer! It's a festival! It's DanEvo! So MermaGirl, which I've been personally and fiercely pushing hard for some time, came to DanEvo!!
Yay yay.
This is a dancing mermaid girl, whose choreography was specially arranged for DanEvo from the version shown at Ryu☆ and moimoi's live performances. It's energetic.
It incorporates a catchy but very intense choreo, so boys and girls, please have fun dancing to it! == Staff Comments == === [[Daichi Watanabe|PON]] === A mermaid is perfect for fantasia!
That's why we decided to cross it over.
When I first listened to it when IIDX18 was released, I wondered "who's this cute vocalist?".
After that, moimoi received more attention. It's a good story, isn't it?
I want to eat cream puffs every once------------- in a while, maybe twice a year.
The moist ones from convenience stores are enough for me. === [[eimy]] === Wo~w! Now you can play it in pop'n quite early! I love how cute it is. === [[tokky]] === When I heard the song for the first time, I thought it was sparkling and cute~ and I didn't realize the lyrics were sad!
The Little Mermaid has a sad fate, someone please make her happy. === [[Chihiro Inoue|Chihi]] === This cute song has a strong image of a sailor girl sporting a bare midriff.
pop'n has a youthful mermaid girl which fits perfectly with the song title! === [[Ryo Sugawara|Ga~su~]] === Was it a sad song!? I don't understand English, so I thought the song was much brighter...
As a side note, I like cream puffs filled with cream. === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === moimoi's success is great, isn't it? She's already a pop'n character too!
Recently, drinking cream puffs seems to be popular~ === [[Shinjiro Otsu|Otsu]] === Cream puffs absolutely contain fresh cream. === [[Tomoko Shiono|shio]] === It's wonderful that the unit name is named after a candy. It contains perfect, sweet vocals, and is a sparkling song♪
I'm impressed that it's sung well at the beginning, like a tongue twister.
Here, I tried to imitate it to learn how to be cute, but it doesn't seem to have yellow temperance. ...shionin is in the mood to eat choux ice cream today. === [[Jun Wakita|wac]] === The hard ones have a luxurious quality that gives me high satisfaction, but I also like soft ones. I think soft puffs are nice for my stomach.
I'm happy if it not only contains custard, but fresh cream as well. I also like ice cream puffs for some reason.
I'm a person who likes éclairs. Éclair is a cool name, isn't it? Oh, speaking of bubblegum, it's more like old-fashioned pop, and I'm not familiar with dance music myself, but when I first heard this song, it reminded me of the early DDR years and I felt nostalgic.
This song was my first moimoi song. Surprisingly, it's very recent. I just noticed, but it's a mermaid because of bubblegum, isn't it? Or is it bubblegum because of a mermaid?
Either way, I can't help but hope KIRARA doesn't disappear like a bubble again. === [[Yuki Shibata|Mameshiba]] === It's abbreviated as "MermaGirl", which Mameshiba is familiar with.

= NEPHILIM DELTA = == Song Information == [[Image:NEPHILIM_DELTA.png|thumb|NEPHILIM DELTA's jacket.]] Artist: L.E.D.-G

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * NEPHILIM DELTA's beat structure shares similarities with [[STEEL NEEDLE]], [[CHIP'N'RIDDIM]], and [[Cookie Bouquets]]. * NEPHILIM DELTA is part of L.E.D.'s "GIANT" series, along with [[TITANS RETURN]]. ** According to L.E.D., these two songs were developed at the same time. == Trivia == * NEPHILIM DELTA is Toshiyuki Kakuta's first original composition for an arcade release of DanceDanceRevolution not released simultaneously with another BEMANI game. * NEPHILIM DELTA was the second ENCORE EXTRA STAGE song from DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX, at Extra Stage Level 2 (January 25th, 2012). ** At Extra Stage Level 3 (April 25th, 2012), it was moved down to EXTRA STAGE. ** As of July 23rd, 2012, NEPHILIM DELTA has been unlocked for normal play. * According to the Bible, the Nephilim were giants who inhabited Canaan. * NEPHILIM DELTA is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 22nd, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.4''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.4). * NEPHILIM DELTA is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS DanceDanceRevolution Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS DanceDanceRevolution セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). == Song Production Information == === L.E.D.-G === Hey everyone, L.E.D. here. I was asked by [[Yasuhiro Taguchi|TAG]] to produce a high-speed HARDCORE song for DDR X3, and the result is "NEPHILIM DELTA".
"Nephilim" is the name of a race of giants (or so it is generally interpreted) that appear in the Old Testament. In my own mind, I categorize this song as part of my "GIANT series", along with "TITANS RETURN", which I produced for [[AC RB limelight|REFLEC BEAT limelight]] around the exact same time.
I produced both of them with a heavy and dynamic theme in mind, imagining giants stomping around with their massive bodies... if I remember correctly. However, 10-footers in [[CS DDR UNIVERSE|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE]] were named "APOCALYPTIC". * PARANOiA Revolution's Single DIFFICULT chart uses a portion of PARANOiA MAX～DIRTY MIX～'s EXPERT chart during the former's 360 BPM section. * PARANOiA Revolution appeared on the Japanese TV show ''Osaka Honwaka TV'' (大阪ほんわかテレビ). * PARANOiA Revolution was one of the qualifying round songs in [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 8th KONAMI Arcade Championship]] for DanceDanceRevolution A. * PARANOiA Revolution is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 13th, 2024, by purchasing '''BEMANI SELECTION music pack vol.1''' (BEMANI SELECTION楽曲パック vol.1). == Song Production Information == === CLIMAX of MAXX 360 === Should I make this remix, or not? Truth be told, I was torn about it until the very last minute. This installment features the coexistence of the latest title, X3, and the classic [[AC DDR 2nd|2ndMIX]]. From a creator's perspective, one always wants to take on new challenges. Because of this, our predecessors have released countless tracks since [[PARANOiA]], including the [[MAX 300|MAX]] series, EVOLVED series, [[Pluto]] series, as well as songs related to [[Trigger]] and Replicant D-action. Given that, shouldn't I also create a completely new track this time around to establish a new legacy for the future? That is what I had been thinking. However, the game's title itself includes "vs 2ndMIX". In an installment where it stands at the forefront right alongside X3, how could I possibly do nothing? But was it truly the right choice to shift the focus back to 2ndMIX here? I struggled with this inner conflict for a long time. While I remained undecided and production neared its end, the development team had made the 2ndMIX MODE ready for test playing. As I was in charge of sound implementation, I had all the voice and sound effect assets on hand, but that was the first time I had actually seen everything put together in-game.
The moment I played it, memories from back in the day came rushing back. "Ah, yes, this is exactly what DDR was all about." While it felt incredibly nostalgic, it also felt strangely fresh. It was a moment that reminded me of something I had long forgotten.
I thought about what I would want if I were a player. When I looked at it from that perspective, I knew I had no choice but to do this remix after all. That is how this track was born. The opponent I faced was my past self. Perhaps what I was truly going "vs" against wasn't just DDR, but myself. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards, and 1 to 10 on DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX's 2ndMIX MODE. Other Music Game Appearances: * [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] * ミライダガッキ FutureTomTom Ver.2 == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * Programmed Universe is part of kors k's "Programmed" song series. * An extended version of Programmed Universe appears in kors k's anthology album, [[S2TB Files Best&Rare Archives]]. == Trivia == * Programmed Universe is the only BEMANI song in the "Programmed" song series that does not originate from the beatmania IIDX series. ** According to Kosuke Saito, [[Toshiyuki Kakuta]] questioned him about why he wrote Programmed Universe for DanceDanceRevolution and not for beatmania IIDX [https://www.facebook.com/saito.kosuke.3/posts/245673282172453]. * According to Kosuke Saito in Programmed Universe's song comments, Programmed Universe was the final song in the "Programmed" song series. However, he later made another song in the series, ''Programmed GAIA'', which appears in his album [[Let's Do It Again!!]]. * Programmed Universe's title was named after the [[CS DDR UNIVERSE|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE]] series of games. ** The S2TB Files Best&Rare Archives album website states that Programmed Universe debuted in the DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE series, rather than DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX. * Programmed Universe was one of the qualifying round songs in the [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|KONAMI Arcade Championship 2012]] for DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX. * Programmed Universe is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from May 25th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.20''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.20). ** It received brand-new CHALLENGE charts, which become available by purchasing both this and '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.19''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.19). ** By purchasing both packs with an active subscription, Programmed Universe's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]]. ** From May 31st, 2024 in DanceDanceRevolution A3, they are available by default for all players. * Programmed Universe is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS Music Pack vol.23''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS 楽曲パック vol.23). == Song Production Information == === kors k === This is an extra installment and the final chapter of the "Programmed" series.
Since this track is being released on DDR, I settled on this title as a nod to DDR Universe.
(Though in terms of meaning, it seems to overlap a bit with "[[Programmed World|World]]".)
Looking back, it's already been a few years since I started producing Psy Trance.
I feel like I'm finally able to achieve the exact sound I've been aiming for.
I included a dubstep-flavored section in the middle with complete confidence, thinking, "There's no way dubstep and DDR wouldn't be a perfect match!"
What did you think of it? == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It could be unlocked from June 25th, 2008. ** From August 6th, 2008, it is available by default. * According to [[Jun Wakita|wac]], SigSig was put in pop'n music 16 PARTY♪ due to its overwhelming popularity. * SigSig does not have a 2P color. * SigSig was added to jubeat on December 15th, 2008. It can be played from jubeat to [[AC jb copious APPEND|copious APPEND]] with an [[e-amusement|e-AMUSEMENT]] PASS. ** In [[AC jb saucer|jubeat saucer]], it can be unlocked via the ''bistro saucer'' unlocking event. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** As of [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is available by default by playing with an [[e-amusement]] pass. * SigSig's jubeat (2021) ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses the jubeat jacket of SigSig, without the beatmania IIDX logo. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], SigSig's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * SigSig received an EASY chart in [[AC pnm Sunny Park|pop'n music Sunny Park]], replacing its old 5-Buttons chart. * SigSig received a new BEGINNER chart in [[AC Lincle|beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle]], instead of using its CS one. * In ポップンリズミン, SigSig's EX chart was re-rated on July 13th, 2014. * SigSig received RENEWAL charts in [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]]. * SigSig can be unlocked in BeatStream アニムトライヴ from September 14th, 2016 as part of the ''Suzuki-san present daisakusen'' (スズキサンプレゼント大作戦) event. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], SigSig was revived on March 23rd, 2017. * SigSig is one of the 2 Players/みんなでBATTLE exclusive songs in DANCERUSH STARDOM. It was available for play from July 30th to August 3rd, 2018, from August 6th to 10th, 2018, from August 13th to 17th, 2018, and from August 20th to 24th, 2018. ** It is permanently available from August 27th, 2018 (though it is still limited to 2 Players/みんなでBATTLE). ** From September 25th, 2018, it is available for all game modes. * SigSig [ 2 ] is one of the unlocks of [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]]'s ''T-emo STORE''. It could be purchased with 200 T-emo from December 3rd, 2018 to January 7th, 2019. ** It can be purchased again with 150 T-emo from July 1st to August 4th, 2019, from February 3rd to March 2nd, 2020, and from December 7th, 2020 to January 4th, 2021. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * SigSig is available in [[CS pnm Lively|pop'n music Lively]] as part of the '''beatmania IIDX Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (beatmania IIDX セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). * SigSig is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from February 20th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.16''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.16). * SigSig appears as selectable background music in ''CHASE CHASE JOKERS'' (チェイスチェイスジョーカーズ), and during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. * SigSig was added to ポラリスコード on August 7th, 2026. == Music Comment == This slightly cute Spanish hardcore song falls in pop'n. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== kors k ==== Let's make a song for female BMers! I created this song with that in mind.
So anyways, while consciously thinking of a cute melody, I arranged it with several sounds which emphasize the gameplay.
(Actual makina songs are much simpler than this!)
I hope you'd feel summer-ish and cuteness when you listen to it!
By the way, the title is called SigSig.
I included it with a proper reason, but it's too embarrassing, so I'll leave it out ^-^; === [[kors k 25th Anniversary ULTIMATE BEST]] === This song was created when I got into Hardcore music and thought its unique style and upbeat rhythm would work well in a music game. Around this time, I started to include more sampled voices in my songs. I remember that my PC back then was so weak that I had to make everything in mono whenever possible. === pop'n music === ==== kors k ==== Hello, I'm kors k.
This is my first appearance in pop'n.
My aura has previously begged wac to "please include me in pop'n", and it finally came true!
When I saw girls play SigSig on a pop'n cabinet at the arcade, I created this song with the feeling "pop'n is great, but please play it in IIDX!".
(Actually, I secretly wanted this song to be crossed over to pop'n if possible [laughs])
Also, to those who haven't played it in IIDX, if you like this song just a bit, by all means, please also try to play it in IIDX!
If you can clear this song here, you should be able to easily clear it in IIDX!
Well then, until we meet again! == Video Production Information == === MAYA === I created this video with many worries, based on the one keyword given to me by kors k.
What's ○○○~!? I thought.
The keyword is a secret.... does this satisfy kors k? When I heard this song, a Japanesque image suddenly came to my mind.
Furthermore, the girls in "[[HORIZON]]", kors k's [[AC IIDX RED|RED]] song, appeared in my mind.
I mixed the images that came to my mind, and tried to complete the video with a nostalgic young girl manga style. == Character Information == Today, we're going to cheerfully run a race~! Let's shout~!
1, 2, 3! Let's go~~~! Pyuu~~! === MAYA === Thanks to everyone's request power, this song was invited to pop'n PARTY from IIDX!
The three SigSig girls are close friends. Yes! Everyone~, please greet them! "Nice to meet you~"
"It's pop'n~!"
"Yaaaahoooooo!" ... I wonder who's the energetic girl~?
Ouch ouch If you're playing around, won't you fall down again~?
Kyai kyai ....
They're energetically dashing as usual! Plus jumping around.
... What do you mean? By all means, please try to play it.
The big SigSig girls are in IIDX, so please support them there as well! OK! ... Oh~ oh, they fell down again. == Chart Production Information == === [[Masanori Kono|Kon-chan]] === This is a cute song, but has a high tension!
I was able to make enjoyable notecharts with a balance between the parts with many and few sounds. Personally, I love the part in the ADVANCED chart where the number of notes increase with the sounds (was it slightly after the middle section?), and the part in the EXTREME chart where they're in the right-side to match the lyrics (where the singer is singing fast). (Did you get the "S" pattern in the final part of the EXTREME chart~) Please use the Afro character marker during the high tension "SigSig", so you can groovily play it even more! == Staff Comments == === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === I'm happy that kors k received a love call.
The questionnaire was filled with love calls. === [[Chihiro Inoue|chihiro]] === We've faithfully recreated everything, from name font, to illustrations~
When I traced maya's illustrations, I remember how I traced~ my favorite manga illustrations on transparent paper using a permanent marker when I was in elementary school. Chihi likes Pink-chan, who's the most energetic among them. === [[Ryuta Tamura|TAMA]] === The character moves quickly.
The dance Ojamas are also quite irritating. By the way, what's SigSig? === [[Yuki Shibata|Mameshiba]] === This is the quickest character in the history of pop'n! Have you experienced that "Zuko"?
And this is a homage to my comments on the official website of the previous [[AC pnm 15|pop'n 15]]'s SKA, "[[Ska a gogo|SKA A GO GO]]". (It's currently located in the BEMANI category.)
I first thought my playing speed was wrong, since it was too fast.
Every time I hear this impressive melody, "taatararaata taataata", I can't get it out of my head. === [[Kiyoshi Murai|Seiya Murai]] === When she falls down, she falls flat on her face, right? If you choose her as your character, please~ don't fall down as much as possible. === [[marimo|kinoko]] === I see, if you fall down like this, people will say "it's cute"...!
I'm going to practice falling down a bit. Zuko! === wac === Thanks kors k, and hello. It's been a while.
It wasn't SigSig, but I could feel your anguishing aura's desire. I'm just insensitively pretending to be a bad girl? But I'm not a woman.
I wanted to include it in pop'n someday.
Such a long-standing dream! Finally this time! Thanks to the many user requests, that time has come! Approximately. With an exaggerated manner. But this song isn't exaggerated. Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * Tohoku EVOLVED is part of the "EVOLVED" song series. ** Unlike most of the songs part of the "EVOLVED" song series, Tohoku EVOLVED only has one version. * Tohoku EVOLVED is a remix of [[London EVOLVED]] by [[Yasuhiro Taguchi|TAG underground]], which appears in [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II]]. * Tohoku EVOLVED was performed live as part of the ''DanceDanceRevolution 20th Anniversary NONSTOP MEGAMIX'' medley at [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 7th KONAMI Arcade Championship]]. * Tohoku EVOLVED shares similar pad synth melodies with [[MAX.(period)]], from [[CS DDR EXTREME JP|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (Japan)]]. == Trivia == [[Image:Tohokuevolvedclearscreen.jpg|thumb|Clear screen for Tohoku EVOLVED on DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS.]] {{Gallery}} * Tohoku EVOLVED was the ENCORE EXTRA STAGE song of the ''EXTRA TOUR'' event in DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX. It could be played as an ENCORE EXTRA STAGE since May 30th, 2012. ** As of September 26th, 2012, it was moved down to EXTRA STAGE. ** As of November 5th, 2012, it has been unlocked for normal play. * Tohoku EVOLVED is the only song in the EVOLVED series to not originate from a CS release of DanceDanceRevolution. * Tohoku EVOLVED references the earthquake and tsunami that struck the Tohoku region of Japan on March 11th, 2011. ** When cleared, the usual "CLEARED" message is replaced by a blue "Pray for All" message. This message was retained in all DanceDanceRevolution titles until [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]]. *** In [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] and [[AC DDR A20|A20]], the "Pray for All" message uses X3 VS 2ndMIX's font when Tohoku EVOLVED is played from the [[DDR SELECTION]] folder. ** If the WAVE option is enabled, the player cannot unlock Tohoku EVOLVED, even if they meet all other conditions. This is most likely a reference to the tsunami. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Tohoku EVOLVED's BPM was shown as 340 for all of its difficulties. This is most likely because the game could show BPMs in only three digits. ** The lowest and highest BPMs are 42.5 and 1020.8 respectively. ** This makes Tohoku EVOLVED the song with the highest BPM at any point (1021 BPM) in the DanceDanceRevolution series, topping the then-record of 800 BPM of [[Pluto Relinquish]]. ** Tohoku EVOLVED also has the second highest BPM at any point in all BEMANI games, behind [[D.I.X.]]'s 1080 BPM from [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]. ** Tohoku EVOLVED also has the second widest BPM range in all BEMANI games, with a peak low BPM-peak high BPM difference of 978.3 BPM, behind D.I.X.'s peak low-peak high BPM difference of 1010 BPM. * Tohoku EVOLVED has 4 different charts with only the last jump (during the speed-up to 1021 BPM) being in a different corner. This jump is random and affects all charts (except BEGINNER, which lacks the ending jump). * During Tohoku EVOLVED, the announcer does not speak anything other than combo announcements. == Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == * TWINKLE♡HEART is part of Phase 1 of the [[APPEND TRAVEL]] event. It was added to DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX on March 14th, 2012, and it could be unlocked in jubeat copious APPEND from the same date. ** In [[AC jb saucer|jubeat saucer]], it can be unlocked via the ''bistro saucer'' unlocking event. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * TWINKLE♡HEART is jun's only original song for the jubeat series. ** It also marks her final song in BEMANI entirely by herself. * TWINKLE♡HEART's jubeat charts were created by MICHI. * TWINKLE♡HEART was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see [[AC jb saucer/Song Swap System|this page]]. * TWINKLE♡HEART's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * TWINKLE♡HEART is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 19th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.12''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.12). * In DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, TWINKLE♡HEART received its difficulty change from [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] on July 3rd, 2024. == Song Production Information == === jun === It was September 10th, 2011... at TOWER RECORDS in Nu Chayamachi, Osaka, immediately after the release commemoration event of [[TERRA|TЁЯRA]]'s 2nd album "[[EVOLUTION (album)|ЁVOLUTIФN]]", [[Hiroyuki Masuda|MUSCLE]] and [[Shigeharu Saeki|Shoccho]] surprisingly came to visit us backstage.
The 4 of us including [[Naoki Maeda|NAOKI]] were getting excited until we were about to leave (laughs), when I was first told about this song's story. It's been only some months, but I'm still nostalgic...!
I had the opportunity to compose in the happy hardcore route after a long time, and I created this song while doing a small dance. After all, I'd like to compose one at least once a year. With this kind of taste. Is this opposite to TЁЯRA's songs (laughs)?
Furthermore, this time, I was able to write the lyrics and sing, so I'm simply really happy.
Thank you very much to everyone on the jubeat team for giving me this opportunity!!
Such feeling appears in this song, which resulted in a particularly bright song among those I've made.
By all means, ride the bursting beat, and please play it with a smile☆ == Jacket Design Information == === T_da === Even a black hole can't swallow it! Something like that.
I have the image of a flowing light which can't be controlled.
These geometric patterns suit jun's shining love songs, but during its production, my eyes were flickering & got screen-sick, so I always worked on it with half-open eyes. == Chart Production Information == === MICHI === Nice to meet you, I'm MICHI!
I'm finally able to appear here. Please take care of me. Are you enjoying TWINKLE HEART? I'm grateful.
I was originally in charge of [[HEAT-BIT-HIT-BEAT]]'s notecharts, but MUSCLE suddenly appeared,
MUSCLE "I'm going to swap both of you"
RAG and MICHI "!?"
Of course, RAG's fans knew about such things, right?
The 2 chips at the start of EXTREME are RAG's style! Amazing! It's interesting! Wow! When I immediately saw this song's EXTREME chart, I wanted to express the feeling☆ of twinkling☆ shining☆ stars☆, and shooting stars☆ like they're flying☆ vertically☆ and horizontally☆.
Shooting stars are fast, right?
You can't catch them, and then they turn black. And BASIC.
I created it while imagining jun dancing with pom poms. (Am I rude to her? It's surely alright)
I wonder if it ended up cute.
It may be easy to understand when you see them with the flower marker.
If you play it with your imagination, you may see something good☆ == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

It could be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX from March 14th, 2012, by acquiring a total of two Daily Stars. ** アルストロメリア (walk with you remix)'s CHALLENGE charts could be unlocked by acquiring five consecutive Daily Stars after unlocking [[TWINKLE HEART|TWINKLE♡HEART]]'s CHALLENGE charts. ** From [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]] onwards, アルストロメリア (walk with you remix) and its CHALLENGE charts are playable by default. * アルストロメリア (walk with you remix) is one of the Gauge unlockable songs in DanceEvolution ARCADE. It can be unlocked from September 2nd to September 29th, 2015, and from January 6th to January 12th, 2016. * アルストロメリア (walk with you remix) was added to DANCERUSH STARDOM on February 26th, 2020. * アルストロメリア (walk with you remix) is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 19th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.12''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.12). == Song Production Information == === TAG === This is a self-remix of "Alstroemeria", from jubeat copious. The original song was arranged in a fusion band style, and I wondered if arranging it with dance-styled rhythms would suit it, so I created it this time. Since it's dance-styled, I kept the main piano while adding a layer of synths to create a slightly different atmosphere to the original song. When I created the original song around this time last year, there were various things happening with my timing, so it had a somewhat sad melody and atmosphere, but I think this remix feels a bit more brighter and energetic because I had some free time and emotionally recovered. Even though the chord progressions and phrases are all similar, the differences appear from my emotions when I created it. In that sense, I think this song and the original are two sides of the same coin. When I started creating this self-remix, I felt "oh, I wish there was a way to make it like this", but on the other hand, I ended up doing everything I wanted to do with the original song, and I had a lot of fun discovering the feeling of pressure such as "oh no! This can't surpass the original song!". I can also say that I was desperate. The modulation zone was raised higher, as I enthusiastically raised it by a whole tone. == Song Connections / Remixes == * 繚乱ヒットチャート is the sequel to [[Pop music ron|ポップミュージック論]], MEGANE ROCK from [[AC pnm 13|pop'n music 13 カーニバル]]. * The shout at the very beginning of 繚乱ヒットチャート is different in the pop'n music series ("How low,P,M?"). == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * 繚乱ヒットチャート is available as an unlockable song in GuitarFreaks V3 & DrumMania V3's ''CHARA BATTLE''. ** As of November 6th, 2006, it is available by default in Standard Mode. * Data for an unused Bass EXTREME chart for 繚乱ヒットチャート can be found in GuitarFreaks V3. * pop'n music characters NAKAJI and SAYURI make cameo appearances in 繚乱ヒットチャート's video. * 繚乱ヒットチャート is one of the Stage 4 unlocks of pop'n music 16 PARTY♪'s ''Atsumare! pop'n PARTY♪'' (あつまれ！ポップンパーティー♪) event. It could be unlocked from July 2nd, 2008. ** From August 6th, 2008, it is available by default. * "Nanashi" means "nameless". The character itself is a sprite modification of NAKAJI, character of ポップミュージック論. ** SAYURI makes a cameo in NANASHI's WIN animation. ** NANASHI does not have a 2P color. * 繚乱ヒットチャート's pop'n music charts were created by wac. * With 678 notes, 繚乱ヒットチャート's NORMAL chart holds the record with the highest notecount for a Level 29 chart in pop'n music. * 繚乱ヒットチャート is available in GuitarFreaksXG & DrumManiaXG as an unlockable song in JukeBox #2 (June 9th, 2010). ** As of August 13th, 2010, it has been automatically unlocked into Standard Mode. * 繚乱ヒットチャート is one of DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX's ''Daily Special'' (デイリースペシャル) songs. It was added on February 23rd, 2012. ** As of May 28th, 2012, 繚乱ヒットチャート has been unlocked for normal play. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], 繚乱ヒットチャート's music video is shown in the background of the WHITE MOVIE background dance stage and is not full-screen. * 繚乱ヒットチャート was added to BeatStream アニムトライヴ on March 17th, 2016, as part of the ''BeaSt selection! Haru no Nyan matsuri!'' (ビーストせれくしょん! 春のにゃん祭り!) event. * 繚乱ヒットチャート (CLASSIC) could be unlocked in [[AC GD EXCHAIN|GITADORA EXCHAIN]] as one of the ''GF&DM CHRONICLE'' 2005～2006 songs from May 8th, 2019, by playing ten credits. ** In [[AC GD NEX+AGE|GITADORA NEX+AGE]], it could be unlocked from March 15th to June 21st, 2020 and from October 28th to November 29th, 2020 as part of the ''Thank you! GITADORA 21st kanshasai'' (サンキュー! ギタドラ21st感謝祭) event. ** As of [[AC GD FUZZ-UP|GITADORA FUZZ-UP]], it is available by default. * 繚乱ヒットチャート is available in [[CS pnm Lively|pop'n music Lively]] as part of the '''GITADORA Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (GITADORA セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). * 繚乱ヒットチャート is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from February 20th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.16''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.16). * 繚乱ヒットチャート and its CLASSIC charts received a widescreen video in GITADORA FUZZ-UP on November 28th, 2023. Sumidagawa is the name of a river in Japan that holds an annual fireworks festival, which is reflected in its jacket and video. * According to Kiyoshi Murai on an interview on the [http://p.eagate.573.jp/game/bemani/p/channel/popn_minnade20/sound/seiya1.html WE LOVE pop'n music Minna de tsukutte 20] website, 隅田川夏恋歌 was sped-up 1.5 times from its original speed after discussion with the jubeat staff, who deemed that the "tempo was too slow". * 隅田川夏恋歌 is one of the only two KONAMI originals from jubeat ripples never removed at any point in the jubeat arcade series, the other being [[Russian Snowy Dance]]. * 隅田川夏恋歌 was the only song to receive a difficulty change between jubeat ripples and [[AC jb knit|jubeat knit]]. * 隅田川夏恋歌 is a hidden song in pop'n music 18 せんごく列伝. They can be unlocked from July 16th, 2026. == Music Comment == A serious boyfriend and a tomboyish girl, a little heartwarming August scene. == Song Production Information == === jubeat === Untranslated. === pop'n music === ==== Seiya Murai ==== A fast crossover from jubeat ripples, this is Sumidagawa karenka.
It's often called "Sumidagawa" than the newly included genre name, and as someone who "cares about gossip", searching for its keywords on the internet is difficult.
When news came out that "oil floated from Sumidagawa", I wonder if a new expression will appear from "muddy stream"....
Even though it's not like its "muddy stream" in jubeat, many people seemed to enjoy the moderately difficult notecharts since its release.
jubeat and pop'n have maximized their characteristics of each game, and I probably felt nervous that "strange sweat came out". I thought for a while about not using ALT, but when I once again researched various production techniques for this song, its articulation slowly improved, and I thought about trying its various possibilities a bit more. It's originally an old software, so it's very difficult for to compete with a modern synthesizer girl's voice....
I can't expect programming technology advancements anymore, so I'd like to try and evolve ALT's voice with just analog efforts and determination to make it slightly easier to hear her sentences. I wonder when I can proudly name her "ALT ver.2.0". == Video Production Information == === Motoko === This time, the jubeat team gave us a lovely jacket and illustrations, so KINRUI created a base that made it easy to create, so it was very fun and groovy to work on it.
I really love the muddy stream scene in the chorus. === KINRUI === I was in charge of the storyboard and notecharts. I'm KINRUI.
You probably grinned when the charts imitated the jubeat markers. （＾▽＾//）
Speaking of Sumidagawa, I absolutely wanted to create this! And this materialized by passionately speaking to Motoko! I did it!
Manually placing the markers to individually match the timing... it was very difficult. But, I couldn't believe I was somehow in charge of Sumidagawa's movie!
As a player, I was completely swept by the muddy stream, and I was deeply moved. == Jacket Design Information == === T_da === An image came to my mind from the moment I heard this song, so I raised my hand and asked "please let me draw this jacket".
It didn't help that each lyric was cute, so I was lost on what scene to draw, but the "strawberry shaved ice" lyric became the final deciding factor as the scene. == Character Information == HELLO, I'M ELECTRONIC IDOL ALT☆
PLEASE, LISTEN TO MY SONG. FROM JUBEAT, FOR YOU, I WILL SING☆ === shio === Hello from the world of 4x4 squares.
Since it's feat.ALT, I immediately decided on Alt as the character, and furthermore selected the pixel ver.
Hmm. It's perfect for jubeat！■■■■ Also, the jacket illustration given by the designer who also did [[Polaris]], is also beautiful and enchanting.
There isn't a way where you can see it in big size on the homepage, so by all means, I wanted~ to create a gallery to show its appeal.
ALT's new color earned a reputation among the team as "appearing frozen and scary!", which was inspired from this jacket. Isn't the black silhouette nice?
Also, I added a fashionable ripples green. By the way, the "Zutto + CHARA-POP-kun" Ojama appears during the gameplay, so you can enjoy the Sumidagawa Fireworks Festival anytime.
If you're confident in your skills, please also try playing it with Jogesakasama! == Chart Production Information == === [[Hiroyuki Masuda|MUSCLE]] === This song somehow has fireworks and surface water!
I created the notecharts with the image of fireworks, and the reflections of their lights on the surface of the water. Did you understand?
The fireworks go up...
Boom! I tried to express various images of fireworks scattering everywhere. I'm unfortunately a very Kansai person, so I haven't seen the fireworks at Sumidagawa... So, please especially try to challenge it using the firework markers! I always listened to this song while creating the notecharts, so I casually hum it at random timing, right?
In ALT's voice style... == Staff Comments == === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === Fully cooperating with "MUSCLE" of jubeat, it was able to appear in pop'n.
There are hidden song hints released on websites besides pop'n! We also challenged this new attempt. === [[Daichi Watanabe|PON]] === The volume of the kicks was low during the data production, so I tried to raise the volume at once, but the distortion-styled kicks became louder, resulting in a funny balance.
And everyone laughed. === [[Shinjiro Otsu|Otsu]] === You can see various things on the shore of Sumidagawa. === Ga~su~ === The tempo is great that I unintentionally play it all the time.
It's a secret that I inevitably lose in the final stage.. === [[eimy]] === This is a lovely, cute, and exciting song! I think the fast BPM is its speedy heart. It's cuteee, cuteee!!/// I can draw a manga to this. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX diffculty rated from 1 to 12.

Upper]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * ΔMAX contains samples songs of the MAX series of boss songs, most notably from [[MAX 300]] and [[The legend of MAX]]. * An early version of ΔMAX was used as the EXTRA STAGE song for the ''DDR Forever'' Stepmania cabinet at the arcade Tokyo Game Action. This early version has softer keyboards and it lacks the explosion sounds every 100 BPM milestones of the song. * [[OVER(delta)|ØVER《Δ》]]'s title and BPM changes are references to ΔMAX [https://x.com/EmoCosine/status/1952559836346159559]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * ΔMAX was originally the EXTRA STAGE of ''DDR Forever'', a fan-made DanceDanceRevolution game that was run by the ''StepMania'' simulator. ** The song was intended to be only playable in DDR Forever, but eventually the simfile was leaked online. ** As such, ΔMAX is the first BEMANI song that was first originated on a BEMANI simulator. * ΔMAX, along with [[aftershock!!]] and [[Your Angel]] being crossed over mark William Shillito's first appearance in the arcade DanceDanceRevolution series. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], ΔMAX's music video, based on DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE3's generic videos, eliminates any on-screen dancers. ** In [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5]], ΔMAX's video is played in a tiny monitor on the opposite side of the player on Single and in the center on Double/Versus, due to Nintendo Wii memory limitations. * ΔMAX's BPM starts at 100 and gradually builds up by 1 BPM per quarter beat until it hits 573 BPM. This is shown by its unique video. ** The same sound effect is played every time the BPM hits a multiple of 100; this is accompanied in ΔMAX's video with a cut-in announcing a new "section". ** A post by DM Ashura on [https://www.reddit.com/r/learnmath/comments/5d7kz2/calculus_a_speedincreasing_song/da530gf/ reddit] details ΔMAX's BPM changes. ** ΔMAX's final BPM, 573, is a reference to the KONAMI number. *** Also, ΔMAX's EXPERT charts have 573 notes. ** In pre-DanceDanceRevolution WORLD installments of the DanceDanceRevolution series, ΔMAX's maximum BPM is shown as 573 for all of its difficulties. * Δ is the uppercase Greek letter "Delta", the fourth letter in the Greek alphabet. In mathematics and science, an uppercase Δ is a common abbreviation for "change" (e.g. Δ''x'' is shorthand for "change in ''x''"). ** This might be a reference to ΔMAX's constant gradual BPM changes. * In DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE3, ΔMAX can be unlocked in QUEST MODE by beating Simba on the final floor of the Universe Tower. * As of December 24th, 2010, ΔMAX's CHALLENGE charts have been made available for play in DanceDanceRevolution X2. These charts were written by DM Ashura himself as the original EXPERT charts planned for ΔMAX. ** ΔMAX's CHALLENGE charts were not playable in the North American/European arcade release of DanceDanceRevolution X2 due to the lack of [[e-AMUSEMENT]] in those regions. * ΔMAX appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''Mega Mix 6''' pack. * ΔMAX is used as background music in a mission on the KONAMI arcade game ''ROAD FIGHTERS'' (ロードファイターズ). * In DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5, ΔMAX is one of the ''Replicant D-action'' hidden songs. * ΔMAX can be unlocked in REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper from July 26th, 2015 as part of the [[BEMANI SUMMER DIARY 2015]] event. ** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]], it could be purchased in the Garage from November 16th, 2015 after obtaining 20 VOLZZA KEYs. *** In [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], it was playable by default. ** ΔMAX being crossed over marks William Shillito's only appearance in the REFLEC BEAT series. ** Also ΔMAX, reaching up to 573 BPM, holds the record for the song with the highest BPM at any point in the REFLEC BEAT series, topping [[Ongaku|音楽]]'s 520. * ΔMAX is the first DanceDanceRevolution crossover song in REFLEC BEAT with a HARD chart rated Level 10+ (11 in REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA/VOLZZA 2). * When sorted alphabetically, ΔMAX was sorted under the "number & symbol" (数字 記号) folder in [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]] and [[AC DDR 2014|DanceDanceRevolution (2014)]]. The name of this folder changed to "NUMBER" in DanceDanceRevolution A, which resulted in ΔMAX being erroneously sorted under it. This was fixed on June 9th, 2016 by moving ΔMAX to the "D" folder. * ΔMAX was one of the qualifying round songs in [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 6th KONAMI Arcade Championship]] for DanceDanceRevolution A. * ΔMAX's difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], ΔMAX was revived on December 18th, 2019. * ΔMAX is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 20th, 2021, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.1''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.1). == Song Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * Versions of going up without vocals, guitars, bass, or drums can be found on the ''GuitarFreaks & DrumMania V Musician's Room "JAM" Collection'' album, a bonus gift that was included with the first pressing of [[CS GFDM V|GuitarFreaks V & DrumMania V CS]]. * A Chinese cover of going up, credited to 色彩乃夢, appears in DanceDanceRevolution X2. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * going up marks Takayuki Ishikawa's first original song in the GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series. ** It also marks colors' first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * During the GuitarFreaks V & DrumMania V location test, going up used a generic video. ** Its placeholder banner can be found unused in the GuitarFreaks V & DrumMania V data. * going up is available for play in GuitarFreaksXG3 & DrumManiaXG3 as an unlockable song in ''Pleasure Box'' Volume 6, from July 11th to August 7th, 2012. * going up (and its Chinese version) can be unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution X2 from December 1st, 2010. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], going up's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * The Chinese version of going up could be played on the DanceDanceRevolution series by playing going up's CHALLENGE chart. ** going up's Chinese version marks the second time that Takayuki Ishikawa uses his Shikisai no yume (色彩乃夢) alias, after [[Desire]]. ** As of [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], the Japanese version of going up will be played instead. * The Chinese version of going up has never been ''any'' CS release. * going up was performed at ''THE GITADO LIVE 2011'' concert, although exclusively in the event held in Tokyo in 2011. * going up received a new jacket in [[AC GD|GITADORA]]. * The male character from going up's video, Aotsuki, would later become a selectable character in [[AC GD OverDrive|GITADORA OverDrive]]'s Battle System. * Through an unknown glitch in DanceDanceRevolution A, going up can be played on Double BEGINNER difficulty. The Double BEGINNER "chart" is rated Level 20, but contains no notes at all. If played, the song will be cleared automatically with a D grade. * going up is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 19th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.12''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.12). == Song Production Information == === TAKA === It's a very "Eight beat life!" song.
As all Gidadora fans are well aware, even though the "hi-hat" on the drums is played in eighth notes, you can hardly hear it in a live performance.
When I first started playing in a band, I wondered why everyone was beating that inaudible sound so hard, but in fact, that inaudible sound had a tremendous impact on the overall groove and sense of speed, and I decided to focus on the particulars of these great drummers for this song.
Actually, I have never seen it played from the game yet, so I'm not sure if I can actually play it, but anyone who can beat eighth notes at this fast tempo must aim for their debut as a beat rocker. == Video Production Information == === Asato Mifune === I tried my best not to be left behind by the coolness of the song.
I'm glad to be able to portray a fighting adult woman, which is one of my favorite cool things.
I hope you enjoy playing it.

That's why, among the songs I've provided on GOLD, the opening theme is actually the one I have the strongest attachment to.
I would be genuinely happy if as many people as possible could listen to and sing this song, and feels cheerful. === Michael a la mode === I say before you read the comment.
...writing the happening thing at the truth and that time...
"When I was beating the keyboard of PC, I was singing before one is aware."
I think that You don't understand what I say, and I have not understood what was done. Yo! All the IIDXers in Japan!
I'm Michael a la mode! Nice to meet you.
To be honest, lyrics and singing aren't really my specialty, but thanks to a passionate offer from my old friend DJ Yoshitaka, I ended up taking on the lyrics and vocals for "GOLD RUSH". It's an incredibly groovy track, and the lyrics just came to me the moment I heard it.
After that, I went all-in on some flashy, over-the-top lyrics, and at Yoshitaka's request, I even shouted out past IIDX series subtitles.
After all, the current IIDX exists because of its past.
And it's going to keep going from here on out.
As a fellow IIDX fan, I'm genuinely glad to have been part of this project! So, all you IIDXers out there, be sure to join in and shout "Make it! Make money!" at the top of your lungs!
Alright, catch you later! == Video Production Information == === kotokoi === I thought, "I wonder if I can somehow bring out the energetic, gorgeous feel that this song has", and so I scoured fashion magazines featuring sparkly women and men and studied them.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of KIMONO♥PRINCESS, titled ''KIMONO♥PRINCESS (TGS2010 Ver.)'', appears in the [[DanceEvolution Original Soundtrack]]. * A portion of KIMONO♥PRINCESS is featured in [[CS DDR 2010|DanceDanceRevolution (2010)]]'s [[HOTTEST PARTY 3]] nonstop megamix. * An instrumental version of KIMONO♥PRINCESS appears in a promotional DanceMasters disc by Taco Bell. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * In the DanceDanceRevolution X2 location tests, KIMONO♥PRINCESS was one of the FINAL STAGE-only songs, along with [[POSSESSION]]. ** In the final release, KIMONO♥PRINCESS is the default EXTRA STAGE song. Obtaining a AA or higher on KIMONO♥PRINCESS lets you play [[roppongi EVOLVED]] as the ENCORE EXTRA STAGE. ** KIMONO♥PRINCESS was temporarily unlocked for normal play from November 19th to 22nd, 2010. ** As of January 26th, 2011, it has been unlocked for normal play. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS received a slightly changed Double EXPERT chart when it appeared in the arcade version of DanceDanceRevolution X2 (however, its total notecount was not modified). * In pre-[[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] installments of the DanceDanceRevolution series, KIMONO♥PRINCESS' music video is shown in the background of the BIG SCREEN dance stage and is not full-screen. ** This video reuses three DDRMAX-EXTREME background movies. ** This video was not retained in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], causing KIMONO♥PRINCESS to be played on the DANCING RAYS stage instead. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS' DanceDanceRevolution jackets re-use the illustration from [[exotic ethnic OR-IF-IS Mix]]'s graphics, as well as artwork of [[YUNI]] from [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX4|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX4]]. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, KIMONO♥PRINCESS' BPM is listed as 95-190. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS is one of the unlockable songs of Phase 4 of pop'n music 20 fantasia's ''Soreyuke! pop'n quest'' (それゆけ！ポップンクエスト) event. It could be unlocked from May 23rd, 2012. ** As of October 1st, 2012, it is available by default. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS being crossed over marks the first appearance of Anna Kaelin in the pop'n music series. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS' songwheel genre (姫コア) reads as '''HIME CORE'''. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS' pop'n music EX chart has a couple of BPM changes to 11 BPM, to simulate the stops in the original DanceDanceRevolution charts. ** In the pop'n music 20 fantasia staff comments for KIMONO♥PRINCESS, [[Daichi Watanabe|PON]] uses the phrase "soflan" when referring to the song's BPM changes. "Soflan" is a reference to [[AC 2nd style|beatmania IIDX 2nd style]]'s [[SOFT LANDING ON THE BODY]] and its big BPM changes. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS was made playable in REFLEC BEAT limelight on June 27th, 2012, as part of its summer update. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS received an EASY chart in [[AC pnm Sunny Park|pop'n music Sunny Park]], replacing its old 5-Buttons chart. * At some time before June 30th, 2016, KIMONO♥PRINCESS' HARD difficulty was re-rated to Level 8 in REFLEC BEAT plus. * KIMONO♥PRINCESS is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from September 26th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.10''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.10). * KIMONO♥PRINCESS' HYPER chart was re-rated in [[AC pnm High Cheers!!|pop'n music High☆Cheers!!]] on December 23rd, 2025. == Music Comment == An elegant princess is dancing to this fusion of a Japanese taste with a miracle happy hardcore☆ == Song Production Information == === jun === From DDR to DanceEvolution, the kimono princess has finally landed in pop'n♥
Being able to play this song in various ways makes me feel really happy. For KIMONO♥PRINCESS, I aimed to make a cute pop melody, which is easy to play despite the fast BPM.
I'd be happy if you play this song for a long time, sometimes dancing to it, and hitting buttons other times. == Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === PON === I missed seeing jun and [[Jun Wakita|wac]] arguing about charts in front of the arcade cabinet.
I thought they were arguing about the chart layout, but before I knew it, they discussed the difficulty of using Twitter.
So that's when I realized. ... No...
... Wait...
... This... ... Isn't this the legendary "double jun×jun"!!
(Yes, the double jun×jun theme song is played here)
Being surrounded by the double jun×jun conversations caused me to slowly become a jun, too. Only EX has the soflan gimmick, but it's not an exaggeration to say that jun's aggressive part is like that.
But rather, jun's kindness isn't shown in the entire chart at all.
It's amazing, jun! === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === To those of you who liked this song!
By all means, please dance to it in DanEvo! === [[Tomoko Shiono|shio]] === The DanEvo choreography for KIMONO♥PRINCESS has too much of a strong impact, so the dance appears in my mind even if I'm playing pop'n.
Join both hands together, and bow left and right. I heard a strange story that Japanese people use one hand to chop through a crowd, but this song is also like a cross-cultural exchange. You can see the choreography in [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zyNLj765qCY the official movie here]. Remember it and make your [https://web.archive.org/web/20181214115733/https://p.eagate.573.jp/game/danceevolution/ac/p/index.html DanEvo ARCADE] debut! === [[Chihiro Inoue|Chihi]] === Is this Princess KIKYO?~ She's a high-class kimono princess, isn't she! Oh, boots.
I was surprised at the opening BPM and skeleton, that I "quickly!" fell~.
But I was alright because I had a full stomach.
Wasn't she the person who liked skeletons...?
It's OK to be full, but I want to take better care of myself. === [[Ryo Sugawara|Ga~su~]] === Even if I know it's coming, the low speed in the middle section defeats me.. === wac === For me, The World stops can be placed in DDR charts.
Time stops flowing in these type of songs.
After that, the consistency somehow fits together.
I still don't understand that logic, but it's reproduced in pop'n like this.
I have to calculate the number of bars and beats using advanced math skills, which my brain hasn't used in a while, and I almost burn out from overheating, but it's not bad to occasionally exercise it.
This was the most difficult math I've ever done. === Mameshiba === I shouted "whoa!" with all my might.
I heard the song a lot beforehand, so I thought I knew it...
And before the hook... will that day come when I can see it...
I like its high-tension feeling. The unlock quest, "Kimono Princess", appears after clearing the "This Shining Fashion Season", "Welcome Fantasy", and "Oriental Rapids" quests.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of Leaving... can be found in Seiya Murai's first album, [[plug+program]]. * A Chinese version of Leaving..., credited to just seiya-murai, appears in DanceDanceRevolution X2. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Leaving... marks Kiyoshi Murai's first original song in the beatmania IIDX series. ** It also marks eimy's first song in BEMANI. *** Leaving... being crossed over also marks her first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * According to Kiyoshi Murai, he created Leaving... two weeks before beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD's location test started on November 22nd, 2005. * Leaving... received a new BEGINNER chart in [[AC SIRIUS|beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS]]. ** This BEGINNER chart was removed in [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]]. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series, Leaving...'s artist was changed to '''seiya-murai meets “eimy”'''. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Leaving...'s music video is shown in the background of the MOVIE WHITE background dance stage and is not full-screen. ** In DanceDanceRevolution X2 and [[AC DDR X3|X3 VS 2ndMIX]], Leaving...'s music video was played on the MOVIE BLACK stage. ** Leaving...'s background video was removed from [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]] on April 4th, 2013, due to technical issues. It was later restored on July 30th, 2013, now playing in the background of the MOVIE WHITE stage instead. * The Chinese cover of Leaving... could be played on the DanceDanceRevolution series by playing Leaving...'s CHALLENGE chart. ** As of [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], the Japanese version of Leaving... will be played instead. * In 狂熱節拍IIDX, Leaving...'s artist was changed to '''SEIYA MURAI meets 罗斓'''. * Leaving... appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''beatmania IIDX Song Pack 2'''. * The Chinese version of Leaving... has never been on ''any'' CS BEMANI release. * Leaving... is one of the hidden revivals in beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro. It can be unlocked by obtaining 120 Tran Medals. ** It received new Single NORMAL and ANOTHER charts, and a brand-new Double ANOTHER chart, upon its revival. ** In [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]], its NORMAL, HYPER, and ANOTHER charts can be unlocked by obtaining four, ten, and 16 Tran Medals respectively. ** As of July 24th, 2014, it could be unlocked in beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA and [[AC PENDUAL|22 PENDUAL]] through the [[Hakken! Yomigaetta BEMANI iseki|発見！よみがえったBEMANI遺跡]] event. ** As of July 1st, 2015, it could be purchased in beatmania IIDX 22 PENDUAL with ''Youkou no hologram'' (陽光のホログラム). ** As of [[AC copula|beatmania IIDX 23 copula]], it is available by default. * Leaving... is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from May 2nd, 2018, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * Leaving... is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 19th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.12''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.12). * Leaving...'s video is absent in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX, causing the song to be played on the CYBER dance stage instead. == Song Production Information == === eimy === This is my first time doing something like this! I'm eimy.
Actually, I couldn't believe that I was somehow singing in Murai's first song written for IIDX, and I was filled with somewhat trembling and happy feelings.
Murai, thank you very much.
And thank you too, MAYA! (What else can I say?) I'm very happy, but I also feel sorry that it was me...
When I listened to my own voice in the cabinet for the first time, it felt like my face was on fire, and I still can't be used to it.
I'm not that good at it, and I secretly play at my hometown. === Seiya Murai === So! I'm Seiya Murai, who's participating in the IIDX series for the first time with a newly-written song.
This time, I'm going to have a long conversation which is filled with stories, OK? In my previous crossover "[[Pink Rose|PinkRose]]", it seemed that my request "by all means, I'd like to compose here next time!", gained attention from the [[Tatsuya Shimizu|great]] [[Takayuki Ishikawa|sound]] [[Yoshitaka Nishimura|directors]], and the idea was suddenly given to me two weeks before the location test... until then, there wasn't a sign that I'd be offered it at all. May, maybe I was a backup artist? （^^;
Well anyways, I created this song without much time, and since I was ordered for "something like PinkRose2", (I've been getting this a lot lately... but [2] is [[DAWN]] in [[AC pnm 13|pop'n Carnival]], so this is somehow [3]) I also had trouble selecting a female vocalist in a limited time. Then, a memory was revived... howawa~wan♪ During a drinking party one day, eimy, who I usually work with and is a graphical designer part of the pop'n team, came to me feeling slightly tipsy and good, immediately started passionately talking and said "I'd like to sing~!".
I was also definitely very drunk and said "hmm, that's fine~. But first, let me hear you record your best song at karaoke. We'll discuss after that~". Since something like that happened, I once again asked eimy.
"Will you sing in IIDX?" She isn't a professional singer, but when I listened to the karaoke demo that I requested, I was convinced that if she had a good direction, it'd turn out well.
For example, would you rather eat out at a high-class three star restaurant, or make delicious food at home using good ingredients?...
For me, it's better to use my own skills in the latter, so I took that stance as well this time.
Also, I wonder if it's a bit interesting that two members from the pop'n team are participating here for the first time? I thought about this. I didn't have time, so I wrote the lyrics myself (^^;。 Just about everything feels handmade♪ I'm a bit embarrassed about writing Japanese lyrics though....
Recording progressed very smoothly. How many times I thought "are you really an amateur?"... (laughs). She was quickly able to understand my instructions, and she was easier to work with than professional vocalists. eimy said that she wanted the singer to be a secret after it was completed for a while... she seemed quite embarrassed.
However, the staff around me were very curious about the mysterious vocalist's identity, and asked me instead of eimy. "Who's singing it?", "has this person sung before?", they were quite persistent about this...(^^;
Evading that was even more difficult than the recording.
It seems that the pop'n team members were somehow aware of this, but it's difficult to confirm with eimy... such delicate atmosphere seemed to last for several days.
It isn't easy to keep secrets (bitter smile).
Then, the information gradually spread, and everyone knew about it.
And this song was completed with a cool movie by MAYA, who's close to eimy! eimy, thank you very much! GOOD JOB!! Please sing again♪
And MAYA, Thanks for the cool movie as well!! pop'n doesn't have these kinds of movies, so I'm infatuated with my song (laughs). Actually, many of our staff members are talented people outside their professions. Something like I'm a programmer, but I'm also a guitarist.
As a director, the most enjoyable part is finding rough gems in a person, regardless of whether they're professional or amateur, polishing them, and making a song with them in it.
Well, I wonder if I'll look for more and more hidden gems within the company♪ == Video Production Information == === MAYA === Wow, that's embarrassing.
eimy, and even Seiya Murai said thank you to me. I'm so honored~. Seiya Murai's PINK ROSE2-styled song is coming to IIDX~!? Knowing this, I asked "yes yes! May I be in charge of it?".
The 3D animations were particular of that, and I groovily drew the illustrations from the sad lyrics.
I'd be happy if they turned out cool. I also knew it was eimy from early on, but I secretly remained silent, right, eimy. ^^
When everyone said "huh?! No way", I felt alone. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A re-arranged long version of Melody Life, titled ''Melody Life 'eco''', appears in [[BeForU]]'s ''Red Rocket Rising'' single. * A rock arrangement of Melody Life, titled ''Melody Life in the Rock'', appears in BeForU's ''Get set GO!! 〜BeForU astronauts set〜'' single. * A Chinese version of Melody Life, with the same title but credited to 張馨予, appears in DanceDanceRevolution X2. == Trivia == * Melody Life's BEGINNER chart was removed in [[AC GOLD|beatmania IIDX 14 GOLD]]. ** However, Melody Life received a new BEGINNER chart in [[AC SIRIUS|beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS]]. This chart was removed in [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]]. * The Chinese cover of Melody Life could be played on the DanceDanceRevolution series by playing Melody Life's CHALLENGE chart. ** As of [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], the Japanese version of Melody Life will be played instead. * The Chinese version of Melody Life has never been on ''any'' CS BEMANI release. * Melody Life is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] from October 7th, 2020 after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * Melody Life is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 19th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.12''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.12). == Song Production Information == === Taka === As someone who likes rock and programmed music, this song falls right in the middle for me. It's not well known, but I actually somehow like these kinds of music. I'm sure I can hear insults like "there's no DistorteD here", but please accept that I wanted to make this song at that moment back then. What I was definitely able to enjoy doing the most in this song is collaborating with musicians. After creating the orchestra base, I recorded the brass, guitar, and vocals in that order, and whenever various people are involved, that person's color, temperature, and soul are instilled in the music, making it feel more lively. Noria, who was present during the entire recording, seemed to feel it as well, and I think we were able to record a lively song with tension and vigor. With that feeling, this song was filled with a human groove by the many live performers.
By all means, please play it while shaking your body. === Noria === It's been a while, hello!
This time, I participated in a solo song after a [[BABY LOVE|long time]], and of course, it was with dj TAKA. It was delivered to everyone as early as the location test, and now, it's finally available across Japan!!!
How was it? Was everyone able to play it?? And somehow, I received many requests by fan mail
Thanks to your support, I was able to "appear in this movie"♪♪♪ Thankfully, everything went smoothly, from the song to Noria's inclusion in the movie, and since I wanted to appear by all means, this song made me really happy.
And this time, I was also able to write the lyrics, but I somehow realized once again that lyrics are important, and I discussed about the "image" of TAKA's sound, so I wonder if it contains a bit of such feelings~??? That's what I thought about. This movie was created by [[Gyo Eguchi|GYO]], who takes care of me every time, and by the person who made movies such as [[KI-SE-KI (IIDX RED EDIT)|KI・SE・KI]] and [[I am]]. On the day we filmed this video, the sky was really beautiful without a single cloud, and I was moved by the deep blue sky which appeared many times.
By all means, please also look at that. Although it was a relatively warm day, Noria, whose sensitive to the cold, was cold since the early morning, and had wrinkles between her eyebrows 【was it around the first verse? (laughs)】
Conversely, the sun was so bright that I couldn't keep my eyes open 【was it around the chorus? (laughs)】 Even though I'm not a model, I thought it was difficult~ for models to be in locations for magazines, regardless of seasons, but since we were filming on location, I was able to do many things and had a really lovely day!
I'm really looking forward to its completion, and above all, since it's a solo song, it'd be great if was released with a Noria-like atmosphere. I can't really watch this video myself, so everyone please play it.
But it's embarrassing, so please don't get angry if I grin and look from behind.
Please forgive my suspiciousness. You can even listen to Melody Life as a ringtone, so I'm sorry for troubling you, but please also support it there. Thank you very much to TAKA and all the 2DX staff for everything.
And thank you very much to the players playing across Japan for your support.
I'm really grateful that Noria can sing these kinds of songs, since everyone is playing them.
Noria will also do her best to get a slightly better score with her own songs (laughs). I'm really happy to sing again. Thank you very much!!! Please surely find your Melody somewhere, and play it. == Video Production Information == === yagi-denko === I connected the image born from the sound with Noria's image & lyrics, thought "well, I only have this", and ran straight with a sprinting feeling.
I can't deny the feeling that I'm too direct, but after all, this video only suits this sound! And I was able to make it with my original intention.
I tried to aim for a standard video using blue connotations, forceful techniques, and Noria's enormous expressive power as weapons.
I'm thankful to [[Goli Matsumoto|GOLI]] and GYO for their help during filming. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * An extended version of Pierce The Sky, titled ''Pierce The Sky（フルバージョン）'', appears in the [[DanceDanceRevolution X2 Original Soundtrack]] album. == Trivia == * Pierce The Sky is one of the ''Replicant D-action'' hidden songs in DanceDanceRevolution X2, representing the color cyan. To play Pierce The Sky as a Replicant D-action song, you must pass 20 or more songs in the DanceDanceRevolution X2 folder. ** As of February 23rd, 2011, Pierce The Sky has been unlocked for normal play. * Pierce The Sky is the only Replicant D-action song with sung vocals. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Pierce The Sky's music video is shown in the background of a light blue-colored version of the REPLICANT background dance stage and is not full-screen. ** In [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5]], Pierce The Sky's video removes any on-screen dancers and is played in a tiny monitor on the opposite side of the player on Single and in the center on Double/Versus, due to Nintendo Wii memory limitations. ** This video reuses eight DDRMAX-EXTREME background movies. * Pierce The Sky marks Josh McInnes' debut in BEMANI. * Pierce The Sky is used as background music in a mission on the KONAMI arcade game ''ROAD FIGHTERS'' (ロードファイターズ). * Pierce The Sky received CHALLENGE charts as part of [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]]' ''DDR CHALLENGE Carnival PLUS'' event. They could be unlocked from August 3rd to December 8th, 2020 after obtaining 5 stamps. ** From [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]] onwards, they are available by default. * Pierce The Sky was added to jubeat (2021) on June 24th, 2022. ** Pierce The Sky being crossed over marks Josh McInnes' debut in the jubeat series. * Pierce The Sky is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 20th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.8''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.8). * Pierce The Sky is one of the FROM DDR-01 unlocks of jubeat Ave.'s ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system. It could be unlocked from June 7th to 27th, 2023. ** In [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|jubeat beyond the Ave.]], it could be unlocked through LIGHT CHAT from March 6th to 26th, 2024. *** Since January 1st, 2026, it can be unlocked by playing the song thrice as a BONUS TUNE. * Prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, Pierce The Sky's BPM was shown as 85-170. == Song Production Information == === JAKAZiD === I co-wrote the original demo version of "Pierce The Sky" with K.N. during my final year of university.
Between then and now I've remixed it several times,
and it's surreal to think that the final definitive mix has been adopted for use in DDR,
especially as I have been a devoted fan of the series for over a decade now.
Within this track I thought a lot about the rhythm of each musical element
and how they could be translated into an interesting but fun schart for DDR.
Additionally, I included the oldskool-style section with piano and breakbeats
to add some variety and excitement to the track before the final chorus.
An interesting piece of trivia about this song is that K.N. recorded the vocals in my closet
which I had converted into a vocal booth at the time.
Given the circumstances, I think the vocals were actually captured rather well! === K.N. === JAKAZiD gave me the demo track for Pierce The Sky and I had an image of Vic Viper flying through space, 
navigating out of tough spots and being unstoppable. 
The message of the song is related to that; if you have your dreams, 
don't be afraid to reach out for them despite how tough it may be. Let's go beyond and pierce the sky on high~ ♪
I wrote most of the lyrics on a commuter train. 
That's not quite a spaceship zooming through the universe, is it? *laughs*
I've been a Bemani fan for ten years now and it gives me such a thrill to know that my song is in DanceDanceRevolution X2.
I hope DDR players will enjoy the song and maybe one day I'll be good enough to full combo it! == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 20 from X onwards.

(ありがとう1周年記念キャンペーン!!). ** Since March 28th, 2018, it is available by default. * POSSESSION is one of the pick up unlocks of jubeat festo's ''TARGET MUSIC'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. ** From [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|jubeat beyond the Ave.]] onwards, it is available by default with an [[e-amusement]] pass. * POSSESSION received a BEGINNER chart in [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]]. * POSSESSION's difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] on March 27th, 2019. * POSSESSION was added to [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] on May 6th, 2021 as part of the May 2021 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From May 6th, 2022, its charts can be purchased with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * POSSESSION is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 20th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.8''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.8). * In the DanceDanceRevolution series prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, POSSESSION's BPM was displayed as 185-370. ** However, in DanceDanceRevolution S+ it is displayed as 185-371 BPM instead. == Song Production Information == === TAG underground === It was over a decade ago when I first encountered DanceDanceRevolution. Back then, most video games were played simply by pressing buttons with your hands. Amidst all that, I was drawn to the unprecedented playstyle of using your feet, which is what got me hooked on this game. I wasn't very good at all in the beginning, but with every session, I could actually feel myself improving. That feeling was so incredibly fun that I ended up playing almost every single day. The number of songs I could clear steadily grew. However, there was one song I just couldn't beat no matter what: [[PARANOiA KCET ~clean mix~|PARANOiA KCET ～clean mix～]]. The overwhelming speed and sheer number of arrows flying at me surpassed any song I had played before. I was just a student at the time and obviously didn't have much money, so I would skip lunches just to save up enough to keep challenging it. After relentlessly playing, I finally managed to clear it. The sense of accomplishment I felt in that moment was truly irreplaceable. But anyway, enough with the trips down memory lane...... This track, POSSESSION, is a song designed to maximize that sheer thrill of clearing a stage.
There are several intense peaks throughout the song, and each one is guaranteed to make you players suffer. It’s easy to just throw in the towel and think, "This is as far as I go." However, if you desperately cling on and somehow manage to overcome them, you'll undoubtedly reach a whole new frontier.
The difference between winning and losing lies in whether or not you can truly embody the word POSSESSION. Go out there and absolutely crush it. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.
