Upper]], sakura storm could be purchased from the REFLEC Shop after clearing it in the BEMANI Stadium Test (BEMANIスタジアム検定) added on July 24th, 2014. ** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]] and [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], sakura storm was playable by default. * sakura storm was added to [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] on April 5th, 2017 as part of the April 2017 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From April 2019, it can be purchased with BITs. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], sakura storm was revived on July 19th, 2018. * sakura storm is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from March 22nd, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.4''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.4). == Song Production Information == === Ryu☆ === This song is a port from the international game DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE3.
The original version of this song is really old, made around the same time as [[starmine]]. Was it around 1997?
Sakura was titled HAPPY HARDCORE at that time. Most of the original melody is still intact. I had left this song alone for a while, but then when DDR Universe 3 was being produced, I was asked to produce a more polished version of the song.
Although the song has some dated gimmicks, such as "1, 12, 123, 1234, Go!", I still like it a lot.
I felt that the song had a nice balance of "Dance & Harmony", so long ago, I explored the possibility of putting the song into [[AC 10th style|beatmania IIDX 10th style]]. That was how [[Setsugekka|雪月花]] came to be.
Here's how, sakura storm was the archetype from which 雪月花 was created.
Hopefully, with your continued support, I will be able to create more songs for many years to come, thank you. == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

To play Shiny World as a Replicant D-action song, you must pass six Courses and one Drill Course. ** As of February 23rd, 2011, Shiny World has been unlocked for normal play. * Shiny World marks Yasuhiro Taguchi's first use of his CAPACITY GATE alias in BEMANI. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Shiny World's music video is shown in the background of a light blue-colored version of the REPLICANT background dance stage and is not full-screen. ** In [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5]], Shiny World's video removes any on-screen dancers and is played in a tiny monitor on the opposite side of the player on Single and in the center on Double/Versus, due to Nintendo Wii memory limitations. ** This video reuses seven DDRMAX-EXTREME background movies. ** At one point in the video, yellow clones of [[RINON]] can be seen dancing. * The 25 BPM part of Shiny World's charts happens ''before'' the steps start. ** With a minimum BPM of 25, Shiny World is the slowest EXTRA STAGE song in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** Prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, Shiny World's BPM was displayed as 100. * Shiny World appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR X2 Special Pack'''. * Shiny World received CHALLENGE charts as part of [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]]' ''DDR CHALLENGE Carnival PLUS'' event. They could be unlocked from August 3rd to December 8th, 2020 after obtaining 1 stamp. ** From [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]] onwards, they are available by default. * Shiny World is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 20th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.8''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.8). == Song Production Information == === CAPACITY GATE === Replicant D-action brings together an extraordinary lineup of songs.
With so many upbeat and high-energy tracks in the mix, I felt we needed something with a slightly different flavor, which is why I created this song.
Truth be told, it actually pays respect to "[[MAKE IT BETTER]]" from [[AC DDR 1st IR|DDR 1st]].
When placed alongside high-speed, tricky tracks like [[PARANOiA]] and [[TRIP MACHINE]], it acts as a spice that gives the entire selection a more colorful and vibrant feel.
Whether or not it will actually refresh your tired body... I can't really say, but I hope you enjoy it.

What's remaining? Even if you wish for eternity, you can't reach it, yet won't give up, you're close, yet so far, you're not too close or far, neither attached nor detached, about two sides of the same situation.
Meanwhile, as time passes by, even if you wanted to do something back then, it's already too late. However, time which passes by is never wasted, and I feel that all I've experienced so far will help me survive in the future. The passage of time makes us stronger.
To my past self, thank you and goodbye. == Staff Comments == === [[Hiroyuki Masuda|MUSCLE]] === You can play this song here and in DanceDanceRevolution as part of APPEND FESTIVAL.
For a long time, there wasn't a TAG song in jubeat, so I asked him "please compose for it! Please compose for it", and this finally happened.
Even though he has played jubeat quite a lot, the timing didn't fit, right? But, now it's linked with DDR and isn't exclusive to jubeat, so he'll have a jubeat original song next time!

To play it, you must obtain medals on the other six Replicant D-action songs. ** As of February 23rd, 2011, Valkyrie dimension has been unlocked for normal play. ** As of April 1st, 2011, Valkyrie dimension's CHALLENGE charts have also been unlocked for normal play. * Valkyrie dimension's Single EXPERT chart was the first Single EXPERT chart to be rated Level 18, with all previous Single Level 18 charts being only on CHALLENGE difficulty. ** Valkyrie dimension's Single and Double CHALLENGE charts were also the first charts to be rated Level 19 in the entire series. (Another chart debuting at the same time, [[POSSESSION]]'s Double CHALLENGE chart, was initially rated Level 18 and only increased to 19 later in [[AC DDR X3|DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX]].) * Valkyrie dimension marks Yoshitaka Nishimura's first use of his Spriggan alias. Spriggans are legendary creatures known from Cornish faery lore. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Valkyrie dimension's music video is shown in the background of a pink-colored version of the REPLICANT background dance stage and is not full-screen. ** This video reuses four DDRMAX-EXTREME background movies. ** In [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5]], Valkyrie dimension's video removes any on-screen dancers and is played in a tiny monitor on the opposite side of the player on Single and in the center on Double/Versus, due to Nintendo Wii memory limitations. ** Different clones of [[RINON]], along with "The Dark One", appear in Valkyrie dimension's video. * Valkyrie dimension received a new jacket in DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5; however, this new jacket has never been used in the arcade versions. * The third 186 BPM section of Valkyrie dimension's Single EXPERT chart is nearly identical to the first 186 BPM section of its Single CHALLENGE chart, except that the left and right arrows are switched. * Valkyrie dimension's difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] on March 27th, 2019. * Valkyrie dimension is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 20th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.8''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.8). * Prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, and in DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5 and GRAND PRIX, Valkyrie dimension's BPM is shown as 47-744 for all of its charts. == Song Production Information == === Spriggan === I think DDR X2 was a project where the hard work of the female development staff really stood out.
Seeing them working tirelessly late into the night, both radiant and strong, I remember being so moved that I shouted, "You're all Valkyries! It's a Valkyrie Dimension!" I'm also incredibly grateful for their thoughtfulness, like giving me a gyoza coupon when I was struggling right up against my deadlines.
However, being a guy constantly chased by one project after another, I ultimately couldn't use the coupon before it expired... so sorry! It could be unlocked from July 4th, 2007 through September 26th, 2007. ** As of September 26th, 2007, ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～ has been unlocked for everyone to play. * IDM stands for "Intelligent Dance Music". * ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～'s title is a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Riemann zeta function|Riemann zeta function]], an important function in complex analysis and number theory, which has deep connections to the prime numbers and is the subject of the [[Wikipedia:Riemann hypothesis|Riemann Hypothesis]], one of the remaining million-dollar [[Wikipedia:Millennium Prize Problems|Millenium Prize Problems]]. Various equations involving the Riemann zeta function can be seen in ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～'s video, as well as other formulas from mathematics and physics. ** ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～'s subtitle literally means "one who transcends the world of prime numbers". ** Fittingly, many of ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～'s charts in the beatmania IIDX, DanceDanceRevolution, pop'n music, ポップンリズミン, and REFLEC BEAT series have prime numbers occuring in either their notecounts (Freeze Arrows in the case of DanceDanceRevolution), level ratings, or both. * ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～'s pop'n music original charts were created by TOMOSUKE himself [https://mond.how/ja/topics/2xyfcbncwcat294]. * ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～ was added to DanceDanceRevolution X2 on August 25th, 2010, as the second song in the "Boss Rush X2" course. ** As of December 24th, 2010, ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～ has been unlocked for normal play. * ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～ received a unique video in the DanceDanceRevolution series, different from its beatmania IIDX video, though it's in the background of the WHITE MOVIE background dance stage and is not full-screen prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** It reuses DDRMAX-EXTREME background movies. ** ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～'s video is not retained in [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5]]. ** The American and European versions of the DanceDanceRevolution series before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] display its title as '''ZETA ~The World of Prime Numbers and the Transcendental Being~'''. *** With 61 characters, this makes this song the longest English song title in DanceDanceRevolution. * ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～ has a different title card in [[AC Lincle|beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle]]. * In beatmania IIDX, ZETA～素数の世界と超越者～ received overlays done by MAYA, which features ∑. To play 冥, you must Hard Clear [[SCREAM SQUAD]]'s ANOTHER chart with a AA grade or higher. * The kanji used for the title (冥) is associated with darkness and is most commonly used in the word 冥王星 (meiousei), the Japanese word for the planet Pluto ("planet of the lord of darkness"). ** Because of this, 冥 is part of DanceDanceRevolution X2's ''PLUTO STORY'' course, alongside [[PARANOiA ~HADES~|PARANOiA ～HADES～]], [[Pluto]], [[Pluto Relinquish]], and [[Pluto The First]]. * The arcade beatmania IIDX LED ticker displays the song as "MEI(TAKASH)", a portmanteau of "dj TAKA" and "Tatsh". * At the time of its release, 冥's ANOTHER charts held the record for the most notes of ''any'' beatmania IIDX chart, with 2000 notes. ** Neither chart was AAA'd until a couple of years after HAPPY SKY's debut. * 冥 has been the final stage of every SP Kaiden course in the arcade beatmania IIDX titles since its introduction in [[AC DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD]]. * 冥 is one of the Phase 1 hidden songs of Toy'sMarch2. * In DanceDanceRevolution X2, 冥 is one of the unlockable songs of the ''Ganbare PiX Kirakira douchuu'' (がんばれPiX キラキラ道中) event. It could be unlocked by having destroyed 800 planets, and launching [[PiX]] to a total distance of 490,000-520,000 light-years. ** As of February 23rd, 2011, 冥 has been unlocked for normal play. ** Also, as of April 1st, 2011, 冥's CHALLENGE charts have been unlocked for normal play. *** 冥 is the first BEMANI crossover song in the DanceDanceRevolution series to have CHALLENGE charts rated Level 18. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], 冥's music video is shown in the background of the WHITE MOVIE background dance stage and is not full-screen. ** In [[CS DDR II|DanceDanceRevolution II / hottest party5]], 冥's video removes any on-screen dancers and is played in a tiny monitor on the opposite side of the player on Single and in the center on Double/Versus, due to Nintendo Wii memory limitations. * On the American and European releases of the DanceDanceRevolution series before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], 冥's title is romanized as '''MEI'''. * 冥 appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''beatmania IIDX Song Pack 3'''. * 冥 was available in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]]' championship Mode from August 10th to 21st, 2016. ** On August 22nd, 2016, it was added to standard Mode for anyone who had played the ''PREMIUM∞CUP'' in championship Mode at least once. ** From December 2019, it can be purchased with BITs. * 冥 was one of the qualifying round songs in [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|The 6th KONAMI Arcade Championship]] for DanceDanceRevolution A. * 冥 is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from May 25th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.20''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.20). == Song Production Information == === D.J.Amuro === This song's theme is a story about a man's sad fate.
He said an eternal farewell to his family, and boards a shuttle alone in silence.
I'd like to leave this story from here up to your imagination.
I'd be happy if you can experience this story from the music. === dj Killer === This time, D.J.Amuro and I prepared killer notecharts with the highest number of notes to date.
I hope you'll experience [a journey to Pluto with no return]. == Video Production Information == === Ta-k(synesthesia) === I tried to create this movie with simple objects and irritating slow movements.

A file of Blue Rain was temporarily included on KONAMI's website, which was known as '''Blue Rain (radio edit)'''. * Blue Rain received a Single Black ANOTHER chart in [[CS DJ TROOPERS|beatmania IIDX 15 DJ TROOPERS CS]]. ** This chart was later ported, alongside a brand-new Double chart, to [[AC CANNON BALLERS|beatmania IIDX 25 CANNON BALLERS]] as LEGGENDARIA charts for Blue Rain. They can be unlocked from May 24th, 2018 by clearing the ''WEATHER'' EXPERT course. *** As of [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]], these charts are available by default. *** These charts are available in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] since July 26th, 2023. * Blue Rain was unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution X for normal play on July 9th, 2009. * Blue Rain was added to [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] on December 4th, 2019 as part of the December 2019 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From August 5th, 2021 in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020), it can be purchased with BITs. * Blue Rain is used as background music in a mission on the KONAMI arcade game ''ROAD FIGHTERS'' (ロードファイターズ). * Blue Rain is also used as a hidden BGM song in KONAMI's pachislot game, ''ROULETTE QUEEN''. * Blue Rain is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from February 20th, 2023, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.16''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.16). ** It received brand-new CHALLENGE charts, which become available by purchasing both this and '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.15''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.15). ** By purchasing both packs with an active subscription, Blue Rain's CHALLENGE charts could be played in [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]]. ** From February 29th, 2024 in DanceDanceRevolution A3, they are available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === dj TAKA === As the lead track of my first album "milestone", I've talked about "Blue Rain" everywhere. Since it's a special occasion, I'd like to share something I haven't mentioned anywhere else, but now I'm wondering what to say... Plus, I've been forgetful lately, and I'm not even sure where and what I've talked about, but... Anyways, as for the production process:
1. I sent Ryu a rough composition I made (this was about 3-4 years ago).
2. Ryu replaced almost all the rhythm tracks and sounds (since it was quite old, he updated everything to a modern feel!).
3. This was our first time working together. We listened to it at Ryu's studio and fine-tuned the details together (the sound like breaking glass after the break was decided here. According to Ryu, "It's a sound I thought no one would ever use").
4. A few days later, we recorded AiMEE's vocals at the KONAMI studio (a brand-new studio; this was probably the first vocal recording there).
5. Ryu took it back, mixed it, and it was complete! (Whoa, Ryu, this might be something special.) That's the flow of the production. Thus, this long collaboration came to an end, but I've often felt that Ryu and I share many similarities in production style and taste. As for this collaboration, once we started moving, it went very smoothly, and I think we created a great track.
But well, since I'm the senior, I wonder if I made Ryu go out of his way a bit.
Ryu, thank you so much, and let's keep working together! === Ryu☆ === Ryu☆ here. Regarding "Blue Rain," the collaboration song with dj TAKA, known as the King of IIDX, as I mentioned during the milestone interview, it's actually an older track. From around 2004, perhaps. Initially, I produced it completely privately, unrelated to any work, but it was decided to release it alongside milestone, so the track was reconstructed. With the addition of AiMEE's wonderful vocals, I believe it's become a track that is both poignant and beautiful. Unfortunately, some parts were cut for this game version. Please do listen to the full version included in milestone! Stillwind also suggested him to make Lift You Up to sound like a pop song instead of a dance-like track as Wolfram originally envisioned. ** Wolfram later posted the original English lyrics on his [https://web.archive.org/web/20090213122545/http://blog.oricon.co.jp/wollie/archive/189/0 blog]. * Lift You Up is used as background music in a mission on the KONAMI arcade game ''ROAD FIGHTERS'' (ロードファイターズ). * Lift You Up is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 20th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.8''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.8). == Song Production Information == === wolli === "This is my first composition for DDR, and I am very excited to share my music with all the fans. One was to have lyrics that are cheerful, and another was to create a melody with good groove - as dancing not only makes everyone happy, but also lets them forget all the bad things that have happened in the past. So I wrote a song based on these ideas. I added the message "Anyone can enjoy dancing, so why don't you dance with us. We'll Lift You Up!" in order to help everyone realize that is the power of dance. Arranging the song was also done keeping these same ideas in mind, but I also wanted everyone to be happy and enjoy the song even when they are not dancing. So, I focused on its quality as a musical piece. I think that I have created a song fulfilling all of these goals. Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC Resort Anthem|beatmania IIDX 18 Resort Anthem]] * [[AC RB groovin'!!|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!]] * [[CS RB plus|REFLEC BEAT plus]] MUSIC PACK 70 == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A remix of SABER WING by [[Akira Ishihara]], titled [[SABER WING (Akira Ishihara Headshot mix)]], also appears in DanceDanceRevolution X. * Another remix of SABER WING, titled [[SABER WING (satellite silhouette remix)]], was included in a line of EMI USB drives as a special bonus MP3. ** A short version of SABER WING (satellite silhouette remix) was later added to [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]]. * SABER WING is one of the songs sampled in [[DDR TAGMIX -LAST DanceR-]], from [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Both SABER WING and [[HOW TO PLAY]] mark Yasuhiro Taguchi's first original songs in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** SABER WING is also his first EXTRA/ENCORE STAGE song on the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** It's also the only new EXTRA/ENCORE STAGE in DanceDanceRevolution X to be composed and arranged by an in-house KONAMI artist. * On the DanceDanceRevolution X location tests, SABER WING was a FINAL STAGE exclusive song. On the final release of the game, SABER WING is the default EXTRA STAGE song instead. ** However, on the [[CS DDR X NA|console versions]] [[CS DDR X JP|of DanceDanceRevolution X]], SABER WING is a default song instead of an EXTRA STAGE song. ** As of May 21st, 2009, SABER WING has been unlocked for normal play. * When played as EXTRA STAGE song in arcade versions of DanceDanceRevolution X, the announcer bits and crowd cheers are completely silent (except at the beginning, before the song starts playing). * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], SABER WING's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** Despite having its own video in DanceDanceRevolution, SABER WING did not use this video in the beatmania IIDX series until [[AC tricoro|beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro]]. * SABER WING appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR X Mega Hit Pack'''. * SABER WING is used as background music in a mission on the KONAMI arcade game ''ROAD FIGHTERS'' (ロードファイターズ). * SABER WING was one of the qualifying round songs in the [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|KONAMI Arcade Championship 2013]] for [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]]. * SABER WING is one of the Refle unlockable songs in REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!. It could be purchased from the Reflec Shop for 1200 Refle, after clearing the song in the ''BPM Change Test'' (BPM変化検定) in REFLEC Dojo, which was added on August 8th, 2014. ** In [[AC RB VOLZZA|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA]] and [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], SABER WING was playable by default. * In REFLEC BEAT plus, SABER WING was subject to a bug wherein the large BPM changes were more pronounced than in the arcade, causing some Objects to travel to the bottom of the screen within a few frames. This has been fixed as of version 4.3.0 of REFLEC BEAT plus. ** The update notes for version 4.3.0 specifically mention SABER WING as being part of the reason for this fix. * SABER WING was added to [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] on December 8th, 2016 as part of the December 2016 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From August 2017, it can be purchased with BITs. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], SABER WING was revived on November 15th, 2018. * SABER WING's sync was fixed in [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] on November 19th, 2019. * Song comments for SABER WING were posted on [https://note.com/tag_underground/n/n523c7dac4e46 TAG's blog]. * SABER WING is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from December 20th, 2021, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.1''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.1). * In the DanceDanceRevolution series prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, SABER WING's BPM was displayed as 74-222. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== TAG ==== Hello all beatmania IIDX fans! TAG here
I thank you all for the popularity of SABER WING and its inclusion into the game!!! The song was originally made for DanceDanceRevolution X, and for this song, we incorporated some unique rhythms and a changing BPM gimmick. I added the BPM gimmick because I felt that the song should coordinate with the moves a person made, and the DDR team also requested me to make a song with some tricks in it. This is based of a story from Macross, in which the space fighter "Saber Wing" travels through space, encountering many scenarios. (?) It's a bit of a complicated story, and I tend to linger on about too much on it. === DanceDanceRevolution === This is TAG's debut release on DDR. Its unique and catchy rhythm stay on everyone's mind once they hear it. Its peculiar sound is formed by interweaving 3-beat and 5-beat patterns, and creates an illusion of floating in the air for the listener. You won't find such a feeling in other songs! Can you follow its roller coaster BPM and tricky rhythm? == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

}} == Song Connections / Remixes == * The full version of TimeHollow, titled ''Time Hollow'', appears in the ''TIMEHOLLOW 〜奪われた過去を求めて〜 Original Soundtracks'' album. * TimeHollow is one of the songs featured in the medley [[Xmix2 (Beats 'n Bangs)]] from DanceDanceRevolution X. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * TimeHollow is the main theme of ''TimeHollow'' (known in Japan as ''TIMEHOLLOW 奪われた過去を求めて''), a graphic adventure game made by KONAMI for Nintendo DS. ** It features the opening video of TimeHollow in DanceDanceRevolution, eliminating any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. * TimeHollow marks Masanori Akita's only appearance outside of the pop'n music series. ** It's also his only BEMANI song credited to his real name, and his only BEMANI song with vocals. * A Japanese translation of TimeHollow's lyrics can be found in the [[DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 Original Soundtrack]] booklet. * TimeHollow is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from July 20th, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.8''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.8). * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], TimeHollow's BPM was shown as 94. == Song Production Information == === DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 === ==== Masanori Akita ==== I wrote this song as the theme song for a DS game, but when I heard that it'll be used in DDR this time, I thought "huh? Can you dance to that song?!".
Because DDR has the image of dancing to up-tempo dance tunes. So, this is a middle tempo girls' rock song.
Since it's a theme song, I listened to the producer's requests of wanting the game's image and keywords to be specific, and the song unusually turned out in my image. (I always selfishly make whatever I want...)
I completely changed the atmosphere in the chorus, and tried to express the protagonist's sadness and impulse after the chorus. ==== Junko Kawano ==== This time, the theme song and opening video of "Time Hollow ~Search for the Stolen Past~" are included in "DDR SuperNOVA2", thank you very much! I had a vague and ambiguous request for this song... but it turned out better than I imagined by Akita, so as the person who made the request, I simply bowed down to his professionalism. I'm moved by him. Since this anime video was originally played many times on a Nintendo DS, the high resolution video can now be viewed on home console games just like "DDR SuperNOVA2", since it was created with an acceptable quality for theaters, so I'd be happy if you can fully enjoy it while dancing to the song's rhythms. === DanceDanceRevolution X === This epic song has made the jump to DDR! Both quiet and stormy, it has been painted with pounding guitar riffs, heavy drums and powerful, yet evocative, vocals. Loose yourself in its mystery! == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. Let's bloom as dignified flowers with all our might! == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS Official Website and pop'n music === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== Umm, I'm sorry to bother you again.
I'm TOMOSUKE, from Red Litmus. NADESHIKO ROCK. I thought of various images before I created this song.
The Edo period. Although the princess appears graceful and tidy in public, she secretly leaves the castle at midnight with South-East Asian instruments, and plays a rock song while jumping around.
There wasn't any rock during the Edo period, though. She has a rock-styled soul.
That was the first image that came to mind, so I thought about creating a "PRINCESS ROCK" song.
A naughty Yamato Nadeshiko princess, wearing a mix of Japanese and South-East Asian clothing while playing her guitar. I thought of the title "Rin to shite saku hana no gotoku" a long time before the lyrics were written, so I requested that the lyrics and vocals aligned with this title.
Furthermore, I selfishly tried to draw the character myself and give them to the designer.
Now that I think about it, perhaps it's embarrassing~ that the character I drew was crazy in various ways.
But I think this character's mood at that time was closely inherited by KANOKO.
Anyways, this song clearly expresses a worldview, which was directly conveyed to everyone.
I wonder if it's a bit clear and polished in the part which emphasizes vigor and distance.
I did my best to make the notecharts enjoyable! The H chart especially makes you want to jump around, so let's wear a kimono! ==== Machiko Oka ==== Firstly, I'm really happy that my voice was used in this song. Thank you very much.
When I first heard this song, I sang it to myself. I was honestly very worried about if I could sing it or not.
Although I really liked this song, it was very fast, had a high key, and was difficult, so I was very worried about if I could properly sing it. But I really enjoyed singing it as I practiced.
During the recording, although I was a bit nervous, when I was asked to "please sing it with the image of dancing cherry blossoms", it became more enjoyable, and I sang it comfortably (o^o^o)
That's right, I tried playing it in the game the other day, but I honestly couldn't clear it at all... (laughs). Since it was very difficult (;_;) (laughs).
By all means, everyone please play this song (*^_^*)
I'm really honored to sing this song (o^o^o) Thank you very much o(^-^)o === beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS Original Soundtrack === ==== [[DOLCE.]] ==== This song is another crossover from pop'n music, and it's a familiar song which can often be heard in other BEMANI series. The melody is exactly as its title suggests, gorgeous and sad, and this song has a Japanesque taste with a dignified flower image. The notechart looks beautiful, with similar colored chords and scales used throughout the entire song, and the chart layout is very useful to practice. Since the chart mainly has straightforward 16th notes, I think it's great to get into the rhythm and play. === GuitarFreaks & DrumMania === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== It's been a long time everyone, I'm TOMOSUKE.
We've received requests to crossover this song into Gitadora, so I created a slightly different version than in pop'n.
And when I created it, I asked [[Jin Senbonmatsu]] to include a brand-new guitar. He did it!
In the original song, there weren't guitars during the piano solo, but I asked Jin to include very appealing arpeggios in it. Thank you, thank you.
I thought it suited Gitadora from the beginning, so I'm honestly happy that this song crossed over.
By all means, I'd like you to jump around and play this song while wearing a kimono.
... Well, did I say this somewhere else? == Video Production Information == === shio === I came alongside with the song from pop'n. Thank you for your continuing support. In order to support the image of this song's vividness, I created this video with the theme of lustrous colors and graceful movements.
I also wanted to slightly revise it so that it appeared "NIPPON-ish" to foreigners, so I added subtitles. Also, from the princess' day and night duality, the visuals are also somehow symmetrical.
For the chorus, I just prepared its parts and endlessly played the song on repeat, which I aimlessly created using the right-side of my brain, but it was a very tripping experience.
It was a bit bad for my eyes... that's what I think, but I hope you'd enjoy it.
Everyone, please fly across the moon and shout "yay!" while playing this song. == Character Information == Fluttering and following the moon. I'm a rabbit. Flying across the sky like a Tengu. === shio === It was so long ago that I don't remember much, but it was interesting that everyone already discussed it when I thought of an idea.
I forgot what idea TOMOSUKE had, but it was often discussed, so I'd like to see it once again. Hehehe. As a pop'n character designer, it's boring to just use the sound designer's image as it was, and conversely, it's also quite boring to just use my image as the designer, so I think it's important to have a balance between the two. So, it's essentially a fusion?
I think this song is a good example of that~. No. I don't know?
Perhaps I'm a bit overwhelmed by TOMOSUKE's enthusiasm (laughs). That's why I want to express~ the individuality and movements of not just the designs, but of pop'n.
It's a bad walking movement! I had a baby Tengu jump around.
It's been a while since I created animations, so it was quite difficult, but I love it. Also, shio's point is quite avant-garde.
She somehow addicting to look at. (She's adorable)
Also, the naming point is TARO's mother. (She's adorable) == Chart Production Information == === [[Erina Takeda|T_da]] === "Rin to shite saku hana no gotoku" is a big hit song that BEMANI users loved with all their heart, from the melody, lyrics, and the character, so I'm happy that many players seem to be enjoying it in jubeat.
For the notecharts, I often distributed the patterns by using point symmetry, so you can expect high arm movements from them.
They visually appear in the image of flowers, so by all means, please use the "flower" markers as well! Although I said this, please use your own favorite marker. The staff around me who played my created notecharts, said that they express the creator's personality.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * Dance Dance Revolution is a remixed medley of the title screen theme from the original [[AC DDR 1st|DanceDanceRevolution]] to [[AC DDR 4th|4thMIX]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Dance Dance Revolution is DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME's ONE MORE EXTRA STAGE. To access it, you must obtain a AA or better in [[The legend of MAX]] as your EXTRA STAGE. ** In [[CS DDR EXTREME JP|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (Japan)]], Dance Dance Revolution can be accessed by getting AA or higher on any boss song as your EXTRA STAGE. * Dance Dance Revolution's CHALLENGE charts feature various sections of past DanceDanceRevolution songs' EXPERT charts, in the following order: ** [[BRILLIANT 2U(Orchestra Groove)]]→[[DEAD END]]→[[DYNAMITE RAVE]]→[[AFRONOVA]]→[[END OF THE CENTURY]]→[[AM-3P]]→[[CELEBRATE NITE]]→[[B4U]]→Dance Dance Revolution. * According to [[Akira Goshima]], Dance Dance Revolution's Single EXPERT chart originally had 400 notes (counting jumps), however, he did not want to cover the final "Dance Dance Revolution" line with the announcer shouting "400 combo!", so he removed a note from the chart. * Dance Dance Revolution's title references the game series where it debuted. It shares this trait with songs [[IIDX]] (beatmania IIDX), [[Keyboard Man]] (KEYBOARDMANIA), and [[Like a pop'n music]] (pop'n music). * With the exception of the DIFFICULT charts, none of Dance Dance Revolution's charts have Freeze Arrows. * '''Dance Dance Revolution(X-Special)''' is one of the X-Special ENCORE EXTRA STAGEs in [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]], which could be played from August 20th, 2009 by obtaining at least a AA rank on The legend of MAX(X-Special) as the EXTRA STAGE. ** As of October 1st, 2009, Dance Dance Revolution(X-Special) has been unlocked for normal play. * From [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]] onwards, Dance Dance Revolution(X-Special) appears in the DanceDanceRevolution X folder instead of the EXTREME folder. * In [[CS DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2 CS]], Dance Dance Revolution is the first FINAL STAGE song. * Dance Dance Revolution received its own video from DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME in [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]] on August 18th, 2013. This video eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** Dance Dance Revolution(X-Special) did not receive this video until September 18th, 2013. Unlike the original Dance Dance Revolution, the video in Dance Dance Revolution(X-Special) appears in the monitors of the purple REPLICANT background stage and is not full-screen prior to DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. * From June 1st, 2017 in [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] to [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]], Dance Dance Revolution(X-Special) does not appear in the song selection screen if the player does not use an [[e-amusement]] pass. ** From DanceDanceRevolution WORLD onwards, it is available by default for all players. * In [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], Dance Dance Revolution received its difficulty change from DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 3rd, 2024. == Song Production Information == Untranslated. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. = PARANOiA ETERNAL = == Song Information == [[Image:PARANOiA ETERNAL.png‎|thumb|PARANOiA ETERNAL's jacket.]] Artist: STM 200
Composition: [[Naoki Maeda|NM SEQENCE UNLIMITED]]

First Music Game Appearance: [[AC DDR 5th|DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX]]
Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * PARANOiA ETERNAL is part of the PARANOiA song series. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} [[Image:naokistm.jpg|thumb|Naoki Maeda shaking hands with Takeshi Matsumoto.]] * During November and December 2000, KONAMI held ''DanceDanceRevolution Artist Audition 2001'' (DanceDanceRevolution アーティストオーディション2001). One of the parts of the audition was a contest for remixing PARANOiA. The winner was 18 year-old Takeshi Matsumoto (松本健), with PARANOiA ETERNAL. ** PARANOiA ETERNAL, under the title ''PARANOiA ETERNAL (Audition Best Remix Tune)'', was then included on the [[NAOKI'S PREMIUM TRACKS]] album, which was a prize for the winners of [[AC DDR 4th PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution 4thMIX PLUS]]' INTERNET RANKING. ** Takeshi Matsumoto later entered another BEMANI contest, the ''Boku mo watashi mo★pop'n artist!'' (ボクもワタシも★ポップンアーティスト!) contest for [[AC pnm 20|pop'n music 20 fantasia]] with ''しゃぼん'', but his song was not selected. * PARANOiA ETERNAL is the third song in the PARANOiA series that was not arranged by Naoki Maeda, after [[PARANOiA KCET ~clean mix~|PARANOiA KCET ～clean mix～]] and [[PARANOiA MAX ~FUNKY BLEEP MIX~|PARANOiA MAX ～FUNKY BLEEP MIX～]]. * Extended comments for PARANOiA ETERNAL appear on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20070526063555/http://www.konami.jp/am/AM/DDR_ad/v_report3.html DanceDanceRevolution Artist Audition 2001 website], as well as [[BeForU]]'s [http://web.archive.org/web/20010416022933/http://www.konami.co.jp/am/AM/beforu/naoki.html official website]. * [[B4U glorious style]], [[DYNAMITE RAVE|DYNAMITE RAVE(Long ver.)]] and PARANOiA ETERNAL do not appear on the nonstop megamix of the [[DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] album. * PARANOiA ETERNAL received new charts for all difficulties except Single LIGHT in [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]], replacing its old charts which were written by STM himself. ** It also received a BEGINNER chart. * PARANOiA ETERNAL's banner was updated in [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]], changing the title font. * '''PARANOiA ETERNAL(X-Special)''' is one of the X-Special EXTRA STAGEs in DanceDanceRevolution X, which can be played from June 18th, 2009 by obtaining a AA rank or better on a Xmix song before the FINAL STAGE. ** As of October 1st, 2009, PARANOiA ETERNAL(X-Special) has been unlocked for normal play. * Much like PARANOiA ETERNAL's original 5thMIX MANIAC chart, PARANOiA ETERNAL(X-Special)'s charts also contain a jackhammer section, but its Single CHALLENGE chart has one more note compared to the original's 14 notes. ** The Single EXPERT charts for [[PARANOiA Revolution]] and [[DDR TAGMIX -LAST DanceR-]] also use the 8th note jackhammer section of PARANOiA ETERNAL's old MANIAC chart. The Double EXPERT charts instead use a section of PARANOiA ETERNAL's new Double EXPERT chart. * From [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]] onwards, PARANOiA ETERNAL(X-Special) appears in the DanceDanceRevolution X folder instead of the 5thMIX folder. * In DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX, PARANOiA ETERNAL's BPM is incorrectly displayed as 204. * According to Aaron Chmielowiec's book ''Counting Combos'' on [http://aaronin.jp/JDDR_book_5x8_update_2013b.pdf page 33], PARANOiA ETERNAL is jokingly referred to as '''PARANOiA YOJO''' (the word yojo meaning "little girl" in Japanese) by Takeshi Matsumoto's friends as an in-joke. * From June 1st, 2017 in [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] to [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]], PARANOiA ETERNAL(X-Special) does not appear in the song selection screen if the player does not use an [[e-amusement]] pass. ** From [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] onwards, it is available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === BeForU Official Website === ==== NAOKI ==== This is a NEW version of PARANOiA by STM, who won the award in the DDR Audition REMIX contest. This was the first song STM created music for. It's a great achievement that he created a song at this level for the first time. I actually asked him to create this updated version in the studio of my workplace. After I saw his determined attitude and uncompromising passion during production, I'm glad that STM completed the song on his own as expected. I hope you will play PARANOiA, which was reborn through a contest, at amusement spots across the country. === DanceDanceRevolution Artist Audition 2001 Official Website === ==== MESSAGE from MATSUMOTO(STM200) ==== I'm STM200, who won the REMIX contest. There was actually a series of coincidences up until I created this song. I was near indifferent for a while after knowing about the audition on the KONAMI homepage, but somewhere in my heart, I had the feeling, "It would be cool to have such a PARANOiA in the game"... While returning home from playing at the arcade, I unexpectedly had an idea when I stopped at the railroad crossing in front of the train station. The rhythm of approaching train sounds and the sound of railroad crossings at regular intervals. "This is it!!" With this image as a starting point, I started creating this song, and my PARANOiA was finally completed.
If I didn't return home at the railroad crossing after dancing to "[[PARANOIA EVOLUTION|PARANOiA-evolution-]]" at the shop that day, this song wouldn't exist. The title of this song I created is "PARANOiA-eternal-".
It's eternal. The railroad tracks go on. Eternally (laughs). Please dance and feel the eternity. I want to sincerely thank all the KONAMI staff who cooperated in finalizing this song, and my friends who supported me.
I'm really thankful!! ==== MESSAGE from NAOKI ==== In the REMIX contest, I asked for a "DJ-styled sense", which is different from composing. The ability to compose sounds and rhythms is the most important part of a REMIX, not chord and melody progressions. When I first heard STM200's song, I thought his ability to compose the song stood out, and I couldn't help but already say "this is it!". I was even more surprised that he was 18 years old and this was the first music he created. I hope he will continue to improve his "DJ-styled sense" and do his best from now on. And everyone, by all means, please try listening to "PARANOiA-eternal-" by STM200 in DDR5thMIX. It's a song that will definitely makes you want to dance! === DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX CS === This song won the "REMIX category" of the "Dance Dance Revolution 5thMIX Artist Audition 2001".
The applicant was a man slightly over 18 years old.
To those who don't know Dance Dance Revolution, please check out the arrangement of the famous "PARANOiA" by all means! === DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX Original Soundtrack === This is a new version of "PARANOIA" by STM, which won the REMIX category of the D.D.R. audition. While keeping the worldview of the original song, the new version features a brand-new arrangement that could only have been created by a contest winner. The tempo is both regular and erratic, the sound expands and contracts, and the voice has been manipulated. The combination of these elements creates a real sense of urgency and spookiness. Please play this piece while feeling the composer's passion for his "eternal masterpiece" with your ears and body. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (North America)]] === "PARANOiA ETERNAL" by STM 200 is the newest version from the "PARANOiA" series. The original "[[PARANOiA]]" was already an instant classic and still holds the record for the highest number of remixes out of any Dance Dance Revolution song. "PARANOiA ETERNAL" is more challenging than the original version, so watch yourself on the dancefloor. Be sure to check out the "[[PARANOiA MAX~DIRTY MIX~|DIRTY MIX]]" version in this game as well. == Staff Comments == A new PARANOiA was born from a new attempt of the audition selection, and I immediately expressed my impression after listening to it.
PARA ETERNAL provides feelings of a successively increasing iron will.
An urgent, chaotic trance feeling.... == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty from 2ndMIX CLUB VER. through 5thMIX (and the Solo games) rated from 1 to 9, 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. August 31st, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Music Comment == With the revival of ancient genetic memories, and their respective justices born from hope and despair, what will be the outcome of this duo at the mercy of fate... == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== Zektbach ==== Nox and Matin. They were two beings with brilliantly beautiful symmetry.
Born from one's self, they were attracted to each other, and planned to follow the lineage of transcendent beings who possessed perfect logic.
However, the emotional faults created in their respective environments were greatly amplified by the jewel [[Ristaccia]], and the logical symmetry maintained by its perfect beauty didn't attract each other, but instead collapsed.
The collapsing harmony caused terrifying contradictions in their hearts――
Nox, who was raised in a weak environment, started to be controlled by negative emotions born from resentment, gradually became self-contradictory and couldn't accept Matin's "similar yet different existence".
And in the end, after much suffering, he ends up choosing the path of "complete justice", by eliminating Matin's evil existence.
Matin, who was raised in a strong and happy environment, after understanding everything, is filled with compassion in her heart and only wants to save Nox.
One's self has been divided in half. Their respective blind justices caused a result that was completely different to their naturally ideal world.
No one knew that the lineage of transcendent beings, who corrected the world since ancient times, was completely lost.
Hi everyone. My name is Zektbach. I'm commonly known as Zektbach the CURUCURU. I'm a spinning Zektbach.
This story reveals something important that controls the center of the epic.
The music score is more systematic than [[Apocalypse ~dirge of swans~|Chapter 4's Apocalypse]], because going back in time, the world in this story hasn't been controlled by chaos yet.
... Let's leave it at that. Well, let's talk a bit about the past.
At a bar in certain town where adventurers gather, there was a legendary artist.
I've previously heard some rumors about her. It's MAYA.
While we were drinking together and talking about our adventures, I thought that she was the only person who could express Chapter 3's scene, and when I told the entire The Epic of Zektbach to her, she kindly agreed.
Now everyone knows the wonderful drawings that were completed several months later. Well then, until the next chapter, farewell! === pop'n music === ==== Zektbach ==== ''Matin climbed up the Sonne Castle watchtower and looked down.''
''A very prominent gigantic fortress could be seen across the beautiful, violet blue Tetoroa Sea.''
''Why does Nox and his allies repeatedly engage in pointless destruction and battles?''
''Trisagion's teachings have always kept people safe since the Kingdom of Noigllado was founded.''
''Why are they now trying to disturb it? Why do they pointlessly cause suffering and sadness to people?''
''Matin firmly held the holy sword in her hand.'' ''Nox... I don't want to fight you if possible....''
''But, I need to maintain justice.''
''To protect the hopes of many people, and to make them happy....''
Hi everyone. My name is Zektbach. I'm commonly known as Zektbach the Party. I'm a feasting Zektbach.
By everyone's requests, Chapter 3's melody can be enjoyed here too.
The respective fates of two people with opposing sides of justice.
They originally should've completed a mission....
By all means, I'd like you to enjoy such a sad story and the moving song. Well then, until the next chapter, farewell! == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 JP|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (Japan)]] / [[CS DDR X NA|DanceDanceRevolution X CS (North America)]] === This song, with it's dramatic opening, is a new work by musical prodigy Zektbach. Its classical harmony spread over the 4/4 rhythm produces a unique sound. This is truly a revolutionary piece. == Video Production Information == === MAYA === It already seems like quite a long time ago... I was asked to be in charge of this song's video about over a year ago.
One pleasant night, when Zektbach and I went out drinking together, I remember that, before I knew it, we bonded over silly stories and spoke to each other with shining eyes.
I truly never dreamed that I'd be involved in such things like The Epic of Zektbach. On the day I received the demo, from the moment I first listened to it, a tremendous amount of imagination started to fill up my mind.
Many scattering stars, a swirling hellfire, metallic sword fighting sounds, people's roars, tears, etc.... I vaguely felt the tragedy surrounding this duo.
Whether or not I was sitting at my desk, images kept coming in succession, and I spent the days taking notes, drawing rough sketches, and following the storyline. While I showed and discussed about that image to Zektbach, the story formed its shape like a rapidly growing ivy.
After I received the lyrics written by koshuka, its vague image solidified, and its world widely expanded. When I completed it, I'm sincerely glad that I formed its shape.
I'm grateful and happy not just to Zektbach, but to everyone who supported us.
I'm truly honored to be able to express a chapter of The Epic of Zektbach in this way. == Character Information == Is it justice to make the weak suffer?
Is it justice to repeat pointless wars and destruction?
Nox and Matin. Two people with similar faces, advocating their own justices. === MAYA === Hello, I'm MAYA.
With the song crossing over from IIDX, Nox and Matin are participating in pop'n. I thought that this duo should both be included here, so I asked the staff to let me draw them both.
Thank you very much to the staff for listening to my selfishness. I tried to express unique aspects and appearances in their animations that couldn't be seen in the IIDX movie.
When I moved them, I think both their hearts were expressed well.
To those who've played this song in IIDX, try it in pop'n!
To those who've first played it in pop'n, please try and play it in IIDX~.
What's between this duo?... was it there?... I'm sure The Epic of Zektbach's world will expand again. == Staff Comments == === [[Marimo|kinoko]] === I recently went to Mont-Saint-Michel, and this song played in my mind during meditation.
In the Middle Ages, "waaaaaaaaaaap"!!!! === [[Kiyoshi Murai|Seiya Murai]] === A suspicious party held in an old house? It felt like the beginning of a grand story.... === [[Yuki Shibata|Mameshiba]] === It's a luxurious song that can be played with different characters for 1P and 2P.
It's great that it's luxurious, but as a programmer, do we need to sort Nox and Matin as different characters? I remember thinking about this during production.
This time, I asked [[Chihiro Inoue|Chihi]] many questions like those in a first-year junior high school student's English textbook, such as "is Satou-san [[Shishamo]]?" or "is Karoline [[Karoline&Yangels|KaroYan]]". === [[Ryuta Tamura|TAMA]] === We also asked MAYA to write NET Taisen comments.
I'm sorry that we couldn't include separate comments for Nox and Matin. === chihiro === Unlike [[SigSig|sigsig]], I had to lower their sizes, but even if they get smaller, their atmosphere is kept! Thank you very much~
There doesn't seem to be many examples of identical twins with different genders, and in addition, their facial features are beautiful~!

== Song Connections / Remixes == * CaptivAte～誓い～ is part of the "CaptivAte" song series. * CaptivAte～誓い～ is based on the [[AC DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD]] opening theme, ''CUSTOM DRIVE''. * A shorter version of CaptivAte～誓い～ is used in the DanceDanceRevolution series, removing the piano intro. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * "Chikai" (誓い) means "Oath" in Japanese. * CaptivAte～誓い～ received a brand-new Double ANOTHER chart in [[AC DJ TROOPERS|beatmania IIDX 15 DJ TROOPERS]]. This chart was carried to [[CS GOLD|beatmania IIDX 14 GOLD CS]]. * CaptivAte～誓い～ was unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 for normal play on December 13th, 2007. ** It is the only song from the CaptivAte series that has appeared in DanceDanceRevolution. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series, CaptivAte～誓い～'s artist was changed to '''DJ YOSHITAKA feat. A/I'''. * In American and European releases of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], CaptivAte～誓い～'s title was romanized as '''CaptivAte ～CHIKAI～'''. ** However, the song's banner and jacket retain the song's Japanese title. * CaptivAte～誓い～ has never been on an American/European CS release of DanceDanceRevolution. * CaptivAte～誓い～ was added to [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] on May 2nd, 2017 as part of the May 2017 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From June 2019, it can be purchased with BITs. * CaptivAte～誓い～ also appears in the ''SPINFEVER'' series of medal redemption games by KONAMI. * CaptivAte～誓い～ received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on October 29th, 2026, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.8''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.8). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, CaptivAte～誓い～'s CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. == Song Production Information == === DJ YOSHITAKA === Wow, now it's our 3rd version of CaptivAte! "To see and do onto others, with no fear of risk", and then you will become the story's "judge", and see if you could keep your promises.
That is this time's story. With this song's arrival, and with the arrivals of so many other amazing songs everyone else as made, I hope the people who are interested in this song will try and check it out! == Video Production Information == === mari === So this is the new IIDX animation! DJ Yoshitaka said, "Just feel free to draw what you feel from the song."
The last theme this time, "oath" is it? It seems to me as something paralleling, a subject that seems to be where you imagine the image to be something you have to search for desperately within your own self.
However, it seems odd returning back to the real world when you have to look for something like that!
So I did something otherworldly, like a little fairy in her own little "incident" of sorts.
An "UMA" fairy, where her wings sprout in spirit, not in actuality, to be honest. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

== Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Both dream of love and [[volcano]] mark Yasuhiro Abe's debut in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** dream of love also marks Kaori Nishina's first KONAMI original song in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * dream of love appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA 2 Pack'''. * dream of love is currently the only song sung by Kaori Nishina still present in ''any'' BEMANI arcade series. == Song Production Information == === Yasuhiro Abe === For this song, I took a specific approach to create its fusion sound. I combined a "dance" beat with a "Koto", which is a Japanese traditional instrument, and used them as the key sounds. In addition, I contrived its melody to have a feeling of oriental melancholy. I also use repetitive, catchy, phrases so the song definitely lends itself to dancing! The R&B sound has become much more popular among the Japanese music scene and has often been used in games. In the DDR series, we usually polish and arrange the sounds in a way that satisfies the desires of the user and makes the song more familiar for the product.
As an example, for this song I strengthened each of the five snares and adjusted their attack time in order to make the sound thicker and heavier. Plus, I used an Access Virus, a plug-in for ProTools, to emphasize the bass part of the attack and to add more volume to the song as a whole. If I have a chance to make a full version of this track, I would accentuate the Koto part by arranging it with other Japanese instruments. This would be my dream and I'm hoping to release it someday in the future. == CS Information Data == === DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America) === "dream of love" creates a musical landscape where your dreams can come true. Journey into a funky, soulful world and enjoy this beautiful work by Kaori Nishina. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. == Song Connections / Remixes == * Fly away -mix del matador- is a remix of [[Fly away]], from [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * A matador (Spanish for "killer") is another name for the torero, a bullfighter and the main performer in bullfighting, practised in Spain, Portugal, Mexico, Peru, France and various other countries influenced by Spanish culture. * Fly away -mix del matador- appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA 2 Pack 4'''. == Song Production Information == === Shoichiro Hirata === In contrast to the original song's fresh feeling, I tried to make this song slightly restrained.
I mainly created it using rumba guitar phrases.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * GIRIGILI門前雀羅 is one of the songs featured in the medley [[Xmix2 (Beats 'n Bangs)]] from [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Both GIRIGILI門前雀羅 and [[A thing called LOVE]] are Osamu Migitera's first original songs in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** It is also the first BEMANI song featuring Chihiro Inoue's vocals. * On the American and European releases of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], GIRIGILI門前雀羅's title was changed to '''GIRIGILI Burning 24H!'''. * GIRIGILI門前雀羅 appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA 2 Pack 4'''. * In pre-[[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] installments of the DanceDanceRevolution series, GIRIGILI門前雀羅's BPM is listed as 148 regardless of the difficulty selected. * In うたっち, GIRIGILI門前雀羅 can be bought in the Shop for 4500 points. * GIRIGILI門前雀羅 is one of the TOWN2 unlocks in pop'n music 19 TUNE STREET's TOWN MODE. ** Once unlocked in pop'n music 19 TUNE STREET, GIRIGILI門前雀羅 can be purchased in the TOWN MODE CD shop for 900 TP. * Despite debuting in the pop'n music series in うたっち, GIRIGILI門前雀羅 is absent from the pop'n music CS folder in the arcade titles. * The pop'n music and うたっち banners resemble GIRIGILI門前雀羅's DanceDanceRevolution song banner. ** Also, GIRIGILI門前雀羅's background is based on the jacket for this song. * According to [[Jun Wakita|wac]], he and [[Daichi Watanabe|PON]] together came up with the genre for GIRIGILI門前雀羅 in pop'n music. ** MIXTURENPON is a portmanteau of "mixture" and "chanpon". == Song Connections / Remixes == * A re-arranged version of MOONSTER was used as the background music in [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]]'s online modes. * MOONSTER is one of two songs in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2's "GRAND CROSS" series of planet-themed songs that is not based on a planetary object in the Solar System, representing the Moon. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * MOONSTER was unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 for normal play on August 26th, 2007. ** It's the only CS song in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 that is a hidden song. * A Japanese translation of MOONSTER's lyrics can be found in the [[DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA Original Soundtrack]] album booklet. == Song Production Information == === Marsha === Nice to meet you, I'm Marsha♪
Actually, this was my first time recording a song. It's been my dream to seriously record my songs and give them a proper form.
When I was first given this song by the composer kobo, it somewhat felt futuristic. So, I said "wow".
Furthermore, I could immediately imagine people dancing to this song.
That's why I didn't really worry about how I could sing it.
When I went to the U.S., I saw a certain man dancing in DDR very well, and I imagined everyone doing a Cool dance to this song while singing it.
For the melody, it's somehow all exciting (laughs), but the rap and interlude in this entire song is very cool!
If I was a dancer, I'd show off in this section quite a lot. That's why I want everyone to become dancers and dance to this song from head to toe. === Scotty D. === When I received a request to write the lyrics and listened to this song for the first time, I first imagined a midnight sky.
Of course, the MOON is the lead role of the night sky. The moon is like a woman, and I wrote the lyrics about a HELPLESS man's feelings, who was at the mercy of a seductive woman who confuses him by transforming into a crescent, half, and full moon.
Actually, it's said that there are many crimes on a night of a full moon, which also turns an ordinary man into a werewolf.
This song's title is the only resistance of a man enjoying and regretting his helplessness against such an absolute and mysterious power.
In English, "...STER" means "... idiot" and "... damned", so this man is saying "you moon-like idiot!" to the woman taking advantage of him.
But since he loves that woman after all, such small resistance also has zero effect （＾＾ === kobo === I suddenly thought of an image of a Cool, mature woman, and the night sky, and created this song.
I was also surprised, but it seems that image was also conveyed to the lyricist Scotty D. without words, and then! He completed the lyrics.
Marsha's sharp singing voice is speedy, blends in with the song's atmosphere, and brings out a night sense even more. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. Under the perfect sky without clouds, I had arrived at a certain arcade in Tenoji, Osaka.
I was there to attend an event... yeah, for the commemoration of DDR`s comeback.
The place was packed, and I made a promise in front of all those people to produce a new PARANOiA...
At that moment, my spirit was drug deep into the underworld.
Hades had been calling me in my heart and told me that this was to be my new burden.
At that point I devoted myself to complete the production, all the while being afraid... aware of Hades always watching me.
The rhythm`s irregular change every four measures shows how nervous and disturbed I was due to Hades` continued presence.
Always running to escape from Hades and the underworld, I would lose my breath and scream out... yet still keep running... my fear of Hades escalating so that my heart rate reached 300... then, I saw something when finishing up the song... it was a shadow with a huge sickle and the crimson red of... == Video Production Information == None. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]] === "PARANOiA ~HADES~" is the latest addition to the "PARANOiA" series. It could be unlocked in pop'n music High☆Cheers!! from June 18th, 2026 to August 17th, 2026. == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== Mr.Saturn ==== Hello, hello. So we meet again.
When you think of the world's greatest, you think of the martial arts tournament. I'm Mr. Saturn, the reigning world champion of combat sports, currently on a winning streak.
Congratulations on the release of CS DJ TROOPERS.
They say persistence is power. Looks like the power got a bit too overwhelming, making it tough for players too. No, it's fantastic. I can't tell you the full story of how things turned out, but when you think of the world's greatest, you think of ramen. And I had a real, no-holds-barred battle to decide who's truly the best with [[Toshiyuki Kakuta|L.E.D.]], whose first album "[[Denjin K]]" is now on sale.
And as a result, well, more like, "Can we crossover this song to the home version of IIDX?" "Sure, why not?" ... it all ended up being pretty casual. Surprisingly, I summed it up quite easily. I mentioned this somewhere before, but this song was originally made for DDR, so I was like, "Lucky, I don't have to think about button sounds at all", hehe. Because of that, I got carried away. I did things I would never do for certain "be-" or "po-" games, like preparing multiple types of kick sounds, changing the blend ratios depending on the section, randomly opening and closing filters on sequence phrases, panning them around, slightly tweaking synth sounds for each part, claiming "This is my groove" while leaving quantize off, hanging on one chord for 8 or 16 measures without varying button placement, creating phrases that don't fit into 7 or 9 buttons, layering them double or triple. In other words, I deliberately did things that would be a hassle later when assigning buttons, or rather, I completely ignored the usual precautions, taking advantage of the fact that it wasn't for buttons. But now, thanks to the honor of getting crossed over, it all came back to bite me, dammit! No, no, "dammit" is too strong. I'm honored to have this crossover. Congratulations. Thank you very much. At the very least, I think we must never forget that any small happiness that comes to Mr. Saturn is ultimately a trap leading to future hardship. === DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 === ==== Mr.Saturn ==== Hello there..
Mr. Saturn, world champion fighter and savior of the world, here.
But you can call me Mr. Saturn, I don't mind. I could go on and on about this, but suffice to say I was told that this latest DDR is a planetary festival, and that I've become Saturn.
That's why I wrote a Saturn-like track. A Saturn-like track?
Yeah, I really don't get it either. Saturn (or Saturnus in Latin) was the Roman equivalent of the Greek god Cronus, father of Zeus and god of the harvest.
Saturn loved eating so much that he devoured his own children.
So, I included a heavy mood and what sounds like a tribal war cry, and then wrapped it all up in some spacey goodness.
Is that Saturn-like?
I really don't know.
Since this was my first experience with DDR, that was enough to get my adrenaline flowing. What's more, I thought it was great how I didn't have to think in terms of sounds becoming buttons like a game, but when I actually got started writing the track and ended up blindly cramming in sounds that seemed like they could become buttons, I think it became an obsession or a kind of sickness. === DanceDanceRevolution X === This song projects an atmosphere of eeriness, giving us a sense of both grandeur and fear. Even though it's rhythm is Techno, composing it with a classical-inspired melody reflects this effect more than anything. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL） - DDR EDITION - is a short edit of STARS☆☆☆(Re-tuned by HΛL), which is a remix of [[STARS|STARS☆☆☆]], HYPER J-POP from [[AC pnm 8|pop'n music 8]]. ** A different cut of STARS☆☆☆(Re-tuned by HΛL), titled [[STARS(Re-tuned by HAL) - IIDX EDITION -|STARS☆☆☆(Re-tuned by HΛL) - IIDX EDITION -]], appears in [[AC GOLD|beatmania IIDX 14 GOLD]]. * The full version of STARS☆☆☆ (Re-tuned by HΛL) was available through the ''KONAMI♪MUSICフル'' service. * STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL） - DDR EDITION - is part of DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2's "GRAND CROSS" planet-themed song series, representing Earth. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL） - DDR EDITION - is the unlockable song of the ''ZUKIN WARS episode:2'' event of DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2. To unlock it, you must beat at least 380 Dark Dancers during October 18th to November 8th, 2007. ** It was unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 for everyone to play on November 29th, 2007. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL） - DDR EDITION -'s music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL） - DDR EDITION - is one of the few DanceDanceRevolution songs which its Single DIFFICULT chart is rated ''higher'' than the Single EXPERT chart. == Song Production Information == === NAOKI === "STARS☆☆☆" is TЁЯRA's debut song, and I think it's filled with a rough and unknown power.
One of the VISIONs I want to depict in this sound is that it's "uncategorizable". For example, this REMIX is a track by HΛL, who arranges, produces, and creates songs for numerous avex artists such as Ayumi Hamasaki, which expresses our intention to be "borderless" in the J-POP scene. Even if a song was written for a game... it's still a J-POP song, the only difference being where it was released... I recorded this song thinking about this.
TЁЯRA's concept since their formation is "to keep it pop"... "STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL）" is a meaningful track which is TЁЯRA's return to the origin and the start of their second stage. === jun === As the title "STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL） - DDR EDITION -" suggests, this song is a customized DDR version of "STARS☆☆☆（Re-tuned by HΛL）".
Although the beatmaniaIIDX series also includes the "IIDX EDITION", this fast-paced, flowing sound is danceable & pressable in both DDR and IIDX, so by all means, everyone please try to play both versions! == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]] === TЁЯRA takes J-POP to the next level! Backed by a driving beat and soaring instruments, these powerful vocals feel like they are raining down from the heavens. Listen to TЁЯRA's songs in many of BEMANI's music games. === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 JP|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (Japan)]] === This is a HYPER J POP styled song by TЁЯRA, who have numerous smash hits throughout the BEMANI series. This is a remix of their signature song "STARS☆☆☆", returning with an even more upper version. The catchy melody, which is immediately familiar to your ears, is must-listen. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. This is the kind of song you just can't help writing from time to time (LOL).
And I immediately thought Alison was the only one who could do the vocals for this one.
I never thought twice about having Alison sing the English version of this track. What was that?! An English version?!
Yep!!!
The track branches when you select it!

There's a version of the track that I sing on! ;-)
The lyrics are different, and even the arrangement has been changed a bit.

== Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * switch is TЁЯRA's only original song in BEMANI without [[Naoki Maeda|NAOKI]]'s involvement. * Despite being in the license category in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2, switch is a KONAMI original song. == Song Production Information == === Daisuke Asakura === This is my first try in DDR (or rather "music games").
It's been a while since my last beat pop song with a female vocalist.
With TЁЯRA's collaboration and jun's voice, I think it became a danceable and refreshing song.
It'd be great if you enjoy playing it in DDR. === jun === "switch" is a collaboration song with Daisuke Asakura.
It's also TЁЯRA's first collaboration ever, and our memorable first collaboration is with Daisuke Asakura!
jun has always admired Daisuke Asakura!!
When she met him in-person, his aura was very bright.
When I heard the song for the first time, Asakura's super-upper and original sound was really powerful.
And Akio Inoue's lyrics were very sad and mature.
I was anxious and wondered "could jun be able to sing them...?" so I tried to sing them powerfully.
I think "switch" was completed in a way unlike anything by TЁЯRA until now.
By all means, everyone please listen and dance to it! === NAOKI MAEDA === With DA (Daisuke Asakura)'s produced sound and jun's vocals... "switch" is a super special collaboration song!!
Of course the song's contents are high quality, with a melodious, digital upper tune... a J-POP number associated with DA's sound.
For TЁЯRA, this song is a "EVOLUTION" of sorts, and I think it suggests their path forward in the future.
(Someday we'll make a theme song for the Gundam series!!... That's one of my long-awaited dreams.) == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 JP|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (Japan)]] / DanceDanceRevolution X CS (North America) === The dream collaboration between these two artist came true! Synchronizing the techniques of these two great artists has generated this top-quality track. You can't miss its wonderfully catchy melody and strong vocals. == Song Connections / Remixes == * Vem brincar shares most of the melody with [[INFERNO]], an earlier Caldeira song from [[AC DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Vem brincar is the first original song of both Tomosuke Funaki and Yoshitaka Nishimura in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * "Vem brincar" is Portuguese for "come and play". * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Vem brincar's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. * Vem brincar received an updated banner in [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]]. ** Curiously, [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 JP|the Japanese release of DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS]] is the only CS version that uses the old banner. ** For the song's appearance in the [[DDR SELECTION]] category, the old banner is used. * Vem brincar appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA 2 Pack 6'''. == Song Production Information == === DJ YOSHITAKA === TOMO-chin, who loves Brazil more than anybody I know, said while eating Indian curry, "I can't get Brazil out of my mind...".
So I say, while drinking my Lassi, "What!? How did Brazil cross your mind while you`re eating Indian curry!?
Unbelievable!".
That was the moment the song was born.
It's a Brazilian House track blessed by the God of Curry.
The sound of its birth was so loud that I said, wide-eyed, "Meow, meow, MEOOOOWWW!!"... and then TOMO-chin sadly shook his head... Oops! let's get back to the topic... === TOMOSUKE === This track was born while I was eating Indian curry and thinking of going to Brazil.
After that I found little gaps in Yoshi`s determination (he had previously refused my wish to join the Pirates).
Although I only play the electric piano on this song, my longing to visit Brazil and my pity towards the Pirates are beautifully woven into it.
When I played it for Yoshi, he exclaimed, "Meow, Meow, MEOOOWWW!!"
And I said, with coffee on my hand, "When did you overcome your allergy to cats!?" We fell into an awkward silence... == CS Information Data == === DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America) === This smooth brazilian-house song has an light airy feeling that reminds you of dancing in the sunlight. So let your mind drift to the ocean while the beautiful vocals invite you to come play, dance and enjoy! == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Both volcano and [[dream of love]] mark Yasuhiro Abe's debut in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * During the DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 location test, volcano was only available during the FINAL STAGE, and players were required to play it (or select random) to get EXTRA STAGE. * volcano appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA 2 Pack 4'''. * volcano received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on May 14th, 2026, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.7''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.7). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, volcano's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. == Song Production Information == === Yasuhiro Abe === This is a upbeat, progressive-rock number. It might take some time and practice to master the track, but it's definitely worth it.
It's the challenge! In the composition process I really enjoyed framing the melody, which will probably sound strange at first, in a way that will take the listener into their own mysterious and imaginary world.
It is absolutely guaranteed that you will be addicted to it.
In addition, I had Yozo on guitar and Nobu on bass this time.
Both of them have been working closely with me and always give me new inspiration and energy.
Their aggressiveness and enthusiasm during recording helped complete the song exactly as I planned. In regards to the composition, I used 6 different guitar parts.
I also used several applications such as ProTools, Amp Farm, Guitar Rig, and Sans Amp in order to amplify each feature of the song.
I even joined in and played some guitar parts myself to help achieve it's intensity.
It is an instrumental monster that rapidly develops and will get you dancing for sure.
I hope all of you enjoy this hyped-up sound in DDR! == CS Information Data == === DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America) === It's time to rock! "volcano" erupts onto the dancefloor with blazing guitars and spitfire drums. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards.
