== Song Connections / Remixes == * According to NAOKI's song production information on the beatmania IIDX 7th style official website, D2R was the foundation for [[BRILLIANT 2U]], [[B4U]] and [[DYNAMITE RAVE]] prior to its debut. * D2R is sampled in [[DDR MEGAMIX]], from [[AC pnm 10|pop'n music 10]]. * An instrumental version of D2R appears in the video ''inside KI・SE・KI'', from [[BeForU]]'s single of the [[KI-SE-KI|same name]]. * An arrangement of D2R is used as the RANDOM BGM in [[CS BBD|BOOM BOOM DANCE / Rhythm Party]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to NAOKI, the concept for D2R was originally made back around [[AC DDR 1st|the first DanceDanceRevolution game]], but it was shelved until its complete rework with brand-new vocals, in DDRMAX2 [https://web.archive.org/web/20150820045407/https://bemanistyle.com/ddr-weekly-journal-1/]. * D2R marks the first appearance of Londell "Taz" Hicks, the announcer of the DanceDanceRevolution series from [[AC DDRMAX|DDRMAX]] through [[AC DDR SuperNOVA2|SuperNOVA2]], as a vocalist. * The robot from [[B4U]] appears in D2R's background animations. * D2R received a BEGINNER chart in [[AC DS EuroMIX2|Dancing Stage EuroMIX2]]. * '''D2R("FREEZE" Special)''' is one of the My GROOVE RADAR (Myグルーヴレーダー) unlockable songs in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2. To unlock it, you must play songs that have charts which focus on the FREEZE parameter of the [[GROOVE RADAR]]. ** As of April 10th, 2008, D2R("FREEZE" Special) has been unlocked for normal play. * D2R's Double EXPERT chart was slightly altered in [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]], fixing a jump which was timed one 16th late. * D2R's overlays were removed from the beatmania IIDX arcade games as of [[AC tricoro|beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro]] due to technical issues. * Prior to [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]], D2R ("FREEZE" Special) had no space between its title and subtitle. * From June 1st, 2017 in [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] to [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]], D2R ("FREEZE" Special) does not appear in the song selection screen if the player does not use an [[e-amusement]] pass. ** From [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] onwards, it is available by default for all players. * D2R is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] from January 6th, 2021 after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * D2R received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on November 27th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.5''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.5). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, D2R's CHALLENGE charts can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. ** From November 30th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they will be available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== NAOKI ==== Brilliant 2U, B4U, and DYNAMITE RAVE are songs that have become synonymous with NAOKI's sound, but D2R served as the original concept for them, and although it was the first original song in the DDR series, it was shelved for various reasons until now.
The feeling of "I want to bring some closure to this song..." grew stronger, so I decided to pick it up this time.
When I picked the song, I created a full-fledged arrangement using current technology, brushed up the melody, and recorded new vocals, so the song has a long story about how it was revived almost in its original form.
The meaning of the coined genre HYPER ROCK BEAT in D2R is "a fusion of ROCK and DANCE BEAT", and I'd like to strengthen this sound style in the future....... that's what I think. === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== NAOKI ==== Brilliant 2U, B4U, and DYNAMITE RAVE are songs that have become synonymous with NAOKI's sound, but D2R served as the original concept for them, and although it was the first original song in the DDR series, it was shelved for various reasons until now. The song was revived after I created a full-fledged arrangement and brushed up the melody before it was included in the game. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution-]] === "D2R" by NAOKI is the latest energetic masterpiece from the same artist behind hit Dance Dance Revolution songs like "[[DYNAMITE RAVE]]", "[[BRILLIANT 2U]]" and "B4U". Packed with high-energy rhythms, ultra-fast rap vocals and soulful female vocals, "D2R" will have you tearing up the dance floor. == Video Production Information == === GOLI === It's hot. Hot phrases from the start!
This is what NAOKI's songs are like, after all.
After receiving the data, this was the only song I listened to when I was creating other animations (laughs). But, NAOKI. You can create a wide variety of songs. As expected. Moreover, the quality is always high. You're a pro.
"A fusion of ROCK AND DANCE BEAT"? Is there a sequel?
No, there should be, right? Because I want to listen while working (laughs). == Staff Comments == === RICE.C === When I received the tentative song, I immediately decided on using the promised robot. The production was quick afterwards. The movie where he spreads his crossed arms in the flames is my favorite, but the part where he shoots the beam overwhelmingly stands out. It's a rather goofy title. I also used weird sampling sounds to create it.
Please have fun playing this!!
Sound-wise, I tried to make it feel a bit nostalgic. == CS Information Data == === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (North America) === "A Stupid Barber" by Sho-T has nothing to do with your hairdresser, but this euro-house tune has so much style, your hairdresser might be jealous! Check out other songs by this artist in [[CS DDR KONAMIX|Dance Dance Revolution KONAMIX]], [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX Dance Dance Revolution]] and DDRMAX2 Dance Dance Revolution. == Staff Comments == === yossi === It's a barber, so I created a mustached old man.

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * AA is part of D.J.Amuro's RENAISSANCE song series. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of AA. * A long version of AA appears in dj TAKA's first album, [[milestone]]. * A remix of AA by [[BlackY]], titled [[AA BlackY mix]], appears in [[AC SDVX|SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH]]. * Another remix of AA by [[OSTER project]], titled ''AA (Renaissance Concertino Mix)'', appears in dj TAKA's second album, [[True Blue...]]. * A remake of AA, titled [[AA -rebuild-]], appears in [[AC CANNON BALLERS|beatmania IIDX 25 CANNON BALLERS]]. * AA is sampled in [[X-DEN]], from [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]], and [[Turn A|∀]], from [[AC BISTROVER|beatmania IIDX 28 BISTROVER]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to the [https://web.archive.org/web/20050228132704fw_/http://www.konami.co.jp/am/bm2dx/bm2dx11/qanda_vol1.html Q&A corner] of the beatmania IIDX 11 IIDX RED official website, there isn't an official way to read AA, although it was generally referred as "ダブルエース" (Double-Ace) by the production team. ** Notably, AA is sorted as "ダブルエース" in beatmania IIDX LIGHTNING MODEL cabinets, and AA BlackY mix has "AA" rendered as "ダブルエース" for sorting purposes in the SOUND VOLTEX series. * AA held the record at the time of its release for the most notes of any ANOTHER chart in beatmania IIDX on both Single and Double, with 1834 and 1739 notes respectively. ** Both of these records would be surpassed by [[Mei|冥]] in [[AC HAPPY SKY|beatmania IIDX 12 HAPPY SKY]], which has 2000 notes on both of its ANOTHER charts. * AA received a brand-new video in [[beatmania IIDX visual emotions 3]]. This video was later added to the arcade series in [[AC DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD]], and was also carried over to [[CS IIDX RED|beatmania IIDX 11 IIDX RED CS]]. * AA was available in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]]' championship Mode from August 10th to 21st, 2016. ** On August 22nd, 2016, it was added to standard Mode for anyone who had played the ''PREMIUM∞CUP'' in championship Mode at least once. ** From December 2019, it could be purchased with BITs. ** From April 20th, 2022, it is available by default in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]]. * AA also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during ''Accel Rave Time'' (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. * AA received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on July 11th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.2''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.2). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, AA's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From July 31st, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === D.J.Amuro === This is the theme of a person during his final moments, who died a heroic death after being betrayed by his trusted friends.
Although its difficulty level is quite high, I'd like for you to deliver flowers to this person's final moments with your brilliant performance. == Video Production Information == Untranslated. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

It's had a generic video in every game since then. * Bad Routine is a hidden revival in [[AC DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD]]. It can be unlocked by collecting 1300 DJ POINTS. ** As of May 10th, 2006, it is unlocked by default. * Bad Routine received ANOTHER charts in [[CS DJ TROOPERS|beatmania IIDX 15 DJ TROOPERS CS]]. These charts were carried over to the arcade releases in [[AC Lincle|beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle]]. * According to the DanceDanceRevolution master song list, Bad Routine was supposed to first appear in [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX -DanceDanceRevolution-]]. * Bad Routine received a new banner in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA. * Bad Routine is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from October 2nd, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. ** As of March 13th, 2024 in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]], it is playable by default. == Song Production Information == === D.J. Spugna === This time, I wanted to try creating a song using a newly-purchased analog filter.
Until now, I've always done the same thing with the way I influence a song's dynamics with the number of sounds and phrases, and wow, I was surprised.
So many dynamics can be added with a single filter. I got a little obsessed.
Next time, I would like to try it with vocals. == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution- / [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME (America)]] === "Bad Routine" by D.J. Spugna. Don't let the song title jinx you during your performance, because "Bad Routine" is an awesome house song that is screaming for a good routine to go with it. == Video Production Information == === shiro === It was my first experience filming the dance while focusing on a single person, and I had a lot of fun with it.
The dancer was a friendly man who danced bravely despite of a sudden illness.
In previous IIDX dance movies, dancers seemed to ad-lib their dances, but choreography was also included in the song this time. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ from 7th through 9th style, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

Other Music Game Appearances: None. == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A remix of CHAOS by [[Youhei Kimura|ARM]], titled [[CHAOS Terror-Tech Mix]], appears in [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]]. * A spritual sequel to CHAOS, titled ''CHAOS AGAIN'', appears in ANDAMIRO's ''PUMP IT UP PHOENIX''. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * CHAOS is DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA's ONE MORE EXTRA STAGE. To access it, clear [[Healing-D-Vision]], [[Fascination MAXX]], or [[Fascination ~eternal love mix~|Fascination ～eternal love mix～]] as your EXTRA STAGE. ** From [[AC DDR SuperNOVA2|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2]] onwards, CHAOS is playable by default. * CHAOS is Naoki Maeda's first song under his DE-SIRE alias since [[TRIP MACHINE survivor]], 4 years ago. The "retunes" suffix refers to this. * Fittingly, all charts for CHAOS have high Chaos ratings on the [[GROOVE RADAR]], with the CHALLENGE charts having the highest rating of 200. This is due to the high number of stops present, which cause notes that would otherwise fall on 4th/8th/16th alignments to fall on different note quantizations, as well as some of the stops being set to higher BPM values that reach a maximum of 281.25 BPM. ** With a Chaos rating of 200, CHAOS' CHALLENGE charts had the highest Chaos rating of any chart in the DanceDanceRevolution series until the introduction of [[BREAKING THE FUTURE]]'s CHALLENGE charts in [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]], with 211 for Single and 218 for Double. ** CHAOS had the highest number of stops of any song in the arcade DanceDanceRevolution series, with 44, until the CHALLENGE charts of its remix beat it out in [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] with ''70''. ** If the CUT option is set to ON1 when playing CHAOS' BEGINNER chart, no arrows show up during gameplay. However, the song will be cleared with a D grade. * According to Naoki, he wrote CHAOS on a MacBook Pro while staying on a hotel in Los Angeles, and it was written near the deadline of SuperNOVA [https://twitter.com/NAOKI_MAEDA428/status/1078889194183811074]. * Despite it running at 170 BPM, CHAOS' BEGINNER chart was rated a 4 on the original 1-10 scale back in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA. * With 405 notes, CHAOS' Single CHALLENGE chart has the lowest notecount of any Single chart rated Level 16. * CHAOS received a slightly different banner in [[CS DDR DANCE WARS|DanceDanceRevolution DANCE WARS]]. * CHAOS was one of the qualifying round songs in the [[KONAMI Arcade Championship|KONAMI Arcade Championship 2013]] for [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]]. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], CHAOS' BPM was displayed as 170 for all of its difficulties. == Song Production Information == === DE-SIRE retunes === The concept was to create a song that is as tricky as possible, something that seemed unlikely to exist in the DDR series until now. Did you like it, players?
Anyways, it repeatedly stops. It's suspenseful. The charts don't naturally flow (smirks).
If you're a deep DDR user, I think you'll be able to understand the meaning of the artist name DE-SIRE.
That's right, CHAOS is currently DE-SIRE's royal road number.
It's the most difficult song in the game specialized only in gameplay. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. }} == Song Connections / Remixes == * DoLL is the fourth song in TЁЯRA's HYPER J-POP song series. * A remix of DoLL by [[Toshiyuki Kakuta|L.E.D.]], titled ''DoLL (L.E.D. style)'', appears in the [[beatmania IIDX REMIX for 10th Success Anniversary]] CD. * A long version of DoLL appears in TЁЯRA's first album, [[REVOLUTION (album)|RЁVOLUTIФN]]. * An unplugged ballad version of DoLL, titled ''DoLL ～Ballad Side～'', appears in TЁЯRA's second album, [[EVOLUTION (album)|ЁVOLUTIФN]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * DoLL is the first entry in the HYPER J-POP series for beatmania IIDX. * DoLL is also Junko Karashima's first original composition for the beatmania IIDX series. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], DoLL's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers. ** In [[CS DDR Disney Channel EDITION|DanceDanceRevolution Disney Channel EDITION]], DoLL received a new unique video, different from the original beatmania IIDX video (which is used in other DanceDanceRevolution releases). * In DanceDanceRevolution Disney Channel EDITION, DoLL's BPM is shown as 170-171. * DoLL can be automatically unlocked in DanceDanceRevolution STR!KE if you have save data of [[CS 10th style|beatmania IIDX 10th style CS]] on your memory card. * DoLL was supposed to appear in the cancelled game [[Cancelled Games#Karaoke Revolution BEMANI series selection|カラオケレボリューション BEMANIシリーズセレクション]]. * DoLL is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from January 4th, 2017, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. ** The BEGINNER chart was added with the launch of [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]]. It can be unlocked with BITs. ** As of March 13th, 2024, all its charts are playable by default. * In DanceDanceRevolution STR!KE, DoLL's BPM was incorrectly displayed as 150. == Song Production Information == === jun === "I, am, here.
Please, notice me, hear, my voice......." DoLL.
Every day, I keep suppressing my emotions and continue to smile.
Are you sad and want to cry? Even so, you still have to laugh.
Does your chest hurt, and your heart tears apart? ...... Even so, you still have to laugh.
That's the only thing you have to do. On the other hand, isn't there an eternal time? "......!!" "DoLL" is a song which was born within me.
How many people relate with this story?
I hope you can find a bit of a brilliant "moment" in this song.
Yes, anyone...... everyone...... even you......
...... even me. === NAOKI MAEDA === jun is the lyricist and composer of "DoLL", and I'm in charge of arranging it. I was deeply impressed by the singing and piano playing demo given to me by jun, and I remember putting a lot of time and effort in arranging "DoLL" to enhance its worldview, until I thought it was appropriate to include in the HYPER series. TЁЯRA expresses their belief to always want to keep it pop. That's why we want TЁЯRA's sound to reach as many people as possible. == Video Production Information == === GOLI === I was very moved by TЁЯRA's song, and delighted to create a movie for it.
No, I'm being selfish. I'm sorry. Actually, although it was supposed to only be animations (briefly overlayed in the movie), the song was so good that I ended in an unexpected situation just before I finished work. I endlessly listened to this song every day since I received it, except for when I slept. On the train, in my workplace at home, and of course whenever I was always at work. When you count the number of times I listened to it, that's a lot of times. But... I never get tired of it. I wonder why.
If the song and lyrics are good, I never get tired of listening to it. In addition, I feel that the fast BPM is comfortable to listen to.
By the way, I unconsciously hum these lyrics while racing my bicycle across Shinjuku. Anyways, I'm moved that everyone in Japan is playing this song so many times. As someone who became the number one fan of TЁЯRA, consisting of NAOKI and jun, I'm really looking forward to TЁЯRA's songs from now on. That's why I started listening to this song again. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

It could be unlocked from July 4th, 2007 through September 26th, 2007. ** As of September 26th, 2007, Flow has been unlocked for everyone to play. ** Flow's crossover to pop'n music marks Yuichi Asami's first appearance in ''any'' BEMANI series other than DanceDanceRevolution. * Flow has never been on a CS release of pop'n music. * According to [[Kiyoshi Murai|Seiya Murai]]'s pop'n music staff comments for Flow, he was introduced to pop'n music via Yuichi Asami's testing out a prototype of [[CS pnm|pop'n music CS]]. He remarked at the time how "he couldn't press 9 buttons!", while also noting the irony that only a year he became the sound director of the arcade pop'n music series. * Flow (True Style) appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA Pack 2'''. * Flow (True Style) appears as downloadable content for DanceDanceRevolution (PS3), in the '''DDR SuperNOVA Greatest Hits 2''' pack. * Flow was one of 30 possible picks for songs for [[AC RB groovin'!! Upper|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper]]'s 7th Set (Users' SELECTION) of the BEMANI MUSIC FOCUS unlocking system. * Flow (True Style)'s difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] on March 27th, 2019. == Music Comment == Time, humans, life, arrow objects, pop-kuns, they are all flowing... Flow! == Song Production Information == === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== Scotty D. ==== When I first listened to the song and was asked what came to my mind, I couldn't think of anything.
However, I felt a vague presence of something... a very big "something". I didn't know if that "something" was God, the universe, nature, or time. But that "something" was never human. Conversely, humans such as myself are very small entities. When confronted with something that big, we are a small thing that doesn't stand out at all. But isn't that just too lonely!? That's why I think, "although we are a small and insignificant existence in the 'flow of this world', which consists of large entities such as the universe, nature, and time, we are here in order to feel and witness that large 'flow of this world'. It's possible to do so, and is exactly proof that it exists because we can feel and witness that flow!" The opponent that confronts us is the flow that we co-exist with, in other words it's "Flow". ==== U1 ==== The word "Flow" has several meanings and thoughts... === pop'n music === ==== U1-ASAMi ====
No one can see it.
Even though the flow of people, time, the surrounding environment, and myself are being drifted away, I don't know whether it's fast or slow.
But that's the whole point, so the destination is pointless.
== Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === [[Shinjiro Otsu|Otsu]] === No matter how many times I try, I'm having trouble with the same speed changes. When it starts moving, it won't stop. === [[Shinichiro Yamanaka|Daniel]] === Flow flow flow When I hear this, am I the only person who thinks of source code or blueprints? === [[Chihiro Inoue|Chippi]] === U1's body fat seems like that of an athlete. That's amazing~ === [[eimy]] === I think I've heard this song the most during checks. No matter how tired I was after checking for many hours, no matter how many times I listened to this song, I never get tired of it. === Seiya Murai === I never thought I'd work on the same job in this way. U1 is one of my very close colleagues since he joined the company back then.
When I was involved in the pop'n series, there was a period when the division changed and I hadn't seen him in a long time, but as they recently merged, we soon sat near each other once again.
Looking back, I first encountered pop'n when he was testing the first home version of pop'n and playing it at his desk, I asked him "what's that?", and he let me play it.
At that time, I felt like I said "Wow~! I don't feel like I could press nine buttons!!", but could you imagine how something like this happened to me afterwards? (laughs) === wac === My memories of Flow? OK, let's talk about it.
Looking back, I was involved in creating pop'n 15 one year ago.
I soon started to decide which songs to crossover, and I reserved a spot for DDR, thinking that it'd be a song from SuperNOVA.
I then started to decide songs related to the four elements, and I reserved one final song for wind.
I've personally been a secret fan of U1's songs and remixes from the beginning, and I wanted to include U1's song in this DDR spot.
In other words, at that time, in that timing, "Flow" fulfilled all these conditions.
Although things in the world generally occur in a big flow, it's said that the process of including this song in pop'n, exactly aligned with this Flow. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards.

== Song Connections / Remixes == None. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Forever Sunshine is Michiru Yamane's only original composition for DanceDanceRevolution. ** It's also her only collaboration with Sota Fujimori in BEMANI. * As of [[Kind Lady]]'s removal from [[AC DDR 2014|DanceDanceRevolution (2014)]], Forever Sunshine is the only song featuring vocals by Erica Ash to still be in any arcade BEMANI release. * Forever Sunshine received a Double BEGINNER chart in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX2|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX2]]. * Forever Sunshine appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA Pack 4'''. * Forever Sunshine received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on May 14th, 2026, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.7''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.7). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, Forever Sunshine's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. == Song Production Information == === Michiru Yamane === Nice to meet you. This is the first time one of my songs has been included in the Dance Dance Revolution series. I'm Chel.Y. Anyways, I composed this song while aiming for a bright, fun, and catchy melody. It was arranged by Sota, famous for "[[Look To The Sky]]". My creation was rough, so he completed it with a cool and danceable result. If you haven't danced to "Forever Sunshine" yet, by all means, please give it a try and dance to it at least once. Now that I've introduced you to the song, let me tell you a bit about myself. To be honest, I usually create music for a certain gothic-styled action game. This is why I often imagine dark and tense images, such as blood. I create magnificent and profound songs with focus on the orchestra, and songs with a quiet atmosphere. That's the opposite image of "Forever Sunshine", right?
That's why I was able to compose this song with a fresh and enjoyable feeling.
If I have another opportunity, I want to try composing a magnificent and profound dance music next time....... === Sota Fujimori === The melody is catchy, right? This song was composed by Chel Y., and I arranged it with a pop melody. It's sung by Erika of "Kind Lady" fame♪
This world has many conflicts, but when you listen to this song, there's no mistake that it will surely cheer you up!
The title still wasn't decided during the production, but when I listened to it, I thought there was no more suitable song title, so I named it "Forever Sunshine". == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution- === You have unlocked the song "Forever Sunshine" by Chel Y. With music and lyrics that sound like they just stepped out of a musical and wound up in Dance Dance Revolution, "Forever Sunshine" is a soft, warm and fuzzy pop song. The warmth feeling in the song comes from the sun of course! == Staff Comments == === yossi === The original photo was taken from the balcony of my house when I looked up at the sky. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. == Song Connections / Remixes == * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of HAPPY☆ANGEL, mostly removing the intro. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * HAPPY☆ANGEL marks Tahirih Walker's debut in BEMANI. * On the American and European versions of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], HAPPY☆ANGEL's artist was credited to '''jun'''. * HAPPY☆ANGEL received a new BEGINNER chart in [[AC SIRIUS|beatmania IIDX 17 SIRIUS]]. * HAPPY☆ANGEL received a Double ANOTHER chart in [[AC tricoro|beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro]]. * HAPPY☆ANGEL is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from March 7th, 2018, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. ** As of March 13th, 2024 in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]], it is playable by default. * HAPPY☆ANGEL received CHALLENGE charts in [[AC DDR A20 PLUS|DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS]]. These charts are only playable in the ''☆☆☆☆'' NONSTOP course. ** These charts are playable by default from [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]] onwards. ** These CHALLENGE charts utilize sections from various other jun songs, including [[UNBELIEVABLE (Sparky remix)]], [[Back In Your Arms]], [[KIMONO PRINCESS|KIMONO♥PRINCESS]], [[SILVER DREAM|SILVER☆DREAM]], [[CRAZY LOVE|CRAZY♥LOVE]], and [[SUPER SAMURAI]]. == Song Production Information == === jun === From the very start of creating "HAPPY☆ANGEL", "let's give it a happy sound to keep up with the game's subtitle, HAPPY SKY!"
.... And so it was decided.
This time, thanks to the featured vocalist TAHIRIH's powerful, cute singing voice, and cute lyrics, jun thinks this resulted in a very happy song from its initial concept (laughs), but what do you think? [[TERRA|TЁЯRA]] is always pursuing the royal road of J-POP, so when I work as a creator, I definitely want to feature English, but I'd be happy if you can just experience the creator jun, who's also different from TЁЯRA's jun. == Video Production Information == === GOLI === This refreshing number is exactly suitable for the 12th theme.
Let's GO with a rounded design touch after a long time!
I remember drawing the flyer materials.
But, I quite love the MISS layers without drawings.
After all, happy hardcore is enjoyable, isn't it? It raises your tension when you're tired. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

There's a high possibility that your mother or father was quite the romantic, right? Such childhood memories stored in your mind are contained in this song, which is about a dandy person with a wonderful mustache.
Well, this song follows my usual lines, but I decided to make it a bit like it was flying somewhere else.
The lyrics are actually quite scary. Destructive.
The color orange somehow feels insane, right? === REFLEC BEAT === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== The lyrics of this song start with "Finally, I was able to bring myself to hate you". The chord progression and other sounds are classics of French chanson, but the rhythm was new at the time. == Video Production Information == === HES === This was initially going to be a generic video due to various circumstances, but I thought "at least give it an atmosphere", so I hurriedly cut and pasted previous Orange Lounge videos into a video. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ in 8th and 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

To unlock it, clear 1st Dan. ** It received brand-new Single HYPER/ANOTHER charts upon its revival. ** As of January 7th, 2009, it is available by default. * Make A Difference received a Double ANOTHER chart in [[CS EMPRESS|beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS + PREMIUM BEST]]. This chart was carried over to the arcade releases in [[AC Resort Anthem|beatmania IIDX 18 Resort Anthem]]. ** It also received a new BEGINNER chart in beatmania IIDX 16 EMPRESS + PREMIUM BEST. * Make A Difference is currently the only song sung by Noriko Fukushima in ''any'' BEMANI arcade series. ** It's only her original BEMANI song she did not write the lyrics for herself. * Make A Difference is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from December 4th, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. == Song Production Information == === wac === The sound director [[Takayuki Ishikawa|TAKA]] told me "OK, make a gospel song next".
I'm wac, a former choir member. I'm still a choir member. Is it because I'm a choir guy?
When I say choir, I mean a boys choir at a boys school, so it's a world where 100 young boys yell "hoiya, hoiya, shuuririenen".
I wondered if it's similar to Tamayura. Rather, I said for it to be in that direction.
I said "No, acapella is next". Something's different. No, acapella is impossible to include in this game. Firstly.
As it's often said, gospel means the Word of God.
I'm a man who sometimes believes in God and Buddha? I wonder if I'm qualified to speak about the Word of God.
However, TAKA told me "No, make a gospel song next".
"But God still won't descend". Therefore.
So, I made a five-note quintet singing "tralalalala", to which God will honorably descend in the end, so please do your best to not be taken away from this world.
Look, this is gospel! Or maybe it's pareidolia?
Actually, MARI's cheerful lyrics, the up-and-coming gospel group CoCoRo*Co, and Lala Moore's session that transcended time-space, we somehow reached a gospel-like joyphilia, maybe, probably, no way, I don't know. For those who know such differences, I dedicate Make a Difference.
This song isn't brought up as a topic in the first place, but when it's brought up, it's "tralalalala", so I created this for LIGHT7. Even now, I regret every night that I should've started creating this with NORMAL.
God won't descend, so to those who are confident in playing this song, please sometimes rejoice in the joy of life. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === This is the first song with the "GOSPEL" genre included in the IIDX series, which feels unique.
When I went on a sightseeing trip in America a long time ago, I had the opportunity to listen to a gospel music performance in a church in Harlem during an optional sightseeing tour of New York City.
Regardless of music likes and dislikes, I remember feeling sincerely moved by all the deeply religious people singing in a way which integrated their daily rituals in everyday life. At that time, I didn't imagine it'd connect with music in IIDX, and conversely, even when I listen to this song, it doesn't connect with my image of that time. However, I can see family and friends playing together, lovers talking to each other, and people walking their dogs at the local park... I was inspired seeing the locals having fun!
I remember those happy and cheerful feelings of when I was among warm, gentle, and bright people who cheerfully called out to me!
As expected of this song! == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ in 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

}} == Song Connections / Remixes == * A new wave remix of MOON by [[Akira Yamaoka|AKIRA YAMAOKA]], titled ''MOON -Sun Mix-'', appears in dj TAKA's first album, [[milestone]]. * A long version of MOON arranged by [[Atsuhiro Ishizuna|TSU-NA]] (MUSELINKS), titled ''MOON -EXTENDED-'', appears in the [[pop'n music request best!]] album. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of MOON, mostly removing the intro. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * "AISYU-EURO" (哀愁ユーロ) translates to "melancholic Euro". ** In the beatmania IIDX series, MOON's genre is kept in Japanese. * MOON marks the first time YUKI has received a new sprite/animations since [[HONE made tonight|HONEまでートトゥナイト]] in [[AC pnm 4|pop'n music 4]]. * MOON marks Erika Mochizuki's debut in the pop'n music series. * According to dj TAKA, he created MOON in dedication to [[Jun Wakita|wac]]. ** According to wac, he wanted MOON to have a unique video when it crossed over to beatmania IIDX, which eventually happened (see below). * MOON received a brand-new video in [[beatmania IIDX VISUAL EMOTIONS 5]]. This video was added to the arcade series in [[AC GOLD|beatmania IIDX 14 GOLD]], and was also carried over to [[CS DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD CS]]. * In the DanceDanceRevolution series, MOON's artist was changed to '''dj TAKA feat.Erika'''. * MOON's BEGINNER and Single BASIC charts have the exact same notecount, although the Single BASIC chart has Freeze Arrows. * MOON's Beat'n Groovy 5-Buttons chart is exactly the same as its original pop'n music 5-Button chart. * MOON appears as DLC for both the American and Japanese versions of [[CS pnm Wii|pop'n music (Wii)]], in the '''Euro''' and '''超上級エクストリームセット''' packs respectively. ** In the American version of pop'n music (Wii), MOON's artist was slightly changed to '''dj TAKA feat. Erika Mochizuchi'''. * MOON is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from January 4th, 2018, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * MOON was added to [[CS pnm Lively|pop'n music Lively]] on August 4th, 2021 as the August 2021 Monthly Bonus Song. ** From August 3rd, 2022, it can be unlocked via Ticket Quest after purchasing the song with two ''Lively Tickets'' (Livelyチケット) == Music Comment == A melancholic Eurobeat appears in pop'n! What did you see past your tears? == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== dj TAKA ==== This song was created for pop'n music13 Carnival.
I wondered what kind of comment I wrote for pop'n13, so when I looked at it in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20150507111349fw_/http://www.konami.jp/bemani/popn/music13/m_and_c/05/05_04.html official website], I somehow saw wac's comment in the very last line, "please include a movie for it when it's crossed over to IIDX.", and there isn't one!! What, I didn't know about this at all... you should've directly told me!
I could've included a completely recreated movie to conclude wac's melancholic story, along with his ParaPara dance (T-T) So, if you're interested in wac's melancholic story, please check out pop'n music13 Carnival's official website.
I can't read it without crying (T-T) === pop'n music === ==== dj TAKA ==== Due to my busy schedule, I always create songs at the very end of pop'n's final production stage.
Well, this time, what should I make? I was nervous about what kinds of unreasonable requests I'd receive for Carnival, but since there were enough songs with that theme, I was asked to make something completely unrelated. Yes wac, I understand. During the final production stage, there are too many songs following the theme, so you want songs which have nothing to do with that theme.
Alright~, I fully understand how wac feels. Since wac's back was so melancholic that it brought out a sad atmosphere like "even though it's in the final production stage, it isn't finished at all, and I don't have time to somehow think about your song", this time, I created melancholic Euro dedicated to wac. Firstly, I started by changing my computer's desktop background from my cute dog Rai, to wac's melancholic back.
I completed the intro from here.
Next, after drinking too much, I went near the toilet at ○○○○○○gaseki Station, where wac went "OTL", to try and get inspiration.
I completed the first verse from here.
Furthermore, I tried to synchronize this song with the image of shaking hands with the elementary school student who hit a big home run at the elementary school next to wac's rented room, and brilliantly [[Peppermint wa watashi no teki|broke the glass window]] of wac's room.
I completed the pre-chorus from there.
Finally, I intended to return to Shinjuku from Shimokitazawa, but I missed the train and soaked myself in Hakone-Yumoto's hot springs.
And then I completed the chorus from there. This is how "moon" was born. == Video Production Information == Untranslated. == Character Information == YUKI is now a teenage fashion leader!
She seems even more beautiful than before. === CHIHI === Her original NEUTRAL animation was very cute, so I started a brand-new idol life for her based on it.
The key point is that there's now a background with a YUKI set in the studio.
I thought about including idol-like choreography in her animations, but since [[Mary]] had them at the same time, it was difficult for me, as someone who can't do idol choreography, or a dancer's dance.
I wonder~ if I was able to bring out a similar atmosphere to the original YUKI, like her competitive spirit in the MISS animation. == Staff Comments == === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === I was curious about this song the most when I heard its preview.
If you haven't played it yet, please listen to its preview!! You'll definitely want to play it. === [[eimy]] === Are you going with melancholic? When I briefly thought about it, melancholic definitely suits this song.
As masaru said, this might be the number you're more curious about after listening to its preview. I also tried doing this first. === [[Takao Yamamoto|amamon.]] === This fully melancholic Euro song unconsciously makes you want to reach the peak! Nice to meet you, melancholy. === [[Shinichiro Yamanaka|Daniel]] === Melancholic.... melancholic.... it's hopeless~. I painfully get it now.
When you're in love, you wonder~ if it's someone you like.
I'd do it if I could, but it's difficult and there's many sad things~.
This time, it's a bit heavy~. Eurobeat loves those kinds of feelings... it resonates with me so much, that I seemed to wet my pillow.
It's truly a masterpiece. Those struggling with love should definitely listen to this song. === [[Kiyoshi Murai|Seiya Murai]] === The "melancholic" sound has a very strong impact, and I certainly didn't realize that it's title was "MOON"... I just noticed it. === wac === Is it melancholic? Melancholic's good. Huh, are you seriously going with the genre name melancholic? TAKA's Euro song caused a controversy.
Well, speaking of djTAKA, I'm sorry for including myself, but we went to the same class during our vocational school days. From back then, I thought he was the kind of guy to feel melancholy on his back, but rather, it was probably my back. That's amazing. Nice to meet you, melancholy.
Oh, about the song. So, when I listened to this melancholic Euro that was created for me, my melancholic life flashed before my eyes, and I wept in the wind. MOON.
Please include a movie for it when it's crossed over to IIDX. == Difficulty & Notecounts == Beat'n Groovy difficulty rated from 1 to 8.

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * No.13 is a remix of Johann Sebastian Bach's ''Invention No. 13 in A minor (BWV 784)''. ** An organ arrangement of Invention No. 13 in A minor (BWV 784), titled [[Invention dai 13 ban|インベンション 第13番]], can be found in [[AC NST|ノスタルジア]]. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of No.13, removing 20 measures from the first half of the song. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * No.13 is the only video in beatmania IIDX 10th style that was commissioned. ** Its video was also made very late into production of beatmania IIDX 10th style (the last week of December 2003), less than two months before the game came out. * No.13 was included as preview song in [[CS 9th style|beatmania IIDX 9th style CS]]. (JAEGER FINAL ATTACK)|炸裂！イェーガー電光チョップ！！]] on any difficulty. * No.13 is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from March 8th, 2017, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * No.13 also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. * No.13 received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on November 27th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.5''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.5). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, No.13's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From November 30th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they will be available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === TAKA respect for J.S.B. === This is No.13, from the renowned composer J.S. Bach's Invention. Even among the classical music, to those who know this song, you're quite the Bach expert, right? I'm certain that the songs in Invention were originally created as piano études, and there are basically many compositions for the left and right hands, but Bach is also known for countermelodies. The changes from right hand to left hand, and left hand to right hand, are both musical and mathematical, and I think the tension and release of the two parts interacting with each other have maximum talent.
As expected, there's nothing more to say about this. You can't hear the delicate interactions in my arrangement, so to those who love it, why don't you try searching for a live piano performance vinyl of this piece? I think you'd be quite impressed. Even if IIDX existed 300 years ago, I wonder if Bach would create études in IIDX with this feeling, a classic and romantic story. == Video Production Information == === TOM === The production schedule for this video was very tight, and I had less than a week to complete it, from the end of the year to the New Year. This is my first time participating in IIDX, so how was it? I created this while being careful about synchronizing the sound and video. Salsa Picante'' sample CD. ** It shares this sample with [[El pais del sol(GIVE ME MORE SALSA MIX)]], LATIN REMIX from [[AC pnm 15|pop'n music 15 ADVENTURE]]. * A long version of Quickening appears in dj TAKA's first album, [[milestone]]. * A small loop of music sounding a lot like Quickening plays in the music select screen in [[AC 5th style|beatmania IIDX 5th style]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to dj TAKA's song comments on [https://web.archive.org/web/20161117062719/http://www.konami.jp/am/bm/final/music/quickening.html beatmania THE FINAL's official website (archived)], he was requested to write Quickening by [[Naoki Maeda|NAOKI]], who was the sound producer of Dance Maniax 2ndMIX. ** dj TAKA was stubbornly against Quickening being crossed over into beatmania IIDX since [[AC 6th style|6th style]], but included it in beatmania THE FINAL, since it was the final game in the series. * Quickening's Single HARD chart was created by DJ CIVA. * According to dj TAKA's song comments on [https://web.archive.org/web/20150507131309fw_/http://www.konami.jp/am/bm2dx/bm2dx9/songs_quickening.html beatmania IIDX 9th style's official website], VJ YUZ created the Quickening video in his own time, and asked for it to be included in beatmania IIDX 9th style. * Quickening is the last Dance Maniax song to date to cross over to the beatmania IIDX series. * Despite that in the beatmania III THE FINAL, the BPM of Quickening's Double ANOTHER chart is shown as 149-150 on the song selection screen, it actually is a constant 149 BPM. * In DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX, Quickening's artist is credited as '''dj. This chart was used as Quickening's Single CHALLENGE chart in [[CS DDR EXTREME2|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2]] and [[CS DS Max|Dancing Stage Max]]. ** The DDR FESTIVAL Single EXPERT chart for Quickening is used in the arcade releases of DanceDanceRevolution. * Quickening received a unique video in DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2, different from its beatmania IIDX video. This video was carried to the arcade releases in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA, and eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. * Quickening received a new Single BEGINNER chart in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA. ** This chart was previously found unused in the DDR FESTIVAL -DanceDanceRevolution- data. * Quickening was one of 30 possible picks for songs for [[AC RB groovin'!! Upper|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper]]'s 7th Set (Users' SELECTION) of the BEMANI MUSIC FOCUS unlocking system. * Quickening is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from October 4th, 2017, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * In [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], Quickening received its difficulty change from DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 3rd, 2024. == Song Production Information == === beatmania === ==== dj TAKA ==== Quickening was a song I made during Dance Maniax 2ndMIX, at the direct request of sound producer NAOKI.
Being a rare opportunity, my idea was to employ a lot of techniques that would be awkward in typical beatmania, due to how the game works.
Even while getting numerous requests from players and the production team to bring the song over to IIDX, I was able to stubbornly fend them off, but...
I got a request this time begging me to put the song in beatmania since it's the last one, so I decided to challenge myself to put it in the game.
With all that background, there were a lot of particular struggles, but thanks to help from CIVA, who did sequence support for the chart, it ended up being satisfactory.
Thank you, CIVA. === beatmania IIDX === ==== dj TAKA ==== I created this groovy, one-shot, happy tune by changing the scene with undulations without adding modulations.
It feels as if it's somehow gradually changing.
I created this song in a style which was very difficult to implement in "button pressing games" such as beatmania and pop'n, and I've been asked to crossover this song to the IIDX series since 6th, which I continuously refused....
During that time, I probably had strong personal beliefs and obsessions about it. The reason why I finally included it in this game is actually because VJ YUZ liked this song very much when it was initially released, and personally created a movie for it, completely unrelated with work.
He told me that it was possible to refine that movie to include in 9th, if only this time, and I unintentionally gave him the OK!!
This movie is cool. === Dance Maniax === dj TAKA has created many famous numbers throughout the history of the BEMANI series. "Quickening", his first appearance in DMX, is a trance song with undulating sounds which clash with each other. The combination of sampled voices, electronic sounds, and mechanical drum rhythms, invites the listener into an unreal space. The impressive last part fades out at once, as if the tuning had malfunctioned. == Video Production Information == === VJ YUZ === I heard this song a long time ago and it moved my heart, so I secretly made a movie of it which is able to see the light of day now. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania difficulty rated from 1 to 9.

It's cool! === pop'n music (English) comment === A fast tempo techno beat. It's cool! == Song Production Information == === pop'n music 1&2 Official Website === This song's selling point is that I fully programmed it with the currently out-of-print "MSX turboR (A1-GT)"'s MIDI functions. It's a good thing that it didn't take much production time.
As for the song, it's embedded with phrases that have a great potential to capture the hearts of the Japanese people, and a grandiose arrangement & light rhythms that feature an obvious progression. That was my aim. I'll be happy if many people play this song. === pop'n music original soundtrack === Even though it's techno, it's a genre with many different types, so I had to think about what type of song to make. Afterwards, I was relieved when the genre was decided to be "J-tekno". By the way, "J=Japan" in J-tekno. From my own interpretation, old Japanese hit songs have a certain regularity to how chords are used, and I was also inadvertently moved by those sections (I understood this when I started composing), so this time, I decided to use chords unique to Japan as its "core". And since the word tekno was part of it, I created this song by arranging and programming all the parts so that normal people can feel that its related to techno. And then I completed it after many adjustments. Is it easy to understand and listen to as I expected? This song is unique for having a grandiose arrangement. If you listen to it, perhaps you'll recognize the artist I liked back then. That artist even has a big influence on me today. But that's a secret. === pop'n stage === ==== [[Kaoko Nayakama|Uoza no Kaorin senior]] ==== This is a famous song from the first pop'n. When I was creating stage, I certainly thought about including this song. Composer S always passionately said, "there's a chord progression that resounds with Japanese people's hearts!".
This time, please enjoy it with your feet. == Character Information == === pop'n music === Despite his cool appearance, his personality is quite wild.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A vocal long version of rainbow flyer featuring [[Sanae Shintani|Sana]], titled ''rainbow flyer (extended vocal mix)'', appears in the [[beatmania IIDX 8th style Original Soundtrack]] and [[Sana-molle Collection]] albums. ** A rearranged version of rainbow flyer (extended vocal mix), titled ''rainbow flyer ~Sana-mode II mix~'', appears in Sana's third album, [[Sana-mode II ~pop'n music & beatmania moments~]]. ** A dance remix of rainbow flyer (extended vocal mix) by [[Yoshitaka Nishimura|DJ YOSHITAKA]], titled ''rainbow flyer (DJ YOSHITAKA remix)'', appears in the [[V-RARE SOUND TRACK 8]] CD. ** Another remix of rainbow flyer (extended vocal mix) by [[Sota Fujimori]], titled ''rainbow flyer -In The Dream Mix-'', appears in dj TAKA's first album, [[milestone]]. ** rainbow flyer (extended vocal mix) is included in the medley [[History of dj TAKA - single style collection -]], which appears in the [[cyber beatnation 4 -beatnation 20th anniversary-]] album. * A drum'n'bass remix of rainbow flyer by [[Takahiro Fukase|PHQUASE]], titled [[rainbow flyer -gratitude remix-]], appears in [[AC SDVX|SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH]]. * A dubstep remix of rainbow flyer by [[Masaharu Kubota|USAO]], titled ''Rainbow Flyer -DUBSTEP RMX!!-'', appears in dj TAKA's second album, [[True Blue...]]. * rainbow flyer is related to [[rainbow guitar weeps]], from [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]]. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of rainbow flyer. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * rainbow flyer is spelled as '''Rainbow Flyer''' in DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3 and [[CS DS Unleashed3|Dancing Stage Unleashed3]]. This was corrected in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA, where it received a new banner with the correct capitalization. * rainbow flyer's Double BEGINNER chart can be found unused in the arcade DanceDanceRevolution data. * rainbow flyer is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from June 5th, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * rainbow flyer also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. * rainbow flyer received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on October 29th, 2026, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.8''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.8). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, rainbow flyer's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. == Song Production Information == === dj TAKA === This tune came to be independently.
Of course, the people who hear it gives some output on it, but how I felt, with the freedom to respond on what I thought of the music, was something that no one but yourself can eventually make the tune sound like. But at the moment, after hearing some of the responses, what's funny is that the sad song's pitch (minor) with the pitch that leaves a bright impression (major) gets overcome, and it pierces you with emotion that makes you feel better, brighter, and more powerful. Perhaps that theory is biased that with the majority of the impressions this song has left, but I still feel that my heart was moved after hearing this song, like a tranquil breeze.
Those who hear this song, I believe it is one of the more lighter-spirited songs I've made, seeing as I have performed it live in several events, and it is something that's sunk deep inside of me now, and it's image is constantly the roots of what I think about lately. I can picture that even when you get the impression that you are lonely, you can still look up and have some hope. This song was a bit of a concept, as after [[AC 4th style|4th style]], it was a turning point, because my Trance music had a supposedly recognizable style that people noticed, and lots of my songs have have a brighter image pitch (major), other than [[Colors (radio edit)|Colors]].
However, there are strictly darker tunes that I have made, too, and the control of thesong's melody and atmosphere took a lot of work to compose properly.
Looking deep into things is not always a good way to look at the world, but the feeling of kind entity that flies across the sky leaves a very positive impression.
So in these sense, "trance" is like the river of my life which traces back to a long time in history, and even if it's a little thing, just like a genre of music, not doing well isn't always an excuse, no matter how little of a subject it is. But, these releases, style by style, always have a trace of the name "dj TAKA", which means a lot to me.
At a glance, when I get that people like to play and listen to my songs, it is very flattering, but sometimes, you get the impression that in a way, some people tend not to say the truth, and are reluctant because the work that I do is raw trance, and perhaps I don't have much talent for other genres or styles.... But, my story is still going, and it's still going quite strong. Normally, I don't to think deeply about these things, because it's not always easy to find the answer, and because sometimes it can really mess with you train of thought!
But, while I made an attempt to make this song, we didn't actually think of the song name at first. But while we made the movie, we compiled some data together, and we decided the song name a few days later.
The image depicted from the song was an array of beautiful, vivd colors, like a flier from the future who faces the rainbow, and flies through the sky. So, this song kind of have two meanings in a way. == Video Production Information == === KAKKI === Nice to meet you. I'm KAKKI. I created this video with the image in mind of the dawn, which will soon greet those who spent the night at raves (outdoor parties), as the light slowly appears from darkness, the world will soon be filled with light and color, and a sense of excitement and energy will appear again to those who danced through the night. I just joined the company this year, so this is my first IIDX movie, which I somehow finished with the staffs' full guidance.
There were several technical limitations, but I hope you can feel a bit of the greatest feeling in the morning with music outside (I think those who have been to raves and festivals would understand, you should go to an outdoor event at least once). == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]] === "rainbow flyer" is a trance song that progresses smoothly from beautiful and mellow to huge and ecstatic. I prefer rainbows than three course meals. However, it was around this time that I went beyond feeling fascinated by the rainbow, to reaching a level of excitement, where there was a happy feeling in my heart.
"I want to convey this excitement to someone"
I thought of a melody in the bathtub, and when something came to me, I dashed to the keyboard.
I recorded the melody, and with my own momentum, arranged it, left it overnight, and evaluated it the next morning.
It went well, so I revised and completed it~.
That's how I created this song. By the way, the song title can either be read as "rainbow rainbow" or "double rainbow".
I wonder if "double rainbow" is more "double rainbow"-ish.
But "rainbow rainbow" sounds nicer. Hmm.... == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === It's rare to see this, so I'm happy just seeing it!
No matter how hard I try or ask others, I can't see it, so I'm happy just seeing it!

== Song Connections / Remixes == * RED ZONE is part of Tatsh's "EURO RAVE" song series, being the "male" counterpart to [[24th Century BOY]]. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of RED ZONE. * A long version of RED ZONE, titled ''REDZONE '', appears in Tatsh's [[MATERIAL]] album. * A remix of RED ZONE by [[Yuuhei Satellite|幽閉カタルシス]], titled [[RED ZONE NeoClassical Party Remix]], appears in [[AC SDVX|SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH]]. * A spiritual sequel of RED ZONE, titled ''REDRAVE'', appears on UNLIMITED STUDiO's ''SEVEN's CODE''. ** Another spiritual sequel, titled ''BLUE ZONE'', appears on SEGA's ''CHUNITHM NEW''. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * RED ZONE received a unique video and brand-new BEGINNER and Double ANOTHER charts in [[AC HAPPY SKY|beatmania IIDX 12 HAPPY SKY]]. These charts and the video were carried to [[CS IIDX RED|beatmania IIDX 11 IIDX RED CS]]. ** This video was removed in [[AC SPADA|beatmania IIDX 21 SPADA]], and replaced with the [[AC 6th style|6th style]] EURO generic video. * RED ZONE had a different banner in the DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA location test, with a different design for the title. * RED ZONE, along with [[Under the Sky]] and [[Xepher]] being crossed over, marks Tatsuya Shimizu's first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * RED ZONE appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR PS3|DanceDanceRevolution (PS3)]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA Greatest Hits 1''' pack. * RED ZONE is the final unlock of jubeat saucer's ''bistro saucer'' 7th Set. It could be unlocked from May 1st to 31st, 2013 after all other 7th Set songs are unlocked. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** In [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is one of the Garnet unlocks of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * RED ZONE is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from January 4th, 2018, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. ** The BEGINNER chart was added with the launch of [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]]. It can be unlocked with BITs. ** From April 20th, 2022, it is available by default. * RED ZONE received LEGGENDARIA charts in [[AC CANNON BALLERS|beatmania IIDX 25 CANNON BALLERS]] as part of the ''Gekisou! Cannon racer'' (激走！キャノンレーサー) event. These charts can be unlocked from January 25th, 2018 by beating Kneeso-hime in the first continent, or by clearing the first continent. ** As of [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]], these charts are available by default. ** These charts are available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) since July 26th, 2023. * RED ZONE received a new BEGINNER chart in beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage. ** With 89 notes, this BEGINNER chart currently has the lowest notecount of any BEGINNER chart in beatmania IIDX arcade games. * RED ZONE's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * RED ZONE's timing was adjusted upon [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]]'s release. * RED ZONE received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on December 25th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.6''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.6). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, RED ZONE's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From December 28th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === NAOKI MAEDA === The "heartbeat" and "shock" in my nearly forgotten SPEED RAVE genre, has been revived by the next generation of composers...
Tatsh brilliantly awakened my original SPEED RAVE genre, which was sealed for a while, and it seemed that my memories of it became linked to this song.
This is authentic high tension song lets you experience the meaning of the title "RED ZONE", so please play it at a high volume on your car stereo, step on the accelerator as hard as you can, and race through the highway!
But please don't break the speed limit. (laughs) === Tatsh === That's right, please don't break the speed limit, OK? This was later corrected. * THE SHINING POLARIS can be unlocked from April 12th, 2016 on [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]]' ''Akashic Explore'' event. ** From November 2016, it could be purchased with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. ** From April 20th, 2022, it is available by default in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]]. * THE SHINING POLARIS received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on October 29th, 2026, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.8''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.8). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, THE SHINING POLARIS' CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. == Song Production Information == === L.E.D. === The appeal of EPIC TRANCE is its melodious and catchy melodies, or the uplifting feeling created through its sweet melodic vocals and upper-style tracks. In "THE SHINING POLARIS", Sana's dreamy vocals, well-known as the "Diva of KONAMI music games!" who has performed in many [[BEMANI]] songs, are matched with the track completing a "crying TRANCE". == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX -DanceDanceRevolution- / DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution- === "THE SHINING POLARIS" by L.E.D. feat Sana is an excellent trance song. If you love trance music, "THE SHINING POLARIS" is packed with beautiful vocals, uplifting melodies and an awesome atmospheric build-up/breakdown. == Video Production Information == === Yasi === I feel as if I've heard it somewhere before in L.E.D.'s world, but the phrases of this "crying trance" (according to L.E.D.) powerfully strike a chord in your heart, don't they?
I think this "really" is the song's key point, while I also "really" dreamed of being a clubber who went to IBIZA Island, and I tried to create my own image of a "real" Pa○○ ○○n ○○ke song.
The "POLARIS" in the title refers to the North Star.
Yes, it was an important navigator for travelers adventuring in the open seas during the Age of Discovery.
Then, when combined with the title of another L.E.D. new song, "[[THE BIG VOYAGER -INFINITE PRAYER REINTERPRETATION-|THE BIG VOYAGER]]", which means "The Adventurer", it seems that L.E.D. was trying to convey BEMANI players the idea of "something" with this new song, right? == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 7 in 4th style, 1 to 7+ in 5th and 6th style, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards. beatmania (2006) difficulty rated from 1 to 10.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * Tomorrow Perfume is an arrangement of the various music tracks from [[AC 6th style|beatmania IIDX 6th style]]'s menu screens. ** The full version of Tomorrow Perfume, titled ''Tomorrow Perfume 〜The Theme of 6th style〜'', originally appeared in the [[beatmania IIDX 6th style Original Soundtrack]] album. * A vocal version of Tomorrow Perfume featuring [[Aimee Blackschleger|AiMEE]], titled ''Tomorrow Perfume -vocal version-'', appears in dj TAKA's first album, [[milestone]]. This version is longer than the original full version, it has deeper beats, and some keysounds from the second part have been removed to provide clearer vocals. * A remix of Tomorrow Perfume by [[Akira Michishita|C-Show]], titled [[Tomorrow Perfume (C-Show Remix)]], appears in [[AC SDVX|SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH]]. ** Another remix by [[Tomoyuki Hamada|t+pazolite]], titled [[Tomorrow Perfume (tpz Despair Remix)]], also appears in SOUND VOLTEX BOOTH. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a short version of Tomorrow Perfume. * Tomorrow Perfume is included in the medley [[History of dj TAKA - single style collection -]], which appears in the [[cyber beatnation 4 -beatnation 20th anniversary-]] album. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Tomorrow Perfume is the first menu screen music in beatmania IIDX to be a separate song. * Tomorrow Perfume's unique title card was removed from the beatmania IIDX arcade titles in [[AC 9th style|beatmania IIDX 9th style]]. It was also absent from [[CS 7th style|beatmania IIDX 7th style CS]]. * Tomorrow Perfume has an alternate chart in [[CS DS Fusion PS2|Dancing Stage Fusion CS (PS2)]]'s MISSION mode Challenge #89. * Tomorrow Perfume is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from December 4th, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. * Tomorrow Perfume also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. * Tomorrow Perfume received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on September 18th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.4''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.4). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, Tomorrow Perfume's CHALLENGE charts could be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From September 30th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === dj TAKA === This is a medley of some 6th style songs that I produced.
I received requests from everyone to make certain 6th songs as playables songs, so instead of that I combined them into a one song using the phrases from the mode select, song select, opening, and ending songs.
These songs originally existed as BGM, where they appeared while looking at game screens, so the refreshing and heavenly image from [[Yoshiaki Heshiki|HES]]'s interface designs led to this kind of song.
The BGM I made up to [[AC 5th style|5th style]] was composed without any connection, but for 6th style the concept was to attempt to create a flow from the opening to the ending music, and make a unified image with the design. == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution- === You have unlocked the song "Tomorrow Perfume" by dj TAKA. Combining sounds straight from the underground with a driving beat and awesome buildup, "Tomorrow Perfume" is an excellent atmospheric trance track that sure smells great today! Check out [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX Dance Dance Revolution]] and [[CS DDR KONAMIX|Dance Dance Revolution KONAMIX]] for more songs from this artist. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === This song is a musical medley of 6th style's BGM, using its theme of "THE PRIMARY VIVID IIDX" as a motif, so this is an experimental movie to make you the spotlight covered dance floor, while swinging and dancing with a stick-shaped, luminous object... that was what I wanted.
Should I call it a "hypnotic support (?)" movie, which accelerates the human body movement freely in another direction from that of an "immersive (?)" video?... it's too difficult
But that is the type of movie that I'd want to pursue. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ from 7th through 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * A slower dance remix of TRUE♥LOVE by Clubstar, titled [[TRUE LOVE (Clubstar's True Club Mix)|TRUE♥LOVE (Clubstar's True Club Mix)]], appears in the [[V-RARE SOUND TRACK-8 USA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA Limited Edition Music Sampler]] CD. ** A short version of TRUE♥LOVE (Clubstar's True Club Mix) appears in the Japanese version of [[CS DDR HOTTEST PARTY|DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * On the American and European versions of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], TRUE♥LOVE's artist was credited to '''jun'''. ** Curiously, TRUE♥LOVE's DanceDanceRevolution jacket is based on its American/European banner, rather than its original banner. * TRUE♥LOVE was added to jubeat on December 15th, 2008. It can be played from jubeat to [[AC jb copious APPEND|copious APPEND]] with an [[e-amusement|e-AMUSEMENT]] PASS. ** In [[AC jb saucer|jubeat saucer]], it can be unlocked via the ''bistro saucer'' unlocking event. ** In [[AC jb saucer fulfill|jubeat saucer fulfill]], it can be unlocked as part of ''saucer macchiato'''s Side Menu from April 23rd, 2014. ** In [[AC jb prop|jubeat prop]], it can be unlocked by playing it as a BONUS TUNE from May 28th, 2015. ** As of [[AC jb Qubell|jubeat Qubell]], it is available by default by playing with an e-amusement pass. * TRUE♥LOVE is the first BEMANI crossover in jubeat to originate from the DanceDanceRevolution series. * TRUE♥LOVE appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR PS3|DanceDanceRevolution (PS3)]], in the '''DDR SuperNOVA Greatest Hits 1''' pack. * TRUE♥LOVE was one of the songs part of jubeat saucer's Song Swap system. For further information on which dates it was removed or revived, please see [[AC jb saucer/Song Swap System|this page]]. * TRUE♥LOVE's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]] ratings on March 7th, 2022. * In [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], TRUE♥LOVE received its difficulty change from [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] on July 3rd, 2024. * TRUE♥LOVE received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode on May 15th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.1''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.1). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, TRUE♥LOVE's CHALLENGE charts can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. ** From May 29th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === jun === This is the first time since "[[Sweet Sweet Love Magic|Sweet Sweet ♥ Magic]]" on [[AC DDRMAX2|MAX2]] that I've made a happy hardcore DDR song.
... So that means it's been 4 years!? ... How quickly the time flies by.
Come to think of it, that song was my BEMANI series debut, and if I remember correctly, I was limited to making a happy hardcore song because I was requested "happy hardcore please". (laughs)
(I think it's just because I listen to dance tunes with fast tempo on a daily basis....)
That was the beginning, I never thought I'd be making more happy hardcore songs after that.
The memories of what happened in those days have not faded away and are very memorable. Now, this is "TRUE♥LOVE".
This time Schanita sang it for the first time!
Thanks to her, I think I was able to create a new tone that's different to my IIDX crossover "[[HAPPY ANGEL|HAPPY☆ANGEL]]", what do you think?
I'd be very happy if you can enjoy dancing to the cute lyrics, lovely voice, and flowing beat. == Chart Production Information == === Tsucchi === Ooooooooh

}} == Song Connections / Remixes == * The ANOTHER version of Under the Sky has a different instrumental bridge than the NORMAL/HYPER version of the song. * A long version of Under the Sky, titled ''Under the Sky ~SAYAKA's solo new version~'', appears in BeForU's second album, [[BeForU II]]. * A happy hardcore remix of Under the Sky by [[Ryutaro Nakahara|Ryu☆]], titled ''Under the Sky (Ryu☆ Remix)'', appears in the [[cyber beatnation 1st conclusion]] album. ** An updated version of Under the Sky (Ryu☆ Remix), titled ''Under the Sky (Ryu☆ Remix)(st2020 Mix)'', can be found in Ryu☆'s eighth album, [[starmine 2020 : Mare Nectaris]]. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a shorter version of Under the Sky, mostly removing the intro and first chorus. ** However, the original beatmania IIDX version of Under the Sky is used instead of the DanceDanceRevolution cut on the American iTunes release of the ''DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA Original Soundtrack''. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Under the Sky was performed at the ''[https://web.archive.org/web/20150507121414fw_/http://www.konami.jp/am/bm2dx/bm2dx11/sl2/sl2_01.html secret LIVE 2 ~Trip Wonder Organize~]'' event on January 22nd, 2005 [https://web.archive.org/web/20221005071742/https://game.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/20050124/2dx.htm]. ** According to F-FLY's video comments, footage from this live performance is used in its beatmania IIDX video. * Under the Sky is one of the beatmania IIDX 12 HAPPY SKY preview songs in [[CS 10th style|beatmania IIDX 10th style CS]]. To unlock it, you must complete any combination of either ARCADE MODE, DAN MODE, or EXPERT MODE three times. * Under the Sky, along with [[RED ZONE]] and [[Xepher]] being crossed over mark Tatsuya Shimizu's first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** It also marks platoniX's only appearance in that series and their only appearance outside of the beatmania IIDX series. *** It is also their final appearance in BEMANI. * On the American and European versions of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], Under the Sky's artist is romanized as '''SayakaMinami(BeForU) with platoniX'''. ** In the American iTunes page of the ''DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA Original Soundtrack'', its artist was changed to '''SayakaMinami (BeForU)'''. However, it was changed again to '''Unknown''' at an unknown date. * Under The Sky's Single BEGINNER and Single BASIC charts have the same notecount, although the Single BASIC chart has two Freeze Arrows. * Under the Sky was revived during the location test of [[AC Resort Anthem|beatmania IIDX 18 Resort Anthem]], but was removed from the final version of the game. ** In the final release, it instead appears as a hidden revival in the '''JAPAN TOUR''' unlock system. * Under the Sky was still present in the location test of [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]], with its new foot ratings. * Under the Sky is one of the unlockable revivals in [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]]. It can be unlocked by reaching ENJOY LEVEL 70. ** As of February 23rd, 2011, Under the Sky has been unlocked for normal play. * Under the Sky can be unlocked from June 6th, 2016 on [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]]' ''Akashic Explore'' event. == Song Production Information == === Tatsh === I'm not a DJ, a remixer, or an arranger.
As a composer, I included the feelings I want to convey in this song.
"A song where I can just convey a bit of my feelings"
I'd be happy if you like it. === Sayaka Minami(BeForU) === I'm Sayaka Minami, who sings "Under the Sky" with platoniX!!
If I had one word to describe this song.... it's refreshing!! Refreshing!! Refreshing!! That's right.
It's really refreshing when I listen to it, and it refreshes my heart!! This song makes me feel that. Tatsh's song perfectly suits the image of HAPPYSKY, and I immediately became addicted to JunkoHirata's "Under the Sky" lyrics.
The "platoniX" duo made a great pair once again!! That's what I think. Sayaka Minami was able to appear together with platoniX in IIDX, and was very happy.
When something bad happens, or you're feeling worried and uneasy, this song will refresh your feelings!!
Please enjoy HAPPY SKY while experiencing this refreshing feeling (o^-^o)♪ == Video Production Information == === F-FLY === I made this MOVIE from the request "please make it using the secret LIVE footage".
I'm always excited by live filming, since you can't refilm it later or make any mistakes.
This time, a problem was that there wasn't a Tatsh cut, and he said "I didn't appear in it~" m(>_ I quickly tried to connect videos of other songs. Does this sound familiar to you? Even though it's titled "Under the Sky", the live footage somehow was pitch black, so I tried to create an image of a "live performance in the heavens!" by adding cut-in sky footage. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]] === "Under the Sky" is a J-EUROTRANCE song that bubbles with fresh sounds and beautiful vocals.
