* The note patterns on measure 38 of Xepher's Single and Double HYPER and ANOTHER charts form an X. * The game version of Xepher is a consistent 170 BPM, unlike its OST version. * Xepher received a BEGINNER chart in [[AC DistorteD|beatmania IIDX 13 DistorteD]]. * Xepher is one of the Phase 1 hidden songs of Toy'sMarch2. * Xepher, along with [[RED ZONE]] and [[Under the Sky]] being crossed over mark Tatsuya Shimizu's first appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Xepher had a different banner in the DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA location test, which used different fonts for its text. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], Xepher's music video eliminates any on-screen dancers in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * Xepher's CHALLENGE charts were the first CHALLENGE charts for a non-boss song in DanceDanceRevolution to be rated Level 10 on the old scale. * Xepher was added to [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] on September 7th, 2016 as part of the September 2016 Basic Subscription Monthly Songs. ** From August 2017, it can be purchased with BITs. * Xepher's timing was slightly fixed on the September 13th, 2016 update of [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]]. * Xepher also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. == Song Production Information == === Tatsh === A song conceived within my world, further expanded by the designer MAYA's MOVIE.
Next, I'd like you to further expand this world called "Xepher" by playing it.
That's why I gave the first letter of this song title "X", which means "the unknown". I asked platoniX's JunkoHirata and Yumi Natori from the gospel world to participate in this choir. Tatsh drew upon them and wrote the lyrics.

The Edo flower path, dyed with cherry blossoms.... this is a Japanese-styled pop dance tune! == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== jun ==== "Hana ranman -Flowers-" was released for DDR SuperNOVA.
And now you can finally play it on IIDX!! This is a memorable song, as it's TЁЯRA's first written song for the DDR series.
I remember that when we were asked to write the song, we pursued the idea of "drawing new ground" with TЁЯRA's unique style, without allowing any compromises. The lyrics depict spring in the Edo (period).
While making this song, the image of a lively and gorgeous spring scenery in Edo wouldn't leave my head, so I wrote the lyrics with that in mind.
....And even now, this image is still fresh in jun's mind. For jun, this song is very emotional.
That's why I'm truly privileged to share it with everyone in a different way this time.
Those who have played DDR, as well as those who haven't.
By all means, please play this song while humming it! ~ Shalala, shalala, people come and go
Shalala, shalala, this is the flower path ~ ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== "Hana ranman -Flowers-" will remain as one of TЁЯRA's representative songs. In order to breathe life into this song, it needs power beyond words.
This becomes the song's essence.
However, its the audience who loves the song that awakens and moves it. Singing, lyrics, songs, arrangements, artists, the audience.....
It's said that a song which connects them to a higher dimension is a masterpiece. If that's the case with "Hana ranman -Flowers-", I'd be extremely happy. === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== jun ==== I never thought TЁЯRA would release a new song in the DDR series.
TЁЯRA wasn't around at the time of [[AC DDRMAX2|MAX2]], and since then it's been 4 years...... Anyways, I only have memories of continuously running in those 4 years.
I never thought the surrounding environment would change so much. That's why... It's nice to meet you, DDR fans.
Have you enjoyed playing "Hana ranman -Flowers-"?
Since DDRSN launched in the United States before Japan, we intentionally made this song with "Japanesque" in mind.
The lyrics depict spring in the Edo (period).
While making this song, the image of a lively and gorgeous spring scenery in Edo wouldn't leave my head, so I wrote the lyrics with that in mind.
This time, we crossed over "[[Mugen no hikari]]" from [[AC pnm 12|pop'nmusic12]], as jun really likes "Japanesque". (laughs) Actually, "Hana ranman -Flowers-" is slightly different from the usual line that TЁЯRA has been doing up until now.
"I want to make a song which seemingly fit into DDR."
So I inserted this concept in this song, which contains an unprecedented melody.
Those who are familiar with TЁЯRA will be surprised, won't they?
Still, if you can feel TЁЯRA's style somewhere in the song, I'd be very happy. Please cheerfully enjoy playing this song, as if you were walking along through the lively and gorgeous streets in Edo. ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== Having jun participate as a composer in DDRMAX2 was the beginning of the formation of TЁЯRA.
TЁЯRA has provided numerous songs to the pop'n music, beatmania IIDX, and GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series, but DDR hasn't received a new song from them until now, so "Hana ranman -Flowers-" is TЁЯRA's first DDR original song.
DDR superNOVA has global standards, so we decided to express our Japanese identity through this song... the concept isn't an interpretation of Japanese traditional folk music like "Mugen no hikari" was, but a HYPER J-POP sound with strong and catchy elements, with casual feelings of "Japanesque".
If you listen carefully, it's also made with a Western music style. This deep musical element is the main point of this song.
While meeting global standards, the fact that this song contains a kanji title shows my obsession with emphasizing Japanese culture. === pop'n music === ==== jun ==== This is "Hana ranman -Flowers-", our debut song in DDR as TЁЯRA.
I remember revising this song many times so DDR fans can enjoy playing it.
The lyrics depict spring in the Edo (period).
While making this song, the image of a lively and gorgeous spring scenery in Edo wouldn't leave my head, so I wrote the lyrics with that in mind.
And even now, this image is still fresh in jun's mind. Before I knew it, you can play "Hana ranman -Flowers-" on three different game series, right?
It started with Dance Dance Revolution, then beatmaniaIIDX, and now it's finally available for pop'n music fans.
I think "Hana ranman -Flowers-" is the first TЁЯRA song on three different machines with the same arrangement.
jun thinks of her own songs like her own children, but I think this song is her happy child. ....And the flower path in the Great Edo spring is also bustling with people today. Every time you tap a button, a bud seems to bloom.
I'd be happy if everyone could have an enjoyable and gorgeous stroll along such a dream-filled "flower path". ─── Shalala, shalala, people come and go
Shalala, shalala, this is the flower path ─── ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== I think "Hana ranman -Flowers-" represents TЁЯRA's changing sound.
When this song was completed, it felt like I saw a new path emerge. == Video Production Information == None. == Character Information == A girl enrolled in an electronics academy. She's aiming to win a robot contest with her "dancing cool super robot" that she built with her classmates. === hasi === Hello.
My name is hasi from the DDR team.
This time, I was able to assist with EMI's animations. She's a 3D character, but I would appreciate if you like her. == Staff Comments == === TAMA === From the crossover requests, this was the number one in the DDR category.
Speaking of DDR, I remember feeling disappointed with my limited timing and motor skills when I used all my strength on [[Little Bitch|Little bitch]]. === [[eimy]] === This song...... I love it! A song which can be remembered after hearing it once is really amazing, isn't it? It makes me want to dance~.
Also, I feel close to the its character, EMI, in several ways. === [[Kiyoshi Murai|Seiya Murai]] === A song that came to pop'n from DDR Super Nova and IIDX15, but based on the genre name, you could say it finally returned to its original place!(^^) === [[Chihiro Inoue|chihiro]] === I didn't know the song title, so when I asked [[Tomoko Shiono|shio]], "what kind of song is Hana ranman?", she sang it.
The part where shalala is sung shows the brilliance of people coming and going, and there are various reasons why I like this part. === Daniel === The atmosphere has changed from HYPER JAPANESQUE 1, hasn't it?
The shalala phrase is very catchy. === [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] === In coordination with the DDR team, we had EMI appear as a 3D character, just like [[AFRO]].
How's the hidden costume! I was a bit obsessed about it. === shio === If you borrow the representative song from SUPER NOVA, we had to bring the character along too! That was what I unreasonably requested. It was a very busy place during the development's climax... Thank you very much! EMI's costume is casual and I was worried about whether it would suit the song, but I learned that the hidden costume is a dress which also displays the lyrics, softly! Lucky!
By the way, when I imagined KIKYO as the character because of the JAPANESQUE connection, it was very surreal seeing her expressionless holding a skull while dancing to the lyrics, shalala shalala. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]] === "Flowers" is a song about the cherry blossoms falling in old Tokyo, their beauty filling the streets like a warm springtime snow. I'm Riyu Kosaka. This time, "Himawari" will be included in beatmaniaIIDX HAPPY SKY.
I'm really, really happy because "Himawari" is one of my favorite songs.
Sunflowers mean... summer!
Summer means... blue skies!
Blue skies mean... Happy Sky!? It's a great season.
Summer is hot. Very hot.
In this hot, hot season, I hope we can get through it as high, bright, and bold(?) as a sunflower that grows straight up to the sun.. And if you enjoy playing beatmaniaIIDX HAPPY SKY and have "Happy" days, Riyu will also be "Happy". === GUITARFREAKS 10thMIX & drummania 9thMIX Official Website === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== "Himawari" is BeForU's third project for GF&dm, following "[[Chikara]]". This is my best number of 2003, in which happy hardcore-styled drumming is intertwined with my own guitar, and Riyu Kosaka's rhythmical and energetic vocals, are matched with her lyrics that only she could write, with high tension. I personally called this sound as J-HAPPYHARD CORE rock.
It follows the flow of my style heard in "[[CANDY (Riyu Kosaka)|CANDY♡]]" and "[[LOVE SHINE|LOVE♡SHINE]]".
However, "Himawari" is a brand-new original song for GF&DM, so I pushed the guitar to the forefront, and you can definitely play real drums (laughs). It's like "Chikara" and "[[BREAK DOWN! (GF&DM STYLE)|BRE∀K DOWN!]]", but you should definitely play them with a band, so please play it at least once!! And much like "Chikara", the lyrics are also quite moving, so please listen carefully to this song's message! === GUITARFREAKS 10thMIX & drummania 9thMIX Soundtracks === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== This J-HAPPY HARDCORE number, "Himawari", is one of the standard styles of the BeForU sound, with an exhilarating pop and speedy feeling.
Riyu Kosaka's lyrics, which completely relate to the real world, continued to give me courage many times as I completed this song.
"If I could make the same flowers bloom, I want them to bloom like the sun...."
I think it's really important to have positive feelings and attitudes.
I think many people unexpectedly almost forget their reality and easily become pessimistic... Well, the full version of Himawari is included in BeForU's 1st album, so to those who like this song, by all means, please listen to it.
Actually, the vocal track and arrangement are completely different to the game version. == Video Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== amamon. ==== Nostalgic, that's all I can say!
It's somewhat embarrassing to see a video I made two years ago on a different game series like this.... In fact, I didn't do anything for this crossover.
It's the same as the original. But the size is different. I didn't do anything, yet I was included in the staff credits. Lucky. === GuitarFreaks & DrumMania === ==== AMAMO ==== This is BeForU's third song in the Gitadora series!!! This is a fresh and youthful song, so RIYU and the other BeForU members also appear in refreshing outfits.
(By the way, RIYU's hairstyle has slightly changed this time ^^;)
Anyways, my first impression of this song was "running", so I made RIYU run this time. Humans want to run somewhere during their youth.
Looking back, those days seemed the most lively....
We felt like we could do anything without "fear". The clip's overall image feels like "BRE∀K DOWN!", but with a pop-tinted screen.
This pop feeling is important after all, right?! This is a bright and fun song.
By all means, please play it! == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

The screeching voices in the middle and at the end of the song are my favorite part.
I mixed it up pretty loudly, so I'm sure this song can be heard all over the arcade.
Also, the clip is wonderful. It reeks of a damp tatami mat.
Normally I leave it up to the artist, but this time, I asked amamon to make a clip to be as close as possible to how I envisioned my song.
The fox's child, the yelping of a fox, the singing of a white crane.
Oh yeah, please enjoy playing this song with three people screeching. Trivia: In the old days, it was said that children were God's children until they reach the age of seven. === GUITARFREAKS 10thMIX & drummania 9thMIX Soundtracks === ==== Asaki ==== It felt like screaming out loud. At least, something like that.
Aren't they great? Those voices. Ahaaha.
It looks like a little music sheet is included, so band kids, please refer to it and try your best. In a foreigner style. === pop'n music 17 THE MOVIE === ==== Asaki ==== Thank you very much. I'm Asaki. This is the sequel of a song I made a long ago called "Shiawase no utau uta". A kind and lovely mother,
A lovely little boy,
A stubborn and aggressive, yet very kind-hearted grandfather,
A likable grandmother, whom we're very sorry for depending on,
A father, who is always there in the distance, gently wrapping them all in his arms, And a little fox, wagging its tail with a smile. I created this song with the image of such a gentle home drama. The scene at the very end, when foxes from all over the world gather together, and welcome the family with a round of applause is a must-see! Anyways, thank you very much for your support! == Video Production Information == === Amamo === Are you tired? I was given the opportunity to create the character "Ame-ningyou Ichi no myo" with a nothing-pop song from pop'n 10 called "Shiawase wo utau uta".
So I made this sequel as well.
There are some subtle links between the two, background and all. I made this clip as an extension of my hobby.
Just a hobby. A hobby.
A lot of things happened while I was making it. A lot of things. I visited Kyoto a few times (as an excuse) to make this video.
I also climbed a mountain on a whim.

It's lovely trance and pop huh,,,,,
It's lovely that it's a trance and popular song huh,,,,,,,

,,,,,,, Love trap

So everyone, instead of "lovely trans pop", let's say "love trap".
Well, let's say "I wanna~" in an English-sounding manner. Let me tell you the story of how this song was created. There was a girl in a wheelchair on the roof of the hospital where I was staying.
She was staring into the distance, but there was a middle school ahead of her gaze.
Apparently, the girl was staring at the field where the baseball and track-and-field boys were practicing.
At that time, something within me began welling up inside my chest.

The version best known is the 1958 version recorded by Ritchie Valens, which is the version MAMBO A GO GO's cover is based on. * The MAMBO A GO GO data credits LA BAMBA's artist as '''BE BORN STUDIO''', although this artist is not shown in-game. * LA BAMBA's MAMBO A GO GO jacket can be seen on its DanceDanceRevolution banner. * On the American and European releases of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], LA BAMBA's artist was romanized as '''Mexican Folk Song'''. * LA BAMBA received a unique video in [[CS DDR EXTREME2|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2]]. This video was carried to the arcade releases in [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]], and eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** Its title was also capitalized as '''La Bamba''' in DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2 and [[CS DS Max|Dancing Stage Max]]. * LA BAMBA was the only licensed song from DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME not removed in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA. ** It is currently the longest surviving license in arcade DanceDanceRevolution history. * LA BAMBA is listed at the very beginning of the DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME folder from [[AC DDR X3|DanceDanceRevolution X3 VS 2ndMIX]] until [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], much like other licensed songs. == Song Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards.

== Song Connections / Remixes == * 1998 is the first song featured in [[DDR MEGAMIX]], from [[AC pnm 10|pop'n music 10]]. * A cover of 1998 by DIGICCO, titled [[Be Rock U (1998 burst style)]], appears in [[AC 9th style|beatmania IIDX 9th style]]. * An instrumental version of 1998 appears in the video ''inside KI・SE・KI'', from [[BeForU]]'s single of the [[KI-SE-KI|same name]]. * A cover of 1998 by NAOKI presents WORLD WIDE STYLE, titled [[1998 (Sparky 2006)]], was available in the ''KONAMI♪MUSICフル'' service. ** A short version of 1998 (Sparky 2006) can be found in [[CS DDR HOTTEST PARTY|DanceDanceRevolution HOTTEST PARTY]]. The artist was changed to J-RAVERS. * A re-arranged version of 1998 is used in [[CS DDR SuperNOVA NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA CS (North America)]] as the BGM in Stellar Master Mode's PIZZA BOX. ** This version appears on the ''DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK'' nonstop megamix as ''ENDING'' by MONSTER-G. * A re-arranged version of 1998 with new vocals was performed live in the release event for [[CS DDR PS3|DanceDanceRevolution (PS3)]]. This version has never been released to the public. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * 1998's title is a reference to the year when the [[AC DDR 1st|original DanceDanceRevolution arcade game]] was released. * A wallpaper based on 1998's background was available on the [https://web.archive.org/web/20121114033456/http://www.konami.jp/bemani/ddr/jp/am/extreme/ddr_new/images/w_1998.jpg DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME website] (archived). * 1998's unique video introduces a blue colored canine mecha first appeared from [[BRILLIANT 2U]] (it was pink-red colored in BRILLIANT 2U, gold-yellow in [[BRILLIANT 2U(Orchestra Groove)]], and light blue in [[BRILLIANT 2U(K.O.G G3 MIX)]].) * 1998 was performed at the ''Extreme! Dance Live ~in velfarre~'' event in 2003. * 1998 received a unique video in [[CS DDR EXTREME2|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2]]. This video was carried over to the arcade releases in [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]] and eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** Its original EXTREME video is shown when 1998 is played from the [[DDR SELECTION]] folder. * 1998 appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR EXTREME Pack 3'''. * In [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], 1998 received its difficulty change from DanceDanceRevolution WORLD on July 3rd, 2024. == Song Production Information == === NAOKI MAEDA === In 1998, DDR was born...
A month and four years have passed since then. Soon, I will have produced a bit more than 100 songs for KONAMI's BEMANI series. I have continued to run without looking aside. I have evolved. My vision also continues to change. But now I remember. All that I felt at that time, in that place..... This is "return to the basics" in a different perspective than [[D2R]]. This main keyword is "1998". "1998"
Beyond the distant memory, I want to deliver the real current NAOKI sound. === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2 === You have unlocked the song "1998" by NAOKI. In classic NAOKI style, get ready to party like it's 1998 with his latest high-energy song. The same artist behind other fan favorite hits like "[[DYNAMITE RAVE]]", "D2R" and "[[B4U]]" turns up the intensity in "1998" with 90's rave synths, rockin' guitar riffs, passionate female vocals, driving rhythms and energetic raps. Check out other songs by this artist in this game and [[CS DDR NA|Dance Dance Revolution]], [[CS DDR KONAMIX|Dance Dance Revolution KONAMIX]], [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX Dance Dance Revolution]], [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 Dance Dance Revolution]] and [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|Dance Dance Revolution EXTREME]]. == Video Production Information == === RICE.C === That nostalgic robotic dog returns. This results in the notes of the song being very cluttered and difficult to read. ** bag's halved BPM, along with the hard to time chart due to DanceDanceRevolution's old engine which didn't have proper 12th/24th/48th notes, were probably the reasons as to why bag's EXPERT charts were rated Level 10 (on the 1-10 scale). bag's charts were fixed in [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]], with proper note quantizations. *** However, bag's old, unfixed EXPERT charts were added again as CHALLENGE charts in [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]]. These are unlockable by reaching ENJOY LEVEL 120. **** As of February 23rd, 2011, these charts have been unlocked for normal play. * bag received a Double BEGINNER chart in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX3|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3]]. * In the beatmania IIDX series, bag's artist is shown as '''Reven-G'''. * After being removed in [[AC DJ TROOPERS|beatmania IIDX 15 DJ TROOPERS]], bag was revived in the ''Lincle Kingdom'' unlock system in [[AC Lincle|beatmania IIDX 19 Lincle]], obtainable upon reaching Level 16. ** It received brand-new ANOTHER charts upon its revival. * bag appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR EXTREME Pack 4'''. * In [[AC DDR 2013|DanceDanceRevolution (2013)]], bag received a unique video on July 30th, 2013, based on its background animations from DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME. This video eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** Its original EXTREME video is shown when bag is played from the [[DDR SELECTION]] folder. * bag is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from October 3rd, 2018, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== Reven-G ==== Following [[Sakura]], this is Reven-G's latest song. I was taken in by the charm of traditional Japanese music for a while as I stayed in Japan, but as I traveled around the world once again, this song is fully loaded with Reven-G taste, and mainly uses the bagpipes, a traditional musical instrument of Europe, combined with a digital beat & tricky super-low BPM.
Actually, traditional music, called ethnic music, has become one of the foundations of modern pop music, which I found out by chance once again, but Reven-G's sound secretly conveys such message. === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME Original Soundtrack === Untranslated. === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME Weekly Journal === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== RevenG stayed in Japan for a long time, producing a mixture of sounds with the latest technology under the theme of traditional Japanese music, but now he has left for Europe. The musical instrument he found there is the bagpipe, which is referenced in the song title. Through trial-and-error, the completed song and chart idea were born from the voices of users. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === A country's name can sometimes be identified from a single landscape photo.
Maybe it's obvious if there's a close-up shot of a building or natural item that symbolizes the country, but it's also somehow possible to identify from the relationship between each image, such as photos of people's clothing, tools, and machines. For example, in the situation you're recreating a partial (or entire) amusement park somewhere in a country, I think it's essential to have broad and deep knowledge of the elements that form the culture of that country, and accurately recreate them in your work without gaps. I feel that Reven-G's sound production, including this song, has a similar stance. == Staff Comments == === moroEX === I made this picture after RevenG explained the image and background process of the song's production. It seems the song title "bag" doesn't only mean bagpipes!? The characters which appear in the movie were also created based on RevenG's image. They appeared in 2D during the location test, but I tried to make them 3D later. I tried to made them walk in a way that reminded me of a certain adventure cartoon named "Tom ○○○yer". I made it in the style of an old-fashioned skit using a set of papier-mâché horses and people. Did anyone notice it? == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR SuperNOVA2 NA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 CS (North America)]] === Another modern-classic from the talented RevenG. }} == Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of Destiny lovers, titled ''Destiny lovers (Full Version)'', appears in the [[GUITARFREAKS & drummania VOCAL COLLECTION]] album. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Destiny lovers marks Miyuki Kunitake's first original song in the GuitarFreaks & DrumMania series. * Destiny lovers was added to pop'n music 10 on February 25th, 2004 via ee'MALL 2nd avenue. * Before pop'n music 15 ADVENTURE, the character for Destiny lovers was [[JUDY]] [2-2P] and its songwheel genre was '''Destiny lovers'''. * Destiny lovers has never been on a CS pop'n music release. * On the American/European releases of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], Destiny lovers' artist is romanized as '''MIYUKI KUNITAKE'''. ** In the pop'n music series, its artist is shown as '''くにたけみゆき'''. * Destiny lovers' title was changed in-game to '''Destiny Lovers''' in [[AC pnm Sunny Park|pop'n music Sunny Park]]. However, its banner remains unchanged. * Destiny lovers received a slightly different banner and a Double BEGINNER chart in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX3|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3]]. * Destiny lovers has never appeared in an American PlayStation 2 DanceDanceRevolution release. * Destiny lovers was unlockable in GuitarFreaksXG2 & DrumManiaXG2 from July 22nd, 2011 by obtaining 71250 Live Points in GROUP MODE. * Destiny lovers can be unlocked in jubeat Qubell as the ''掘りすぎ dig RUSH 2nd dig GITADORA'' STAGE 1 unlock of the ''dig dig Qubell'' unlocking system. For more information on the dates it can be unlocked, please see [[AC jb Qubell/QUBE Availability|this page]]. ** In [[AC jb clan|jubeat clan]], it can be unlocked in the ''jubeat SHOP''. ** In [[AC jb festo|jubeat festo]], it can be purchased at the ''emo MART''. ** In [[AC jb Ave.|jubeat Ave.]] and [[AC jb beyond the Ave.|beyond the Ave.]], it is one of the CONCIERGE unlocks of the ''LIGHT CHAT'' unlocking system from August 17th, 2022. * Destiny lovers' [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat festo ratings on March 7th, 2022. * Destiny lovers received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on August 28th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.3''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.3). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, Destiny lovers' CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From August 31st, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. * Destiny lovers is available in beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020) from December 25th, 2025 by purchasing '''beatmania IIDX INFINITAS GITADORA Selection Music Pack vol.1''' (beatmania IIDX INFINITAS GITADORA セレクション 楽曲パック vol.1). == Music Comment == It's a very speedy song, so try to be cool! == Song Production Information == === Mutsuhiko Izumi === I put a hard rock style guitar on a Eurobeat-styled rhythm, and an easy-to-remember melody on top of it. The tempo is fast and difficult, and it has a fast-paced feel too, so if you can play it well, you will feel good. The vocalist is Miyuki Kunitake, who also sang "[[MISS YOU]]". == Video Production Information == === tQy === At first, I was troubled when Mr. Izumi asked me to create "a romantic image". And then, dance! I love gamelan. == Song Production Information == === beatmania === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== I like to listen to gamelan by the riverside while I broil food in my brazier.
I like to listen to gamelan while I recite beautiful Japanese poetry.
I like to make my friends listen to gamelan when I reconcile with them after a fight, instead of saying sorry. I like to play gamelan for shy people who can't bring themselves to ask, to hide their embarrassment.
I like to listen to gamelan while sitting on the floor, hands on my knees, watching static camera footage of highways on TV late at night and in the early morning.
I like gamelan. === MAMBO A GO GO === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== When the production entered the final stage, wouldn't it be interesting if the 3 congas acted as separate folk instruments each, so that everyone had a percussion session? When I thought this, I wrote this song with a Gamelan theme.
Since each conga has a separate phrase, I think it's enjoyable to play together with 2 people.
I tried to make the center conga a love-dovey zone, and searched for various ways where during the sequences, your hands could touch, but due to the specifications, it was rejected... the lovey-dovey strategy failed (laughs).
Since gamelan phrases are also often used in techno, this song also took over techno-ish trends.
However, gamelan scales are very similar to Okinawan scales. Was it probably conveyed as Bali → Okinawa? === pop'n music === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== I love gamelan music!
I still love gamelan! So, this is a crossover from [https://web.archive.org/web/20050228003752fw_/http://www.konami.co.jp/am/AM/mamboagogo/mambo_ug/songs.html MAMBO A GO GO].
The word gamelan represents the music style and the instruments used in it.
The gamelan instrument has extremely distinct overtone components, with the music style and musical scales making it extremely trancey and playful.
I think there are quite many musicians who noted that this instrument really fits repetitive music genres such as minimal and trance.
Gamelan scales are similar to Okinawan scales, and I think they fit easily into Japanese ears. The title is Gamelan de Couple because I originally wanted couples to play it together in MAMBO.
So, the MAMBO notecharts were created for couples to enjoy playing together. Well, for the pop'n charts, I really recommend finger pressing this!
Since it's a percussive song, when you flexibly move and press well with the back of your hand, it creates a very pleasant trance-like percussion play.
Instead of individually pressing each button, please try to think of a great hand flow. If you do that, all good kids will also love gamelan! === REFLEC BEAT === ==== TOMOSUKE ==== I created this song emphasizing the uplifting feeling from ethnicity or blood. Southeast Asian music blends very well with repetitive music such as techno, and the gamelan scale is close to the Ryukyuan scale, so it feels very familiar to us. == Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== moroEX ==== This is the renewal of a character who also appeared in beatmania THEFINAL! Actually, his name is "Leonardo". He's named by a certain programmer. It seems intuitive. It doesn't have a deep meaning. I'm currently looking for cactus names! Orange, who has appeared in various songs, apparently seems to resemble his creator. === pop'n music === ==== [[Takao Yamamoto|amamon.]] ==== This is a crossover from the nostalgic MAMBO!
The green song card image strongly remained in my mind. ==== [[Ryuta Tamura|tama]] ==== Although I played it MAMBO A GO GO, this was completely impossible. ==== [[Shinichiro Yamanaka|Daniel]] ==== Gamelan is the noun of the verb gamel (hit, grab). ==== [[Kiyoshi Murai|Seiya Murai]] ==== I like gamelan.
Or rather, Japanese people quite like the gamelan, right? Isn't it probably from festival music? Doesn't it probably make the Japanese festival-loving blood excited?
Although there are some gamelan-styled songs in the BEMANI series, this is another intense gamelan!
Although it's too difficult and it doesn't feel like I could clear it, when I hear that the people next to me can clear it, I also become passionate. ==== [[eimy]] ==== I somehow love these kinds of songs, right~? Although it feels like I'm saying I like this song too much in comments here and there, please don't worry about it. I somehow like them all. I can't choose. I want to find a lovely Southeast Asian man and live a carefree life. ==== wac ==== My memories of Gamelan de Couple? OK, let's talk about it.
Looking back 5 years ago, I was involved in developing pop'n 8. Around that time in a Nishi-Shinjuku arcade, TOMOSUKE and I were surprised to see many single players playing a song meant for two people, but that didn't matter too much.
pop'n 8's main feature was the crossover songs from other game series, which wasn't very common in pop'n back then.
Remembering those times, I'm certain that it was during New Years Day when I went to a hot spring with TOMOSUKE, who I just shortly met and were both reserved. "I'd like to cross over MAMBO's songs, but what do you think? Thank you for your support and please remember me" "Not at all, by all means, we'd also love to cross it over. Thank you for your support and please remember me" Through that exchange, MAMBO's songs were included in pop'n 8.
I'm certain that Gamelan de Couple was the top candidate at that time, but I just included a song which exactly sounded [[Denpasar|Gamelan-ish]] in the [[AC pnm 7|previous game]], so it went away. And during [[AC pnm 12|Iroha]], I moved this song aside and included [[Klungkung 1655|GAMELAN]] from [[AC KBM 3rd|KEYMANI]].
So, this somehow became the third Gamelan song in pop'n. The pop'n team loves gamelan. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania difficulty rated from 1 to 9.

This sweet and sad graduation song is from DDR. == Song Production Information == === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME Original Soundtrack === Untranslated. === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME Weekly Journal === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== This is BeForU's first dramatic mid-tempo number. People repeatedly experience meetings and partings, and live their lives with various overlapping thoughts. If there's a beginning, there's an end. But if there's an end, there's something that begins. This song, named graduation, is not just about looking back at the past and ending a drama, but also about graduating from something and the future that starts tomorrow. === pop'n music === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== There are 4 versions of GRADUATION, and the version used this time in pop'n 12 is the game-sized short version used in DDR. During the time when I was making this song, it coincided with the time when the main vocalist, Kosaka, graduated from high school.
Her real feelings were seemingly reflected in this song's lyrics. Several times in life when people repeatedly "graduate", what do they gain and lose? A "graduation" may be there to guide us to the path we should advance, for the sake of our future. == Character Information == In this season when cherry blossoms bloom... I'm graduating!
After all, a new world awaits me! === Chihi === She was in a frog color last time, so this time I've selected white for spring.
Her ears look like cute kamaboko, don't they?
Graduation... speaking of graduation, in my case, I didn't really feel sad about the second button. My mood was more like "Yay~! I'm graduating~!", even if there were a lot of people unsure of what to do next. == Staff Comments == === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== RICE.C ==== During the movie scene where she's running down a slope, I initially thought of including [[EMI]]'s family-run electronics store on a telephone pole sign, but the idea was rejected with the risk it used another company's name. With the "Shiba" connection, it became "Biker Mikoshiba" (note: pop'n team designer). I thought about telling him, but forgot to do so, so I vigorously got consent after video production concluded. I'm sorry Mikoshiba. PS: Congratulations to everyone who graduated this year! === pop'n music === ==== [[Takao Yamamoto|amamon.]] ==== Graduation, that sounds nostalgic. Let's start walking forwards! It makes me feel like this. ==== [[Masaru Nakamura|masaru]] ==== It's been a long time~ since I graduated from school.
It's nostalgic, or rather it's fading from my memory. ==== [[Ryuta Tamura|tama]] ==== It's been a long time since I graduated while weighing 60 kilograms.
I'll do my best to enroll again. ==== wac ==== I wanted to have a graduation ceremony event, and thought about creating an original pop'n song for it, but there was already a signature graduation song in the BEMANI series, so I just crossed it over. At the end when Riyu's voice whispers "I'll never forget", it makes you feel more excited about graduation, but if it were a pop'n original song, I'll definitely assign this as a hidden button. But as I was thinking "I'll do it someday, I'll do it someday", I forgot to do this. So it might be assigned as a hidden button in the [[AC pnm 13|next game]], so please search for Riyu's voice then. But it seems I'll somehow forget again. == Song Connections / Remixes == * A long version of Happy Wedding, titled ''Happy Wedding (for party mix)'', appears on the [[beatmania IIDX 7th style Original Soundtrack]] album. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a noticeably shorter version of Happy Wedding. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to Takayuki, he wrote Happy Wedding in celebration of one of the then-current beatmania IIDX VJs getting married (he doesn't mention which one). * [[Celica]] appears throughout Happy Wedding's overlays. GOLI mentions in the song comments that the wedding dress Celica wears in the overlays is based on the same one the wife of the then-recent married VJ wore at their wedding. ** A special overlay with Celica will appear towards the end of Happy Wedding if the player manages to full-combo the song up to the point where the overlay would trigger. * Happy Wedding and [[A]] are the only songs with G2ARTS wallpapers not in the website of the same style they debuted in. They both appeared in [[AC 9th style|beatmania IIDX 9th style]]'s website instead. * Happy Wedding received slightly updated overlays in [[AC 10th style|beatmania IIDX 10th style]]. * Happy Wedding's overlays were removed from the beatmania IIDX arcade games as of [[AC tricoro|beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro]] due to technical issues. * Happy Wedding's DanceDanceRevolution background features [[LADY]]. * Happy Wedding received a unique video in [[CS DDR EXTREME2|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2]]. This video was carried to the arcade releases in [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]] and eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. * Happy Wedding is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from January 9th, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. ** From April 20th, 2022, it is available by default in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]]. == Song Production Information == === TAKA === After GOLI, [[Gyo Eguchi|GYO]], and I had a brief discussion, the perfect plan was born.
I started making a song with animations and music related to weddings in connection with a certain VJ's wedding, and the title was first called "HAPPY WEDDING ○○○!", but I thought the situation was too limited, so I made a general wedding song.
Many people around me are recently getting married, but after marriage, your wife is waiting for you, and the relationship deteriorates, so it can get pretty boring around you, right?
Even when I attend wedding ceremonies, I also help organize it in tears, so I feel bad for my father.... when I think about it, it's becoming quite lonely, so I wanted to include the hidden joy and loneliness within the happiness in this song.
I thought about it, and I struggled a lot because I rarely write songs with a theme these days. I tried my best to express the tears associated with happiness and sadness, without using phrases and tones with blatant association with them. == Video Production Information == === GOLI === Congratulations on your marriage. To a certain VJ.
By the way, the wedding dress is based on the wife of that certain VJ.
Thank you very much for your cooperation. I'm grateful for something.... a guarantee? Payment... Now, let's talk about the animation. TAKA "HAPPY WEDDING ○○○! What's this?" GOLI "Of course it's a gag song, right?" TAKA "That's right." GOLI "That's interesting, let's do it. You want to do it for impact?" TAKA "That's right." A few weeks later...
GOLI "How is it~? Did you do it~?"
TAKA "......... Something '''seems unreasonable'''"
GOLI "Are you satisfied with it? NOW... I GOT IT, i'm GOING TO DO IT!" A few weeks later...
GOLI "Huh, what is it?"
TAKA "I did it. I made it."
GOLI "What?"
TAKA "HAPPY WEDDING.... Well, just listen to it now."
GOLI "Oh. It's nice. This...." However.......... '''Where's the gag song?'''
'''I need to redraw it!!''' In that case, it became the animations of Celica's dreams. == Staff Comments == === RICE.C === I intended for this situation to be about LADY ([[AC DDR 1st|1st]]), who was invited to her friend's wedding, and brilliantly caught the bouquet. == Song Connections / Remixes == * jane jana shares vocal samples with [[Macho Gang]], from [[AC substream|beatmania IIDX substream]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * In the Dance Maniax series, "Mohammed" in jane jana's artist is mispelled as "Mohamm'''a'''d". * jane jana's Dance Maniax charts were created by TOMOSUKE himself. [https://mond.how/ja/topics/2xyfcbncwcat294] * jane jana, along with [[Gamelan de Couple]], [[MOBO MOGA|MOBO★MOGA]], and [[STAY (Organic house Version)]] being crossed over mark Tomosuke Funaki's debut in the mainline arcade DanceDanceRevolution series. * Before [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]], jane jana's title was shown as '''JANEJANA'''. * None of jane jana's charts have Freeze Arrows. == Song Production Information == Among the songs included in Dance Maniax, this number particularly stands out. The melody immediately changes after the lively intro at the start. The fantastic chorus with male and female vocals, the occasionally heard string instrument timbres, and the unmodulated, unique melody, are unified, forming an oriental mood. When you listen to that flavor, you'll become addicted to it. Won't you try elegantly dancing to it with Tai chi-like movements, while singing "jane, jana......"? == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (North America)]] === "JANE JANA" by T.E.M.P.O. feat. Mohammed & Emi is another diverse song that borrows musical influences from a wide variety of ethnic backgrounds and cultures. Continuing with the Dance Dance Revolution tradition of showcasing music from all around the world, "JANE JANA" will take you on an international dancing journey. == Staff Comments == === moroEX === I created this with the image of a mandala. I'd be happy if you can feel its Indian qualities. I'm eating curry (it's a Japanese expression). This is a bear movie series, which somehow received a good reaction among the staff. It's easy to make, and appears in all genres of music. There's an impactful punchline in it, too. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards.

I came up with the song's motifs by playing the piano and singing along.
Also, out of all the songs in my HYPER EUROBEAT series, it's the only one that hadn't been in beatmania.
There's also an unreleased version sung by one of my mainstay vocalists.
There may be a day where I unveil it somewhere. === Dance Maniax === This is a standard Eurobeat number which has the flow of [[BROKEN MY HEART]] from the [[AC DMX|previous game]]. == Song Connections / Remixes == * [[CELEBRATE NITE]] is the name of another NAOKI song (which apparently has some sort of connection to this song, according to NAOKI's comments on CELEBRATE NITE on the [[AC 8th style|beatmania IIDX 8th style]] website). == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Kiss me all night long marks the debut of vocalist Miyuki Kunitake in BEMANI. ** It crossing over to beatmania IIDX in 5th style also marks her debut in the beatmania IIDX series. *** It is also the only BEMANI song sung by her that she provided her own lyrics for. * NAOKI claims that Kiss me all night long was his first song with Japanese vocals in the BEMANI series, although the [[AC DDR 2nd|DanceDanceRevolution 2ndMIX]] song [[AM-3P]] contained (brief) Japanese lyrics a year and a half prior to this song's debut. * A partial English translation of the lyrics can be seen during Kiss me all night long's video. * Kiss me all night long's DanceDanceRevolution background and jacket features [[LADY]]'s silhouette. * Kiss me all night long has never appeared in a non-Japanese PlayStation 2 DanceDanceRevolution release. * Prior to [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]], Kiss me all night long's title in the DanceDanceRevolution series was capitalized as '''KISS ME ALL NIGHT LONG'''. * KISS ME ALL NIGHT LONG received a Double BEGINNER chart in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX3|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3]]. * KISS ME ALL NIGHT LONG received new graphics and CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR UNIVERSE|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE]]. However, these CHALLENGE charts were not carried over to [[CS DDR UNIVERSE3|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE3]]. * In the DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX and UNIVERSE titles, and in the Dancing Stage series, KISS ME ALL NIGHT LONG's BPM is shown as 0-155. * Kiss me all night long received a new jacket in DanceDanceRevolution X2. * Kiss me all night long is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] from December 8th, 2021 after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== NAOKI ==== "LOVE AFFAIR" is the theme of this song's lyrics, and I aimed to arrange it while creating a driving and thrilling sense which feels like racing with passion, as two people hide in the midnight darkness.
"Kiss me all night long" is my first song with Japanese vocals in the BEMANI series, and I tried many new things with its arrangement. === Dance Maniax === This number is the definitive version of dance music, with its stimulating beat shaking your body from the beginning. Of course, it has a catchy melody, and vocalist MIU's adorable singing voice is must-listen. The unusual point for DMX that all the lyrics are written in Japanese, including the rap inserted in the song, which feels really refreshing. This song is easy to remember and familiarize with, so there should also be many repeat players. Everyone, please hum the lyrics, perform a cool and sharp dance, and monopolize the gaze of the crowd! == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === Overflowing strange information. Overcooled reasons. Overheated emotions.
Everything surges through your body at once.
Too much. Too fast. Too complex.
A mixed, hazy, abstract flow. For the video image, I attempted to use a similar method with the singer as a model.
The music and lyrics were in an altered state... instead, I was electrified by them and created it all at once (my schedule was completely full and my eyes were swirling).
Without stopping the flow, let's combine the rapidly changing images, that was one of my production goals (I really liked the scene in the middle of the song where the rap is included with the filtered voice).
I was deeply impressed that my most controversial(?) movie received positive reactions from various perspectives ("○○ is nice~"... laughs) by those around me. == Staff Comments == === RICE.C === I remember a long time ago, when this song was loudly played from the DMX team next to us. It's nostalgic. It's been a long time since I burst into high tension, and it has recently become one of my favorite songs.
Following [[BREAK DOWN!|BRE∀K DOWN!]], BeForU member Riyu Kosaka broke out.
Her beautiful and punchy vocals have a good chemistry with the straight groovy beat numbers, and she poured her entire soul into LOVE・SHINE.
I really care about current trends, since we're transitioning into an era of convenience.
If you think my music is stoic, it's because I'm obsessed with commercial POP. This is simply because POP is my "favorite" genre.
That's what I thought about this song, which I named its genre J-HAPPY HARDCORE, and want to advance towards an unprecedented genre in J-POP. === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME Original Soundtrack === Untranslated. === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME Weekly Journal === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== Making [[CANDY (Riyu Kosaka)|CANDY♥]] finer, it contains MAX cuteness and is a straight groovy HAPPY HARDCORE number with an energetic ROCK taste. This is a song that makes you feel excited and energized, enjoying the sunshine with your body, without thinking about anything. PURE and HAPPY feelings... Have you recently forgotten when you became an adult?? == Video Production Information == === GOLI === This song is familiar(?) to those who extremely heard it playing from the DDR cabinet.
The first image I heard when I received the data was that it was a major straight song.
As expected of the NAOKI SOUND! Whenever a song contains singing, my consciousness tends to be biased towards it, but there has never been a song which raises the tension like this song. This is a first-class song, from the chosen sounds to the song development. All of them suit my tastes. As expected of the NAOKI SOUND! Please let me create this video~. And I repeatedly requested for it. I decided relatively early to try creating a POP atmosphere. I didn't use any live-action or 3DCG, it's all 2D animation....
That was the concept behind this video. I intended to create the animations without breaking the atmosphere of Riyu's cute and clear voice. I'd be happy if you can watch it and feel it as the IIDX version of "Minna no Uta".
Due to the difficult schedule of creating other videos, there were times when I thought about using live-action footage while creating it, but I eventually completed it with 2D only. It's been a long time since I created this movie, and I forgot how I felt back then, but it took a very long time.... I had a very nice experience this time. ucchie also created nice notecharts for this song, and playing them is the best. Well, they're too difficult for me to the point that I didn't have time to watch the movie (laughs). * By the way, no one should beat the number of times I listened to this song. Ever since I received the song, I endlessly listened to it every day from beginning to end of work during the production of 9th. After counting, that's a lot of times.... I enjoy creating new things. Wow~ you did it. When I hear people say this, you know it was worth.
If I create another movie next time, I'll fly further~. What is this? == Staff Comments == === moroEX === This song was very popular during the location test. Of all the songs I made, this song has the strongest connection to the DDR series. I believe that many DDR players still have clear memories of it... The long time sealed PARANOiA, in its final form has become "PARANOIA survivor". My thoughts... Because it's EXTREME, I want to finish with PARANOIA survivor......
The last PARANOiA was born, while reminiscing about everything from the time of DDR production, to affirm the present. == Video Production Information == === RICE.C === Continuing the imagery of the PARANOiA tradition... It doesn't feel like a survivor. I tried to make a movie in which a DDR cabinet is assembled. At the end, the [[AC DDRMAX2|MAX2]] marquee is replaced with by EXTREME. However, if you fail halfway, the assembly won't be completed.

However, there's no nostalgia here.
Etched within this version are many memories over the passage of the last five years, a time when the only thing I knew I had to do was to keep running.
Indeed... as long as memories continue to shine within our hearts, then perhaps the word for "past" may not exist. Neither would the word "end". === DanceDanceRevolution === Untranslated. == Video Production Information == === RICE.C === Nice to meet you. My name is RICE.C., and I was involved in DDR production.
DDR and 2DX have been linked with each other ever since the [[AC DDR CLUB VER.1|CLUB kit]] days, haven't they? I'm somewhat deeply moved. I've wanted to participate in creating a video for quite some time, so I'm very, very, very thankful & very grateful that I was invited. Since this song is a crossover from EXTREME, I tried to remake the two men in a chase as they appeared in that game. Having said that, I redid almost everything aside from the assembly of the DDR cabinet.
It was my first time creating a full movie for a song, so every day working on it had my heart racing from the excitement. Originally, I planned to create the monochrome world turning into color scene for DDR, but it was cut during development due to space limitations. That's why I happily got revenge, although something didn't turn out well. How shameful. Just before the deadline, I had a terrible dream of a man wearing sunglasses chasing me around. He kept chasing me even though I hid and hid. It was really scary. Everyone, please also try playing DDR if possible!
I'd like to create movies again.
Bye bye. == Staff Comments == === RICE.C === Those who gave their best effort are amazing! Remarkable! The PARA-kings! == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ in 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

It's cool and attractive! === ノスタルジア === From "KEYBOARDMANIA". == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== Seiya ==== This song fi~na~lly~ makes its first appearance in the IIDX series!! Hello, I'm Seiya Murai, a.k.a. Seiya of Kiyommy+Seiya.
Pink Rose first appeared in KEYBOARDMANIA 3rdMix, and has since been included in other game series, in chronological order, from pop'n → DDR → IIDX.
It has already been 5 years since this song debuted in 2000, but I'd be very happy if you still love it now.
It'd be great if I can use this song as a business card and participate in the IIDX series [[AC DistorteD|next time]] with a [[Leaving...|new song]]~♪ === KEYBOARDMANIA === The gap between children and adults doesn't know disgrace or loneliness, like a pale rose... ==== Seiya Murai ==== Following "[[Mighty Guy]]" and "[[Massara]]", this J-pop song series greets you every time. This time, I'm serving as the main sound director of "KEYBOARDMANIA 3rd MIX", so I put my heart and soul into it with the feeling of carrying a billboard. The lyrics were written by the familiar Kiyomi Kumano. Can you believe this same person sang "Massara"? (laughs) === REFLEC BEAT === ==== Seiya Murai ==== Even though it was created 15 years ago, I'm amazed that this song is still loved to this day. I created it with great ambition back then, and I think it has enough soul to fly away after leaving my hands. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (North America)]] === "Pink Rose" by Kiyommy + Seiya is a new dance song from the land of the rising sun. Featuring melodic synths, driving rhythms and Japanese pop vocals, fans of this genre will want to order a full dozen of this rose. == Video Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== HES ==== After 5 years, this song appeared in the IIDX series.
This video was displayed full-screen in the KEYBOARDMANIA series at 4:3, so I tuned it for the IIDX version.
Its overall development was slow, so I made it speedier by inserting footage everywhere to appear balanced.
By the way, when you miss a note, you can see a noisy damage effect on the screen. === KEYBOARDMANIA === ==== HES ==== On a certain day in December 2000. The date of a certain project's deadline.
[[Yuji Takahashi|YUZ]] went straight to my seat and said "this is a cool song, so try and listen to it", and I replied back to him.
HES "Wow, it's hot! Isn't it very cool?"
YUZ "Yes, please take care of this song"
HES "Huh. Huh!?"
YUZ "It'd be great if you can quickly make something cool which looks like [[AC PPP|PPP]]"
HES "Got it. I'll try my best" And the fight continues...
So with that spirit, I helped making this movie. When I first heard this song, the vocals weren't included yet, but an image of a certain famous robot anime sequel came to my mind.
[[Noriyuki Niiyama|NEW-3]] said "this has the image of a real robot appearing..."
I encouraged him? I made it while fully exposing his hobby.
This movie is perhaps quite unusual in the KBM series.
The song's image is different for each person, but it's also rare for myself, NEW-3, and the other designers to start agreeing that it's "real robot-styled".
He just simply likes talking about robots...
I hope some story comes to your mind while watching this video. I'd like to really thank the KBM team for giving me the chance to create this movie. == Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === moroEX === This song was very popular in KEYBOARD MANIA3. I can't believe it's included in DDR! This song should have its movie! I asked HES, who was "Pink Rose"'s movie creator in KEYBOARD MANIA3, to provide me the data. I had trouble choosing one animation from its famous movie scenes. There are many highlights, so please try to look for them! It can be unlocked by reaching ENJOY LEVEL 54. ** As of February 23rd, 2011, TEARS has been unlocked for normal play. * A crop of TEARS' jacket is used as its banner in [[CS DDR DANCE WARS|DanceDanceRevolution DANCE WARS]]. * TEARS has never appeared on a non-Japanese PlayStation 2 DanceDanceRevolution release. == Song Production Information == === NAOKI MAEDA === This song consists of two sides. Like two truths in a society where two sides of human psychology swirl, it's an original song which can possibly be separated into two different types of songs. The version used in EXTREME is the back side. Therefore, it's a song hidden with negative power. Perhaps the only person who understands the depths of human psychology is themselves. This song was made with such thoughts in my head. == Video Production Information == === RICE.C === As this song contains a unique floating feel, I intended to make the entire video feel completely dreamy. I quite like it. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]] onwards, the title is '''Twin Bee -Generation X-'''. ** In beatmania THE FINAL and in the pop'n music series before [[AC pnm 16|pop'n music 16 PARTY♪]], the title Go!! == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX and beatmania III === ==== [[Reo Nagumo|dj nagureo]] ==== This is a beatmania REMIX of TwinBee, which is one of KONAMI's flagship titles.
Isn't the ParaPara-styled Eurobeat and nostalgic SCC sounds a big hit with gamers? === Dance Maniax === The theme from the shooting game masterpiece "TwinBee" is included here, so those from the video game generation will probably cry! After the "1, 2, 3, 4" countdown, that nostalgic melody plays. Then, a more up-tempo pop song welcomes you, as if the TwinBee received the Bell Power-Up. Perhaps the game's original sounds used in the opening and ending is KONAMI fanservice? == Video Production Information == This song is a crossover from beatmaniaIII.
When this song was released on beatmaniaIII, which is part of the same beatmania family lineage, [[Goli Matsumoto|GOLI]] and I raced to the cabinet, and I remember exclaiming "wow" after hearing it.
Thanks to the support of the beatmaniaIII team, this time the song can be played in IIDX using the seven keys.
Eurobeat has become a popular genre even in the IIDX series, but this song shows us an brand-new horizon from the songs currently included in the game. == Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === moroEX === This game is too nostalgic for my generation. I was obsessed with playing it when I was an elementary school student. So, I drew the background with the image of the hot Famicom version of TwinBee. The words were drawn with rough pixels to give it a retro feeling. For the movie, I added the motions while remembering the hot Famicom version of TwinBee. This time, the last-minute tension just before I had to upload it was fully condensed into a thrilling song.
Originally, these kinds of music really used the synthesizer's built-in arpeggiator, but in my case, I completely programmed the beta version in MIDI. The sound was better. (I'm lying) I just don't know how to use it.
These parts are generally assigned as keysounds, so the game becomes kind of a human arpeggiator, right? ※Arpeggiator: a function that automatically performs arpeggios. == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution- === You have unlocked the song "xenon" by Mr.T. Invisible like the air, "xenon" is a special element that can create intense light without a lot of energy. Difficult to extract and rare in the atmosphere, the song "xenon" is much like the gas - intense but minimal, one of a kind and hidden in its own atmosphere. Be sure to breathe deeply while playing. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === It was the end of this summer.
As the festival reached the end, all of the IIDX staff saw the final fireworks display together.
The brilliantly colored sparks rained before our eyes, flickering at a high speed.
The extra large fireworks were rather dangerous electrical devices.

''This page is for the [[Naoki Maeda|Reven-G]] song titled 桜. For other songs titled Sakura, please see [[Sakura (disambiguation)]].'' ''For the beatmania IIDX DJ Sakura, please see [[Sakura (character)]].'' = 桜 = == Song Information == [[Image:Sakura.png|thumb|桜's jacket.]] Artist: Reven-G
Composition: [[Naoki Maeda|NAOKI MAEDA]], Japanese folk song
Arrangement: NAOKI MAEDA
BPM: 13-320 (beatmania IIDX), 21-320 (DanceDanceRevolution), 320 (REFLEC BEAT)
Length: 1:40
Genre: SPIRITUAL

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]] * [[AC DanEvo|DanceEvolution ARCADE]] * [[CS DanEvo|DanceMasters / DanceEvolution]] * [[AC RB colette Spring|REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring-]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * 桜 is a remix of a traditional Japanese folk song called ''Sakura Sakura'' (often just shortened to Sakura). ** Another remix of [[Sakura sakura|さくらさくら]] by [[nora2r]] appears in [[AC DaR|DANCE aROUND]]. ** Other songs that sample Sakura sakura include [[Tsuminagara... to kanojo wa ifu|ツミナガラ... と彼女は謂ふ]] from [[AC GF8DM7|GUITARFREAKS 8thMIX & drummania 7thMIX]], [[Meikyoushisui|明鏡止水]] from [[AC pnm 10|pop'n music 10]], [[IKI|粋 -IKI-]] from [[AC pnm UniLab|pop'n music UniLab]], and [[MURASAME]] from [[AC SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR]]. * A remix of 桜, titled ''桜 -DAM LA MIX-'', appears in the [[DanceEvolution V-RARE EX SOUNDTRACK]] CD. * 桜 shares many elements with [[MAXX UNLIMITED]], as noted by Naoki Maeda in the Song Production Information. * 桜 shares a vocal sample with [[1st Samurai]], from [[AC 10th style|beatmania IIDX 10th style]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * The name "Sakura" refers to the cherry blossom tree that blossoms during the springtime. * 桜 is beatmania IIDX 8th style's EXTRA STAGE song. When accessed as such, the music select BGM changes to a sample of 桜, and the background changes to cherry blossom petals. ** In the arcade version of beatmania IIDX 8th style, 桜 had its own unique splash screen, with the text in pink. This was not carried over to any CS beatmania IIDX game. * In beatmania IIDX 8th style, 桜's genre in the song selection screen is misspelled as '''SPRITUAL'''. * 桜 is one of the 6th PASS hidden songs of DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME. * 桜 held the record for the song with the lowest BPM at any point in the DanceDanceRevolution arcade series, at 20.6 BPM, for nearly 20 years, until it was beaten by [[Get Your Wish]] from [[AC DDR A3|DanceDanceRevolution A3]] and [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], with 20 BPM. ** From DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME to [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|SuperNOVA]], 桜's BPM was displayed as 14-320. *** From [[AC DDR SuperNOVA2|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2]] to A3, it is displayed as 20-320. *** In [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX3|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3]] and [[CS DS Unleashed3|Dancing Stage Unleashed3]], it is shown as 20-319 instead. ** Also, with a peak low of 13 BPM, 桜 has the lowest BPM point of any song in the REFLEC BEAT series. * Before [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]] and in the REFLEC BEAT series, 桜's artist is shown as '''RevenG'''. * [[ALICE]] appears in 桜's DanceDanceRevolution graphics and movies. * SAKURA received a unique video in [[CS DDR EXTREME2|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2]]. This video was carried over to the arcade releases of DanceDanceRevolution in DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA, and eliminates any on-screen dancers prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** As of [[AC tricoro|beatmania IIDX 20 tricoro]], 桜 also uses a revised version of this video in the beatmania IIDX series. * 桜 is one of very few songs in DanceDanceRevolution in which the EXPERT chart is more difficult and higher rated than the CHALLENGE chart. ** 桜 had its EXPERT and CHALLENGE charts swapped during the DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA2 location test. After the test, the charts were swapped back, and the Single charts re-rated, but the swapped ratings were not fixed on Double. * SAKURA received a Double BEGINNER chart in DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3. * SAKURA received a new set of graphics in [[CS DDR Disney Channel EDITION|DanceDanceRevolution Disney Channel EDITION]]. However, it uses its EXTREME2 video instead of a brand-new one created exclusively for Disney Channel EDITION. * 桜 was performed live in the release event for [[CS DDR PS3|DanceDanceRevolution (PS3)]]. * 桜 appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR EXTREME Pack 4'''. * 桜 is the second FINAL ROUND song of REFLEC BEAT colette -Spring-. ** From [[AC RB groovin'!!|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!!]] to [[AC RB VOLZZA 2|REFLEC BEAT VOLZZA 2]], 桜 was playable by default. * 桜 was added to DanceEvolution ARCADE on March 22nd, 2013. ** It has both the slowest ''and'' fastest BPMs in the DanceEvolution series, at 13 and 320 BPM respectively. * 桜 can be unlocked from April 12th, 2016 on [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]]' ''Akashic Explore'' event. == Song Production Information == === Reven-G === "Sakura" is the flower in the hearts of Japanese people.
When I listen to this melody, I strangely feel nostalgic, something which awakens my Japanese genes.
Although the rhythm is based on the artificial rhythm of MAXX UNLIMITED, it has been fully refined and customized throughout the song.
I introduced traditional Japanese instruments in the arrangement, fusing them with current synthesizer technology. As a Japanese person, I've recently made a lot of songs with traditional and classical Japanese music as the theme, but now the songs under Reven-G are finally departing Japan and [[bag|heading towards Europe]]. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === When you think about it, it's really amazing that you can clearly understand which country this song is from, by the instruments used and its melody. I think it's surprising.
Music evolves while spreading. I think that's one of the charms of dance music.
On the other hand, this song deepens evolution and promotes new music. On the dance floor filled with people wearing various non-national costumes, wearing an extravagant and seasonal kimono with bright flowing patterns (would men wear oyoroi and jinbaori?), would attract big attention! It feels like that. == Staff Comments == === RICE.C === This is my favorite song. Japanese things are hot. I've received many e-mails asking "who's that girl?". Thank you. As you can see, she's ALICE. Although she's from Hong Kong, please don't mind that she's wearing a kimono. I thought a kimono suited her the most.. I wonder if this theme is "beauty-styled honor". == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ in 8th and 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

This is a cute pop and groovy rock number!! == Song Production Information == === BeForU Official Website === ==== NAOKI ==== BeForU's new song has a full-fledged rock tone which features guitar. Perhaps it's a song which is unusual in the DDR series. It has nice rhythms which are up-tempo and groovy, but the melody feels sorrowful. This time, Riyu Kosaka is in charge of the song's lyrics. Kosaka expressed her straight feelings and teen words into the song as she felt them when she first heard it. These lyrics are wonderfully nice. Please don't miss it. ==== RIYU KOSAKA ==== And... Kosaka wrote the lyrics for BREAK DOWN, and it was a big change~!? Unlike CANDY, I'm acting as a delinquent, so it was very difficult (laughs), but I did my best in Kosaka's own style, so everyone please try to dance to this song by all means (^-^)/ ==== [[Nao Komatsu|YOMA KOMATSU]] ==== When I received this song, I immediately liked it because it was groovy and nice. Riyu wrote the lyrics, which are powerful and energetic. This song is very easy to sing along to. I want everyone to feel excited about it. ==== [[Shiyuna Maehara|SHIYUNA MAEHARA]] ==== When I first heard this new song, I was surprised at how good NAOKI is at making nice songs~. Anyways, I thought the song's melody was upbeat~, so Shiyuna was also excited↑ by the tension♪ This time, the lyrics are full of Riyu's world, and I think you can really relate to them! It seems that DDRMAX2 is going to have various different gameplay elements, so please look forward to it★ Everyone please follow DDRMAX2!!! ==== [[Noria Shiraishi|NORIA SHIRAISHI]] ==== When I heard from NAOKI that this song was rock, I felt completely nervous, asking myself "what kind of song would be~??" until I heard it. When the intro started, my head warped for a moment... huh! Is this in a live venue? The exciting climax! The roaring guitars! My body continues to jump... I said "that's exactly rock!!!" as an amazing and real image came to my mind!!! Well, don't you want to shake your head while listening to this? I think everyone has their own "rock image", but I wonder if they'll feel the same way Noria does when listening to this song? I'm looking forward to it. The contents of these lyrics is expressing the resentment of the world as a "rebellious chick". Noria sang the top part of the chorus with a high pitched voice. I recommend Yoma's narration. I really love listening to that. If you're frustrated by something, try to loudly sing BRE∀K DOWN! Of course, try to play it in DDR too! Noria is also looking forward to MAX2! I want to play as soon as possible★ Well then, see you at the arcade. (laughs) === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== NAOKI ==== This is my first original rock number in the DDR series, featuring edgy and solid guitars. I personally thought Be For U were better suited for this type of lengthy rock sound, with the girls' current positive power pushing into an energetic and aggressive super pop number, BRE∀K DOWN! ==== Liner Notes ==== This is a thrilling rock number which is reminiscent of the '80s band boom. The booming and flying guitar, and the cute and powerful female vocals, unconsciously raise the tension. When the chorus groovily reaches the climax, the teenage girl-styled lines are also amazing. This is just an exceptionally positive song, and if you hum the phrases while energetically dancing, it should be even more exciting. This song is recommended for female D.D.R. beginners. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution-]] === "BREAK DOWN" by Be For U is the latest song from the same group behind "[[DIVE]]." Fans of Japanese pop will surely be getting down with "BREAK DOWN". Check out the other song from Be For U in this game as well. == Character Information == None. == Staff Comments == === Octoman === When I heard this song, I thought "it's so energetic..."
After many all-nighters and greasy meals, my brain, stomach, and pancreas were exhausted, and I was envious of this song's "energy".
Furthermore, at that time, a certain "MARTIALBEAT" cabinet was installed at the entrance of the company. It kept screaming "Punch! Kick! One more!", day after day.
The result was:
"Straight punch"
"Aerobics"
"Singing frog"
"A few wiggling frogs", etc.
Looking back, I wonder "why?", but I'm sure that my state of mind wasn't normal at that time.
The director, who saw the production, said "this is indeed too much", and therefore, it was never implemented. (..ho-ho..)
If not for that, I might've gone ahead with it.
As such, "Straight punch" and "Aerobics" were used for [[THE WHISTLE SONG (Blow My Whistle Bitch)|other songs]].
...But, is "Singing Frog" still around? Yeah. === [[Kanako Yonezawa|RICE.C]] === "Please let me direct BRE∀K DOWN!"
When I requested for it, they came up with something very strong. It was finished without any problems, but when I thought about the reaction it could receive if it was distributed in the market as it originally appeared, I wanted to see that reaction. Hehehe. I was able to sing CANDY with my best feelings (^^) It's a cute song, so I did my best to write the lyrics and sing them without losing♪ === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== NAOKI ==== An instrumental version was included in DDR MAX, but due to many fan requests, a long-awaited vocal version is included here. Riyu Kosaka performed the vocals and lyrics to CANDY♥, a version with a new, stronger rock arrangement, which has become one of my favorite numbers among my recent creations. === pop'n music === ==== NAOKI ==== I really wanted Riyu Kosaka to provide a comment here, but she was super busy with a high school festival, so NAOKI wrote this on her behalf, although CANDY♥ doesn't seem to suit him. CANDY♥ is my interpretation of a cute & pop, yet exciting song. Actually, it's of my favorite recent songs. When I completed this song, something in me changed.
And it feels like BRE∀K DOWN!.
I was unexpectedly free beyond my obsessions.
If you put too much effort into anything, it will eventually become unreasonable, so I want to live naturally. I wonder if CANDY♥ is a radical song which included such feelings. It'd be nice if many people as possible played this song with happy feelings~. == CS Information Data == === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2 === The original version of the song, "CANDY", debuted on [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX DanceDanceRevolution]] and was entirely instrumental. The song's fun combination of pop, rock and a fast-paced tempo gets a new sugar coating with cute Japanese pop styled vocals. With its sweeter appeal, everyone will be jumping up and down for some candy. == Character Information == I'm delighted for my pop'n debut!
With a flat face and surprisingly beautiful legs, this mysterious creature loves to dance.
I'm dancing today with my handmade hood! === shio === I selected Kaera as number two from the many ZUKIN tribes. But, I couldn't forget the other tribe members, so I had them occasionally appear. It was very fun drawing the images of various characters with the treasured images I received as examples. A salute to the DDR team from the other side. Thank you very much! Her appearance is very delicate, and it was very difficult to express her ugly cuteness (sorry if my statement is rude...).
She's a nice character.... (seriously) == Staff Comments == === [[Kanako Yonezawa|RICE.C]] === When I first heard CANDY☆, I felt that it expressed a bright and driving sensation. I wanted to show a romantic atmosphere through the appearance of the characters, JOHNNY and his lover LORRAINE (who makes her first appearance), but I'm embarrassed that I created her (laughs). }} == Song Connections / Remixes == * DIVE TO THE NIGHT is a remake of [[BeForU]]'s [[DIVE]], from [[AC DDR 5th|DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX]]. ** Unlike the original DIVE, DIVE TO THE NIGHT has only vocals by Riyu Kosaka. * The full version of DIVE TO THE NIGHT appears on Riyu Kosaka's [[true...]] single. ** DIVE TO THE NIGHT's long version samples the chorus of [[CAN'T STOP FALLIN' IN LOVE]], from [[AC DDR Solo 2000|DanceDanceRevolution Solo 2000]]. ** A remix of DIVE TO THE NIGHT, titled ''DIVE TO THE NIGHT (NM Rock Style)'', can also be found on true.... * Another remix of DIVE TO THE NIGHT by [[Junko Karashima|jun]], titled ''DIVE TO THE NIGHT (TËЯRA WORKS remix)'', appears on Riyu Kosaka's album, [[begin (album)|begin]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to Riyu Kosaka's diary entry, DIVE TO THE NIGHT was [http://web.archive.org/web/20030504070546/http://www.konamistyle.com/stores/konamistyle/riyu/diary8.html recorded on August 30, 2001]. * DIVE TO THE NIGHT was performed live at Tokyo Game Show 2001's ''BEMANI SHOW with RIYU KOSAKA'' event. * DIVE TO THE NIGHT received a BEGINNER chart in [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]]. * DIVE TO THE NIGHT has never been on an American/European CS release of DanceDanceRevolution. * On the American and European arcade releases of DanceDanceRevolution before [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]], DIVE TO THE NIGHT's artist is romanized as '''RIYU KOSAKA'''. * DIVE TO THE NIGHT is the only solo Riyu Kosaka song in DanceDanceRevolution to never be removed at any point in the arcade series. ** However, DIVE TO THE NIGHT was removed from the location test of [[AC DDR X2|DanceDanceRevolution X2]], although it reappeared in the final release. * DIVE TO THE NIGHT's difficulty level changes from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] were applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. == Song Production Information == === NAOKI === This is a game-sized version of the coupling track of Riyu Kosaka's debut maxi single "true...". It's a HYPER ROCK BEAT song that mixes the rough and ready vocals of a teenager with an upper beat and guitar sound, which is a direct match for Kosaka's material, having the staff debating whether or not to release this song as the single front until the very end. == Staff Comments == === Octoman === I wanted it to feel like "flying off into the night" as the lyrics suggest...
It's like a summer bug flying into the fire.
I wish I could have made it a little more transparent~. === [[Kanako Yonezawa|RICE.C]] === I was careful to make the atmosphere somewhat similar to that of the [[AC DDRMAX|MAX]] [[DIVE(more deep & deeper style)|version of DIVE]], but not the same production. == Difficulty & Notecounts == DanceDanceRevolution difficulty rated from 1 to 10 from DDRMAX2 to SuperNOVA2, and 1 to 20 from X onwards. But, when I play it with more than dancing, my legs get tangled. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution-]] === "rain of sorrow" by NM feat.
