== Song Connections / Remixes == * A Japanese cover of Secret Rendez-vous by [[Tatsuya Shimizu|plat]][[Junko Hirata|oniX]], titled [[PLATONIC-XXX]], appears in [[AC 10th style|beatmania IIDX 10th style]]. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * Secret Rendez-vous' graphics and movies feature [[JANET]] and [[TRACY]]. * Secret Rendez-vous had a different banner in the DDRMAX2 location test. * Secret Rendez-vous' lyrics are not included on the [[DDRMAX2 ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] album booklet. ** The lyrics are listed on the [[DanceEvolution Original Soundtrack]] album booklet, though. * Secret Rendez-vous received a Single BEGINNER chart in [[AC DS EuroMIX2|Dancing Stage EuroMIX2]]. * Secret Rendez-vous is the only song from the [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX]] series that debuted first as a default song and appeared later again as DLC in a following game. * Secret Rendez-vous received Single/Double CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX4|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX4]]. ** It also received new graphics, where TRACY and JANET were replaced by [[YUNI]] and [[HONEY]]. * Although Secret Rendez-vous is one of the default songs in [[CS DDR S|DanceDanceRevolution S]], it didn't appear in [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]]. * Secret Rendez-vous can be unlocked in DanceEvolution ARCADE on the ''Charlie's desire ~negai no kagami~'' (Charlie's desire～願いの鏡～) event, which started on February 8th, 2013. * Secret Rendez-vous' jacket in DanceEvolution ARCADE misspells the title as '''Secret Rendez-vouz'''. == Song Production Information == === NAOKI === I've always been an R&B freak, and Secret Rendez-vous was honestly a song I created with that feeling. R&B seems to be unsuitable for DDR due to its slow groove, but there's no reason why you can't dance to it. But even in DDR... I still believe that the relationship between R&B and DDR has a lot of potential. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX -DanceDanceRevolution-]] / [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution-]] === "Secret Rendez-vous" by DIVAS is the newest R&B track from the same group behind "[[BABY BABY GIMME YOUR LOVE]]". "Secret Rendez-vous" pours with soulful emotion and excellent female vocals. == Staff Comments == === RICE.C === I tried to make a promotional video-like production! I did my best to give it a groovy feeling, so how was it? I'd be happy if you pay attention to JANET and TRACY's new outfits, which are a big change from their prior outfits. The movie was very popular during production, and as a result, it became one of the demo songs. Songs with slow BPM in DDR tend to not be played a lot, but it's a very nice song, so by all means, please try and play it at least once (or two and three times)! === Octoman === Those who played this song in the location test might know it, but the design of the still image is completely different between the location test and final versions.

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC pnm 18|pop'n music 18 せんごく列伝]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * According to Naoki, TSUGARU is the "instrumental version" of [[TSUGARU (APPLE MIX)]], which also appears in DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution 7thMIX- as a Challenge Mode exclusive. TSUGARU (APPLE MIX) was made normally playable in [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]]. * A remix of TSUGARU by [[Dave Levison|OR-IF-IS]], titled [[Tsugaru OR-IF-IS Mix]], appears in [[CS DDR UNIVERSE|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE]]. == Trivia == * The brothers in TSUGARU's background animations are named Shinichi, Yuichi, and Eiichi, as noted on the [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]] [https://web.archive.org/web/20021203022420/http://www.konami.co.jp/am/ddr/ddr_new/index.html weekly journal]. * TSUGARU received a Single BEGINNER chart in [[AC DS EuroMIX2|Dancing Stage EuroMIX2]]. * TSUGARU's DanceDanceRevolution charts (with the exception of the BEGINNER and BASIC charts) were modified in [[AC DDR X|DanceDanceRevolution X]], fixing their major quantization issues. * TSUGARU is one of the songs part of Week 2 of the ''Mezase tenka touitsu! pop'n fuuunroku'' (めざせ天下統一！ ポップン風雲録) event. It could be unlocked in pop'n music 18 せんごく列伝 from April 7th to April 13th, 2010. * 内田一門's 2P palette was not carried over to the arcade pop'n music games. * TSUGARU's pop'n music charts were created by [[Hidenori Kotera|Cody]]. * TSUGARU appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR MAX2 Pack''' pack. * TSUGARU's difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] on March 27th, 2019. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], TSUGARU's BPM was incorrectly displayed as 165. * TSUGARU received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on May 14th, 2026, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.7''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.7). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, TSUGARU's CHALLENGE charts can be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. == Music Comment == This is a high quality collaboration of traditional Japanese folk songs and dance music, played on an edgy Tsugaru shamisen. == Song Production Information == === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== NAOKI ==== This is a new song by RevenG and DE-SIRE, inheriting the fusion of world folk music and dance music that has gained strong support on the DDR series. This time, with the theme of "Aomori", I attempted a musical collaboration with Tsugaru jongara bushi, featuring "Tsugaru shamisen". If there is an opportunity for the next time, should I go for a fusion with Asian music outside of Japan?... That's what I think. === pop'n music === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== TSUGARU features an authentic Tsugaru shamisen combined with dance music throughout the song.
The name Re-venge or Reven-G exists to express the identity, "I want to convey traditional Japanese music to everyone through music games".
I believe that the collaboration between pop music, which uses modern technology, and traditional Japanese music, are elements which express feelings of strong originality among people around the world, and I also currently plan to release traditional music from various regions of Japan, so please wait for that time to come! == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution-]] === "TSUGARU" by RevenG vs. DE-SIRE is a collaboration between RevenG ([[Matsuri JAPAN|MATSURI JAPAN]]/[[exotic ethnic]]) and DE-SIRE ([[TRIP MACHINE]]/[[Healing Vision]]). This duo combines their strengths to deliver a tribal song that is organic and electronic at the same time. The dance steps are tricky, so watch your timing! === [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (North America)]] === "TSUGARU" by RevenG vs. DE-SIRE is a collaboration between RevenG (MATSURI JAPAN/exotic ethnic) and DE-SIRE (TRIP MACHINE/Healing Vision). This duo combines their strengths to deliver a tribal song that is organic and electronic at the same time. The dance steps are tricky, so watch your timing! Check out the new "APPLE MIX" in this game as well. == Character Information ==
All the brothers quickly visited a concert to hear the melody of a Tsugaru shamisen.
=== [[Tomoko Shiono|shio]] === This character is from the [[CS pnm 12|home version]] of [[AC pnm 12|12 Iroha]]. They were created by [[Aoi Tagami|aonisai]], much like Kurota-chan.
The design of parts of their faces are too nice, and it's one of my favorite characters. While having such identity, how did they come to the arcade first as a character for a different song?... I was worried about that.
But we decided that these brothers perfectly fit TSUGARU! So I was able to cross them over.
When I listened with the song, I'm still glad to have the jongara updated version. I also received materials from the DDR team, so the background looks cool.
The movie's spring-styled chonmage animations were revolutionary, so I was able to use the illustrations and materials.
When your performance reaches the climax, I'm sure your hair will also jump. ♪Benbebenbebebenbebebenbe, byo~n (older brother). Byo~n (younger brother). == Staff Comments == === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== Octoman ==== The first image is "RevenG vs DE-SIRE", so I immediately created it with the feeling of a "showdown". But, it doesn't seem to fit the atmosphere of the movie. I like the intense image.... By the way, the chonmage movie was initially planned to have fireworks appear above the "chonmages". The ninja's "stop" immediately resonated with me. ==== RICE.C ==== The song itself is very nice, so it was easy to direct the images. I think the movement of the ninja stop-motions, and the sudden appearance of a nobleman (?) have a nice taste. === pop'n music === ==== [[Ryuta Tamura|TAMA]] ==== You never get tired of listening to the nice sounds of the lighthearted shamisen, right?
Benbenbenbenben~ ==== [[eimy]] ==== Oh, jongara... what was that?!
It's an interesting mix. Personally, I want to listen to it even longer~. ==== [[Yuki Shibata|Mameshiba]] ==== Aomori means Tsugaru shamisen.
When I hear the sounds of a shamisen, I remember a folk song TV show which aired on Sunday mornings at 6 o'clock.
Well. This is a danceable folk song, which brilliantly fuses shamisen and dance! It's different. ==== Ga~su~ ==== The shamisen is hot, right!
My grandfather also played it often, but I've never heard such a cool one as this. ==== [[Daichi Watanabe|PON]] ==== This is a song crossed over from DDR.
The sharp tone of the shamisen raises the tension.
Oh, come to think of it, I asked cody for the data of this song.

single style collection -]], which appears in the [[cyber beatnation 4 -beatnation 20th anniversary-]] album. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to dj TAKA, ABSOLUTE was originally titled '''Special Thanks''', but both [[Gyo Eguchi|VJ GYO]] and GOLI thought it was "lame", and rejected it [https://x.com/iam_nota_djtaka/status/173088204960956417]. * ABSOLUTE is included as a preview song on the [[beatmania IIDX 3rd style Original Soundtracks]] album. * ABSOLUTE's BPM changes vary slightly between games: ** beatmania IIDX, REFLEC BEAT: 144→133→120→112→89→85→60→80. ** DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX→MAX2: 144.01→128.57→125→102.27→100→83.33→57.69→38. ** DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME→present: 144→130.44→123.29→103.49→98.9→82.57→58.06→38. ** Dance Maniax: 144→114.65→109.09→92.31→81.82→57.14. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]], ABSOLUTE's BPM was shown as 144, with the exception of [[CS DDR UNIVERSE3|DanceDanceRevolution UNIVERSE3]], where it is shown as 38-144. * ABSOLUTE received a different banner in [[CS DDR KONAMIX|DanceDanceRevolution KONAMIX]]. * In DanceDanceRevolution KONAMIX and [[CS DS PARTY EDiTiON|Dancing Stage PARTY EDiTiON]], ABSOLUTE reuses [[Young Forever]]'s background animations. * ABSOLUTE's background animations in [[AC DDRMAX2|DDRMAX2]] feature most of the DanceDanceRevolution character cast at the time. * ABSOLUTE received a Single BEGINNER chart in [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]]. * ABSOLUTE received a new banner in [[CS DDR Party Collection|DanceDanceRevolution Party Collection]]. These charts can be unlocked by reaching DJ RANK BRONZE. ** As of [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]], these charts are available by default. ** These charts are available in [[CS INFINITAS 2020|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS (2020)]] since July 26th, 2023. * ABSOLUTE also appears as one of the background music selectable to play during Accel Rave Time (アクセルレイブタイム) in ''SEVEN'S BEAT'' (セブンスビート), a KONAMI medal redemption game. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== dj TAKA ==== Although it has a somewhat unique game flavor, this track is inspired by the club scene.
The trance scene around me recently feels slightly less psychedelic, and it feels like tracks with brighter atmosphere and vocals will be more prominent in the future.
In that sense, my collaboration with GOLI, who captured the club sound in this track, meant a lot to me, and I almost cried when I first saw the movie.
Of course, the interesting thing about music is that it feels different for each listener, and I'd be happy if everyone can enjoy this track with their own feelings. === Dance Maniax === The title "ABSOLUTE" means "definitely" or "perfectly unmatched". As title suggests, this number is filled with positivity and brightness. The refrain phrases used in the beginning and ending sections are so impressive, that you won't forget once you hear them. The vibrant synths give you happiness. The middle section suddenly becomes melodious, and its balance with the main phrase is exquisite. This song demonstrates dj TAKA's skill, who also composed "[[Quickening]]". === REFLEC BEAT === ==== DJ TOTTO ==== This song shocked me with its mix of club track + melodious development. I was so impressed by the alternating button presses in IIDX, that I played it so many times back then! == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDR EXTREME NA|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME CS (North America)]] === You have unlocked the song "ABSOLUTE" by dj TAKA. Debuting on Dance Dance Revolution KONAMIX, "ABSOLUTE" is an absolutely cool song to dance to with its driving bass line, classical piano melodies and modern day electronic music sounds. Check out other songs by this artist in this game and Dance Dance Revolution KONAMIX, [[CS DDRMAX NA|DDRMAX Dance Dance Revolution]], and [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 Dance Dance Revolution]]. == Video Production Information == === GOLI === GOLI here.
I became addicted to dj TAKA's songs, so I tried to create a movie for the first time.
Drawing animation materials, adding effects, and editing. It was fun.
I wasn't familiar with this process, so I learned various things under VJ YUZ's guidance, and it somehow ended like this by repeatedly using VJ YUZ's techniques.
However, it took me longer than I expected, and I worked on this song while ignoring the system screens (other than movies such as SELECT and gameplay screens) I was originally in charge of.
That's why I had to make up for time towards the end... Personally, dj TAKA's recent songs, all have sounds I like, so I quite like them.
dj TAKA's songs are high quality for games, and somehow remain in your mind just by listening to them.
And he uses various distinct sounds, which results in his skill of creating the eventual song.
Every time he does this, it provides me with a brand-new challenge. The songs in famous trance CDs (which I mostly borrow from VJ YUZ) are certainly wonderful, and I often listen to them, but when I hear dj TAKA's arrangements and songs, there's something different about them.
I've only participated in creating button-pressing animations and materials for movies until now.
That was also my initial plan, but this phrase "ABSOLUTE" remained in my mind, and I wanted to try and create a movie for dj TAKA's song from scratch.
So I unreasonably requested VJ GYO to let me do it. I felt a brand-new sensation.
If I somehow have another opportunity, I want to challenge myself to create a different type of movie. == Staff Comments == It's an enjoyable song, so I tried to make it feel enjoyable. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 7 in 4th style, 1 to 7+ from 5th through 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and from 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards.

You might naturally only want to dance!? == Song Production Information == === beatmania === ==== NAOKI ==== AFRONOVA comes from a fusion of regional African folk instruments, primitive beats, and modern musical technology.
AFRONOVA PRIMEVAL is a harder, more stoic remix of the original. ==== [[Takehiko Fujii|Fujii]] ==== Out of all the popular songs in DDR, there was an especially high demand to crossover AFRONOVA, which finally makes its debut here.
This high-speed tribal track is like a madly dancing primitive cyberethnic tribe. === DanceDanceRevolution === "AFRONOVA PRIMEVAL" has a stronger Afro taste compared to its original version in 3rdMIX. Wild voices, ethnic instrument timbres, and occasional beast roars, clearly evoke the image of a vast African land. Sweaty enthusiasm and constantly dynamic sensations are created by overlapping native sounds with modern beats. Let's dance to it by following your instincts, while feeling the primitive blood flow through your bodies. === Dance Maniax === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== AFRONOVA PRIMEVAL has a stronger Afro taste than its original version in D.D.R. 3rdMIX, and I made this song to be quite maniac with emphasis on the rhythmic beat and edgy feeling, while aiming to fuse primitive and rare elements with modern and cool technology. ==== Liner Notes ==== "AFRONOVA" is from DanceDanceRevolution 3rdMIX, but the title once again appears here as a wilder number. Singing voices that awaken ancient species, powerful percussions, ethnic instrument timbres, and beast roars....... everything becomes one, and listeners are taken to a distant land. The characteristic worldview of dance elements mixed with Afro music is unique to NAOKI, who has created many masterpieces. This is a unique song where you can wildly dance like a native African. == CS Information Data == === DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME2 === Debuting on DanceDanceRevolution KONAMIX, "AFRONOVA PRIMEVAL" is a more upbeat remix of the original tribal song.
The "AFRONOVA" series will always be recognized as the first tribal song to appear in the game and continues to remain a fan favorite. == Video Production Information == === Chobi. === OO is a popular character from DDR.
Even though it was my first time encountering him, I had him appear a lot as the main character.
Playing off of the song's title, I added silhouettes of someone's afro coming off.
Check out the silhouette right after it happens!
(Shoutouts to everyone on the DDR team!) == Character Information == None. == Chart Production Information == === DJ HIBI @ TOP RANKERS === I was familiar with the song, since it was a DDR crossover, so I took the liberty of getting to play around with the chart.
I ended up submitting more requests relating to the movie than the chart or anything else.

The lyrics to this song are linked to that of [[CAN'T STOP FALLIN' IN LOVE]], so I hope people will take interest in finding the connections between these two.
And the conclusion to this story can be found in the lyrics of [[LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT~For Melissa MIX~|LOVE AGAI]][[Love Again Tonight -high speed mix-|N TONIGHT]] from [[AC DDR 4th|DDR4th MIX]] and [[AC PPP|ParaParaParadise]].
This is the second song in my NAOKI Euro music series. === DanceDanceRevolution === This standard Euro number features the Australian-born female vocalist Paula Terry. The pleasant tempo, accompanied by the mellow singing voice and catchy melody, results in a song that's great to listen and dance to. The highlight is the chorus, which begins with the phrase "You broken my heart". The heartbreaking melody should unconsciously move you. If you can express your melancholic feelings with its emotional steps, perhaps you can say you're an expert D.D.R. player? === Dance Maniax === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== Broken my heart follows Can't stop fallin' in love, from [[AC DDR Solo 2000|D.D.R. Solo2000]], as the second song in my second NAOKI Eurogroove music series, which features the Australian-born female vocalist Paula Terry in all its songs. Broken my heart serves as a bridge linking the story in the lyrics to Love again tonight from D.D.R. 4thMIX. ==== Liner Notes ==== ParaPara freaks can't get enough of this song, which is considered to be a royal Eurobeat song. The passionate singing voice of the main female vocalist will naturally lift your heart. Even though it remains up-tempo from beginning to end, the finely detailed melody cuts somewhere into your feelings. The chorus phrase in "BROKEN MY HEART" should unconsciously move people. It'd be extremely cool if female players decide to dance to this song's exceptional groove. == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX -DanceDanceRevolution- === "BROKEN MY HEART" by NAOKI Feat. PAULA TERRY is a fast Eurobeat song about the ups & downs of love and relationships. == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === Following "CAN'T STOP FALLIN' IN LOVE" is "Broken My Heart".
But the end of the story is "LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT"...
I see~... I get it~... I'm impressed.
But I actually pondered towards myself, reminiscing about the experiences which ended at this "Broken My Heart".
It's a maddening, tragic feeling when you have a broken heart, using the "power of speed" to shred that feeling.
Maybe it's just a temporary escape, but I wanted to completely replace this feeling with a sense of speed.
I understand... but this is something you should never do (maybe it's a good idea to sprint on a running course or schoolyard instead). Music and video games are not only for fun, but can also act as a "replacement" for that. The tempo changes throughout the song make you feel like you're being shaken, and although the ending becomes fast towards the climax, I want you to keep playing it like you're addicted, especially those who experienced "such situations". === BeForU Official Website === ==== NAOKI ==== I've recently been addicted to trance, so I naturally wanted to include it in my music, and "INSERTiON" is the result of my interpretation of that. I never really liked techno music in the past, but in the last few years, I've been immersed with digital music to this day. Actually, I play and create everything in real time, from the drums to the keyboard, whether it's techno or Euro music. Furthermore, INSERTiON is a song that's conscious of DDR's gameplay, so it has a few new tricks. The shifting tempo of this song will make you feel "something", especially when it reaches the climax at its ending. === DanceDanceRevolution === ==== NAOKI MAEDA ==== This song is strongly conscious of D.D.R. gameplay. The shifting tempo will make you feel "something", and in the ending the increasing tempo is heading towards a climax, making this a song that you will want to keep playing like you're addicted to it. ==== Liner Notes ==== To those who like programmed sounds, you'll definitely be addicted to this number. The unique drifting sensation created from digital sounds crowded together in space, is a feeling that can only be experienced with trance music. Furthermore, the extreme tempo changes gives this number a unique D.D.R. feel. If you're confused by the irregular tempo from beginning to end, you'll be mysteriously wrapped in a sense of exaltation when it becomes one at the end. == CS Information Data == === DDRMAX -DanceDanceRevolution- === "INSERTiON" by NAOKI underground is a pounding Euro-styled trance song. == Song Connections / Remixes == * According to NAOKI, STILL IN MY HEART is a summary of his "Love" series, which continues from [[LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT~For Melissa MIX~|LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT～For Melissa MIX～]]. * A remix of STILL IN MY HEART by FASTFORWARD appears in the [[DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX ORIGINAL SOUNDTRACK]] NONSTOP MEGAMIX. * A speed remix of STILL IN MY HEART, titled [[STILL IN MY HEART(MOMO MIX)]], appears in [[AC DDRMAX2|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution 7thMIX-]]. * A Japanese remake of STILL IN MY HEART, titled ''LIFELESS'', appears on [[Riyu Kosaka]]'s album, [[begin (album)|begin]]. ** LIFELESS was supposed to appear in the cancelled game [[Cancelled Games#Karaoke Revolution BEMANI series selection|カラオケレボリューション BEMANIシリーズセレクション]]. * An instrumental version of STILL IN MY HEART can be found in a promotional DanceMasters disc by Taco Bell. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * According to Riyu Kosaka, STILL IN MY HEART is one of her favorite BEMANI songs. * STILL IN MY HEART received a new banner in [[CS DDR PC|DanceDanceRevolution (PC)]]. * In DanceDanceRevolution (PC), STILL IN MY HEART reuses [[Young Forever]]'s background animations. * STILL IN MY HEART received a BEGINNER chart in [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]]. * STILL IN MY HEART appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''DDR 5thMIX Pack 3'''. * STILL IN MY HEART is unlockable in [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]] from April 3rd, 2019, after purchasing its charts with [[CS INFINITAS/BIT unlocks|BITs]]. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX and DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX === ==== NAOKI ==== [[CAN'T STOP FALLIN' IN LOVE]], [[BROKEN MY HEART]], and LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT are songs I've released as part of my second Euro song series.
These three songs are strongly connected by the story of their lyrics (about a romantic journey), with LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT intended to conclude as the happy ending.
However, as nothing remains the same, the time came to say "goodbye" for the sake of their futures......
Such a scene was completed with "STILL IN MY HEART", a song positioned as a summary of the second Euro song series.
Every time you play and listen to this song, perhaps you may remember the existence of "that person".
Music always resonates with people's emotions, and has the power to shake their hearts and move their bodies... that's what I think. === DanceDanceRevolution 5thMIX Original Soundtrack === From "CAN'T STOP FALLIN' IN LOVE" in [[AC DDR Solo 2000|D.D.R.Solo 2000]] to "LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT" in [[AC DDR 4th|4thMIX]], this Euro trilogy was created with the theme about a romantic journey. This impressive song, which contains a "melancholic" melody that Japanese people like, was created as a summary to link them together. The vocalist's sorrowful singing voice, and the chorus which feels as a burst out of restrained emotions, unconsciously moves your heart. I'd like everyone who knows the bittersweet feeling of love to listen to this number. === [[CS DDR Party Collection|DanceDanceRevolution Party Collection]] === From "CAN'T STOP FALLIN' IN LOVE" to "LOVE AGAIN TONIGHT", this Euro trilogy was written with the theme about a romantic journey. It contains a "melancholic" melody that Japanese people like, and unconsciously moves your heart. I'd like to dedicate this song to everyone who knows the bittersweet feeling of love. == CS Information Data == === [[CS DDRMAX2 NA|DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution-]] === "STILL IN MY HEART" by NAOKI is a song about holding onto the ones that you love. Once you hear the song, it will always stay in your head too! == Video Production Information == === VJ GYO === When music synchronizes with your current situation, it acts like BGM for your current situation (right now), as if it was a drama created by you.
And you're portraying the lead role of that drama...
I think that the four songs in the second Euro song series, including NAOKI's "STILL IN MY HEART", are strong among the songs included in IIDX, not only in the image evoked through the song title and lyrics, but also I think each melody and transition contains a strong power to provide listeners with these experiences (and often, fully immersing them in it). I personally find it easy to immerse myself when driving "a vehicle" (not limited to cars, but any vehicle that can travel somewhere).
Also, my favorite time is when positive emotions are attracted to me, and it's easy to repel negative emotions.
That's why NAOKI's Euro music, flowing with a sense of drive, is suitable for me.
[[Mika]] and [[Yuri]] (the characters who appear in the movie) also suit that type.
Therefore... == Staff Comments == The draft illustration is based on a certain actor (not major at all) I vaguely thought about in my memories. But unfortunately, they don't look very similar.
"STILL IN MY HEART" is an ironic title. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated 1 to 7+ in 5th through 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in IIDX RED, and 1 to 12 from HAPPY SKY onwards. The version on track 9 features a piano technique called montuno that makes up the characteristic sound of salsa. The one on track 20, B.L.T (Beat Lolita Style) STYLE, is a mondo-style remix that I've reworked to try and change the nuance of the lyrics and singing style to match that of the sound. Give it a listen and try comparing the two. The carefree, seductive Sana's vocals come to life!? Make sure to listen to her solo album [[Sana-mode]] (TYCY-10046) too~. (It has a remix called B.L.T.sandwitch style) Feel free to read into the lyrics and song title, but... I won't dare say anything (I can't say anything!). === beatmania IIDX === We've invited a special guest.
From Togo Project featuring Sana, it's the vocalist Sana! ==== Sana ==== Hello, I'm the vocalist Sana.
The other day, I was looking back on the songs I have sung in the BEMANI series, and unexpectedly thought "Come to think of it, there hasn't been a groovy song so far...", and then "SANA MORETTE NE ENTE" came to me.
I was just in the mood for Buena Vista Social Club(※), and combined with the fact that my jeans and chest were becoming hot, I didn't think that my encounter with the Cuban-taste SANA MORE(abbreviated) was a coincidence. Thank God (Togo?).
That intro, you can't get that phrase out of your head from the day you heard it, right?
Especially, the male chorus in the interlude is a masterpiece.
As expected, Togo-chef himself, and the director of the [[CS pnm|PS/DC version of "pop'n music"]] HAYA-P both performed in the song.
HAYA-P defied Togo-chef's difficult orders and managed to perform the chorus, how does he have five different vocals?
It's difficult to identify HAYA-P's five overlapping vocals, so please come and experience his thick, hot, and enthusiastic harmonies and temperature. By the way, do you know the meaning of SANA MORETTE NE ENTE?
I was so excited when I listened to Togo-chef play it with just a guitar (hmmm)... Please let me know if you know. The summer which suits Cuban music has passed, but there's music in autumn, so let's eat, cry, and laugh a lot while living the Latin life!
Sana wants to cook with Togo-chef again sometime. P.S. I really love drinking alcohol ※BUENA VISTA SOCIAL CLUB

= LEADING CYBER = == Song Information == [[Image:LEADING CYBER.png|thumb|LEADING CYBER's jacket.]] Artist: dj TAKA

Other Music Game Appearances: * [[AC DDR 4th|DanceDanceRevolution 4thMIX]] == Lyrics == None. == Song Connections / Remixes == * LEADING CYBER is considered as a successor to [[GRADIUSIC CYBER]], from beatmania IIDX. ** A sequel to LEADING CYBER by [[Shunsuke Sato|Captain Sonic]], titled [[COSMIC CYBER]], appears in [[AC Rootage|beatmania IIDX 26 Rootage]], sharing the same vocal samples. * The ANOTHER chart version of LEADING CYBER sounds quite different from its other charts. * The DanceDanceRevolution series uses a slightly shorter version of LEADING CYBER, cutting a bit of the beginning. == Trivia == {{Gallery}} * LEADING CYBER received ANOTHER charts in [[AC 4th style|beatmania IIDX 4th style]]. * LEADING CYBER was the first beatmania IIDX song to ever receive its own unique title card before the song started. Since then, quite a small amount of beatmania IIDX songs have gotten this treatment, typically about three to five a game. ** However, it later lost its unique title card in [[AC 9th style|beatmania IIDX 9th style]]. * LEADING CYBER has never appeared on a PlayStation 2 DanceDanceRevolution release. * Prior to [[AC DDR SuperNOVA|DanceDanceRevolution SuperNOVA]], LEADING CYBER's banner displayed the artist as '''dj.TAKA'''. ** [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX2|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX2]] / [[CS DS Unleashed2|Dancing Stage Unleashed2]] used this artist credit as well. * LEADING CYBER can be unlocked from May 18th, 2016 on [[CS INFINITAS|beatmania IIDX INFINITAS]]' ''Akashic Explore'' event. == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === ==== dj TAKA ==== I challenged myself to create a track which inherits the atmosphere of GRADIUSIC CYBER, which was well received by everyone.
I scattered some tones which were featured in the previous song to bring the atmosphere closer to it, but with a fresh feeling.
I needed the courage to create a track which serves as a sequel to a popular song, but this is personally my favorite.
By the way, although the song title is based on a certain KONAMI medal game, it has nothing to do with it, I'm sorry. Well, let's talk about its genre like [[Hiroyuki Togo|Togo-chef]] sometimes does.
What's the difference between "BIG BEAT" and "DIGITAL ROCK"? It's often discussed, but as far as I know, there's no clear difference between them (I haven't heard the term "DIGITAL ROCK" being used much lately).
From there, it's based on my personal interpretation.
From my vague image, BIG BEAT has a middle tempo with bulky rhythms, which feels like it's sitting on your back.
Examples of these included in the IIDX series include "[[GAMBOL]]", "[[Electro Tuned(the SubS mix)|ELECTRO TUNED]]", and "[[Schlagwerk]]".
Conversely, DIGI ROCK has an up-tempo and speedy image, like sprinting.
This song highly relies on breakbeats, so I wonder if it can be used to push the song forward.
It's just my own personal interpretation, so perhaps it's best not to use it elsewhere.
But, the genre originated by someone on their own, so I wonder if this could become a new standard~.
Just kidding.
So, IIDX properly uses genres likes this, but what is shown as the genre is basically decided by the person who created the track, so of course there are exceptions depending on the person's interpretation. === DanceDanceRevolution === Untranslated. == Video Production Information == === [[Gyo Eguchi|VJ GYO]] === ''LEADING CYBER'''s movie is the second movie made by ''VJ YUZ''!
The ''beauty'' of the ''multi-layered'' style of the video, which ''continuously transitions'' at ''high-speed'' over the ''song'', is ''VJ YUZ'''s specialty!
I was really impressed... (I'm still impressed)
Well, for this song introduction, I'll invite the special guest ''himself'' to comment, ''VJ YUZ''! === VJ YUZ === I was so lucky to be in charge of the movie of dj TAKA's "LEADING CYBER", which is my favorite song in beatmania IIDX 3rd style? I think so.
Although the development time felt a bit harsh, the power of dj TAKA's music motivated me, and I was able to enjoy working on it with an extremely high tension.
I really enjoyed the process of gathering the finely scattered sounds and inserting them in the video. The more you listen (and the more you play), you can taste LEADING CYBER!
As a fan of dj TAKA, I'm looking forward to more hot songs in the future.
Movie Production Process: LEADING CYBER edition! 0. Suddenly, receive a mini ramen (supper) from the director [[Tadao Kageyama|KAGE]].
1. Receive a convenience store lunch box from '''VJ GYO'''.
2. Receive yogurt from '''GOLI'''.
3. Realize that I had limited sleep time.
4. Listen to the explosive song.
5. Calculate the number of frames from the '''BPM''', and create the looping materials.
6. Create a base using the materials, according to the song's length.
7. Take the illustration materials from GOLI.
8. Create the materials of the climax part. Include them in the base.
9. Add the opening and ending.
10. Show the completed video to KAGE!
11. (Start over again) == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty from 3rd style through 5th style rated 1 to 7, 1 to 7+ from 6th through 9th style, 1 to 8 in 10th style, 1 to 8+ in 11 IIDX RED, and 1 to 12 from 12 HAPPY SKY onwards.

It was renamed by KONAMI because they did not want the word "Christmas" in the song title. * Both Silent Hill and [[La Senorita|La Señorita]] mark Thomas Howard Lichtenstein's debut in the DanceDanceRevolution series. ** Also, both songs are the only new KONAMI original songs with on-screen lyrics in DanceDanceRevolution 3rdMIX which display their song credits as "Thomas Howard Lichtenstein" instead of "KONAMI Presents" under the "READY" text. * Silent Hill received a Single BEGINNER chart in [[AC DS EuroMIX|Dancing Stage EuroMIX]]. * Silent Hill is a hidden revival in DDRMAX2 -DanceDanceRevolution 7thMIX-. It can be unlocked by reaching level 20, or using an operator code to unlock it via 4th PASS. ** From [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]] onwards, it is playable by default. * Silent Hill received a Double BEGINNER chart in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX2|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX2]]. * Silent Hill appears as downloadable content for [[CS DDR S+|DanceDanceRevolution S+]], in the '''Mega Mix''' pack. * In DanceDanceRevolution GB2, Silent Hill runs at 123 BPM. * Silent Hill received CHALLENGE charts in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode on July 11th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.2''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.2). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, Silent Hill's CHALLENGE charts can be played in [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]]. ** From July 31st, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Song Production Information == === DanceDanceRevolution 3rdMIX Official Website === ==== NAOKI ==== People's thoughts and memories intersect during the Christmas season, as if a warmth and slight sadness casually fills the city... This song is filled with such feelings. I wish you have good memories this Christmas. I hope you enjoy the atmosphere of this song and dance to it. === DanceDanceRevolution 3rdMIX Original Soundtrack === This is a new original song from D.D.R. 3rd. This song has a fresh melody, reminiscent of Wham!. Heart-warming vocals, a beautiful chorus, clear bell chimes...... you can feel the overflowing warmth. == Chart Production Information == === KAZ === ==== SINGLE ==== This song is designed for beginners, so it's easy to play. Most of the patterns are in 4th notes, so even DDR beginners can enjoy dancing to it. I would love to see you playing ANOTHER with the 2P side using MIRROR. ==== DOUBLE ==== This was also made for Double beginners. They were added in beatmania 2ndMIX. ** In [[AC bm complete|beatmania completeMIX]], the FREE ZONEs were removed, but the scratch notes on them remained. *** In beatmania III, the scratch notes of the FREE ZONEs were removed too. * e-motion's Single chart was slightly modified in beatmania 2ndMIX. * e-motion received HARD charts in beatmania completeMIX, although these charts are duplicates of e-motion's NORMAL charts. ** These charts were not present in [[AC bm THE FINAL|beatmania THE FINAL]]. * e-motion (2nd MIX)'s charts were moved to the HARD difficulty in beatmania completeMIX. ** It received brand-new NORMAL charts in beatmania THE FINAL, replacing its old charts. * e-motion placed ninth at the popularity poll as to what songs should be included in beatmania BEST HITS [https://twitter.com/satsuya388/status/1708104257227128875]. * e-motion is the first song crossed over to another BEMANI game, being included in pop'n music. * e-motion is a hidden song in pop'n music. To play it: ** For your FIRST STAGE, clear [[Quick Master]] (J-TEKNO) with a GREAT rate of 85% or higher. ** Four your SECOND STAGE, clear [[Hi-Tekno]] (DANCE) with a GREAT rate of 85% or higher as well. ** e-motion will then be playable on FINAL STAGE. *** In [[AC pnm 2|pop'n music 2]] and [[AC pnm 4|4]], e-motion instead appears on SECOND STAGE. *** From [[AC pnm 9|pop'n music 9]] onward, e-motion is playable on any stage. * Currently, e-motion is the only song in pop'n music's BEMANI Category that does not have a HYPER chart. ** It is also the shortest playable song in the entire arcade pop'n music series. * In pop'n music 2 and its [[CS pnm 2|CS counterpart]], e-motion's character was Rave girl [2], and it has never been used elsewhere. * e-motion received ANOTHER charts in [[AC substream|beatmania IIDX substream]]. * e-motion received LIGHT charts in [[CS 3rd style|beatmania IIDX 3rd style CS]]. * e-motion's beatmania IIDX notecharts are notorious for being off-sync. * e-motion being crossed over marks Tomomi Ohta's only appearance in the DanceDanceRevolution series. * e-motion received brand new Single BEGINNER and Double HEAVY charts in [[AC DDR EXTREME|DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME]]. * e-motion received slightly different Single ANOTHER and Double NORMAL/HYPER charts in [[CS 2006|beatmania (2006)]], alongside a BEGINNER chart. * e-motion received a Double BEGINNER chart in [[CS DDR ULTRAMIX3|DanceDanceRevolution ULTRAMIX3]]. * e-motion is one of the two songs from the DanceDanceRevolution 2ndMIX CLUB VERSION games still playable in the arcade versions of DanceDanceRevolution, along with [[GENOM SCREAMS]]. ** It is also the ''only'' song from the original beatmania still playable on any current arcade BEMANI title, likewise making it the oldest BEMANI song to still be present in one. * e-motion was one of 30 possible picks for songs for [[AC RB groovin'!! Upper|REFLEC BEAT groovin'!! Upper]]'s 7th Set (Users' SELECTION) of the BEMANI MUSIC FOCUS unlocking system. * From pop'n music 9 to [[AC pnm 11|11]], e-motion's BPM was shown as 140-145. * Prior to [[AC DDR WORLD|DanceDanceRevolution WORLD]] and in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]], e-motion's BPM is shown as 145. * e-motion received CHALLENGE charts in DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX's GRAND PRIX mode on September 18th, 2025, which become available by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX chart pack vol.4''' (グランプリ譜面パック vol.4). ** By purchasing the pack with an active subscription, e-motion's CHALLENGE charts could be played in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD. ** From September 30th, 2026 in DanceDanceRevolution WORLD, they are available by default for all players. == Music Comment == === pop'n music === That excitement is back! A legendary hit number!! === pop'n music (English) comment === Refreshing excitement with this great hit! == Song Production Information == === beatmania === They wanted a "poppy and danceable song", and it's also my favorite genre, so it all came together relatively smoothly. On the CD, you should also be able to identify sounds that you couldn't hear in the arcade. === beatmania completeMIX English site === ==== Original Version ==== The deep bass hardcore beat will get your adrenaline pumping. ==== 2nd MIX ==== The 2nd MIX of the original rave number. === DanceDanceRevolution === This hidden masterpiece expanded the musical scope that has existed since the beginning of the beatmania series. A flurry of refreshing, bright phrases contrasts its dark introduction, and the composition returns back to normal, which sounds as if it's showing a long drama in such a short time.
Instead of showing a sense of refreshing phrases like [[20,november]], this song is completed in a way which listeners can first hear from beginning to end, and may feel deeply moved as if they just finished watching a movie. === pop'n music === As an idea for a hidden song, we easily thought "let's crossover a beatmania song".
pop'n is pop'n, don't let it have a beatmania scent! There was such movement, but we eventually included it due to various circumstances....
It was a hidden song in beatmania, and it's hidden here too!! (laughs)
Even if you know the original song, please enjoy by playing it in a different way. === pop'n music 2 === As an idea for a hidden song, we easily thought "let's crossover a beatmania song".
pop'n is pop'n, don't let it have a beatmania scent! There was such movement, but we eventually included it due to various circumstances....

It can be unlocked with BITs. * From [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] onwards, bass 2 bass appears in the DanceDanceRevolution A folder instead of the (2014) folder. * After being removed from the initial release of [[AC RB Reflesia|REFLEC BEAT 悠久のリフレシア]], bass 2 bass was revived on July 14th, 2017. * bass 2 bass could be unlocked in DANCERUSH STARDOM from August 10th to 30th, 2018, and from February 11th to March 3rd, 2019, by obtaining 9 play stamps. ** It could be unlocked with 150 ★ from May 8th, 2019 onwards. ** As of April 19th, 2023, it is available by default. * bass 2 bass's difficulty level changes from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] were applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. * bass 2 bass is available in [[CS DDR GRAND PRIX|DanceDanceRevolution GRAND PRIX]]'s GRAND PRIX mode from May 23rd, 2022, by purchasing '''GRAND PRIX music pack vol.6''' (グランプリ楽曲パック vol.6). == Song Production Information == === beatmania IIDX === A song that gained popularity in jubeat, can also be fully enjoyed in IIDX. The synth parts and male rap are both light and extremely groovy, and it's one of the catchiest among the jubeat original songs. The male rap is in a dance pop-style that was often heard a few years ago, and somehow makes you feel nostalgic. Despite that it's a crossover from a game with completely different gameplay, it feels like jubeat's songs have a high affinity with IIDX. === jubeat === ==== Ryu☆ ==== To everyone enjoying jubeat, hello. I'm Ryu☆.
This time, I'm extremely delighted to be able to be involved in a new game series by "BEMANI", KONAMI's proud music game brand. This time, I recorded "bass 2 bass" while considering jubeat's gameplay, aiming to emphasize a fresh feeling and a melody with easy to follow rhythms. Also, since this is a new game, I thought it'd be great to continuously practice and learn the catchy parts to get used to the game, so I made the synth riff parts appear three times. From this, I created bass 2 bass in my own way while thinking on jubeat beginners, but actually, it seems you won't be able to play it until you have enough experience.
That's amazing. Well then, thank you very much for your support of this super exciting number "bass 2 bass". == Video Production Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == beatmania IIDX difficulty rated from 1 to 12.

It was removed from said category on May 31st, 2016. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE was added to the pop'n music BEMANI category on March 2nd, 2016. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE's HYPER chart was re-rated in pop'n music éclale on March 22nd, 2016. * From [[AC DDR A|DanceDanceRevolution A]] onwards, きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE appears in the DanceDanceRevolution A folder instead of the (2014) folder. * In jubeat plus and REFLEC BEAT plus, きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE's title is shown as '''きゅん×きゅん ばっきゅん☆LOVE'''. ** Despite being rated one Level higher in jubeat plus, きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE's EXTREME chart is the same exact chart that in arcades. * Unlike [[Go Go Girls&Boys!|Go↓Go↑Girls&Boys!]], きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE does appear on its respective pop'n music game's soundtrack - the [[pop'n music eclale Original Soundtrack|pop'n music éclale Original Soundtrack]] album. * Unused data for きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE can be found in [[AC MSC 1+1/2|MÚSECA 1+1/2]], which includes its jacket and audio, but no chart data is present. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE's difficulty level change from [[AC DDR A20|DanceDanceRevolution A20]] was applied to DanceDanceRevolution A on March 27th, 2019. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE was added to [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s REGULAR course on August 1st, 2019. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE could be unlocked in [[CS SDVX III|SOUND VOLTEX III GRAVITY WARS コナステ]]'s INFINITE course from September 5th to September 30th, 2019 by playing INFINITE at least once during that time frame. ** It could be unlocked again in INFINITE from December 2nd, 2020 to December 31st, 2020. ** In [[CS SDVX EG|SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR コナステ]], it could be unlocked via [[CS SDVX EG/BLASTER GATE|BLASTER GATE]] from January 18th, 2022 to February 17th, 2022. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE's jacket was removed from SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR コナステ, being replaced by an uncredited generic jacket. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE's [[CS jb 2021|jubeat (2021)]] ratings were adjusted to its jubeat clan ratings on March 7th, 2022. * きゅん×きゅんばっきゅん☆LOVE is available in [[CS pnm Lively|pop'n music Lively]] by purchasing '''pop'n music Lively Music Pack vol.15''' (pop'n music Lively 楽曲パック vol.15). == Music Comment == None. == Song Production Information == None. == Character Information == None. == Difficulty & Notecounts == BeatStream difficulty rated from 1 to Kami (神) in アニムトライヴ.
